`apps/eblemweave/src/engine.rs`:

```rs
//! The game engine: fefw-recomp (Goldoire, GPL-3.0), included as the git
//! submodule `engine/fefw-recomp`.
//!
//! The launcher builds the game with the engine's own steps (its
//! `docs/BUILDING.md`), from the user's dump, and runs it:
//!
//! 1. the engine's Python environment (`tools/.venv`, made with uv);
//! 2. the dump's ExeFS prepared for the lifter (`main` written uncompressed);
//! 3. the game code lifted and compiled (`recomp/scripts/build_game.cmd`);
//! 4. the texture transcoder sources;
//! 5. `fefw.exe`;
//! 6. the shader translator (Ryujinx's shader code, MIT, at the engine's
//!    pinned revision);
//! 7. the game's shaders translated to SPIR-V;
//! 8. `fefw.ini` in the launcher's run folder.
//!
//! Steps whose output is already there are skipped, and every command's
//! output goes to the job log. The dump is only read.

use crate::config::Config;
use crate::jobs::{Ctx, JobResult, StageStatus};
use std::io::{BufRead, BufReader};
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::process::{Command, Stdio};

/// Ryujinx revision the engine's shader translator is built against.
const RYUBING_URL: &str = "https://git.ryujinx.app/ryubing/ryujinx.git";
const RYUBING_REV: &str = "a82350bb774f70fcbd41c9987bf67a3775409963";

pub const STAGES: [&str; 8] = [
    "Python environment",
    "Prepare the ExeFS",
    "Recompile the game code",
    "Texture transcoders",
    "Build fefw.exe",
    "Shader translator",
    "Translate the shaders",
    "Write fefw.ini",
];

/// The file in the settings folder that remembers where the engine is, so a
/// launcher copied anywhere (a release download, say) finds a checkout that
/// is already built.
fn remembered() -> Option<PathBuf> {
    Config::dir().map(|d| d.join("engine.txt"))
}

/// The engine checkout. Candidates, in order: `EW_ENGINE`, the remembered
/// folder, then `engine/fefw-recomp` above the launcher or the working
/// folder. One whose game is already built wins; otherwise the first that
/// exists. The choice is remembered for next time.
pub fn root() -> Option<PathBuf> {
    let mut found: Vec<PathBuf> = Vec::new();
    if let Some(e) = std::env::var_os("EW_ENGINE") {
        found.push(PathBuf::from(e));
    }
    if let Some(text) = remembered().and_then(|f| std::fs::read_to_string(f).ok()) {
        found.push(PathBuf::from(text.trim()));
    }
    for start in [std::env::current_exe().ok(), std::env::current_dir().ok()].into_iter().flatten() {
        found.extend(start.ancestors().map(|a| a.join("engine").join("fefw-recomp")));
    }
    found.retain(|e| e.join("game-build").is_dir());
    let pick = found.iter().find(|e| game_exe(e).is_file()).or(found.first()).cloned()?;
    if let Some(f) = remembered() {
        if std::fs::read_to_string(&f).ok().map(|t| t.trim().to_string()) != Some(pick.display().to_string()) {
            let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(f.parent().unwrap_or(Path::new(".")));
            let _ = std::fs::write(&f, pick.display().to_string());
        }
    }
    Some(pick)
}

/// The built game, if it exists.
pub fn game_exe(root: &Path) -> PathBuf {
    root.join("game-build").join("fefw").join("build").join("release").join("fefw.exe")
}

/// Where the game runs: its `fefw.ini`, log, mods and album live here.
pub fn run_dir() -> Option<PathBuf> {
    Config::dir().map(|d| d.join("play"))
}

/// Whether the game has been built and configured, ready to play.
pub fn ready() -> bool {
    match (root(), run_dir()) {
        (Some(r), Some(d)) => game_exe(&r).is_file() && d.join("fefw.ini").is_file(),
        _ => false,
    }
}

/// Folders of the build tools, put first on PATH for every step: winget's
/// default locations for LLVM, CMake, Ninja, NASM and .NET.
fn tool_path() -> String {
    let local = std::env::var("LOCALAPPDATA").unwrap_or_default();
    let dirs = [
        r"C:\Program Files\LLVM\bin".to_string(),
        r"C:\Program Files\CMake\bin".to_string(),
        r"C:\Program Files\dotnet".to_string(),
        format!(r"{local}\Microsoft\WinGet\Links"),
        format!(r"{local}\bin\NASM"),
    ];
    let mut path: Vec<String> = dirs.into_iter().filter(|d| Path::new(d).is_dir()).collect();
    path.push(std::env::var("PATH").unwrap_or_default());
    path.join(";")
}

/// The tools the build needs, and whether each was found.
pub fn missing_tools() -> Vec<&'static str> {
    let path = tool_path();
    let found = |exe: &str| path.split(';').any(|d| Path::new(d).join(exe).is_file());
    [
        ("clang-cl.exe", "LLVM 23 (clang-cl)"),
        ("cmake.exe", "CMake"),
        ("ninja.exe", "Ninja"),
        ("dotnet.exe", ".NET 10 SDK"),
        ("uv.exe", "uv"),
        ("git.exe", "Git"),
        ("pwsh.exe", "PowerShell 7"),
    ]
    .into_iter()
    .filter(|(exe, _)| !found(exe))
    .map(|(_, name)| name)
    .collect()
}

/// Run one command in `cwd`, its output (stdout and stderr) into the job
/// log, with no console window. Cancelling the job stops it.
fn run(ctx: &Ctx, cwd: &Path, program: &str, args: &[&str]) -> Result<(), String> {
    run_env(ctx, cwd, program, args, &[])
}

fn run_env(ctx: &Ctx, cwd: &Path, program: &str, args: &[&str], envs: &[(&str, &str)]) -> Result<(), String> {
    let mut cmd = Command::new(program);
    cmd.args(args).envs(envs.iter().copied()).current_dir(cwd).env("PATH", tool_path()).stdin(Stdio::null()).stdout(Stdio::piped()).stderr(Stdio::piped());
    #[cfg(windows)]
    {
        use std::os::windows::process::CommandExt;
        cmd.creation_flags(0x0800_0000); // CREATE_NO_WINDOW
    }
    ctx.log(format!("> {program} {}", args.join(" ")));
    let mut child = cmd.spawn().map_err(|e| format!("starting {program}: {e}"))?;
    let err = child.stderr.take().map(|e| {
        let ctx = ctx.clone();
        std::thread::spawn(move || {
            for line in BufReader::new(e).lines().map_while(Result::ok) {
                ctx.log(line);
            }
        })
    });
    if let Some(out) = child.stdout.take() {
        for line in BufReader::new(out).lines().map_while(Result::ok) {
            ctx.log(line);
            if ctx.cancelled() {
                let _ = child.kill();
                return Err("cancelled".into());
            }
        }
    }
    if let Some(t) = err {
        let _ = t.join();
    }
    let status = child.wait().map_err(|e| format!("waiting for {program}: {e}"))?;
    if ctx.cancelled() {
        return Err("cancelled".into());
    }
    if status.success() {
        Ok(())
    } else {
        Err(format!("{program} {} failed ({status})", args.first().copied().unwrap_or("")))
    }
}

fn has_files(dir: &Path) -> bool {
    std::fs::read_dir(dir).map(|mut d| d.next().is_some()).unwrap_or(false)
}

/// Settings written to `fefw.ini`.
pub struct RunConfig {
    pub exefs: PathBuf,
    pub romfs: PathBuf,
    pub save_dir: PathBuf,
}

/// The engine's configuration for the launcher's run folder.
pub fn ini_text(root: &Path, run: &RunConfig) -> String {
    let fwd = |p: &Path| p.display().to_string().replace('\\', "/");
    format!(
        "; Written by EmblemWeave. Every key is described in engine/fefw-recomp/runtime/docs/CONFIG.md.\n\
         [log]\npath = fefw.log\n\
         [fs]\nexefs = {}\nromfs = {}\nsave_dir = {}\nmods = mods\n\
         [nvn]\nshader_cache = {}\nbc7_cache = {}\n\
         [dlss]\nupscaler = auto\n\
         [fefw]\nfps60 = 1\n",
        fwd(&run.exefs),
        fwd(&run.romfs),
        fwd(&run.save_dir),
        fwd(&root.join("work").join("shaders").join("spirv")),
        fwd(&root.join("work").join("bc7_cache")),
    )
}

/// The build job's work: every step in order.
pub fn build(ctx: &Ctx, exefs: PathBuf, romfs: PathBuf) -> Result<JobResult, String> {
    let root = root().ok_or("the engine (engine/fefw-recomp) was not found; run `git submodule update --init`")?;
    let missing = missing_tools();
    if !missing.is_empty() {
        return Err(format!("build tools missing: {}", missing.join(", ")));
    }
    let python = root.join("tools").join(".venv").join("Scripts").join("python.exe");
    let py = python.display().to_string();

    // 1. Python environment.
    ctx.start(0);
    if python.is_file() {
        ctx.end(0, StageStatus::Skipped, "already set up");
    } else {
        run(ctx, &root, "uv", &["venv", "tools\\.venv", "--python", "3.13"])?;
        run(ctx, &root, "uv", &["pip", "install", "--python", "tools\\.venv", "-r", "recomp\\requirements.txt"])?;
        ctx.end(0, StageStatus::Done, "tools\\.venv ready");
    }

    // 2. ExeFS.
    ctx.start(1);
    let ex = exefs.display().to_string();
    run(ctx, &root, &py, &["-I", "tools\\nso\\prepare_exefs.py", "--exefs", &ex])?;
    ctx.end(1, StageStatus::Done, "game\\dump\\exefs ready");

    // 3. Game code: ninja rebuilds only what changed.
    ctx.start(2);
    let jobs = std::thread::available_parallelism().map(|n| n.get().saturating_sub(2).max(1)).unwrap_or(8).to_string();
    run_env(ctx, &root, "cmd", &["/C", "recomp\\scripts\\build_game.cmd", "fefw"], &[("NX_JOBS", &jobs)])?;
    ctx.end(2, StageStatus::Done, format!("six modules compiled ({jobs} jobs)"));

    // 4. Texture transcoders.
    ctx.start(3);
    if has_files(&root.join("tools").join("textures").join("third_party")) {
        ctx.end(3, StageStatus::Skipped, "already fetched");
    } else {
        run(ctx, &root, "pwsh", &["-NoProfile", "-File", "tools\\textures\\scripts\\fetch_third_party.ps1"])?;
        ctx.end(3, StageStatus::Done, "astc-encoder and bc7enc_rdo fetched");
    }

    // 5. fefw.exe.
    ctx.start(4);
    run(ctx, &root, "pwsh", &["-NoProfile", "-File", "game-build\\scripts\\build_fefw.ps1"])?;
    ctx.end(4, StageStatus::Done, "fefw.exe built");

    // 6. Shader translator.
    ctx.start(5);
    let harness = root.join("tools").join("shaders").join("build").join("bin").join("Release").join("net10.0").join("spirv_harness.dll");
    if harness.is_file() {
        ctx.end(5, StageStatus::Skipped, "already built");
    } else {
        let refs = root.join("work").join("refs").join("ryubing");
        if !refs.join(".git").is_dir() {
            run(ctx, &root, "git", &["clone", "--filter=blob:none", "--no-checkout", RYUBING_URL, "work\\refs\\ryubing"])?;
        }
        run(ctx, &root, "git", &["-C", "work\\refs\\ryubing", "checkout", RYUBING_REV])?;
        run(ctx, &root, "pwsh", &["-NoProfile", "-File", "tools\\shaders\\scripts\\setup_ryujinx.ps1", "-Ryubing", "work\\refs\\ryubing"])?;
        run(ctx, &root, "dotnet", &["build", "tools\\shaders\\harness\\SpirvHarness.csproj", "-c", "Release"])?;
        ctx.end(5, StageStatus::Done, "spirv_harness built");
    }

    // 7. Shaders.
    ctx.start(6);
    let spirv = root.join("work").join("shaders").join("spirv");
    if has_files(&spirv) {
        ctx.end(6, StageStatus::Skipped, "already translated");
    } else {
        let rom = romfs.display().to_string();
        let main = root.join("game").join("dump").join("exefs").join("main").display().to_string();
        let dump = root.join("game").join("dump").join("exefs").display().to_string();
        run(ctx, &root, &py, &["-I", "tools\\shaders\\ampere\\extract_corpus.py", "--romfs", &rom, "--main", &main, "--exefs", &dump, "--out", "work\\shaders\\corpus", "--jobs", "4"])?;
        // Without the Vulkan SDK there is no spirv-val; the shaders are used unvalidated.
        let h = harness.display().to_string();
        run(ctx, &root, "dotnet", &[&h, "--batch", "work\\shaders\\corpus", "--out", "work\\shaders\\spirv", "--jobs", "4", "--no-val"])?;
        ctx.end(6, StageStatus::Done, "shaders translated to SPIR-V");
    }

    // 8. fefw.ini.
    ctx.start(7);
    let dir = run_dir().ok_or("APPDATA is not set")?;
    let save_dir = Config::save_dir().ok_or("APPDATA is not set")?;
    std::fs::create_dir_all(dir.join("mods")).map_err(|e| format!("creating {}: {e}", dir.display()))?;
    let ini = ini_text(&root, &RunConfig { exefs: root.join("game").join("dump").join("exefs"), romfs, save_dir });
    std::fs::write(dir.join("fefw.ini"), ini).map_err(|e| format!("writing fefw.ini: {e}"))?;
    ctx.end(7, StageStatus::Done, format!("{}", dir.join("fefw.ini").display()));
    Ok(JobResult::Engine(dir))
}

/// Start the game from the run folder. It runs on its own; the launcher
/// stays open.
pub fn play() -> Result<(), String> {
    let root = root().ok_or("the engine was not found")?;
    let dir = run_dir().ok_or("APPDATA is not set")?;
    let exe = game_exe(&root);
    if !exe.is_file() || !dir.join("fefw.ini").is_file() {
        return Err("the game is not built yet: run Build the game on Game Setup".into());
    }
    Command::new(&exe).current_dir(&dir).spawn().map(|_| ()).map_err(|e| format!("starting {}: {e}", exe.display()))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {

    fn the_ini_points_at_the_dump_saves_and_shaders() {

    }
```

`apps/eblemweave/src/gamedata.rs`:

```rs
//! Detection and validation of the user's game data.
//!
//! The user points the launcher at a `.nup` dump or at one folder. A `.nup`
//! is used as it is: its small ExeFS is copied once into the launcher's work
//! folder, its RomFS is read in place by the runtime, and its title and
//! version come from its own metadata. A folder may be a plain dump (with
//! `exefs/` and `romfs/`), an NSP extraction (`exefs/`, `romfs/`,
//! `data/control/control.nacp`), or the ExeFS folder itself. Each location can
//! also be overridden individually. Nothing here writes to the user's files.

use crate::config::{Config, Paths};
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

/// The module the game's code lives in.
pub const MAIN_MODULE: &str = "main";
/// The title this launcher is built for.
pub const TITLE_NAME: &str = "Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave";

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Severity {
    Ok,
    Info,
    Warn,
    Error,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Check {
    pub severity: Severity,
    pub label: String,
    pub detail: String,
}

impl Check {
    fn new(severity: Severity, label: &str, detail: impl Into<String>) -> Check {
        Check { severity, label: label.to_string(), detail: detail.into() }
    }
}

/// One decompressed segment compared with the size its module header declares.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct SegmentCheck {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub actual: Option<u64>,
    pub declared: Option<u64>,
}

impl SegmentCheck {
    pub fn ok(&self) -> bool {
        matches!((self.actual, self.declared), (Some(a), Some(d)) if a == d)
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
pub struct GameData {
    /// The `.nup` dump, when the game data is one.
    pub nup: Option<PathBuf>,
    /// The program id, from the `.nup` or `control.nacp`; it names the save
    /// folder in an emulator.
    pub title_id: Option<u64>,
    pub exefs: Option<PathBuf>,
    pub romfs: Option<PathBuf>,
    pub nacp: Option<PathBuf>,
    pub decoded: Option<PathBuf>,
    pub modules: Option<ew_format::ExeFs>,
    pub npdm: Option<ew_format::exefs::NpdmInfo>,
    /// Title name and display version from `control.nacp`.
    pub title: Option<(String, String)>,
    pub romfs_entries: usize,
    pub segments: Vec<SegmentCheck>,
    pub checks: Vec<Check>,
}

impl GameData {
    /// Everything the runtime needs to attempt a boot is present and valid.
    pub fn bootable_inputs(&self) -> bool {
        self.decoded.is_some() && self.segments.iter().all(|s| s.ok()) && self.romfs.is_some()
    }

    pub fn worst(&self) -> Severity {
        let mut worst = Severity::Ok;
        for c in &self.checks {
            worst = match (worst, c.severity) {
                (_, Severity::Error) | (Severity::Error, _) => Severity::Error,
                (_, Severity::Warn) | (Severity::Warn, _) => Severity::Warn,
                (w, _) => w,
            };
        }
        worst
    }
}

fn non_empty(s: &str) -> Option<PathBuf> {
    let t = s.trim();
    (!t.is_empty()).then(|| PathBuf::from(t))
}

/// Breadth-first search for a directory entry named `name` under `root`.
fn find_named(root: &Path, name: &str, want_dir: bool, depth: usize) -> Option<PathBuf> {
    let mut level = vec![root.to_path_buf()];
    for _ in 0..=depth {
        let mut next = Vec::new();
        for dir in &level {
            let Ok(rd) = std::fs::read_dir(dir) else { continue };
            for entry in rd.flatten() {
                let path = entry.path();
                let is_dir = path.is_dir();
                if entry.file_name().to_string_lossy().eq_ignore_ascii_case(name) && is_dir == want_dir {
                    return Some(path);
                }
                if is_dir {
                    next.push(path);
                }
            }
        }
        level = next;
        if level.len() > 4000 {
            break;
        }
    }
    None
}

fn file_len(p: &Path) -> Option<u64> {
    std::fs::metadata(p).ok().map(|m| m.len())
}

/// Open a `.nup` dump: copy its ExeFS out once (it is small) and use its
/// RomFS in place. Returns the ExeFS folder and the title metadata.
fn use_nup(g: &mut GameData, path: &Path) -> Option<PathBuf> {
    let nup = match ew_format::nup::Nup::open(path) {
        Ok(n) => n,
        Err(e) => {
            g.checks.push(Check::new(Severity::Error, "Game file", format!("{e:#}")));
            return None;
        }
    };
    let Some(pkg) = nup.program_package().cloned() else {
        g.checks.push(Check::new(Severity::Error, "Game file", "the .nup holds no base game or update"));
        return None;
    };
    g.checks.push(Check::new(
        Severity::Ok,
        "Game file",
        format!(".nup, title {:016X} v{}, {} files, checked against its SHA-256", pkg.title_id, pkg.version, nup.files.len()),
    ));
    if let Ok(meta) = nup.metadata(&pkg) {
        if let (Some(name), Some(version)) = (meta.title(), meta.display_version()) {
            g.title = Some((name, version));
        }
    }
    let exefs = nup.walk(pkg.exefs);
    let dir = Config::work_dir()?.join("nup").join(format!("{:016X}-v{}", pkg.title_id, pkg.version)).join("exefs");
    let current = exefs.iter().all(|(name, i)| file_len(&dir.join(name)) == Some(nup.files[*i as usize].size));
    if !current {
        if let Err(e) = std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir) {
            g.checks.push(Check::new(Severity::Error, "ExeFS", format!("creating {}: {e}", dir.display())));
            return None;
        }
        for (name, i) in &exefs {
            match nup.read(*i).map_err(|e| format!("{e:#}")).and_then(|b| std::fs::write(dir.join(name), b).map_err(|e| e.to_string())) {
                Ok(()) => {}
                Err(e) => {
                    g.checks.push(Check::new(Severity::Error, "ExeFS", format!("copying {name} out of the .nup: {e}")));
                    return None;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    g.romfs_entries = nup.dirs[pkg.romfs as usize].children.len();
    g.nup = Some(path.to_path_buf());
    g.title_id = Some(pkg.title_id);
    g.romfs = Some(path.to_path_buf());
    Some(dir)
}

/// Locate and validate everything. Explicit paths win over detection.
pub fn detect(paths: &Paths) -> GameData {
    let mut g = GameData::default();
    let root = non_empty(&paths.game_root);

    // A .nup dump supplies everything itself.
    if let Some(r) = root.as_ref().filter(|r| r.is_file() && ew_format::nup::Nup::is_nup(r)) {
        let r = r.clone();
        if let Some(exefs) = use_nup(&mut g, &r) {
            g.exefs = non_empty(&paths.exefs).or(Some(exefs));
        }
        return finish(g, paths);
    }

    if let Some(r) = &root {
        if !r.is_dir() {
            g.checks.push(Check::new(Severity::Error, "Game folder", format!("{} does not exist", r.display())));
        }
    }

    // ExeFS: explicit, root/exefs, the root itself, or a nested exefs.
    g.exefs = non_empty(&paths.exefs).or_else(|| {
        let r = root.as_ref()?;
        if r.join("exefs").is_dir() {
            Some(r.join("exefs"))
        } else if r.join(MAIN_MODULE).is_file() {
            Some(r.clone())
        } else {
            find_named(r, "exefs", true, 3)
        }
    });
    // RomFS: explicit, next to the ExeFS, or under the root.
    g.romfs = non_empty(&paths.romfs).or_else(|| {
        let near = g.exefs.as_ref().and_then(|e| e.parent()).map(|p| p.join("romfs"));
        near.filter(|p| p.is_dir()).or_else(|| {
            let r = root.as_ref()?;
            if r.join("romfs").is_dir() {
                Some(r.join("romfs"))
            } else {
                find_named(r, "romfs", true, 3)
            }
        })
    });
    // control.nacp: explicit, the NSP layout, or a search.
    g.nacp = non_empty(&paths.nacp).or_else(|| {
        let base = g.exefs.as_ref().and_then(|e| e.parent()).map(Path::to_path_buf).or(root.clone())?;
        let nsp = base.join("data").join("control").join("control.nacp");
        if nsp.is_file() {
            return Some(nsp);
        }
        find_named(&base, "control.nacp", false, 3).or_else(|| root.as_ref().and_then(|r| find_named(r, "control.nacp", false, 3)))
    });
    finish(g, paths)
}

/// The checks shared by every kind of game data: ExeFS contents, RomFS, title
/// metadata and the decoded module.
fn finish(mut g: GameData, paths: &Paths) -> GameData {
    // Decoded module: explicit, the launcher's work folder, or the repository's.
    g.decoded = non_empty(&paths.decoded).or_else(|| {
        let mut candidates = Vec::new();
        if let Some(w) = Config::work_dir() {
            candidates.push(w.join("decoded").join(MAIN_MODULE));
        }
        candidates.push(PathBuf::from("work/decoded/main"));
        candidates.into_iter().find(|p| p.join("text.bin").is_file())
    });

    // ExeFS contents.
    match &g.exefs {
        None => g.checks.push(Check::new(Severity::Error, "ExeFS", "not found; choose the folder that contains your extracted exefs")),
        Some(dir) => match ew_format::ExeFs::scan_dir(dir) {
            Ok(exefs) => {
                if let Ok(Some(npdm)) = exefs.read_npdm() {
                    g.npdm = Some(npdm);
                }
                match exefs.find(MAIN_MODULE) {
                    Some(m) => g.checks.push(Check::new(
                        Severity::Ok,
                        "ExeFS",
                        format!("{} modules; `main` is `{}` ({})", exefs.modules.len(), m.module_name, m.compressions.join(" + ")),
                    )),
                    None => g.checks.push(Check::new(Severity::Error, "ExeFS", "no `main` module in this ExeFS")),
                }
                g.modules = Some(exefs);
            }
            Err(e) => g.checks.push(Check::new(Severity::Error, "ExeFS", format!("{}: {e:#}", dir.display()))),
        },
    }

    // RomFS.
    match &g.romfs {
        None => g.checks.push(Check::new(Severity::Error, "RomFS", "not found; the game cannot load its assets without it")),
        Some(_) if g.nup.is_some() => g.checks.push(Check::new(
            Severity::Ok,
            "RomFS",
            format!("{} top-level entries, read in place from the .nup", g.romfs_entries),
        )),
        Some(dir) => {
            g.romfs_entries = std::fs::read_dir(dir).map(|rd| rd.count()).unwrap_or(0);
            if g.romfs_entries == 0 {
                g.checks.push(Check::new(Severity::Error, "RomFS", format!("{} is empty", dir.display())));
            } else if dir.join("Fs.bin.zst").is_file() {
                g.checks.push(Check::new(Severity::Ok, "RomFS", format!("{} top-level entries, content index present", g.romfs_entries)));
            } else {
                g.checks.push(Check::new(Severity::Warn, "RomFS", "Fs.bin.zst (the content index the game loads first) is missing"));
            }
        }
    }

    // Title metadata: the .nup's own, or control.nacp.
    let nacp_title = if g.nup.is_some() { g.title.clone() } else { g.nacp.as_deref().and_then(ew_boot::read_nacp) };
    match nacp_title {
        Some((name, version)) => {
            let sev = if name == TITLE_NAME { Severity::Ok } else { Severity::Warn };
            g.checks.push(Check::new(sev, "Title", format!("{name}, version {version}")));
            g.title = Some((name, version));
        }
        None => g.checks.push(Check::new(
            Severity::Warn,
            "Title metadata",
            "control.nacp not found; the game's display version cannot be reported to it",
        )),
    }

    // Decoded segments against the module header.
    let main = g.modules.as_ref().and_then(|e| e.find(MAIN_MODULE));
    if let Some(dir) = &g.decoded {
        for (name, declared) in [
            ("text", main.map(|m| m.text_size as u64)),
            ("rodata", main.map(|m| m.rodata_size as u64)),
            ("data", main.map(|m| m.data_size as u64)),
        ] {
            g.segments.push(SegmentCheck { name, actual: file_len(&dir.join(format!("{name}.bin"))), declared });
        }
        let ok = g.segments.iter().all(|s| s.ok());
        g.checks.push(if ok {
            Check::new(Severity::Ok, "Decoded module", "every segment matches the size its header declares")
        } else if main.is_none() {
            Check::new(Severity::Warn, "Decoded module", "present, but there is no ExeFS to check it against")
        } else {
            Check::new(Severity::Error, "Decoded module", "segment sizes do not match the module header; decode again")
        });
    } else {
        g.checks.push(Check::new(
            Severity::Warn,
            "Decoded module",
            "not decoded yet; the main module is ZBIC-compressed and must be decoded once",
        ));
    }
    g
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn detects_the_nsp_layout() {
        let root = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("ew-detect-{}", std::process::id()));
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
        std::fs::create_dir_all(root.join("dump").join("exefs")).unwrap();
        std::fs::create_dir_all(root.join("dump").join("romfs")).unwrap();
        std::fs::create_dir_all(root.join("dump").join("data").join("control")).unwrap();
        std::fs::write(root.join("dump").join("romfs").join("Fs.bin.zst"), b"x").unwrap();
        let paths = Paths { game_root: root.to_string_lossy().into(), ..Default::default() };
        let g = detect(&paths);
        assert_eq!(g.exefs.as_deref(), Some(root.join("dump").join("exefs").as_path()));
        assert_eq!(g.romfs.as_deref(), Some(root.join("dump").join("romfs").as_path()));
        assert_eq!(g.romfs_entries, 1);
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }

    /// On a real dump: `EW_NUP=<file.nup> cargo test -p eblemweave -- --ignored`.
    #[test]
    #[ignore]
    fn detects_a_nup_dump() {
        let path = std::env::var("EW_NUP").expect("EW_NUP");
        let g = detect(&Paths { game_root: path.clone(), ..Default::default() });
        for c in &g.checks {
            eprintln!("{:?} {}: {}", c.severity, c.label, c.detail);
        }
        assert_eq!(g.nup.as_deref(), Some(std::path::Path::new(&path)));
        assert_eq!(g.romfs.as_deref(), Some(std::path::Path::new(&path)));
        assert!(g.exefs.as_ref().is_some_and(|e| e.join("main").is_file() && e.join("sdk").is_file()));
        assert_eq!(g.title.as_ref().map(|t| t.0.as_str()), Some(TITLE_NAME));
        assert!(g.romfs_entries > 0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_missing_folder_is_an_error_not_a_panic() {
        let paths = Paths { game_root: "Z:/definitely/not/here".into(), ..Default::default() };
        let g = detect(&paths);
        assert_eq!(g.worst(), Severity::Error);
    }
}
```

`apps/eblemweave/src/ingame.rs`:

```rs
//! The in-game menu: a window that stays on top of the game while it runs,
//! opened and closed with F10 or Back + RB on a controller. It holds the
//! quick cheats, the cheat codes and tables, and the settings that matter
//! while playing.
//!
//! It is EmblemWeave's own window, not part of the game's engine, so it works
//! the same with any engine: cheats reach the game through its memory, and
//! settings through the files the engine reads.

use crate::theme;
use crate::widgets::{self, Tone};
use crate::App;
use eframe::egui::{self, RichText};
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
pub enum Tab {
    #[default]
    Quick,
    Codes,
    Display,
    Controls,
    States,
}

pub struct Ingame {
    pub open: bool,
    tab: Tab,
    running: bool,
    last_check: Instant,
    key_down: bool,
    pad_down: bool,
    paused: bool,
    confirm_stop: bool,
    /// A screenshot waiting for the menu to get out of the picture.
    shot_at: Option<Instant>,
}

impl Default for Ingame {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Ingame { open: false, tab: Tab::Quick, running: false, last_check: Instant::now() - Duration::from_secs(10), key_down: false, pad_down: false, paused: false, confirm_stop: false, shot_at: None }
    }
}

#[cfg(windows)]
fn f10_held() -> bool {
    use windows_sys::Win32::UI::Input::KeyboardAndMouse::{GetAsyncKeyState, VK_F10};
    unsafe { (GetAsyncKeyState(VK_F10 as i32) as u16) & 0x8000 != 0 }
}

/// The engine's play settings file, where window mode and the like live.
pub fn controls_ini() -> Option<PathBuf> {
    crate::engine::run_dir().map(|d| d.join("controls.ini"))
}

/// Read `key` in `[section]` of an ini file.
pub fn ini_get(path: &Path, section: &str, key: &str) -> Option<String> {
    let text = std::fs::read_to_string(path).ok()?;
    let mut in_section = false;
    for line in text.lines() {
        let l = line.trim();
        if l.starts_with('[') {
            in_section = l.trim_matches(['[', ']']).eq_ignore_ascii_case(section);
        } else if in_section {
            if let Some((k, v)) = l.split_once('=') {
                if k.trim().eq_ignore_ascii_case(key) {
                    return Some(v.split(';').next().unwrap_or("").trim().to_string());
                }
            }
        }
    }
    None
}

/// Set `key` in `[section]`, keeping everything else in the file as it was.
pub fn ini_set(path: &Path, section: &str, key: &str, value: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
    let text = std::fs::read_to_string(path).unwrap_or_default();
    let mut out: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    let (mut in_section, mut seen_section, mut done) = (false, false, false);
    for line in text.lines() {
        let l = line.trim();
        if l.starts_with('[') {
            if in_section && !done {
                out.push(format!("{key} = {value}"));
                done = true;
            }
            in_section = l.trim_matches(['[', ']']).eq_ignore_ascii_case(section);
            seen_section |= in_section;
        } else if in_section && !done {
            if let Some((k, _)) = l.split_once('=') {
                if k.trim().eq_ignore_ascii_case(key) {
                    out.push(format!("{key} = {value}"));
                    done = true;
                    continue;
                }
            }
        }
        out.push(line.to_string());
    }
    if !done {
        if !seen_section {
            out.push(format!("[{section}]"));
        }
        out.push(format!("{key} = {value}"));
    }
    let mut s = out.join("\n");
    s.push('\n');
    std::fs::write(path, s).map_err(|e| format!("writing {}: {e}", path.display()))
}

/// Called every frame: watches for the game, the hotkey and the controller
/// chord, and draws the menu window while it is open.
pub fn frame(app: &mut App, ctx: &egui::Context) {
    let now = Instant::now();
    if now.duration_since(app.ingame.last_check) > Duration::from_millis(700) {
        app.ingame.last_check = now;
        let was = app.ingame.running;
        app.ingame.running = crate::cheats::process::find(crate::cheats::GAME_EXE).is_some();
        if app.ingame.running && !was {
            app.notify("Game started: press F10, or Back + RB on a controller, for the EmblemWeave menu", Tone::Ok);
        }
        if !app.ingame.running {
            app.ingame.open = false;
            app.ingame.paused = false;
        }
    }
    if !app.ingame.running {
        return;
    }
    // The launcher may be in the background: keep looking at the keys.
    ctx.request_repaint_after(Duration::from_millis(80));
    #[cfg(windows)]
    {
        let k = f10_held();
        if k && !app.ingame.key_down {
            app.ingame.open = !app.ingame.open;
        }
        app.ingame.key_down = k;
        let pad = crate::cheats::held_keys();
        let chord = pad & crate::cheats::keys::MINUS != 0 && pad & crate::cheats::keys::R != 0;
        if chord && !app.ingame.pad_down {
            app.ingame.open = !app.ingame.open;
        }
        app.ingame.pad_down = chord;
    }
    #[cfg(windows)]
    if let Some(at) = app.ingame.shot_at {
        if Instant::now() >= at {
            app.ingame.shot_at = None;
            take_screenshot(app);
            app.ingame.open = true;
        }
    }
    if !app.ingame.open {
        return;
    }
    let vp = egui::ViewportId::from_hash_of("emblemweave-ingame");
    let builder = egui::ViewportBuilder::default()
        .with_title("EmblemWeave — in-game menu")
        .with_inner_size([560.0, 680.0])
        .with_always_on_top()
        .with_resizable(true);
    ctx.show_viewport_immediate(vp, builder, |ctx, _class| {
        if ctx.input(|i| i.viewport().close_requested()) {
            app.ingame.open = false;
            return;
        }
        let p = app.config.theme.palette();
        egui::CentralPanel::default().frame(egui::Frame::new().fill(p.bg).inner_margin(egui::Margin::same(14))).show(ctx, |ui| {
            ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                for (t, label) in [(Tab::Quick, "Quick cheats"), (Tab::Codes, "Codes & tables"), (Tab::Display, "Display"), (Tab::Controls, "Controls"), (Tab::States, "Save states")] {
                    if ui.selectable_label(app.ingame.tab == t, RichText::new(label).font(theme::semibold(13.5))).clicked() {
                        app.ingame.tab = t;
                    }
                }
            });
            ui.separator();
            session_bar(app, ui, &p, ctx);
            ui.separator();
            egui::ScrollArea::vertical().auto_shrink([false, false]).show(ui, |ui| match app.ingame.tab {
                Tab::Quick => crate::pages::cheats::quick(app, ui),
                Tab::Codes => crate::pages::cheats::show(app, ui),
                Tab::Display => display(app, ui, &p),
                Tab::Controls => controls(ui, &p),
                Tab::States => {
                    widgets::status_line(ui, &p, Tone::Neutral, "Not available yet", "The engine the game runs on today has no save states. They are planned for EmblemWeave's own engine, which holds the whole game state in one place.");
                }
            });
        });
    });
}

fn display(app: &mut App, ui: &mut egui::Ui, p: &crate::theme::Palette) {
    let Some(ini) = controls_ini() else { return };
    widgets::section(ui, p, "Window", |ui| {
        let mode = ini_get(&ini, "display", "window_mode").unwrap_or_else(|| "windowed".into());
        ui.label("Alt+Enter in the game switches between a window and full screen at once. The mode it starts in:");
        ui.horizontal(|ui| {
            for (m, label) in [("windowed", "Windowed"), ("borderless", "Borderless full screen"), ("exclusive", "Exclusive full screen")] {
                if ui.selectable_label(mode == m, label).clicked() {
                    match ini_set(&ini, "display", "window_mode", m) {
                        Ok(()) => app.notify(format!("{label}: applies the next time the game starts (Alt+Enter switches now)"), Tone::Ok),
                        Err(e) => app.notify(e, Tone::Bad),
                    }
                }
            }
        });
        ui.add_space(6.0);
        let mut w: u32 = ini_get(&ini, "display", "render_width").and_then(|v| v.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0);
        let mut h: u32 = ini_get(&ini, "display", "render_height").and_then(|v| v.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0);
        ui.label("Picture size (0 = the window's size when the game starts):");
        ui.horizontal(|ui| {
            let a = ui.add(egui::DragValue::new(&mut w).range(0..=7680).suffix(" wide"));
            let b = ui.add(egui::DragValue::new(&mut h).range(0..=4320).suffix(" high"));
            if a.changed() || b.changed() {
                let _ = ini_set(&ini, "display", "render_width", &w.to_string());
                let _ = ini_set(&ini, "display", "render_height", &h.to_string());
            }
            for (pw, ph) in [(1280, 720), (1920, 1080), (2560, 1440), (3840, 2160)] {
                if ui.small_button(format!("{pw}x{ph}")).clicked() {
                    let _ = ini_set(&ini, "display", "render_width", &pw.to_string());
                    let _ = ini_set(&ini, "display", "render_height", &ph.to_string());
                }
            }
        });
        ui.label(RichText::new("The picture size applies the next time the game starts.").size(12.0).color(p.muted));
    });
    widgets::section(ui, p, "Frame rate counter", |ui| {
        let mut on = ini_get(&ini, "fps", "show").as_deref() == Some("1");
        ui.horizontal(|ui| {
            if widgets::toggle(ui, p, &mut on).changed() {
                let _ = ini_set(&ini, "fps", "show", if on { "1" } else { "0" });
            }
            ui.label("Show the frame rate in a corner of the game (applies on the next frame; F2 in the game too)");
        });
    });
}

fn controls(ui: &mut egui::Ui, p: &crate::theme::Palette) {
    widgets::section(ui, p, "Controls", |ui| {
        ui.label("Keyboard and controller buttons can be rebound in the game's own settings: press F1 in the game, then Controls. The launcher's Controls page holds EmblemWeave's bindings for its own engine.");
        ui.add_space(6.0);
        egui::Grid::new("default-keys").num_columns(2).spacing([16.0, 4.0]).show(ui, |ui| {
            for (k, what) in [("F10, or Back + RB", "this menu"), ("F1", "the game engine's settings"), ("F2", "frame rate counter"), ("Alt+Enter", "window / full screen")] {
                ui.label(RichText::new(k).font(theme::mono(13.0)).color(p.ink));
                ui.label(what);
                ui.end_row();
            }
        });
    });
}

/// Pausing, stopping and capturing the game's process from outside it.
#[cfg(windows)]
pub mod session {
    use windows_sys::Win32::Foundation::{CloseHandle, HWND, LPARAM, RECT};
    use windows_sys::Win32::Graphics::Gdi::*;
    use windows_sys::Win32::System::Diagnostics::ToolHelp::{CreateToolhelp32Snapshot, Thread32First, Thread32Next, TH32CS_SNAPTHREAD, THREADENTRY32};
    use windows_sys::Win32::System::Threading::{OpenProcess, OpenThread, ResumeThread, SuspendThread, TerminateProcess, PROCESS_TERMINATE, THREAD_SUSPEND_RESUME};
    use windows_sys::Win32::UI::WindowsAndMessaging::{EnumWindows, GetWindowRect, GetWindowThreadProcessId, IsWindowVisible, SetForegroundWindow};

    fn threads(pid: u32) -> Vec<u32> {
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        unsafe {
            let snap = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPTHREAD, 0);
            if snap.is_null() || snap as isize == -1 {
                return out;
            }
            let mut e: THREADENTRY32 = std::mem::zeroed();
            e.dwSize = std::mem::size_of::<THREADENTRY32>() as u32;
            let mut ok = Thread32First(snap, &mut e);
            while ok != 0 {
                if e.th32OwnerProcessID == pid {
                    out.push(e.th32ThreadID);
                }
                ok = Thread32Next(snap, &mut e);
            }
            CloseHandle(snap);
        }
        out
    }

    /// Suspend (`true`) or resume every thread of the process. Returns how
    /// many threads were reached.
    pub fn set_paused(pid: u32, pause: bool) -> usize {
        let mut n = 0;
        for t in threads(pid) {
            unsafe {
                let h = OpenThread(THREAD_SUSPEND_RESUME, 0, t);
                if h.is_null() {
                    continue;
                }
                let r = if pause { SuspendThread(h) } else { ResumeThread(h) };
                if r != u32::MAX {
                    n += 1;
                }
                CloseHandle(h);
            }
        }
        n
    }

    pub fn stop(pid: u32) -> bool {
        unsafe {
            let h = OpenProcess(PROCESS_TERMINATE, 0, pid);
            if h.is_null() {
                return false;
            }
            let ok = TerminateProcess(h, 0) != 0;
            CloseHandle(h);
            ok
        }
    }

    struct Find {
        pid: u32,
        best: HWND,
        area: i64,
    }

    unsafe extern "system" fn each(hwnd: HWND, lp: LPARAM) -> i32 {
        let f = unsafe { &mut *(lp as *mut Find) };
        let mut pid = 0u32;
        unsafe { GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, &mut pid) };
        if pid == f.pid && unsafe { IsWindowVisible(hwnd) } != 0 {
            let mut r: RECT = unsafe { std::mem::zeroed() };
            unsafe { GetWindowRect(hwnd, &mut r) };
            let area = (r.right - r.left) as i64 * (r.bottom - r.top) as i64;
            if area > f.area {
                f.area = area;
                f.best = hwnd;
            }
        }
        1
    }

    /// The game's largest visible window.
    pub fn window(pid: u32) -> Option<HWND> {
        let mut f = Find { pid, best: std::ptr::null_mut(), area: 0 };
        unsafe { EnumWindows(Some(each), &mut f as *mut Find as LPARAM) };
        (!f.best.is_null()).then_some(f.best)
    }

    pub fn focus(pid: u32) {
        if let Some(w) = window(pid) {
            unsafe { SetForegroundWindow(w) };
        }
    }

    /// What the screen shows where the game's window is, as RGBA.
    pub fn capture(pid: u32) -> Option<(u32, u32, Vec<u8>)> {
        let w = window(pid)?;
        let mut r: RECT = unsafe { std::mem::zeroed() };
        unsafe { GetWindowRect(w, &mut r) };
        let (width, height) = ((r.right - r.left).max(0), (r.bottom - r.top).max(0));
        if width == 0 || height == 0 {
            return None;
        }
        unsafe {
            let screen = GetDC(std::ptr::null_mut());
            let mem = CreateCompatibleDC(screen);
            let bmp = CreateCompatibleBitmap(screen, width, height);
            let old = SelectObject(mem, bmp);
            BitBlt(mem, 0, 0, width, height, screen, r.left, r.top, SRCCOPY);
            let mut info: BITMAPINFO = std::mem::zeroed();
            info.bmiHeader.biSize = std::mem::size_of::<BITMAPINFOHEADER>() as u32;
            info.bmiHeader.biWidth = width;
            info.bmiHeader.biHeight = -height;
            info.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
            info.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 32;
            info.bmiHeader.biCompression = BI_RGB;
            let mut px = vec![0u8; (width * height * 4) as usize];
            let got = GetDIBits(mem, bmp, 0, height as u32, px.as_mut_ptr() as _, &mut info, DIB_RGB_COLORS);
            SelectObject(mem, old);
            DeleteObject(bmp);
            DeleteDC(mem);
            ReleaseDC(std::ptr::null_mut(), screen);
            if got == 0 {
                return None;
            }
            for c in px.chunks_exact_mut(4) {
                c.swap(0, 2);
                c[3] = 255;
            }
            Some((width as u32, height as u32, px))
        }
    }
}

/// Where screenshots go: Pictures\EmblemWeave.
pub fn screenshot_dir() -> PathBuf {
    std::env::var_os("USERPROFILE").map(PathBuf::from).unwrap_or_default().join("Pictures").join("EmblemWeave")
}

fn game_pid() -> Option<u32> {
    crate::cheats::process::find(crate::cheats::GAME_EXE)
}

#[cfg(windows)]
fn take_screenshot(app: &mut App) {
    let Some(pid) = game_pid() else { return };
    match session::capture(pid) {
        Some((w, h, px)) => {
            let dir = screenshot_dir();
            let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir);
            let secs = std::time::SystemTime::now().duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).map(|d| d.as_millis()).unwrap_or(0);
            let path = dir.join(format!("FortunesWeave-{secs}.png"));
            match image::RgbaImage::from_raw(w, h, px).map(|img| img.save(&path)) {
                Some(Ok(())) => app.notify(format!("Screenshot saved to {}", path.display()), Tone::Ok),
                _ => app.notify("Could not save the screenshot", Tone::Bad),
            }
        }
        None => app.notify("Could not capture the game window (exclusive full screen cannot be captured: use borderless)", Tone::Bad),
    }
}

/// Pause, screenshot, restart and stop.
fn session_bar(app: &mut App, ui: &mut egui::Ui, p: &crate::theme::Palette, ctx: &egui::Context) {
    #[cfg(windows)]
    {
        let Some(pid) = game_pid() else { return };
        ui.horizontal_wrapped(|ui| {
            if widgets::button(ui, p, if app.ingame.paused { "▶ Resume" } else { "⏸ Pause" }, true).clicked() {
                let pause = !app.ingame.paused;
                if session::set_paused(pid, pause) > 0 {
                    app.ingame.paused = pause;
                    if !pause {
                        session::focus(pid);
                    }
                }
            }
            if widgets::button(ui, p, "📷 Screenshot", !app.ingame.paused).on_hover_text("Saved to the EmblemWeave folder in Pictures").clicked() {
                app.ingame.open = false;
                app.ingame.shot_at = Some(Instant::now() + Duration::from_millis(350));
            }
            if widgets::button(ui, p, "⟲ Restart", true).on_hover_text("Closes the game and starts it again, at the title screen. Unsaved progress is lost.").clicked() {
                app.ingame.confirm_stop = false;
                if app.ingame.paused {
                    session::set_paused(pid, false);
                }
                if session::stop(pid) {
                    std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(600));
                    match crate::engine::play() {
                        Ok(()) => app.notify("Restarting the game", Tone::Ok),
                        Err(e) => app.notify(e, Tone::Bad),
                    }
                }
                app.ingame.paused = false;
            }
            if !app.ingame.confirm_stop {
                if widgets::button(ui, p, "⏹ Stop", true).clicked() {
                    app.ingame.confirm_stop = true;
                }
            } else {
                ui.label(RichText::new("Stop the game? Unsaved progress is lost.").color(p.warn));
                if widgets::button(ui, p, "Stop and return", true).clicked() {
                    if app.ingame.paused {
                        session::set_paused(pid, false);
                    }
                    if session::stop(pid) {
                        app.ingame.open = false;
                        app.ingame.paused = false;
                        ctx.send_viewport_cmd_to(egui::ViewportId::ROOT, egui::ViewportCommand::Focus);
                        app.page = crate::pages::Page::Overview;
                        app.notify("The game was stopped", Tone::Ok);
                    }
                    app.ingame.confirm_stop = false;
                }
                if widgets::button(ui, p, "Cancel", true).clicked() {
                    app.ingame.confirm_stop = false;
                }
            }
        });
        if app.ingame.paused {
            ui.label(RichText::new("Paused: the game and its sound are frozen until you resume.").size(12.0).color(p.muted));
        }
    }
}

```

`apps/eblemweave/src/jobs.rs`:

```rs
//! Background work: data detection, module decoding, the recompilation
//! pipeline and boot runs.
//!
//! Each job runs on its own thread and reports through a shared [`Progress`]:
//! named stages with their status and timing, a current message, a log, and a
//! result. The interface reads that state every frame and never waits on a
//! job. Cancellation is a flag the job checks between units of work (and, for
//! a boot, inside the dispatch loop), so it stops at a safe point.

use crate::config::Config;
use crate::gamedata::{self, GameData};
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, AtomicU64, Ordering};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum StageStatus {
    Pending,
    Active,
    Done,
    Skipped,
    Failed,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Stage {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub status: StageStatus,
    pub detail: String,
    pub started: Option<Instant>,
    pub elapsed: Option<Duration>,
}

/// What a finished pipeline measured, for the overview and diagnostics.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
pub struct PipelineSummary {
    pub report: Option<ew_lift::LiftReport>,
    pub output: Option<PathBuf>,
    pub compiled: Option<bool>,
    pub verified: Option<(usize, usize)>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum JobResult {
    Detected(Box<GameData>),
    Decoded(PathBuf),
    Pipeline(Box<PipelineSummary>),
    Boot(Box<ew_boot::BootReport>, u128),
    /// The engine built the game; the run folder holding fefw.ini.
    Engine(PathBuf),
}

#[derive(Debug, Default)]
pub struct Progress {
    pub stages: Vec<Stage>,
    pub message: String,
    pub log: Vec<String>,
    pub finished: bool,
    pub failed: Option<String>,
    pub result: Option<JobResult>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum JobKind {
    Detect,
    Decode,
    Pipeline,
    Boot,
    Engine,
}

impl JobKind {
    pub fn title(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            JobKind::Detect => "Checking game data",
            JobKind::Decode => "Decoding the main module",
            JobKind::Pipeline => "Recompilation pipeline",
            JobKind::Boot => "Running the game",
            JobKind::Engine => "Building the game",
        }
    }
}

pub struct Job {
    pub kind: JobKind,
    pub started: Instant,
    pub progress: Arc<Mutex<Progress>>,
    pub cancel: Arc<AtomicBool>,
    /// Guest instructions executed, for a boot job.
    pub steps: Arc<AtomicU64>,
    pub handle: Option<std::thread::JoinHandle<()>>,
}

impl Job {
    pub fn snapshot<R>(&self, f: impl FnOnce(&Progress) -> R) -> R {
        let p = self.progress.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
        f(&p)
    }

    pub fn finished(&self) -> bool {
        self.snapshot(|p| p.finished)
    }

    pub fn request_cancel(&self) {
        self.cancel.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
}

/// The job's side of the shared state.
#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct Ctx {
    progress: Arc<Mutex<Progress>>,
    pub cancel: Arc<AtomicBool>,
    pub steps: Arc<AtomicU64>,
}

impl Ctx {
    fn with<R>(&self, f: impl FnOnce(&mut Progress) -> R) -> R {
        let mut p = self.progress.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
        f(&mut p)
    }
    pub fn cancelled(&self) -> bool {
        self.cancel.load(Ordering::Relaxed)
    }
    pub fn log(&self, line: impl Into<String>) {
        let line = line.into();
        self.with(|p| {
            p.message = line.clone();
            p.log.push(line);
        });
    }
    pub fn start(&self, i: usize) {
        self.with(|p| {
            if let Some(s) = p.stages.get_mut(i) {
                s.status = StageStatus::Active;
                s.started = Some(Instant::now());
                p.message = format!("{}...", s.name);
            }
        });
    }
    pub fn end(&self, i: usize, status: StageStatus, detail: impl Into<String>) {
        let detail = detail.into();
        self.with(|p| {
            if let Some(s) = p.stages.get_mut(i) {
                s.status = status;
                s.elapsed = s.started.map(|t| t.elapsed());
                s.detail = detail.clone();
            }
            p.log.push(format!("{:?}: {}", status, detail));
        });
    }
    fn finish(&self, result: Result<JobResult, String>) {
        self.with(|p| {
            for s in p.stages.iter_mut().filter(|s| s.status == StageStatus::Pending) {
                s.status = StageStatus::Skipped;
            }
            match result {
                Ok(r) => p.result = Some(r),
                Err(e) => {
                    p.log.push(format!("failed: {e}"));
                    p.failed = Some(e);
                }
            }
            p.finished = true;
        });
    }
}

pub(crate) fn spawn(kind: JobKind, stages: &[&'static str], work: impl FnOnce(&Ctx) -> Result<JobResult, String> + Send + 'static) -> Job {
    let progress = Arc::new(Mutex::new(Progress {
        stages: stages
            .iter()
            .map(|&name| Stage { name, status: StageStatus::Pending, detail: String::new(), started: None, elapsed: None })
            .collect(),
        ..Default::default()
    }));
    let ctx = Ctx { progress: progress.clone(), cancel: Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false)), steps: Arc::new(AtomicU64::new(0)) };
    let job = Job {
        kind,
        started: Instant::now(),
        progress,
        cancel: ctx.cancel.clone(),
        steps: ctx.steps.clone(),
        handle: None,
    };
    let thread_ctx = ctx.clone();
    let handle = std::thread::Builder::new()
        .name(format!("ew-{kind:?}"))
        // Recovery and the dispatcher recurse; give them room.
        .stack_size(64 << 20)
        .spawn(move || {
            let r = std::panic::catch_unwind(std::panic::AssertUnwindSafe(|| work(&thread_ctx)));
            let r = r.unwrap_or_else(|panic| {
                let what = panic
                    .downcast_ref::<String>()
                    .cloned()
                    .or_else(|| panic.downcast_ref::<&str>().map(|s| s.to_string()))
                    .unwrap_or_else(|| "unknown panic".into());
                Err(format!("internal error: {what}"))
            });
            thread_ctx.finish(r);
        })
        .ok();
    Job { handle, ..job }
}

// ---- detection ---------------------------------------------------------------

pub fn detect(config: &Config) -> Job {
    let paths = config.paths.clone();
    spawn(JobKind::Detect, &["Locate and validate game data"], move |ctx| {
        ctx.start(0);
        let g = gamedata::detect(&paths);
        ctx.end(0, StageStatus::Done, format!("{} checks", g.checks.len()));
        Ok(JobResult::Detected(Box::new(g)))
    })
}

// ---- decoding ------------------------------------------------------------------

/// The ZBIC decoder is a development bridge (`tools/zbic_extract.py`, run out
/// of process). Look for it next to the executable and in the working tree.
fn find_bridge() -> Option<(PathBuf, PathBuf)> {
    let exe_dir = std::env::current_exe().ok().and_then(|p| p.parent().map(Path::to_path_buf));
    let mut roots: Vec<PathBuf> = vec![std::env::current_dir().ok()?];
    if let Some(d) = exe_dir {
        roots.extend(d.ancestors().take(5).map(Path::to_path_buf));
    }
    for root in roots {
        let script = root.join("tools").join("zbic_extract.py");
        if script.is_file() {
            let venv = root.join(".venv").join("Scripts").join("python.exe");
            let python = if venv.is_file() { venv } else { PathBuf::from("python") };
            return Some((python, script));
        }
    }
    None
}

pub fn decode(exefs: PathBuf) -> Job {
    spawn(JobKind::Decode, &["Find the ZBIC bridge", "Decode text, rodata and data", "Check sizes"], move |ctx| {
        ctx.start(0);
        let (python, script) = find_bridge().ok_or_else(|| {
            "tools/zbic_extract.py was not found next to the launcher or in the working folder".to_string()
        })?;
        ctx.end(0, StageStatus::Done, format!("{} with {}", script.display(), python.display()));
        let out = Config::work_dir().ok_or("APPDATA is not set")?.join("decoded");
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&out).map_err(|e| format!("creating {}: {e}", out.display()))?;
        ctx.start(1);
        let output = std::process::Command::new(&python)
            .arg("-I")
            .arg(&script)
            .arg(&exefs)
            .arg(&out)
            .arg(gamedata::MAIN_MODULE)
            .output()
            .map_err(|e| format!("starting {}: {e}", python.display()))?;
        let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).into_owned() + &String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr);
        for line in text.lines() {
            ctx.log(line.to_string());
        }
        if !output.status.success() {
            ctx.end(1, StageStatus::Failed, "the bridge reported an error (see the log)");
            return Err("decoding failed; if the log mentions `zbic`, install it with `pip install zbic`".into());
        }
        ctx.end(1, StageStatus::Done, "segments written");
        ctx.start(2);
        let mismatch = text.lines().any(|l| l.trim_start().starts_with("text") && !l.ends_with("OK"));
        if mismatch {
            ctx.end(2, StageStatus::Failed, "a decoded size differs from the module header");
            return Err("decoded sizes do not match the module header".into());
        }
        ctx.end(2, StageStatus::Done, "every segment matches its declared size");
        Ok(JobResult::Decoded(out.join(gamedata::MAIN_MODULE)))
    })
}

// ---- recompilation pipeline -----------------------------------------------------

pub const PIPELINE_STAGES: [&str; 9] = [
    "Parse executable",
    "Segment decompression",
    "Instruction decoding",
    "Function recovery",
    "Control-flow analysis",
    "C code generation",
    "Native compilation",
    "Verification",
    "Runtime preparation",
];

/// A C compiler for the emitted code: zig's bundled clang through the Python
/// wheel, or clang on the PATH.
fn find_cc() -> Option<Vec<String>> {
    if let Some((python, _)) = find_bridge() {
        let ok = std::process::Command::new(&python)
            .args(["-m", "ziglang", "version"])
            .output()
            .map(|o| o.status.success())
            .unwrap_or(false);
        if ok {
            return Some(vec![python.to_string_lossy().into(), "-m".into(), "ziglang".into(), "cc".into()]);
        }
    }
    let clang = std::process::Command::new("clang").arg("--version").output().map(|o| o.status.success()).unwrap_or(false);
    clang.then(|| vec!["clang".to_string()])
}

pub fn pipeline(game: GameData, limit: usize) -> Job {
    spawn(JobKind::Pipeline, &PIPELINE_STAGES, move |ctx| {
        let mut summary = PipelineSummary::default();
        let check = |ctx: &Ctx| if ctx.cancelled() { Err("cancelled by the user".to_string()) } else { Ok(()) };

        ctx.start(0);
        let main = game.modules.as_ref().and_then(|e| e.find(gamedata::MAIN_MODULE)).cloned();
        let Some(main) = main else {
            ctx.end(0, StageStatus::Failed, "no ExeFS with a `main` module");
            return Err("set the game folder on Game Setup first".into());
        };
        ctx.end(0, StageStatus::Done, format!("`{}`: text {} bytes, rodata {}, data {}", main.module_name, main.text_size, main.rodata_size, main.data_size));
        check(ctx)?;

        ctx.start(1);
        let Some(dir) = game.decoded.clone().filter(|_| game.segments.iter().all(|s| s.ok())) else {
            ctx.end(1, StageStatus::Failed, "decode the module on Game Setup first");
            return Err("the main module is not decoded".into());
        };
        let module = ew_boot::Module::from_dir(&dir).map_err(|e| format!("{e:#}"))?;
        ctx.end(1, StageStatus::Done, format!("{} verified against the header", dir.display()));
        check(ctx)?;

        ctx.start(2);
        let segments: Vec<(u64, &[u8])> = vec![(module.rodata_addr, &module.rodata), (module.data_addr, &module.data)];
        let opts = ew_lift::LiftOptions {
            module: "app".into(),
            max_functions: limit,
            max_insns: 4096,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let (report, funcs) = ew_lift::lift_text_in(&module.text, &segments, &opts);
        ctx.end(
            2,
            StageStatus::Done,
            format!("{:.2}% of {} instruction words decode ({} unsupported)", report.decode_coverage * 100.0, report.text_words - report.padding_words, report.unsupported_words),
        );
        ctx.start(3);
        ctx.end(3, StageStatus::Done, format!("{} functions recovered, {} complete", report.lifted_functions, report.complete_functions));
        ctx.start(4);
        ctx.end(
            4,
            StageStatus::Done,
            format!("{} blocks, {} jump tables ({} targets), {} indirect edges left for run time", report.blocks_lifted, report.jump_tables, report.jump_table_targets, report.unresolved_edges),
        );
        check(ctx)?;

        ctx.start(5);
        let out = Config::work_dir().ok_or("APPDATA is not set")?.join("lift");
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&out).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        // Shards of a few hundred functions compile in parallel and fail
        // independently, where one translation unit of the whole lift takes
        // minutes on a single core.
        for old in std::fs::read_dir(&out).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?.flatten() {
            let name = old.file_name().to_string_lossy().into_owned();
            if name.starts_with("app_lift") && (name.ends_with(".c") || name.ends_with(".o")) {
                let _ = std::fs::remove_file(old.path());
            }
        }
        std::fs::write(out.join("ew_aarch64.h"), ew_lift::RUNTIME_HEADER).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        std::fs::write(out.join("ew_dispatch.h"), ew_lift::dispatch_header()).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let mut shards = Vec::new();
        let mut bytes = 0usize;
        for (i, chunk) in balanced_shards(&funcs).into_iter().enumerate() {
            let c = ew_lift::emit_module(&format!("app_{i:03}"), chunk);
            bytes += c.len();
            let path = out.join(format!("app_lift_{i:03}.c"));
            std::fs::write(&path, &c).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            shards.push(path);
            check(ctx)?;
        }
        ctx.end(5, StageStatus::Done, format!("{} MiB of C in {} shards, {}", bytes >> 20, shards.len(), out.display()));
        summary.output = Some(out.clone());
        check(ctx)?;

        ctx.start(6);
        let cc = find_cc();
        match &cc {
            None => ctx.end(6, StageStatus::Skipped, "no C compiler found (install zig with `pip install ziglang`, or clang)"),
            Some(cc) => {
                let (built, failed, threads) = compile_shards(ctx, cc, &out, &shards)?;
                summary.compiled = Some(failed == 0);
                if failed == 0 {
                    ctx.end(6, StageStatus::Done, format!("{built} native objects built on {threads} threads"));
                } else {
                    ctx.end(6, StageStatus::Failed, format!("{failed} of {} shards were rejected by the C compiler (see the log)", shards.len()));
                }
            }
        }
        check(ctx)?;

        ctx.start(7);
        match &cc {
            Some(cc) if summary.compiled == Some(true) => {
                let (ok, total) = verify(ctx, cc, &funcs, &out)?;
                summary.verified = Some((ok, total));
                let status = if ok == total { StageStatus::Done } else { StageStatus::Failed };
                ctx.end(7, status, format!("{ok} of {total} functions identical to the reference interpreter"));
            }
            _ => ctx.end(7, StageStatus::Skipped, "needs the native build"),
        }

        ctx.start(8);
        let services = ew_boot::hle::HostServices::defaults();
        let seq = module.startup_sequence();
        ctx.end(
            8,
            StageStatus::Done,
            format!("{} imports named, {} host services, startup: {}", module.imports.jumps.len(), services.len(), seq.iter().map(|(n, _)| n.as_str()).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(" -> ")),
        );
        summary.report = Some(report);
        Ok(JobResult::Pipeline(Box::new(summary)))
    })
}

/// Translation units per compiler thread. Several per thread keep every core
/// busy to the end even when one unit holds an unusually large function.
const SHARDS_PER_THREAD: usize = 4;

/// Split the lifted functions into contiguous groups of roughly equal
/// instruction count, which is what compile time follows.
fn balanced_shards(funcs: &[ew_lift::LiftedFunction]) -> Vec<&[ew_lift::LiftedFunction]> {
    let threads = std::thread::available_parallelism().map(|n| n.get()).unwrap_or(4);
    let total: usize = funcs.iter().map(|f| f.insn_count()).sum();
    let target = (total / (threads * SHARDS_PER_THREAD).max(1)).max(1);
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    let (mut start, mut acc) = (0usize, 0usize);
    for (i, f) in funcs.iter().enumerate() {
        acc += f.insn_count();
        if acc >= target {
            out.push(&funcs[start..=i]);
            start = i + 1;
            acc = 0;
        }
    }
    if start < funcs.len() {
        out.push(&funcs[start..]);
    }
    out
}

/// Compile every shard with one compiler process per core. Cancelling kills
/// the processes still running. Returns (built, failed, threads).
fn compile_shards(ctx: &Ctx, cc: &[String], out: &Path, shards: &[PathBuf]) -> Result<(usize, usize, usize), String> {
    let threads = std::thread::available_parallelism().map(|n| n.get()).unwrap_or(4).clamp(1, 32);
    let mut pending: std::collections::VecDeque<&PathBuf> = shards.iter().collect();
    let mut running: Vec<(PathBuf, std::process::Child)> = Vec::new();
    let (mut built, mut failed) = (0usize, 0usize);
    loop {
        if ctx.cancelled() {
            for (_, mut child) in running {
                let _ = child.kill();
            }
            return Err("cancelled by the user".into());
        }
        while running.len() < threads {
            let Some(src) = pending.pop_front() else { break };
            let child = std::process::Command::new(&cc[0])
                .args(&cc[1..])
                // -O0: this stage proves the translation builds natively. The
                // largest lifted functions take many minutes at -O1, which is
                // recorded as open work in docs/STATUS.md.
                .args(["-std=c99", "-O0", "-c", "-w", "-I"])
                .arg(out)
                .arg(src)
                .arg("-o")
                .arg(src.with_extension("o"))
                .stdout(std::process::Stdio::null())
                .stderr(std::process::Stdio::piped())
                .spawn()
                .map_err(|e| format!("starting the C compiler: {e}"))?;
            running.push((src.clone(), child));
        }
        if running.is_empty() {
            break;
        }
        let mut still = Vec::new();
        for (src, mut child) in running {
            match child.try_wait() {
                Ok(Some(status)) => {
                    if status.success() {
                        built += 1;
                    } else {
                        failed += 1;
                        let mut err = String::new();
                        if let Some(mut e) = child.stderr.take() {
                            use std::io::Read;
                            let _ = e.read_to_string(&mut err);
                        }
                        ctx.log(format!("{}: {}", src.display(), err.lines().take(6).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(" | ")));
                    }
                    ctx.log(format!("compiled {} of {} shards", built + failed, shards.len()));
                }
                Ok(None) => still.push((src, child)),
                Err(e) => return Err(format!("waiting for the C compiler: {e}")),
            }
        }
        running = still;
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(50));
    }
    Ok((built, failed, threads))
}

/// Run up to 100 leaf functions through the reference interpreter and the
/// compiled C, and count the ones whose final registers agree.
fn verify(ctx: &Ctx, cc: &[String], funcs: &[ew_lift::LiftedFunction], out: &Path) -> Result<(usize, usize), String> {
    let mut chosen = Vec::new();
    let mut expected = Vec::new();
    for f in funcs.iter().filter(|f| f.complete && !f.has_calls) {
        if chosen.len() >= 100 {
            break;
        }
        let mut st = ew_lift::State::patterned();
        if ew_lift::interpreter::run_function(&mut st, f, 5000).is_ok() {
            let mut line = format!("fn=0x{:x} halted={} pc={:x} nzcv={:x}", f.addr, st.halted as u32, st.pc, st.nzcv);
            for i in 0..31 {
                line.push_str(&format!(" x{i}={:x}", st.x[i]));
            }
            line.push_str(&format!(" sp={:x}", st.sp));
            for i in 0..32 {
                line.push_str(&format!(" v{i}={:x}:{:x}", st.v[i][1], st.v[i][0]));
            }
            expected.push(line);
            chosen.push(f.clone());
        }
    }
    let src = out.join("campaign.c");
    std::fs::write(&src, ew_lift::emit_campaign("app", &chosen)).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let exe = out.join("campaign.exe");
    let built = std::process::Command::new(&cc[0])
        .args(&cc[1..])
        .args(["-std=c99", "-O1", "-w", "-I"])
        .arg(out)
        .arg(&src)
        .arg("-o")
        .arg(&exe)
        .output()
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    if !built.status.success() {
        ctx.log(String::from_utf8_lossy(&built.stderr).into_owned());
        return Err("the verification program did not compile".into());
    }
    let ran = std::process::Command::new(&exe).output().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let native = String::from_utf8_lossy(&ran.stdout).replace('\r', "");
    let native: Vec<&str> = native.lines().filter(|l| l.starts_with("fn=")).collect();
    let ok = expected.iter().zip(&native).filter(|(a, b)| a.as_str() == **b).count();
    Ok((ok, expected.len()))
}

// ---- boot ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

pub fn boot(config: &Config, game: &GameData) -> Job {
    let decoded = game.decoded.clone();
    let romfs = game.romfs.clone();
    let exefs = game.exefs.clone();
    let title = game.title.clone();
    let cfg = config.clone();
    spawn(JobKind::Boot, &["Map the modules", "Execute the game"], move |ctx| {
        ctx.start(0);
        let dir = decoded.ok_or("the main module is not decoded")?;
        let module = ew_boot::Module::from_dir(&dir).map_err(|e| format!("{e:#}"))?;
        let mut sequence = module.startup_sequence();
        let (entry_name, entry) = sequence.remove(0);
        // The title's sdk module supplies the C++ standard library and other
        // pure library code. It is LZ4 compressed, so it is read straight from
        // the dump and never written anywhere.
        let mut libraries = Vec::new();
        if let Some(path) = exefs.map(|e| e.join("sdk")).filter(|p| p.is_file()) {
            let bytes = std::fs::read(&path).map_err(|e| format!("reading {}: {e}", path.display()))?;
            let nso = ew_format::Nso::parse(&bytes).map_err(|e| format!("{e:#}"))?;
            let seg = |k| nso.decompress_segment(k).map_err(|e| format!("{e:#}"));
            let (t, r, d) = (seg(ew_format::SegmentKind::Text)?, seg(ew_format::SegmentKind::Rodata)?, seg(ew_format::SegmentKind::Data)?);
            libraries.push(ew_boot::Module::from_segments("sdk", t, r, d).map_err(|e| format!("{e:#}"))?);
            ctx.log(format!("sdk loaded from {}", path.display()));
        } else {
            ctx.log("no sdk module next to main; library calls will stop the run".to_string());
        }
        ctx.end(
            0,
            StageStatus::Done,
            format!("{} imports, {} library module(s), startup {} then {} more", module.imports.jumps.len(), libraries.len(), entry_name, sequence.len()),
        );

        let mut settings = std::collections::BTreeMap::new();
        settings.insert("language".to_string(), cfg.system.language.clone());
        settings.insert("user_name".to_string(), cfg.system.user_name.clone());
        if let Some((_, version)) = title {
            settings.insert("display_version".to_string(), version);
        }
        let opts = ew_boot::BootOptions {
            entry,
            entry_name,
            then: sequence,
            max_steps: cfg.runtime.max_steps,
            heap_bytes: cfg.runtime.heap_mib.clamp(64, 8192) << 20,
            romfs,
            save_dir: Config::save_dir(),
            settings,
            cancel: Some(ctx.cancel.clone()),
            progress: Some(ctx.steps.clone()),
            libraries,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        ctx.start(1);
        let started = Instant::now();
        let report = ew_boot::boot(&module, &opts).map_err(|e| format!("{e:#}"))?;
        let ms = started.elapsed().as_millis();
        ctx.end(1, StageStatus::Done, report.headline());
        if let Some(path) = Config::dir().map(|d| d.join("last-boot.json")) {
            if let Ok(json) = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&report) {
                let _ = std::fs::write(path, json);
            }
        }
        Ok(JobResult::Boot(Box::new(report), ms))
    })
}
```

`apps/eblemweave/src/logo.rs`:

```rs
//! The EmblemWeave logo: the rendered EMBLEM WEAVE artwork, cut out of its
//! background, in one colourway per scheme.
//!
//! The artwork lives in `assets/branding` as transparent PNGs:
//! `logo-fe.png` is the original render (gold, silver and royal blue),
//! `logo-xion.png` is recoloured from it by `tools/recolor_logo.py`, and
//! `logo-arcade.png` is separate 8-bit artwork with a neon glow, cut out of its
//! white background by `tools/unmatte_logo.py`. Each is decoded and uploaded
//! to the GPU once, the first time it is drawn, and drawn at its own aspect.

use eframe::egui::{self, Color32, Rect, Vec2};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::Mutex;

use crate::theme::Palette;

pub const LOGO_XION: &[u8] = include_bytes!("../../../assets/branding/logo-xion.png");
pub const LOGO_ARCADE: &[u8] = include_bytes!("../../../assets/branding/logo-arcade.png");
pub const LOGO_FE: &[u8] = include_bytes!("../../../assets/branding/logo-fe.png");

/// Height relative to width of the rendered artwork (FE and XiØN); the
/// fallback when a scheme's texture cannot be loaded.
pub const LOCKUP_ASPECT: f32 = 439.0 / 922.0;

static TEXTURES: Mutex<Option<HashMap<usize, egui::TextureHandle>>> = Mutex::new(None);

/// The scheme's artwork as a texture, created on first use.
fn texture(ctx: &egui::Context, png: &'static [u8]) -> Option<egui::TextureHandle> {
    let mut guard = TEXTURES.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    let map = guard.get_or_insert_with(HashMap::new);
    let key = png.as_ptr() as usize;
    if let Some(t) = map.get(&key) {
        return Some(t.clone());
    }
    let decoded = image::load_from_memory_with_format(png, image::ImageFormat::Png).ok()?.to_rgba8();
    let size = [decoded.width() as usize, decoded.height() as usize];
    let pixels = egui::ColorImage::from_rgba_unmultiplied(size, decoded.as_raw());
    let handle = ctx.load_texture(format!("logo-{key:x}"), pixels, egui::TextureOptions::LINEAR);
    map.insert(key, handle.clone());
    Some(handle)
}

/// Draw the logo into `rect`, fitted and centred, with a soft accent glow.
pub fn lockup(painter: &egui::Painter, rect: Rect, palette: &Palette) {
    let Some(tex) = texture(painter.ctx(), palette.logo) else { return };
    let [w, h] = tex.size();
    let scale = (rect.width() / w as f32).min(rect.height() / h as f32);
    let size = Vec2::new(w as f32, h as f32) * scale;
    let at = Rect::from_center_size(rect.center(), size);
    glow(painter, at.center(), Vec2::new(size.x * 0.52, size.y * 0.62), palette.electric);
    let uv = Rect::from_min_max(egui::pos2(0.0, 0.0), egui::pos2(1.0, 1.0));
    painter.image(tex.id(), at, uv, Color32::WHITE);
}

/// An elliptical glow from the accent to clear, as one mesh.
fn glow(p: &egui::Painter, centre: egui::Pos2, radius: Vec2, colour: Color32) {
    let [r, g, b, _] = colour.to_array();
    let peak = 34u8;
    let mut mesh = egui::Mesh::default();
    let (rings, segments) = (10u32, 40u32);
    mesh.colored_vertex(centre, Color32::from_rgba_unmultiplied(r, g, b, peak));
    for ring in 1..=rings {
        let t = ring as f32 / rings as f32;
        let a = (peak as f32 * (1.0 - t * t).powi(2)) as u8;
        for s in 0..segments {
            let ang = s as f32 / segments as f32 * std::f32::consts::TAU;
            mesh.colored_vertex(centre + Vec2::new(ang.cos() * radius.x * t, ang.sin() * radius.y * t), Color32::from_rgba_unmultiplied(r, g, b, a));
        }
    }
    let idx = |ring: u32, s: u32| 1 + (ring - 1) * segments + (s % segments);
    for s in 0..segments {
        mesh.add_triangle(0, idx(1, s), idx(1, s + 1));
    }
    for ring in 1..rings {
        for s in 0..segments {
            let (a, b, c, d) = (idx(ring, s), idx(ring, s + 1), idx(ring + 1, s), idx(ring + 1, s + 1));
            mesh.add_triangle(a, b, c);
            mesh.add_triangle(b, d, c);
        }
    }
    p.add(egui::Shape::mesh(mesh));
}

/// The logo inline in a layout, sized by width.
pub fn show_lockup(ui: &mut egui::Ui, palette: &Palette, width: f32) -> egui::Response {
    let aspect = texture(ui.ctx(), palette.logo).map(|t| t.size()[1] as f32 / t.size()[0] as f32).unwrap_or(LOCKUP_ASPECT);
    let (rect, response) = ui.allocate_exact_size(Vec2::new(width, width * aspect), egui::Sense::hover());
    lockup(ui.painter(), rect, palette);
    response
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn the_rendered_colourways_share_a_size() {
        for png in [LOGO_XION, LOGO_FE] {
            let img = image::load_from_memory(png).unwrap();
            assert_eq!((img.width(), img.height()), (922, 439));
            assert!(img.color().has_alpha());
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn the_arcade_artwork_is_cut_out() {
        let img = image::load_from_memory(LOGO_ARCADE).unwrap().to_rgba8();
        assert!(img.width() > img.height() * 2);
        // Corners are transparent: no white background left.
        for (x, y) in [(0, 0), (img.width() - 1, 0), (0, img.height() - 1), (img.width() - 1, img.height() - 1)] {
            assert_eq!(img.get_pixel(x, y)[3], 0, "corner ({x}, {y})");
        }
        // No opaque near-white pixels remain anywhere.
        assert!(!img.pixels().any(|p| p[3] > 200 && p[0] > 240 && p[1] > 240 && p[2] > 240));
    }
}
```
