`apps/eblemweave/src/main.rs`:

```rs
//! EmblemWeave: the native PC recompilation launcher for Fire Emblem:
//! Fortune's Weave, by XiØN.
//!
//! The launcher is the product interface to the recompilation system: it
//! locates and validates the user's own game data, decodes and recompiles the
//! game's code, runs the runtime, and reports exactly how far it gets. It never
//! claims more than the runtime delivers: Play stays unavailable until the game
//! can present a frame.

#![cfg_attr(not(debug_assertions), windows_subsystem = "windows")]

mod config;
mod engine;
mod gamedata;
mod jobs;
mod logo;
mod pages;
mod cheats;
mod ingame;
mod mods;
mod saves;
mod savefile;
mod theme;
mod widgets;

use config::Config;
use eframe::egui::{self, RichText};
use gamedata::GameData;
use jobs::{Job, JobKind, JobResult};
use pages::Page;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};
use widgets::Tone;

/// One line of the activity feed.
pub struct Activity {
    pub at: String,
    pub text: String,
    pub tone: Tone,
}

pub struct Toast {
    pub text: String,
    pub tone: Tone,
    pub until: Instant,
}

/// A question the user must answer before an action runs.
pub enum Confirm {
    ResetBindings,
    CancelJob(JobKind),
}

pub struct App {
    pub config: Config,
    saved: String,
    last_save_check: Instant,
    pub page: Page,
    pub game: GameData,
    pub jobs: Vec<Job>,
    pub last_boot: Option<(ew_boot::BootReport, u128)>,
    pub last_pipeline: Option<jobs::PipelineSummary>,
    pub last_job_log: Vec<String>,
    pub activity: Vec<Activity>,
    pub toasts: Vec<Toast>,
    pub confirm: Option<Confirm>,
    pub capture: Option<usize>,
    pub diag_tab: pages::diagnostics::Tab,
    pub diag_filter: String,
    pub lift_limit: usize,
    /// `--boot-test`: start a boot test once game detection finishes.
    pub boot_on_start: bool,
    /// `--build-engine`: build the game with the engine once detection finishes.
    build_on_start: bool,
    /// `--screenshot PATH`: save the window's own rendered frame and close.
    screenshot: Option<(std::path::PathBuf, u32)>,
    applied: theme::Scheme,
    pub saves_ui: pages::saves::Ui,
    pub mods_ui: pages::mods::Ui,
    pub cheats_ui: pages::cheats::Ui,
    pub ingame: ingame::Ingame,
}

fn clock() -> String {
    let secs = std::time::SystemTime::now().duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).map(|d| d.as_secs()).unwrap_or(0);
    let s = secs % 86_400;
    format!("{:02}:{:02}:{:02} UTC", s / 3600, s % 3600 / 60, s % 60)
}

impl App {
    fn new(cc: &eframe::CreationContext<'_>) -> App {
        theme::configure_fonts(&cc.egui_ctx);
        let (config, warning) = Config::load();
        theme::apply(&cc.egui_ctx, config.theme);
        let saved = serde_json::to_string(&config).unwrap_or_default();
        let last_boot = Config::dir()
            .map(|d| d.join("last-boot.json"))
            .and_then(|p| std::fs::read_to_string(p).ok())
            .and_then(|s| serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&s).ok())
            .map(|_| ());
        let mut app = App {
            applied: config.theme,
            config,
            saved,
            last_save_check: Instant::now(),
            page: Page::Overview,
            game: GameData::default(),
            jobs: Vec::new(),
            last_boot: None,
            last_pipeline: None,
            last_job_log: Vec::new(),
            activity: Vec::new(),
            toasts: Vec::new(),
            confirm: None,
            capture: None,
            diag_tab: pages::diagnostics::Tab::Runtime,
            diag_filter: String::new(),
            lift_limit: 4000,
            boot_on_start: false,
            build_on_start: false,
            screenshot: None,
            saves_ui: Default::default(),
            mods_ui: Default::default(),
            cheats_ui: Default::default(),
            ingame: Default::default(),
        };
        // Command line: `--page <name>` opens a page, `--boot-test` runs the
        // boot test as soon as the game data is detected.
        let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().collect();
        for (i, a) in args.iter().enumerate() {
            match a.as_str() {
                "--boot-test" => app.boot_on_start = true,
                "--build-engine" => app.build_on_start = true,
                "--screenshot" => app.screenshot = args.get(i + 1).map(|p| (std::path::PathBuf::from(p), 0)),
                "--page" => {
                    if let Some(name) = args.get(i + 1) {
                        if let Some(p) = Page::ALL.iter().find(|p| p.label().eq_ignore_ascii_case(name.replace('-', " ").as_str())) {
                            app.page = *p;
                        }
                    }
                }
                _ => {}
            }
        }
        let _ = last_boot;
        if let Some(w) = warning {
            app.notify(w, Tone::Warn);
        }
        app.note("Launcher started", Tone::Neutral);
        app.start(JobKind::Detect);
        app
    }

    pub fn note(&mut self, text: impl Into<String>, tone: Tone) {
        self.activity.push(Activity { at: clock(), text: text.into(), tone });
        if self.activity.len() > 200 {
            self.activity.remove(0);
        }
    }

    pub fn notify(&mut self, text: impl Into<String>, tone: Tone) {
        let text = text.into();
        self.note(text.clone(), tone);
        self.toasts.push(Toast { text, tone, until: Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(5) });
    }

    pub fn running(&self, kind: JobKind) -> Option<&Job> {
        self.jobs.iter().find(|j| j.kind == kind && !j.finished())
    }

    pub fn busy(&self) -> bool {
        self.jobs.iter().any(|j| !j.finished() && j.kind != JobKind::Detect)
    }

    /// Start a job of `kind` unless one is already running.
    pub fn start(&mut self, kind: JobKind) {
        if self.running(kind).is_some() {
            return;
        }
        let job = match kind {
            JobKind::Detect => jobs::detect(&self.config),
            JobKind::Decode => match self.game.exefs.clone() {
                Some(exefs) => jobs::decode(exefs),
                None => return self.notify("Choose the game folder before decoding", Tone::Warn),
            },
            JobKind::Pipeline => jobs::pipeline(self.game.clone(), self.lift_limit),
            JobKind::Boot => jobs::boot(&self.config, &self.game),
            JobKind::Engine => match (self.game.exefs.clone(), self.game.nup.clone().or_else(|| self.game.romfs.clone())) {
                (Some(exefs), Some(romfs)) => jobs::spawn(JobKind::Engine, &engine::STAGES, move |ctx| engine::build(ctx, exefs, romfs)),
                _ => return self.notify("Choose the game data on Game Setup before building", Tone::Warn),
            },
        };
        if kind != JobKind::Detect {
            self.note(format!("{} started", kind.title()), Tone::Accent);
        }
        self.jobs.push(job);
    }

    /// Collect finished jobs and apply their results.
    fn poll_jobs(&mut self) {
        let mut finished = Vec::new();
        self.jobs.retain(|j| {
            if j.finished() {
                finished.push((j.kind, j.progress.clone()));
                false
            } else {
                true
            }
        });
        for (kind, progress) in finished {
            let mut p = progress.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
            if kind != JobKind::Detect {
                self.last_job_log = std::mem::take(&mut p.log);
            }
            if let Some(err) = p.failed.take() {
                drop(p);
                self.notify(format!("{}: {err}", kind.title()), Tone::Bad);
                continue;
            }
            match p.result.take() {
                Some(JobResult::Detected(g)) => {
                    self.game = *g;
                }
                Some(JobResult::Decoded(dir)) => {
                    drop(p);
                    self.config.paths.decoded = dir.to_string_lossy().into_owned();
                    self.notify("Main module decoded and verified", Tone::Ok);
                    self.start(JobKind::Detect);
                }
                Some(JobResult::Pipeline(s)) => {
                    drop(p);
                    let tone = if s.verified.is_some_and(|(ok, n)| ok == n) { Tone::Ok } else { Tone::Warn };
                    let text = match (&s.report, s.verified) {
                        (Some(r), Some((ok, n))) => format!("Pipeline finished: {} functions, {ok}/{n} verified", r.lifted_functions),
                        (Some(r), None) => format!("Pipeline finished: {} functions (native build not verified)", r.lifted_functions),
                        _ => "Pipeline finished".to_string(),
                    };
                    self.last_pipeline = Some(*s);
                    self.notify(text, tone);
                }
                Some(JobResult::Engine(dir)) => {
                    drop(p);
                    self.notify(format!("The game is built and ready to play ({})", dir.display()), Tone::Ok);
                }
                Some(JobResult::Boot(report, ms)) => {
                    drop(p);
                    let text = format!("Runtime stopped: {}", report.stop.describe());
                    self.last_boot = Some((*report, ms));
                    self.notify(text, Tone::Accent);
                }
                None => {}
            }
        }
    }

    fn autosave(&mut self) {
        if self.last_save_check.elapsed() < Duration::from_millis(400) {
            return;
        }
        self.last_save_check = Instant::now();
        let now = serde_json::to_string(&self.config).unwrap_or_default();
        if now != self.saved {
            let paths_changed = serde_json::to_string(&self.config.paths).ok()
                != serde_json::from_str::<Config>(&self.saved).ok().and_then(|c| serde_json::to_string(&c.paths).ok());
            match self.config.save() {
                Ok(()) => self.saved = now,
                Err(e) => {
                    self.saved = now;
                    self.notify(format!("Settings could not be saved: {e}"), Tone::Bad);
                }
            }
            if paths_changed {
                self.start(JobKind::Detect);
            }
        }
    }

    fn shortcuts(&mut self, ctx: &egui::Context) {
        if self.capture.is_some() {
            return;
        }
        let pages = Page::ALL;
        ctx.input(|i| {
            if i.modifiers.ctrl {
                for (n, key) in [egui::Key::Num1, egui::Key::Num2, egui::Key::Num3, egui::Key::Num4, egui::Key::Num5, egui::Key::Num6, egui::Key::Num7, egui::Key::Num8, egui::Key::Num9]
                    .into_iter()
                    .enumerate()
                {
                    if i.key_pressed(key) {
                        if let Some(p) = pages.get(n) {
                            self.page = *p;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    }

    fn nav(&mut self, ctx: &egui::Context) {
        let p = self.config.theme.palette();
        egui::SidePanel::left("nav")
            .exact_width(theme::NAV_WIDTH)
            .resizable(false)
            .frame(egui::Frame::new().fill(p.bg).inner_margin(egui::Margin { left: 14, right: 4, top: 14, bottom: 14 }))
            .show(ctx, |ui| {
                // A floating, rounded rail.
                let full = ui.available_rect_before_wrap();
                let painter = ui.painter();
                for i in 1..=6 {
                    let g = full.expand(i as f32 * 3.0).translate(egui::vec2(0.0, 8.0));
                    painter.rect_filled(g, egui::CornerRadius::same(theme::RADIUS_L + i as u8 * 3), egui::Color32::from_black_alpha((40 / i) as u8));
                }
                painter.rect_filled(full, egui::CornerRadius::same(theme::RADIUS_L), p.panel);
                widgets::gradient_fill(painter, full.shrink(1.0), theme::RADIUS_L as f32 - 1.0, egui::Color32::from_white_alpha(8), egui::Color32::from_white_alpha(0));
                painter.rect_stroke(full, egui::CornerRadius::same(theme::RADIUS_L), egui::Stroke::new(1.0_f32, egui::Color32::from_white_alpha(10)), egui::StrokeKind::Inside);
                ui.add_space(theme::SPACE_M);
                ui.vertical_centered(|ui| {
                    logo::show_lockup(ui, &p, theme::NAV_WIDTH - 60.0);
                    ui.label(RichText::new("NATIVE PC RECOMPILATION").font(theme::semibold(10.5)).color(p.muted));
                });
                ui.add_space(theme::SPACE_L);
                for (i, page) in Page::ALL.iter().enumerate() {
                    let r = widgets::nav_item(ui, &p, page.icon(), page.label(), self.page == *page)
                        .on_hover_text(format!("{}  (Ctrl+{})", page.label(), i + 1));
                    if r.clicked() {
                        self.page = *page;
                    }
                }
                ui.with_layout(egui::Layout::bottom_up(egui::Align::Min), |ui| {
                    ui.add_space(theme::SPACE_M);
                    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                        ui.add_space(theme::SPACE_M);
                        ui.label(RichText::new("by").size(12.0).color(p.muted));
                        ui.hyperlink_to(RichText::new("XiØN").font(theme::semibold(13.0)).color(p.accent_hi), "https://github.com/XiONDiGiTaL");
                    });
                });
            });
    }

    fn status_bar(&mut self, ctx: &egui::Context) {
        let p = self.config.theme.palette();
        egui::TopBottomPanel::bottom("status")
            .exact_height(46.0)
            .frame(egui::Frame::new().fill(p.bg).inner_margin(egui::Margin { left: 14, right: 14, top: 4, bottom: 10 }))
            .show(ctx, |ui| {
                // A floating status pill.
                let r = ui.available_rect_before_wrap();
                ui.painter().rect_filled(r, egui::CornerRadius::same(255), p.panel);
                ui.painter().rect_stroke(r, egui::CornerRadius::same(255), egui::Stroke::new(1.0_f32, egui::Color32::from_white_alpha(10)), egui::StrokeKind::Inside);
                ui.horizontal_centered(|ui| {
                    ui.add_space(16.0);
                    let active = self.jobs.iter().find(|j| !j.finished() && j.kind != JobKind::Detect);
                    match active {
                        Some(job) => {
                            let kind = job.kind;
                            let message = job.snapshot(|pr| pr.message.clone());
                            let steps = job.steps.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
                            ui.spinner();
                            ui.label(RichText::new(kind.title()).font(theme::semibold(13.0)).color(p.ink));
                            let extra = if kind == JobKind::Boot && steps > 0 { format!("  {} guest instructions", fmt_count(steps)) } else { String::new() };
                            ui.label(RichText::new(format!("{message}{extra}")).size(12.5).color(p.body));
                            ui.label(RichText::new(format!("{:.1}s", job.started.elapsed().as_secs_f32())).font(theme::mono(12.0)).color(p.muted));
                            ui.with_layout(egui::Layout::right_to_left(egui::Align::Center), |ui| {
                                if ui.small_button("Cancel").on_hover_text("Stop at the next safe point").clicked() {
                                    self.confirm = Some(Confirm::CancelJob(kind));
                                }

                        }
                        None => {
                            ui.label(RichText::new("Ready").size(12.5).color(p.muted));
                            let (text, tone) = pages::overview::readiness(self);
                            ui.add_space(8.0);
                            let (dot, _) = ui.allocate_exact_size(egui::vec2(8.0, 8.0), egui::Sense::hover());
                            ui.painter().circle_filled(dot.center(), 3.5, tone.colour(&p));
                            ui.label(RichText::new(text).size(12.5).color(p.body));
                            ui.with_layout(egui::Layout::right_to_left(egui::Align::Center), |ui| {
                                ui.add_space(16.0);
                                ui.label(RichText::new(concat!("v", env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"), " · ", env!("EW_GIT_REV"))).font(theme::mono(11.5)).color(p.muted));
                            });
                        }
                    }
                });
            });
    }

    fn overlays(&mut self, ctx: &egui::Context) {
        let p = self.config.theme.palette();
        // Toasts, newest at the bottom right.
        self.toasts.retain(|t| t.until > Instant::now());
        if !self.toasts.is_empty() {
            egui::Area::new(egui::Id::new("toasts"))
                .anchor(egui::Align2::RIGHT_BOTTOM, egui::vec2(-18.0, -48.0))
                .order(egui::Order::Foreground)
                .show(ctx, |ui| {
                    for t in &self.toasts {
                        egui::Frame::new()
                            .fill(p.surface)
                            .stroke(egui::Stroke::new(1.0_f32, theme::alpha(t.tone.colour(&p), 160)))
                            .corner_radius(egui::CornerRadius::same(theme::RADIUS_M))
                            .inner_margin(egui::Margin::symmetric(14, 10))
                            .show(ui, |ui| {
                                ui.set_max_width(420.0);
                                ui.label(RichText::new(&t.text).size(13.5).color(p.ink));
                            });
                        ui.add_space(6.0);
                    }
                });
            ctx.request_repaint_after(Duration::from_millis(250));
        }
        // Confirmation dialog.
        if let Some(confirm) = &self.confirm {
            let (title, body, action) = match confirm {
                Confirm::ResetBindings => ("Reset controls?", "Every binding returns to its default. This cannot be undone.", "Reset"),
                Confirm::CancelJob(k) => ("Stop this task?", k.title(), "Stop"),
            };
            let mut decision = None;
            egui::Window::new(title)
                .collapsible(false)
                .resizable(false)
                .anchor(egui::Align2::CENTER_CENTER, egui::Vec2::ZERO)
                .show(ctx, |ui| {
                    ui.label(RichText::new(body).color(p.body));
                    ui.add_space(theme::SPACE_M);
                    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                        if widgets::button(ui, &p, action, true).clicked() {
                            decision = Some(true);
                        }
                        if widgets::button(ui, &p, "Keep", true).clicked() || ui.input(|i| i.key_pressed(egui::Key::Escape)) {
                            decision = Some(false);
                        }
                    });
                });
            if let Some(yes) = decision {
                if yes {
                    match self.confirm.take() {
                        Some(Confirm::ResetBindings) => {
                            self.config.input.bindings = config::default_bindings();
                            self.notify("Controls reset to their defaults", Tone::Ok);
                        }
                        Some(Confirm::CancelJob(kind)) => {
                            if let Some(j) = self.jobs.iter().find(|j| j.kind == kind && !j.finished()) {
                                j.request_cancel();
                            }
                        }
                        None => {}
                    }
                }
                self.confirm = None;
            }
        }
    }
}

pub fn fmt_count(n: u64) -> String {
    let s = n.to_string();
    let mut out = String::new();
    for (i, c) in s.chars().enumerate() {
        if i > 0 && (s.len() - i) % 3 == 0 {
            out.push(',');
        }
        out.push(c);
    }
    out
}

impl App {
    /// For `--screenshot`: once the page has settled, ask the renderer for
    /// this window's frame, save it as PNG, and close. The image comes from
    /// the GPU frame itself, so other windows can never appear in it.
    fn take_screenshot(&mut self, ctx: &egui::Context) {
        let Some((path, frames)) = &mut self.screenshot else { return };
        *frames += 1;
        ctx.request_repaint();
        if *frames == 90 {
            ctx.send_viewport_cmd(egui::ViewportCommand::Screenshot(egui::UserData::default()));
        }
        let shot = ctx.input(|i| {
            i.raw.events.iter().find_map(|e| match e {
                egui::Event::Screenshot { image, .. } => Some(image.clone()),
                _ => None,
            })
        });
        if let Some(image) = shot {
            let [w, h] = image.size;
            let bytes: Vec<u8> = image.pixels.iter().flat_map(|c| c.to_array()).collect();
            if let Some(img) = image::RgbaImage::from_raw(w as u32, h as u32, bytes) {
                if let Err(e) = img.save(&*path) {
                    eprintln!("saving {}: {e}", path.display());
                }
            }
            ctx.send_viewport_cmd(egui::ViewportCommand::Close);
        }
    }
}

impl eframe::App for App {
    fn update(&mut self, ctx: &egui::Context, _frame: &mut eframe::Frame) {
        if self.config.theme != self.applied {
            self.applied = self.config.theme;
            theme::apply(ctx, self.config.theme);
        }
        self.poll_jobs();
        if self.boot_on_start && self.running(JobKind::Detect).is_none() && self.game.bootable_inputs() {
            self.boot_on_start = false;
            self.start(JobKind::Boot);
        }
        if self.build_on_start && self.running(JobKind::Detect).is_none() && self.game.exefs.is_some() {
            self.build_on_start = false;
            self.start(JobKind::Engine);
        }
        if self.running(JobKind::Engine).is_some() {
            ctx.request_repaint_after(Duration::from_millis(250));
        }
        self.shortcuts(ctx);
        self.nav(ctx);
        self.status_bar(ctx);
        let p = self.config.theme.palette();
        egui::CentralPanel::default()
            .frame(egui::Frame::new().fill(p.bg).inner_margin(egui::Margin { left: 36, right: 36, top: 0, bottom: 0 }))
            .show(ctx, |ui| {
                crate::widgets::backdrop(ui.painter(), ui.max_rect().expand2(egui::vec2(36.0, 0.0)), &p);
                egui::ScrollArea::vertical().auto_shrink([false, false]).show(ui, |ui| {
                    let w = ui.available_width().min(1100.0);
                    ui.set_width(w);
                    ui.set_max_width(w);
                    pages::show(self, ui);
                    ui.add_space(theme::SPACE_XL);
                });
            });
        self.overlays(ctx);
        ingame::frame(self, ctx);
        self.take_screenshot(ctx);
        self.autosave();
        if !self.jobs.is_empty() {
            ctx.request_repaint_after(Duration::from_millis(150));
        }
    }

    fn on_exit(&mut self, _gl: Option<&eframe::glow::Context>) {
        if self.screenshot.is_some() {
            // A capture run leaves the user's settings exactly as they were.
            return;
        }
        for j in &self.jobs {
            j.request_cancel();
        }
        let _ = self.config.save();
    }
}

fn window_icon() -> Option<egui::IconData> {
    eframe::icon_data::from_png_bytes(include_bytes!("../assets/icon.png")).ok()
}

/// `--import-save <folder>`: import a save the way Game Setup does, print
/// what happened, and exit without opening a window.
fn import_save_cli(source: &str) -> std::process::ExitCode {
    let Some(save_dir) = config::Config::save_dir() else {
        eprintln!("APPDATA is not set");
        return std::process::ExitCode::FAILURE;
    };
    let stamp = std::time::SystemTime::now().duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).map(|d| d.as_secs()).unwrap_or(0).to_string();
    match saves::import(std::path::Path::new(source), &save_dir, saves::FALLBACK_TITLE_ID, &stamp) {
        Ok(i) => {
            println!("imported {} files into {}", i.files, saves::account_dir(&save_dir).display());
            if let Some(b) = i.backup {
                println!("the previous save is in {}", b.display());
            }
            std::process::ExitCode::SUCCESS
        }
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("import failed: {e}");
            std::process::ExitCode::FAILURE
        }
    }
}

fn main() -> eframe::Result<()> {
    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().collect();
    if let Some(i) = args.iter().position(|a| a == "--import-save") {
        let code = args.get(i + 1).map(|s| import_save_cli(s)).unwrap_or(std::process::ExitCode::FAILURE);
        std::process::exit(if code == std::process::ExitCode::SUCCESS { 0 } else { 1 });
    }
    let mut viewport = egui::ViewportBuilder::default()
        .with_inner_size([1280.0, 820.0])
        .with_min_inner_size([980.0, 640.0])
        .with_title("EmblemWeave");
    if let Some(icon) = window_icon() {
        viewport = viewport.with_icon(icon);
    }
    eframe::run_native(
        "EmblemWeave",
        eframe::NativeOptions { viewport, ..Default::default() },
        Box::new(|cc| Ok(Box::new(App::new(cc)))),
    )
}

```

`apps/eblemweave/src/mods.rs`:

```rs
//! RomFS mods: the game's `mods` folder, importing archives and folders, and
//! GameBanana.
//!
//! The engine lays every `<mods>/<name>/romfs` over the game's RomFS when the
//! game starts. A mod folder whose name starts with `_` is skipped, which is
//! how a mod is switched off. `exefs/` patches (`.ips`, `.pchtxt`) cannot
//! apply, because the game's code is compiled ahead of time; an import keeps
//! them but says so.
//!
//! Archives are unpacked with Windows' own `tar.exe` (libarchive), which reads
//! zip, 7z and rar. GameBanana is read through its public API with Windows'
//! own `curl.exe`.

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::process::Command;

/// What EmblemWeave records about a mod it installed, in `emblemweave.json`.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Info {
    pub title: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub source: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub author: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub version: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub gamebanana_id: Option<u64>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Mod {
    pub path: PathBuf,
    pub name: String,
    pub enabled: bool,
    pub info: Info,
    pub files: usize,
    pub has_romfs: bool,
    pub has_exefs: bool,
}

pub fn dir() -> Option<PathBuf> {
    crate::engine::run_dir().map(|d| d.join("mods"))
}

/// Where removed mods go (outside the mods folder, so the engine never sees them).
pub fn removed_dir() -> Option<PathBuf> {
    crate::engine::run_dir().map(|d| d.join("mods-removed"))
}

fn find_named(root: &Path, name: &str, depth: usize, out: &mut Vec<PathBuf>) {
    let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(root) else { return };
    for e in entries.flatten() {
        let p = e.path();
        if p.is_dir() {
            if p.file_name().is_some_and(|n| n.to_string_lossy().eq_ignore_ascii_case(name)) {
                out.push(p);
            } else if depth > 0 {
                find_named(&p, name, depth - 1, out);
            }
        }
    }
}

pub fn list(mods: &Path) -> Vec<Mod> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(mods) else { return out };
    for e in entries.flatten() {
        let path = e.path();
        if !path.is_dir() {
            continue;
        }
        let folder = e.file_name().to_string_lossy().into_owned();
        let enabled = !(folder.starts_with('_') || folder.starts_with('-'));
        let name = folder.trim_start_matches(['_', '-']).to_string();
        let info = std::fs::read_to_string(path.join("emblemweave.json"))
            .ok()
            .and_then(|t| serde_json::from_str(&t).ok())
            .unwrap_or_else(|| Info { title: name.clone(), ..Info::default() });
        let (mut r, mut x) = (Vec::new(), Vec::new());
        find_named(&path, "romfs", 3, &mut r);
        find_named(&path, "exefs", 3, &mut x);
        out.push(Mod { files: crate::saves::summary(&path).0, path, name, enabled, info, has_romfs: !r.is_empty(), has_exefs: !x.is_empty() });
    }
    out.sort_by(|a, b| a.name.to_lowercase().cmp(&b.name.to_lowercase()));
    out
}

pub fn set_enabled(m: &Mod, on: bool) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
    let parent = m.path.parent().ok_or("no parent folder")?;
    let to = parent.join(if on { m.name.clone() } else { format!("_{}", m.name) });
    if to == m.path {
        return Ok(to);
    }
    std::fs::rename(&m.path, &to).map_err(|e| format!("renaming {}: {e}", m.path.display()))?;
    Ok(to)
}

/// Move a mod out of the mods folder into `mods-removed`.
pub fn remove(m: &Mod) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
    let bin = removed_dir().ok_or("APPDATA is not set")?;
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&bin).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let mut to = bin.join(&m.name);
    let mut n = 1;
    while to.exists() {
        n += 1;
        to = bin.join(format!("{} ({n})", m.name));
    }
    std::fs::rename(&m.path, &to).map_err(|e| format!("moving {}: {e}", m.path.display()))?;
    Ok(to)
}

/// A folder name safe on Windows.
pub fn clean_name(s: &str) -> String {
    let t: String = s.chars().map(|c| if c.is_control() || r#"<>:"/\|?*"#.contains(c) { '_' } else { c }).collect();
    let t = t.trim().trim_matches('.').trim_start_matches(['_', '-']).trim().to_string();
    if t.is_empty() { "mod".into() } else { t.chars().take(80).collect() }
}

fn hidden(cmd: &mut Command) -> &mut Command {
    #[cfg(windows)]
    {
        use std::os::windows::process::CommandExt;
        cmd.creation_flags(0x0800_0000);
    }
    cmd
}

fn system_tool(name: &str) -> PathBuf {
    let sys = std::env::var_os("SystemRoot").map(PathBuf::from).unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from(r"C:\Windows"));
    let p = sys.join("System32").join(name);
    if p.is_file() { p } else { PathBuf::from(name) }
}

fn unpack(archive: &Path, to: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
    std::fs::create_dir_all(to).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let out = hidden(Command::new(system_tool("tar.exe")).arg("-xf").arg(archive).arg("-C").arg(to))
        .output()
        .map_err(|e| format!("running tar: {e}"))?;
    if !out.status.success() {
        return Err(format!("could not unpack {}: {}", archive.display(), String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stderr).trim()));
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn copy_tree(from: &Path, to: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
    std::fs::create_dir_all(to).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    for e in std::fs::read_dir(from).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?.flatten() {
        let (s, d) = (e.path(), to.join(e.file_name()));
        if s.is_dir() {
            copy_tree(&s, &d)?;
        } else {
            std::fs::copy(&s, &d).map_err(|e| format!("copying {}: {e}", s.display()))?;
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// Top-level RomFS folders of this game, used to recognise a mod packed
/// without a `romfs` folder.
const ROMFS_TOP: &[&str] = &["Animation", "Character", "Effect", "Font", "GameData", "Graphics", "Layout", "Map", "Movie", "Msg", "Sound", "Shader"];

/// What an install did.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Installed {
    pub mods: Vec<String>,
    pub exefs_only: bool,
}

/// Install the mod in `staged` (an unpacked archive or a folder) into `mods`.
/// Every `romfs` folder found becomes a mod; when there are several (an
/// archive offering variants), all but the first are installed switched off.
pub fn install_from(staged: &Path, mods: &Path, info: &Info) -> Result<Installed, String> {
    let mut romfs = Vec::new();
    find_named(staged, "romfs", 4, &mut romfs);
    romfs.sort();
    if romfs.is_empty() {
        // A folder whose top level looks like the game's RomFS.
        let mut root = staged.to_path_buf();
        for _ in 0..3 {
            let looks = std::fs::read_dir(&root)
                .map(|d| d.flatten().any(|e| ROMFS_TOP.iter().any(|t| e.file_name().to_string_lossy().eq_ignore_ascii_case(t))))
                .unwrap_or(false);
            if looks {
                romfs.push(root.clone());
                break;
            }
            let subdirs: Vec<PathBuf> = std::fs::read_dir(&root).map(|d| d.flatten().map(|e| e.path()).filter(|p| p.is_dir()).collect()).unwrap_or_default();
            if subdirs.len() != 1 {
                break;
            }
            root = subdirs[0].clone();
        }
    }
    let mut exefs = Vec::new();
    find_named(staged, "exefs", 4, &mut exefs);
    if romfs.is_empty() {
        if !exefs.is_empty() {
            return Ok(Installed { mods: Vec::new(), exefs_only: true });
        }
        return Err("no romfs folder or game files were found in it".into());
    }
    std::fs::create_dir_all(mods).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let base = clean_name(&info.title);
    let mut names = Vec::new();
    for (i, r) in romfs.iter().enumerate() {
        let variant = r.parent().filter(|p| *p != staged && romfs.len() > 1).and_then(|p| p.strip_prefix(staged).ok()).map(|p| p.display().to_string());
        let mut name = match &variant {
            Some(v) if !v.is_empty() => clean_name(&format!("{base} - {v}")),
            _ => base.clone(),
        };
        let first = name.clone();
        let mut n = 1;
        while mods.join(&name).exists() || mods.join(format!("_{name}")).exists() {
            n += 1;
            name = format!("{first} ({n})");
        }
        let folder = mods.join(if i == 0 { name.clone() } else { format!("_{name}") });
        copy_tree(r, &folder.join("romfs"))?;
        let mut info = info.clone();
        info.title = name.clone();
        let _ = std::fs::write(folder.join("emblemweave.json"), serde_json::to_string_pretty(&info).unwrap_or_default());
        names.push(name);
    }
    Ok(Installed { mods: names, exefs_only: false })
}

fn staging() -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
    let base = crate::engine::run_dir().ok_or("APPDATA is not set")?.join("mods-incoming");
    let stamp = std::time::SystemTime::now().duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).map(|d| d.as_nanos()).unwrap_or(0);
    let d = base.join(stamp.to_string());
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&d).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    Ok(d)
}

/// Install from an archive (.zip, .7z, .rar) or a folder.
pub fn install(source: &Path, mods: &Path, mut info: Info) -> Result<Installed, String> {
    if info.title.is_empty() {
        info.title = source.file_stem().map(|s| s.to_string_lossy().into_owned()).unwrap_or_else(|| "mod".into());
    }
    if source.is_dir() {
        return install_from(source, mods, &info);
    }
    let stage = staging()?;
    let r = unpack(source, &stage).and_then(|_| install_from(&stage, mods, &info));
    let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&stage);
    r
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- GameBanana

/// Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave on GameBanana.
pub const GAMEBANANA_GAME: u64 = 26274;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct GbMod {
    pub id: u64,
    pub kind: String,
    pub name: String,
    pub author: String,
    pub version: String,
    pub likes: u64,
    pub url: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct GbFile {
    pub name: String,
    pub size: u64,
    pub url: String,
    pub description: String,
}

fn fetch(url: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
    let out = hidden(Command::new(system_tool("curl.exe")).args(["-sSfL", "--max-time", "600", "-A", "EmblemWeave", url]))
        .output()
        .map_err(|e| format!("running curl: {e}"))?;
    if !out.status.success() {
        return Err(format!("download failed: {}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stderr).trim()));
    }
    Ok(out.stdout)
}

fn json(url: &str) -> Result<serde_json::Value, String> {
    serde_json::from_slice(&fetch(url)?).map_err(|e| format!("GameBanana answered with something unexpected: {e}"))
}

fn s(v: &serde_json::Value, k: &str) -> String {
    v.get(k).and_then(|x| x.as_str()).unwrap_or_default().to_string()
}

/// One page of the game's submissions, newest first.
pub fn gb_list(page: u32) -> Result<(Vec<GbMod>, bool), String> {
    let v = json(&format!("https://gamebanana.com/apiv11/Game/{GAMEBANANA_GAME}/Subfeed?_nPage={page}&_sSort=new"))?;
    let done = v.pointer("/_aMetadata/_bIsComplete").and_then(|b| b.as_bool()).unwrap_or(true);
    let mods = v
        .get("_aRecords")
        .and_then(|r| r.as_array())
        .map(|a| {
            a.iter()
                .filter(|r| r.get("_bHasFiles").and_then(|b| b.as_bool()).unwrap_or(true))
                .map(|r| GbMod {
                    id: r.get("_idRow").and_then(|x| x.as_u64()).unwrap_or(0),
                    kind: s(r, "_sModelName"),
                    name: s(r, "_sName"),
                    author: r.get("_aSubmitter").map(|a| s(a, "_sName")).unwrap_or_default(),
                    version: s(r, "_sVersion"),
                    likes: r.get("_nLikeCount").and_then(|x| x.as_u64()).unwrap_or(0),
                    url: s(r, "_sProfileUrl"),
                })
                .collect()
        })
        .unwrap_or_default();
    Ok((mods, !done))
}

/// The mod id in a GameBanana link (`https://gamebanana.com/mods/738457`).
pub fn gb_id(link: &str) -> Option<u64> {
    let t = link.trim().trim_end_matches('/');
    if let Ok(n) = t.parse() {
        return Some(n);
    }
    let i = t.find("/mods/")?;
    t[i + 6..].split(|c: char| !c.is_ascii_digit()).next()?.parse().ok()
}

pub fn gb_mod(id: u64) -> Result<(GbMod, Vec<GbFile>), String> {
    let v = json(&format!("https://gamebanana.com/apiv11/Mod/{id}?_csvProperties=_sName,_aFiles,_aSubmitter,_sVersion,_sProfileUrl"))?;
    let m = GbMod {
        id,
        kind: "Mod".into(),
        name: s(&v, "_sName"),
        author: v.get("_aSubmitter").map(|a| s(a, "_sName")).unwrap_or_default(),
        version: s(&v, "_sVersion"),
        likes: 0,
        url: s(&v, "_sProfileUrl"),
    };
    let files = v
        .get("_aFiles")
        .and_then(|f| f.as_array())
        .map(|a| {
            a.iter()
                .map(|f| GbFile {
                    name: s(f, "_sFile"),
                    size: f.get("_nFilesize").and_then(|x| x.as_u64()).unwrap_or(0),
                    url: s(f, "_sDownloadUrl"),
                    description: s(f, "_sDescription"),
                })
                .collect()
        })
        .unwrap_or_default();
    Ok((m, files))
}

/// Download one of a mod's files and install it.
pub fn gb_install(m: &GbMod, file: &GbFile, mods: &Path) -> Result<Installed, String> {
    if !file.url.starts_with("https://gamebanana.com/") {
        return Err("that download is not on gamebanana.com".into());
    }
    let stage = staging()?;
    let archive = stage.join(clean_name(&file.name));
    let r = fetch(&file.url).and_then(|bytes| {
        std::fs::write(&archive, bytes).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let unpacked = stage.join("unpacked");
        unpack(&archive, &unpacked)?;
        let info = Info { title: m.name.clone(), source: m.url.clone(), author: m.author.clone(), version: m.version.clone(), gamebanana_id: Some(m.id) };
        install_from(&unpacked, mods, &info)
    });
    let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&stage);
    r
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn temp(name: &str) -> PathBuf {
        let d = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("ew-mods-{name}-{}", std::process::id()));
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&d);
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&d).unwrap();
        d
    }

    fn write(p: &Path) {
        std::fs::create_dir_all(p.parent().unwrap()).unwrap();
        std::fs::write(p, "x").unwrap();
    }

    #[test]
    fn installs_romfs_layouts() {
        let root = temp("layouts");
        let mods = root.join("mods");
        // romfs folder below a top folder
        let a = root.join("a");
        write(&a.join("FEFW-Witch/romfs/Character/x.bin"));
        let r = install_from(&a, &mods, &Info { title: "Witch".into(), ..Info::default() }).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(r.mods, vec!["Witch".to_string()]);
        assert!(mods.join("Witch/romfs/Character/x.bin").is_file());
        // bare game folders
        let b = root.join("b");
        write(&b.join("Mod/GameData/Person.bin"));
        install_from(&b, &mods, &Info { title: "Recruit".into(), ..Info::default() }).unwrap();
        assert!(mods.join("Recruit/romfs/GameData/Person.bin").is_file());
        // exefs only
        let c = root.join("c");
        write(&c.join("60 FPS/exefs/fps.pchtxt"));
        assert!(install_from(&c, &mods, &Info { title: "fps".into(), ..Info::default() }).unwrap().exefs_only);
        // variants: second one off
        let d = root.join("d");
        write(&d.join("Light/romfs/Msg/a"));
        write(&d.join("Dark/romfs/Msg/a"));
        let r = install_from(&d, &mods, &Info { title: "Theme".into(), ..Info::default() }).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(r.mods.len(), 2);
        let l = list(&mods);
        assert_eq!(l.iter().filter(|m| m.name.starts_with("Theme")).filter(|m| m.enabled).count(), 1);
        // toggle
        let w = l.iter().find(|m| m.name == "Witch").unwrap();
        let off = set_enabled(w, false).unwrap();
        assert!(off.ends_with("_Witch"));
        assert!(!list(&mods).iter().find(|m| m.name == "Witch").unwrap().enabled);
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(root);
    }

    #[test]
    fn reads_gamebanana_links() {
        assert_eq!(gb_id("https://gamebanana.com/mods/738457"), Some(738457));
        assert_eq!(gb_id("gamebanana.com/mods/737235/"), Some(737235));
        assert_eq!(gb_id("737235"), Some(737235));
        assert_eq!(gb_id("https://example.com"), None);
    }

    /// Installs a real mod from GameBanana (network).
    #[test]
    #[ignore]
    fn live_gamebanana_install() {
        let (feed, _) = gb_list(1).unwrap();
        assert!(!feed.is_empty());
        let mods = temp("gb");
        let (m, files) = gb_mod(737235).unwrap();
        println!("{} by {}: {:?}", m.name, m.author, files.iter().map(|f| &f.name).collect::<Vec<_>>());
        let r = gb_install(&m, &files[0], &mods).unwrap();
        println!("{r:?}");
        let l = list(&mods);
        assert!(l[0].has_romfs && l[0].enabled);
        assert_eq!(l[0].info.gamebanana_id, Some(737235));
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(mods);
    }
}
```

```rs
//! Appearance: choose the launcher's colour scheme from live previews.

use crate::theme::{self, Scheme};
use crate::widgets::{self, Tone};
use crate::{logo, App};
use eframe::egui::{self, RichText};

pub fn show(app: &mut App, ui: &mut egui::Ui) {
    let p = app.config.theme.palette();
    widgets::page_header(ui, &p, "Appearance", "Three coordinated schemes. Each preview is drawn in its own palette; the choice is saved.");
    let mut chosen = None;
    for scheme in Scheme::ALL {
        let sp = scheme.palette();
        let active = app.config.theme == scheme;
        let r = egui::Frame::new()
            .fill(sp.bg)
            .stroke(egui::Stroke::new(if active { 2.0_f32 } else { 1.0_f32 }, if active { sp.electric } else { sp.line }))
            .corner_radius(egui::CornerRadius::same(theme::RADIUS_M + 2))
            .inner_margin(egui::Margin::same(18))
            .show(ui, |ui| {
                ui.set_width(ui.available_width());
                ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                    logo::show_lockup(ui, &sp, 300.0);
                    ui.add_space(theme::SPACE_L);
                    ui.vertical(|ui| {
                        ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                            ui.label(RichText::new(scheme.label()).font(theme::display(22.0)).color(sp.ink));
                            if active {
                                widgets::pill(ui, &sp, "Active", Tone::Accent);
                            }
                        });
                        ui.label(RichText::new(scheme.detail()).size(13.0).color(sp.body));
                        ui.add_space(theme::SPACE_S);
                        ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                            for (name, c) in [
                                ("Background", sp.bg),
                                ("Surface", sp.surface),
                                ("Border", sp.line),
                                ("Text", sp.ink),
                                ("Accent", sp.accent),
                                ("Highlight", sp.electric),
                                ("Gold", sp.gold),
                            ] {
                                let (rect, resp) = ui.allocate_exact_size(egui::vec2(30.0, 20.0), egui::Sense::hover());
                                ui.painter().rect_filled(rect, 4, c);
                                ui.painter().rect_stroke(rect, 4, egui::Stroke::new(1.0_f32, sp.line), egui::StrokeKind::Inside);
                                resp.on_hover_text(format!("{name}  #{:02X}{:02X}{:02X}", c.r(), c.g(), c.b()));
                            }
                        });
                        ui.add_space(theme::SPACE_S);
                        if !active && widgets::button(ui, &sp, "Use this scheme", true).clicked() {
                            chosen = Some(scheme);
                        }
                    });
                });
            });
        if r.response.interact(egui::Sense::click()).clicked() && !active {
            chosen = Some(scheme);
        }
        ui.add_space(theme::SPACE_M);
    }
    if let Some(s) = chosen {
        app.config.theme = s;
        app.note(format!("Theme set to {}", s.label()), Tone::Neutral);
    }
}
```

```rs
//! Cheats: Atmosphere cheat codes to switch on and off, and Cheat Engine
//! tables with live, editable and freezable values.

use crate::cheats::{self, Code, Entry, Memory, Table};
use crate::theme;
use crate::widgets::{self, Tone};
use crate::App;
use eframe::egui::{self, RichText};
use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};
use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};

struct CodeFile {
    name: String,
    path: PathBuf,
    codes: Vec<Code>,
    error: Option<String>,
}

struct TableState {
    table: Table,
    path: PathBuf,
    symbols: HashMap<String, u64>,
    /// Script entries switched on, by id.
    active: HashSet<String>,
    edits: HashMap<String, String>,
    frozen: HashMap<String, (u64, Vec<u8>)>,
    notes: HashMap<String, String>,
    /// Pattern searches still running, by entry id.
    pending: HashMap<String, Arc<Mutex<Option<Vec<(String, Option<u64>)>>>>>,
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct Ui {
    loaded: bool,
    files: Vec<CodeFile>,
    enabled: HashMap<String, Vec<String>>,
    new_name: String,
    new_codes: String,
    tables: Vec<TableState>,
    runner: Option<cheats::Handle>,
    /// Unit records found in the game's memory, and the search under way.
    units: Vec<u64>,
    searching: Option<Arc<Mutex<Option<Vec<u64>>>>>,
    /// Per unit: infinite HP, quick level-up, max stats.
    unit_cheats: HashMap<u64, [bool; 3]>,
    /// The values those cheats hold, refreshed while the menu is open.
    unit_freezes: Vec<(u64, Vec<u8>)>,
}

fn load(ui_state: &mut Ui, dir: &std::path::Path) {
    ui_state.files.clear();
    ui_state.tables.clear();
    ui_state.enabled = cheats::load_enabled(dir);
    let mut entries: Vec<PathBuf> = std::fs::read_dir(dir).map(|d| d.flatten().map(|e| e.path()).collect()).unwrap_or_default();
    entries.sort();
    for path in entries {
        let ext = path.extension().and_then(|e| e.to_str()).unwrap_or("").to_ascii_lowercase();
        let name = path.file_name().unwrap_or_default().to_string_lossy().into_owned();
        let Ok(text) = std::fs::read_to_string(&path) else { continue };
        match ext.as_str() {
            "txt" => {
                let (codes, error) = match cheats::parse_codes(&text) {
                    Ok(c) => (c, None),
                    Err(e) => (Vec::new(), Some(e)),
                };
                ui_state.files.push(CodeFile { name, path, codes, error });
            }
            "ct" => {
                if let Ok(table) = cheats::parse_table(&name, &text) {
                    ui_state.tables.push(TableState {
                        table,
                        path,
                        symbols: HashMap::new(),
                        active: HashSet::new(),
                        edits: HashMap::new(),
                        frozen: HashMap::new(),
                        notes: HashMap::new(),
                        pending: HashMap::new(),
                    });
                }
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }
    ui_state.loaded = true;
}

fn copy_in(dir: &std::path::Path, from: &std::path::Path) -> Result<(), String> {
    std::fs::create_dir_all(dir).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let to = dir.join(from.file_name().ok_or("no file name")?);
    std::fs::copy(from, &to).map_err(|e| format!("copying {}: {e}", from.display()))?;
    Ok(())
}

pub fn show(app: &mut App, ui: &mut egui::Ui) {
    let p = app.config.theme.palette();
    widgets::page_header(ui, &p, "Cheats", "Atmosphere cheat codes and Cheat Engine tables, applied to the game while it runs.");
    let Some(dir) = cheats::dir() else { return };
    let mut message: Option<(String, Tone)> = None;
    if !app.cheats_ui.loaded {
        load(&mut app.cheats_ui, &dir);
    }
    #[cfg(windows)]
    if app.cheats_ui.runner.is_none() {
        app.cheats_ui.runner = Some(cheats::start());
    }
    let game = cheats::game();
    ui.ctx().request_repaint_after(std::time::Duration::from_millis(300));

    match &game {
        Some(g) => widgets::status_line(ui, &p, Tone::Ok, "Game running", &format!("Attached to {} (process {}). Switched-on codes are applied about 60 times a second.", cheats::GAME_EXE, g.pid)),
        None => widgets::status_line(ui, &p, Tone::Neutral, "Game not running", "Switch codes on here; they apply as soon as the game starts. Table values show while it runs."),
    }
    ui.add_space(theme::SPACE_S);

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ codes
    let mut enabled_changed = false;
    widgets::section(ui, &p, "Cheat codes (Atmosphere format)", |ui| {
        if app.cheats_ui.files.is_empty() {
            ui.label(RichText::new("No cheat files yet. Add codes below or import a .txt from a cheats folder.").color(p.muted));
        }
        for f in &app.cheats_ui.files {
            ui.label(RichText::new(&f.name).font(theme::semibold(14.0)).color(p.ink));
            if let Some(e) = &f.error {
                widgets::status_line(ui, &p, Tone::Bad, "Could not read it", e);
            }
            let on = app.cheats_ui.enabled.entry(f.name.clone()).or_default();
            for c in &f.codes {
                ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                    ui.add_space(12.0);
                    if c.master {
                        widgets::pill(ui, &p, "master", Tone::Accent);
                        ui.label(RichText::new(&c.name).color(p.body)).on_hover_text("Runs whenever any code of this file is on");
                        return;
                    }
                    let mut is_on = on.contains(&c.name);
                    if widgets::toggle(ui, &p, &mut is_on).changed() {
                        if is_on {
                            on.push(c.name.clone());
                        } else {
                            on.retain(|n| n != &c.name);
                        }
                        enabled_changed = true;
                    }
                    ui.label(RichText::new(&c.name).color(p.ink));
                    ui.label(RichText::new(format!("{} words", c.words.len())).size(12.0).color(p.muted));
                });
            }
            ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                ui.add_space(12.0);
                if widgets::button(ui, &p, "Edit file", true).clicked() {
                    let _ = std::process::Command::new("notepad").arg(&f.path).spawn();
                }
            });
            ui.add_space(6.0);
        }
        ui.separator();
        ui.label(RichText::new("Add codes").font(theme::semibold(14.0)).color(p.ink));
        ui.label(
            RichText::new("Paste codes as they are shared for Atmosphere: a [Name] line, then the code's hex words. Several codes can go in one paste.")
                .size(12.5)
                .color(p.muted),
        );
        ui.horizontal(|ui| {
            ui.label("File name");
            ui.add(egui::TextEdit::singleline(&mut app.cheats_ui.new_name).hint_text("my-codes").desired_width(200.0));
        });
        ui.add(egui::TextEdit::multiline(&mut app.cheats_ui.new_codes).font(egui::TextStyle::Monospace).desired_rows(6).desired_width(f32::INFINITY).hint_text("[Max gold]\n04100000 01234567 0098967F"));
        ui.horizontal(|ui| {
            let parsed = cheats::parse_codes(&app.cheats_ui.new_codes);
            let ok = matches!(&parsed, Ok(c) if !c.is_empty());
            if widgets::button(ui, &p, "Add", ok).clicked() {
                let name = crate::mods::clean_name(if app.cheats_ui.new_name.trim().is_empty() { "codes" } else { app.cheats_ui.new_name.trim() });
                let path = dir.join(format!("{name}.txt"));
                let mut text = std::fs::read_to_string(&path).unwrap_or_default();
                if !text.is_empty() && !text.ends_with('\n') {
                    text.push('\n');
                }
                text.push_str(app.cheats_ui.new_codes.trim());
                text.push('\n');
                let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir);
                message = Some(match std::fs::write(&path, text) {
                    Ok(()) => (format!("Added to {}", path.display()), Tone::Ok),
                    Err(e) => (format!("Could not write {}: {e}", path.display()), Tone::Bad),
                });
                app.cheats_ui.new_codes.clear();
                app.cheats_ui.loaded = false;
            }
            if let Err(e) = &parsed {
                if !app.cheats_ui.new_codes.trim().is_empty() {
                    ui.label(RichText::new(e).color(p.bad));
                }
            }
            if widgets::button(ui, &p, "Import .txt…", true).clicked() {
                if let Some(f) = rfd::FileDialog::new().add_filter("Atmosphere cheats", &["txt"]).pick_file() {
                    message = Some(match copy_in(&dir, &f) {
                        Ok(()) => ("Imported the cheat file".into(), Tone::Ok),
                        Err(e) => (e, Tone::Bad),
                    });
                    app.cheats_ui.loaded = false;
                }
            }
            if widgets::button(ui, &p, "Open cheats folder", true).clicked() {
                let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir);
                let _ = std::process::Command::new("explorer").arg(&dir).spawn();
            }
            if widgets::button(ui, &p, "Reload", true).clicked() {
                app.cheats_ui.loaded = false;
            }
        });
        ui.label(
            RichText::new("Codes that patch the game's instructions do nothing here (the code is compiled ahead of time); codes that change data, follow pointers or test buttons work. Button tests read the first controller.")
                .size(12.5)
                .color(p.muted),
        );
    });
    if enabled_changed {
        cheats::save_enabled(&dir, &app.cheats_ui.enabled);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ tables
    widgets::section(ui, &p, "Cheat Engine tables", |ui| {
        ui.horizontal(|ui| {
            if widgets::button(ui, &p, "Load table…", true).clicked() {
                if let Some(f) = rfd::FileDialog::new().add_filter("Cheat Engine table", &["CT", "ct"]).pick_file() {
                    message = Some(match std::fs::read_to_string(&f).map_err(|e| e.to_string()).and_then(|t| cheats::parse_table("", &t)).and_then(|_| copy_in(&dir, &f)) {
                        Ok(()) => ("Loaded the table".into(), Tone::Ok),
                        Err(e) => (e, Tone::Bad),
                    });
                    app.cheats_ui.loaded = false;
                }
            }
        });
        ui.label(
            RichText::new("Switch on a script entry to find its pattern in the game's memory; the values below it then show live. Type a value and press Enter to write it, or tick Freeze to hold it.")
                .size(12.5)
                .color(p.muted),
        );
        for (ti, t) in app.cheats_ui.tables.iter_mut().enumerate() {
            egui::CollapsingHeader::new(RichText::new(&t.table.name).font(theme::semibold(14.0)).color(p.ink)).id_salt(("table", ti)).default_open(true).show(ui, |ui| {
                let entries = t.table.entries.clone();
                for e in &entries {
                    entry(ui, &p, t, e, None, game.as_ref(), &mut message);
                }
                if widgets::button(ui, &p, "Remove table", true).clicked() {
                    let _ = std::fs::rename(&t.path, t.path.with_extension("CT.removed"));
                    app.cheats_ui.loaded = false;
                }
            });
        }
    });

    // Hand the switched-on codes and frozen values to the cheat thread.
    if let Some(r) = &app.cheats_ui.runner {
        let mut codes = Vec::new();
        for f in &app.cheats_ui.files {
            let on = app.cheats_ui.enabled.get(&f.name).cloned().unwrap_or_default();
            if on.is_empty() {
                continue;
            }
            codes.extend(f.codes.iter().filter(|c| c.master).cloned());
            codes.extend(f.codes.iter().filter(|c| !c.master && on.contains(&c.name)).cloned());
        }
        let mut freezes: Vec<(u64, Vec<u8>)> = app.cheats_ui.tables.iter().flat_map(|t| t.frozen.values().cloned()).collect();
        freezes.extend(app.cheats_ui.unit_freezes.iter().cloned());
        let mut s = r.lock().unwrap();
        s.codes = codes;
        s.freezes = freezes;
    }
    if let Some((text, tone)) = message {
        app.notify(text, tone);
    }
}

type Game = crate::cheats::process::Process;

fn entry(ui: &mut egui::Ui, p: &crate::theme::Palette, t: &mut TableState, e: &Entry, parent: Option<u64>, game: Option<&Arc<Game>>, message: &mut Option<(String, Tone)>) {
    let mut addr = None;
    let script = !e.scans.is_empty() || e.unsupported_script;
    let done = t.pending.get(&e.id).and_then(|s| s.lock().unwrap().take());
    if let Some(found) = done {
        t.pending.remove(&e.id);
        if !found.is_empty() && found.iter().all(|(_, a)| a.is_some()) {
            for (sym, a) in found {
                t.symbols.insert(sym, a.unwrap());
            }
            t.active.insert(e.id.clone());
            t.notes.insert(e.id.clone(), "found".into());
        } else {
            t.notes.insert(e.id.clone(), "pattern not found (the data may not be loaded yet: try again in game)".into());
        }
    }
    if script {
        ui.horizontal(|ui| {
            let mut on = t.active.contains(&e.id) || t.pending.contains_key(&e.id);
            let r = widgets::toggle(ui, p, &mut on);
            ui.label(RichText::new(&e.description).font(theme::semibold(13.5)).color(p.ink));
            if e.unsupported_script {
                ui.label(RichText::new("uses script commands EmblemWeave cannot run").size(12.0).color(p.warn));
            }
            if let Some(n) = t.notes.get(&e.id) {
                ui.label(RichText::new(n).size(12.0).color(p.muted));
            }
            if r.changed() {
                if on {
                    match game {
                        None => *message = Some(("Start the game first: the pattern is searched in its memory".into(), Tone::Warn)),
                        Some(g) => {
                            let (g, scans) = (g.clone(), e.scans.clone());
                            let slot: Arc<Mutex<Option<Vec<(String, Option<u64>)>>>> = Default::default();
                            let out = slot.clone();
                            std::thread::spawn(move || {
                                let r = scans
                                    .iter()
                                    .map(|s| (s.symbol.to_ascii_lowercase(), cheats::aob_scan_parallel(g.as_ref(), cheats::GUEST_RANGE.0, cheats::GUEST_RANGE.1, &s.pattern)))
                                    .collect();
                                *out.lock().unwrap() = Some(r);
                            });
                            t.pending.insert(e.id.clone(), slot);
                            t.notes.insert(e.id.clone(), "searching the game's memory…".into());
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    t.active.remove(&e.id);
                    t.pending.remove(&e.id);
                    for s in &e.scans {
                        t.symbols.remove(&s.symbol.to_ascii_lowercase());
                    }
                    t.notes.remove(&e.id);
                    let ids: Vec<String> = all_ids(e);
                    t.frozen.retain(|k, _| !ids.contains(k));
                }
            }
        });
    }
    if let Some(var) = e.var {
        addr = cheats::resolve(&e.address, parent, &t.symbols);
        ui.horizontal(|ui| {
            ui.add_space(if parent.is_some() { 24.0 } else { 0.0 });
            ui.label(RichText::new(&e.description).color(p.body));
            match (addr, game) {
                (Some(a), Some(g)) => {
                    let mut buf = vec![0u8; var.size()];
                    let value = if g.read(a, &mut buf) { var.format(&buf, e.signed) } else { "??".into() };
                    ui.label(RichText::new(&value).font(theme::mono(13.0)).color(p.ink)).on_hover_text(format!("{a:#x}"));
                    let text = t.edits.entry(e.id.clone()).or_default();
                    let r = ui.add(egui::TextEdit::singleline(text).desired_width(90.0).hint_text("new value"));
                    if r.lost_focus() && ui.input(|i| i.key_pressed(egui::Key::Enter)) {
                        match var.encode(text) {
                            Some(b) => {
                                if !g.write(a, &b) {
                                    *message = Some(("Could not write to the game's memory".into(), Tone::Bad));
                                }
                                if let Some(f) = t.frozen.get_mut(&e.id) {
                                    f.1 = b;
                                }
                            }
                            None => *message = Some((format!("{text:?} is not a valid value"), Tone::Bad)),
                        }
                        text.clear();
                    }
                    let mut frozen = t.frozen.contains_key(&e.id);
                    if ui.checkbox(&mut frozen, "Freeze").changed() {
                        if frozen {
                            t.frozen.insert(e.id.clone(), (a, buf));
                        } else {
                            t.frozen.remove(&e.id);
                        }
                    }
                }
                (None, _) => {
                    ui.label(RichText::new("switch on the entry above").size(12.0).color(p.muted));
                }
                (Some(_), None) => {
                    ui.label(RichText::new("game not running").size(12.0).color(p.muted));
                }
            }
        });
    } else if !script && !e.group && !e.address.is_empty() {
        addr = cheats::resolve(&e.address, parent, &t.symbols);
    }
    if e.children.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    let child_parent = addr.or(parent);
    if script || e.group {
        egui::CollapsingHeader::new(if script { "Values".to_string() } else { e.description.clone() }).id_salt(("ce", &t.table.name, &e.id)).default_open(script && t.active.contains(&e.id)).show(ui, |ui| {
            for c in &e.children {
                entry(ui, p, t, c, child_parent, game, message);
            }
        });
    } else {
        ui.indent(("ce", &e.id), |ui| {
            for c in &e.children {
                entry(ui, p, t, c, child_parent, game, message);
            }
        });
    }
}

fn all_ids(e: &Entry) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut v = vec![e.id.clone()];
    for c in &e.children {
        v.extend(all_ids(c));
    }
    v
}

const QUICK: [(&str, &str); 3] = [
    ("Infinite HP", "HP is held at max HP"),
    ("Quick level-up", "experience is held at 99, so the next experience gained levels the unit up"),
    ("Max stats", "max HP and every stat set to 99 (the game may cap them by class)"),
];

/// Quick cheats: per-unit switches for the units found in the game's memory.
pub fn quick(app: &mut App, ui: &mut egui::Ui) {
    let p = app.config.theme.palette();
    if app.cheats_ui.runner.is_none() {
        app.cheats_ui.runner = Some(cheats::start());
    }
    let game = cheats::game();
    widgets::section(ui, &p, "Units on the map", |ui| {
        ui.label(
            RichText::new("Finds the units in the game's memory by the layout their records share (experimental: results may include units not on the map). Search once a map is loaded, and again on the next map.")
                .size(12.5)
                .color(p.muted),
        );
        ui.horizontal(|ui| {
            let busy = app.cheats_ui.searching.is_some();
            if widgets::button(ui, &p, if busy { "Searching…" } else { "Find units" }, game.is_some() && !busy).clicked() {
                let g = game.clone().unwrap();
                let slot: Arc<Mutex<Option<Vec<u64>>>> = Default::default();
                let out = slot.clone();
                std::thread::spawn(move || {
                    let v = cheats::scan_units(g.as_ref());
                    *out.lock().unwrap() = Some(v);
                });
                app.cheats_ui.searching = Some(slot);
            }
            if game.is_none() {
                ui.label(RichText::new("Start the game first.").color(p.muted));
            }
        });
        if let Some(done) = app.cheats_ui.searching.as_ref().and_then(|s| s.lock().unwrap().take()) {
            app.cheats_ui.searching = None;
            app.cheats_ui.units = done.into_iter().take(40).collect();
            app.cheats_ui.unit_cheats.retain(|k, _| app.cheats_ui.units.contains(k));
        }
        let Some(g) = game.as_deref() else { return };
        let mut freezes = Vec::new();
        egui::Grid::new("quick-units").num_columns(6).spacing([12.0, 6.0]).striped(true).show(ui, |ui| {
            if !app.cheats_ui.units.is_empty() {
                for h in ["Slot", "Lv", "HP", QUICK[0].0, QUICK[1].0, QUICK[2].0] {
                    ui.label(RichText::new(h).font(theme::semibold(12.0)).color(p.muted));
                }
                ui.end_row();
            }
            for (n, &a) in app.cheats_ui.units.iter().enumerate() {
                let mut b = [0u8; cheats::unit::LEN];
                if !g.read(a, &mut b) || !cheats::looks_like_unit(&b) {
                    continue;
                }
                let max_hp = u16::from_le_bytes([b[8], b[9]]);
                let hp = u16::from_le_bytes([b[0x20], b[0x21]]);
                ui.label(RichText::new(format!("{}", n + 1)).color(p.ink)).on_hover_text(format!("record at {a:#x}"));
                ui.label(format!("{}", b[0x26]));
                ui.label(format!("{hp} / {max_hp}"));
                let on = app.cheats_ui.unit_cheats.entry(a).or_default();
                for (i, (_, help)) in QUICK.iter().enumerate() {
                    widgets::toggle(ui, &p, &mut on[i]).on_hover_text(*help);
                }
                ui.end_row();
                if on[2] {
                    let mut stats = Vec::new();
                    for _ in 0..9 {
                        stats.extend(99u16.to_le_bytes());
                    }
                    freezes.push((a + cheats::unit::STATS, stats));
                }
                let target_hp = if on[2] { 99 } else { max_hp };
                if on[0] {
                    freezes.push((a + cheats::unit::HP, target_hp.to_le_bytes().to_vec()));
                }
                if on[1] {
                    freezes.push((a + cheats::unit::EXP, 99u32.to_le_bytes().to_vec()));
                }
            }
        });
        app.cheats_ui.unit_freezes = freezes;
        ui.label(RichText::new("\"Unit can move again\" is not available yet: where the game keeps a unit's moved flag has not been found.").size(12.0).color(p.muted));
    });
    // The cheat thread picks the held values up from the page's hand-off.
    if let Some(r) = &app.cheats_ui.runner {
        let mut s = r.lock().unwrap();
        s.freezes.retain(|(a, _)| !app.cheats_ui.units.iter().any(|u| *a >= *u && *a < *u + cheats::unit::LEN as u64));
        s.freezes.extend(app.cheats_ui.unit_freezes.iter().cloned());
    }
}
```

```rs
//! Controls: keyboard and controller bindings for the game's actions.

use crate::theme;
use crate::widgets;
use crate::App;
use eframe::egui::{self, RichText};

pub fn show(app: &mut App, ui: &mut egui::Ui) {
    let p = app.config.theme.palette();
    widgets::page_header(ui, &p, "Controls", "Bind the game's actions to your keyboard and controller.");
    widgets::pending_note(
        ui,
        &p,
        "The game reads player 1 from the first XInput gamepad, with buttons mapped by position to the Nintendo layout. Keyboard bindings are saved and apply once the game has its own window.",
    );

    // Key capture: the next key press becomes the binding.
    if let Some(i) = app.capture {
        let pressed = ui.input(|inp| {
            inp.events.iter().find_map(|e| match e {
                egui::Event::Key { key, pressed: true, .. } => Some(*key),
                _ => None,
            })
        });
        if let Some(key) = pressed {
            if key != egui::Key::Escape {
                if let Some(b) = app.config.input.bindings.get_mut(i) {
                    b.key = key.name().to_string();
                }
            }
            app.capture = None;
        }
    }

    widgets::section(ui, &p, "Profile", |ui| {
        widgets::setting_row(ui, &p, "Stick dead zone", "Movement below this is ignored.", |ui| {
            let mut pct = (app.config.input.deadzone * 100.0).round() as u32;
            if ui.add(egui::Slider::new(&mut pct, 0..=50).suffix(" %")).changed() {
                app.config.input.deadzone = pct as f32 / 100.0;
            }
        });
        widgets::setting_row(ui, &p, "Vibration", "", |ui| {
            let mut pct = (app.config.input.vibration * 100.0).round() as u32;
            if ui.add(egui::Slider::new(&mut pct, 0..=100).suffix(" %")).changed() {
                app.config.input.vibration = pct as f32 / 100.0;
            }
        });
    });

    widgets::section(ui, &p, "Bindings", |ui| {
        egui::Grid::new("bindings").num_columns(3).spacing([24.0, 8.0]).striped(true).show(ui, |ui| {
            for h in ["Action", "Keyboard", "Controller"] {
                ui.label(RichText::new(h).font(theme::semibold(12.0)).color(p.muted));
            }
            ui.end_row();
            for (i, b) in app.config.input.bindings.iter_mut().enumerate() {
                ui.label(RichText::new(&b.action).color(p.ink));
                let capturing = app.capture == Some(i);
                let text = if capturing { "Press a key… (Esc cancels)".to_string() } else { b.key.clone() };
                let r = ui.add_sized([210.0, 26.0], egui::Button::new(RichText::new(text).font(theme::mono(12.5))).selected(capturing));
                if r.on_hover_text("Click, then press the key to bind").clicked() {
                    app.capture = Some(i);
                }
                ui.add(egui::TextEdit::singleline(&mut b.pad).desired_width(220.0));
                ui.end_row();
            }
        });
        ui.add_space(theme::SPACE_M);
        if widgets::button(ui, &p, "Reset to defaults", true).clicked() {
            app.confirm = Some(crate::Confirm::ResetBindings);
        }
    });
}
```
