```rs
//! Diagnostics: what the runtime and the pipeline measured, with search and
//! an exportable report.

use crate::theme;
use crate::widgets::{self, Tone};
use crate::App;
use eframe::egui::{self, RichText};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Tab {
    Runtime,
    Recompilation,
    Log,
}

fn matches(filter: &str, text: &str) -> bool {
    filter.is_empty() || text.to_lowercase().contains(&filter.to_lowercase())
}

pub fn show(app: &mut App, ui: &mut egui::Ui) {
    let p = app.config.theme.palette();
    widgets::page_header(ui, &p, "Diagnostics", "Measurements from the runtime and the recompiler, for troubleshooting and bug reports.");

    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        for (tab, label) in [(Tab::Runtime, "Runtime"), (Tab::Recompilation, "Recompilation"), (Tab::Log, "Activity log")] {
            if ui.selectable_label(app.diag_tab == tab, RichText::new(label).font(theme::semibold(14.0))).clicked() {
                app.diag_tab = tab;
            }
        }
        ui.with_layout(egui::Layout::right_to_left(egui::Align::Center), |ui| {
            if widgets::button(ui, &p, "Export report…", true).clicked() {
                export(app);
            }
            ui.add(egui::TextEdit::singleline(&mut app.diag_filter).hint_text("🔍 Filter").desired_width(220.0));
        });
    });
    ui.add_space(theme::SPACE_M);
    let filter = app.diag_filter.clone();

    match app.diag_tab {
        Tab::Runtime => {
            let Some((r, ms)) = &app.last_boot else {
                widgets::section(ui, &p, "", |ui| {
                    ui.label(RichText::new("No boot test has run this session. Run one from the Overview.").color(p.body));
                });
                return;
            };
            widgets::section(ui, &p, "Stop", |ui| {
                widgets::mono_line(ui, &widgets::demangle_line(&r.stop.describe()), p.warn);
                ui.add_space(theme::SPACE_S);
                widgets::kv(ui, &p, "Phase", &r.phase);
                widgets::kv(ui, &p, "Completed phases", &r.phases.join(" → "));
                widgets::kv(ui, &p, "Instructions", &crate::fmt_count(r.steps));
                widgets::kv(ui, &p, "Distinct functions", &crate::fmt_count(r.distinct_functions as u64));
                widgets::kv(ui, &p, "Host calls", &format!("{} ({} services available)", crate::fmt_count(r.host_calls), r.host_implemented));
                widgets::kv(ui, &p, "Threads / switches", &format!("{} / {}", r.threads, crate::fmt_count(r.switches)));
                widgets::kv(ui, &p, "Wall time", &format!("{:.2}s", *ms as f32 / 1000.0));
            });
            widgets::section(ui, &p, "Guest threads", |ui| {
                for t in r.thread_states.iter().filter(|t| matches(&filter, t)) {
                    let tone = if t.contains("running") { Tone::Accent } else if t.contains("waiting") { Tone::Neutral } else { Tone::Warn };
                    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                        widgets::pill(ui, &p, if t.contains("running") { "running" } else if t.contains("waiting") { "waiting" } else { "ready" }, tone);
                        widgets::mono_line(ui, &widgets::demangle_line(t), p.body);
                    });
                }
            });
            widgets::section(ui, &p, "Host events", |ui| {
                for l in r.host_log.iter().filter(|l| matches(&filter, l)) {
                    widgets::mono_line(ui, l, p.body);
                }
            });
            widgets::section(ui, &p, "Imports reached", |ui| {
                egui::ScrollArea::vertical().id_salt("imports").max_height(260.0).show(ui, |ui| {
                    for i in r.import_calls.iter().filter(|i| matches(&filter, &i.name) || matches(&filter, &widgets::demangle(&i.name))) {
                        ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                            ui.add_sized([70.0, 16.0], egui::Label::new(RichText::new(crate::fmt_count(i.calls)).font(theme::mono(12.0)).color(p.accent_hi)));
                            ui.label(RichText::new(widgets::demangle(&i.name)).font(theme::mono(12.0)).color(p.body))
                                .on_hover_text(&i.name);
                        });
                    }
                });
            });
            widgets::section(ui, &p, "Last events before the stop", |ui| {
                egui::ScrollArea::vertical().id_salt("recent").max_height(300.0).stick_to_bottom(true).show(ui, |ui| {
                    for e in r.recent.iter().filter(|e| matches(&filter, e)) {
                        widgets::mono_line(ui, &widgets::demangle_line(e), p.body);
                    }
                });
            });
            widgets::section(ui, &p, "Hottest functions", |ui| {
                for h in &r.hot {
                    widgets::kv(ui, &p, &format!("0x{:x}", h.addr), &format!("{} entries, {} instructions", crate::fmt_count(h.entries), crate::fmt_count(h.instructions)));
                }
            });
        }
        Tab::Recompilation => match app.last_pipeline.as_ref().and_then(|s| s.report.as_ref()) {
            None => {
                widgets::section(ui, &p, "", |ui| {
                    ui.label(RichText::new("The pipeline has not run this session.").color(p.body));
                });
            }
            Some(r) => {
                widgets::section(ui, &p, "Lift report", |ui| {
                    let json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(r).unwrap_or_default();
                    for line in json.lines().filter(|l| matches(&filter, l)) {
                        ui.label(RichText::new(line).font(theme::mono(12.0)).color(p.body));
                    }
                });
            }
        },
        Tab::Log => {
            widgets::section(ui, &p, "Activity", |ui| {
                for a in app.activity.iter().rev().filter(|a| matches(&filter, &a.text)) {
                    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                        ui.label(RichText::new(&a.at).font(theme::mono(11.5)).color(p.muted));
                        ui.label(RichText::new(&a.text).color(a.tone.colour(&p)));
                    });
                }
            });
            widgets::section(ui, &p, "Last task log", |ui| {
                for l in app.last_job_log.iter().filter(|l| matches(&filter, l)) {
                    ui.label(RichText::new(l).font(theme::mono(12.0)).color(p.body));
                }
            });
        }
    }
}

/// Write everything this page shows to a text file the user chooses.
fn export(app: &mut App) {
    let Some(path) = rfd::FileDialog::new().set_file_name("emblemweave-diagnostics.txt").save_file() else {
        return;
    };
    let mut out = String::new();
    out.push_str(&format!("EmblemWeave {} ({})\n\n", env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"), env!("EW_GIT_REV")));
    out.push_str("== game data ==\n");
    for c in &app.game.checks {
        out.push_str(&format!("{:?} {}: {}\n", c.severity, c.label, c.detail));
    }
    if let Some((r, ms)) = &app.last_boot {
        out.push_str(&format!("\n== runtime ({ms} ms) ==\n{}\n", r.headline()));
        for t in &r.thread_states {
            out.push_str(&format!("{t}\n"));
        }
        for l in &r.host_log {
            out.push_str(&format!("host: {l}\n"));
        }
        for i in &r.import_calls {
            out.push_str(&format!("import {} x{}\n", i.name, i.calls));
        }
        for e in &r.recent {
            out.push_str(&format!("event {e}\n"));
        }
    }
    if let Some(r) = app.last_pipeline.as_ref().and_then(|s| s.report.as_ref()) {
        out.push_str(&format!("\n== lift ==\n{}\n", serde_json::to_string_pretty(r).unwrap_or_default()));
    }
    out.push_str("\n== activity ==\n");
    for a in &app.activity {
        out.push_str(&format!("{} {}\n", a.at, a.text));
    }
    match std::fs::write(&path, out) {
        Ok(()) => app.notify(format!("Diagnostics written to {}", path.display()), Tone::Ok),
        Err(e) => app.notify(format!("Could not write the report: {e}"), Tone::Bad),
    }
}
```

```rs
            Page::Audio => "Audio",
            Page::Controls => "Controls",
            Page::Appearance => "Appearance",
            Page::Diagnostics => "Diagnostics",
            Page::About => "About",
        }
    }

            Page::Overview => "🏠",
            Page::Setup => "📁",

            Page::Graphics => "🖥",
            Page::Audio => "🔊",
            Page::Controls => "🎮",
            Page::Appearance => "🎨",
            Page::Diagnostics => "🔍",
            Page::About => "ℹ",
        }
    }
}

    match app.page {
        Page::Overview => overview::show(app, ui),
        Page::Setup => setup::show(app, ui),
        Page::Saves => saves::show(app, ui),
        Page::Mods => mods::show(app, ui),
        Page::Cheats => cheats::show(app, ui),
        Page::Recompile => recompile::show(app, ui),
        Page::Graphics => media::graphics(app, ui),
        Page::Audio => media::audio(app, ui),
        Page::Controls => controls::show(app, ui),
        Page::Appearance => appearance::show(app, ui),
        Page::Diagnostics => diagnostics::show(app, ui),
        Page::About => about::show(app, ui),
    }
}
```

`apps/eblemweave/src/pages/mods.rs`:

```rs
//! Mods: the installed RomFS mods, importing archives and folders, and
//! browsing and installing from GameBanana.

use crate::mods::{self, GbFile, GbMod, Installed};
use crate::theme;
use crate::widgets::{self, Tone};
use crate::App;
use eframe::egui::{self, RichText};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};

type Slot<T> = Arc<Mutex<Option<Result<T, String>>>>;

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct Ui {
    link: String,
    browse: Vec<GbMod>,
    more: bool,
    page: u32,
    listing: Option<Slot<(Vec<GbMod>, bool)>>,
    /// The mod whose files are listed, and its files.
    files: Option<(GbMod, Vec<GbFile>)>,
    fetching: Option<Slot<(GbMod, Vec<GbFile>)>>,
    installing: Option<(String, Slot<Installed>)>,
}

fn spawn<T: Send + 'static>(f: impl FnOnce() -> Result<T, String> + Send + 'static) -> Slot<T> {
    let slot: Slot<T> = Arc::new(Mutex::new(None));
    let s = slot.clone();
    std::thread::spawn(move || {
        let r = f();
        *s.lock().unwrap() = Some(r);
    });
    slot
}

fn take<T>(slot: &Option<Slot<T>>) -> Option<Result<T, String>> {
    slot.as_ref().and_then(|s| s.lock().unwrap().take())
}

fn installed_message(what: &str, r: Result<Installed, String>) -> (String, Tone) {
    match r {
        Ok(i) if i.exefs_only => (
            format!("{what} only patches the game's code (exefs), which cannot apply to a recompiled game. Nothing was installed."),
            Tone::Warn,
        ),
        Ok(i) if i.mods.len() > 1 => (format!("Installed {what} as {} variants; only the first is switched on: {}", i.mods.len(), i.mods.join(", ")), Tone::Ok),
        Ok(i) => (format!("Installed {}", i.mods.join(", ")), Tone::Ok),
        Err(e) => (format!("Could not install {what}: {e}"), Tone::Bad),
    }
}

pub fn show(app: &mut App, ui: &mut egui::Ui) {
    let p = app.config.theme.palette();
    widgets::page_header(ui, &p, "Mods", "RomFS mods laid over the game's files when it starts, from an archive, a folder or GameBanana.");
    let Some(dir) = mods::dir() else { return };
    let mut message: Option<(String, Tone)> = None;
    let busy = app.mods_ui.installing.is_some() || app.mods_ui.fetching.is_some() || app.mods_ui.listing.is_some();
    if busy {
        ui.ctx().request_repaint_after(std::time::Duration::from_millis(200));
    }

    // Results from background work.
    if let Some(r) = take(&app.mods_ui.listing) {
        app.mods_ui.listing = None;
        match r {
            Ok((list, more)) => {
                if app.mods_ui.page <= 1 {
                    app.mods_ui.browse = list;
                } else {
                    app.mods_ui.browse.extend(list);
                }
                app.mods_ui.more = more;
            }
            Err(e) => message = Some((format!("GameBanana: {e}"), Tone::Bad)),
        }
    }
    if let Some(r) = take(&app.mods_ui.fetching) {
        app.mods_ui.fetching = None;
        match r {
            Ok((m, files)) if files.is_empty() => message = Some((format!("{} has no files to download", m.name), Tone::Warn)),
            Ok((m, files)) if files.len() == 1 => {
                let d = dir.clone();
                let (mm, f) = (m.clone(), files[0].clone());
                app.mods_ui.installing = Some((m.name.clone(), spawn(move || mods::gb_install(&mm, &f, &d))));
            }
            Ok(x) => app.mods_ui.files = Some(x),
            Err(e) => message = Some((format!("GameBanana: {e}"), Tone::Bad)),
        }
    }
    if let Some((name, slot)) = &app.mods_ui.installing {
        let done = slot.lock().unwrap().take();
        if let Some(r) = done {
            message = Some(installed_message(name, r));
            app.mods_ui.installing = None;
        }
    }

    widgets::section(ui, &p, "Installed", |ui| {
        let list = mods::list(&dir);
        if list.is_empty() {
            ui.label(RichText::new("No mods installed.").color(p.muted));
        }
        for m in &list {
            ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                let mut on = m.enabled;
                if widgets::toggle(ui, &p, &mut on).changed() {
                    if let Err(e) = mods::set_enabled(m, on) {
                        message = Some((e, Tone::Bad));
                    }
                }
                ui.vertical(|ui| {
                    ui.label(RichText::new(&m.info.title).font(theme::semibold(14.0)).color(if m.enabled { p.ink } else { p.muted }));
                    let mut bits = vec![format!("{} files", m.files)];
                    if !m.info.author.is_empty() {
                        bits.push(format!("by {}", m.info.author));
                    }
                    if !m.info.version.is_empty() {
                        bits.push(m.info.version.clone());
                    }
                    if !m.has_romfs {
                        bits.push("no romfs folder: the game will not see it".into());
                    }
                    if m.has_exefs {
                        bits.push("its exefs patches cannot apply".into());
                    }
                    ui.label(RichText::new(bits.join("  ·  ")).size(12.5).color(p.muted));
                });
                ui.with_layout(egui::Layout::right_to_left(egui::Align::Center), |ui| {
                    if widgets::button(ui, &p, "Remove", true).on_hover_text("Moves the mod to the mods-removed folder").clicked() {
                        message = Some(match mods::remove(m) {
                            Ok(to) => (format!("Moved {} to {}", m.info.title, to.display()), Tone::Ok),
                            Err(e) => (e, Tone::Bad),
                        });
                    }
                    if widgets::button(ui, &p, "Folder", true).clicked() {
                        let _ = std::process::Command::new("explorer").arg(&m.path).spawn();
                    }
                    if !m.info.source.is_empty() {
                        ui.hyperlink_to("Page", &m.info.source);
                    }
                });
            });
            ui.add_space(4.0);
        }
        ui.add_space(6.0);
        ui.label(RichText::new("Changes apply the next time the game starts. When two mods change the same file, the one later in the list wins.").size(12.5).color(p.muted));
    });

    widgets::section(ui, &p, "Add a mod", |ui| {
        ui.horizontal(|ui| {
            if widgets::button(ui, &p, "From archive…", !busy).clicked() {
                if let Some(f) = rfd::FileDialog::new().add_filter("Mod archive", &["zip", "7z", "rar", "tar", "gz"]).pick_file() {
                    let d = dir.clone();
                    let name = f.file_name().unwrap_or_default().to_string_lossy().into_owned();
                    app.mods_ui.installing = Some((name, spawn(move || mods::install(&f, &d, mods::Info::default()))));
                }
            }
            if widgets::button(ui, &p, "From folder…", !busy).clicked() {
                if let Some(f) = rfd::FileDialog::new().pick_folder() {
                    message = Some(installed_message(&f.display().to_string(), mods::install(&f, &dir, mods::Info::default())));
                }
            }
            if widgets::button(ui, &p, "Open mods folder", true).clicked() {
                let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir);
                let _ = std::process::Command::new("explorer").arg(&dir).spawn();
            }
        });
        ui.add_space(6.0);
        ui.horizontal(|ui| {
            ui.add(egui::TextEdit::singleline(&mut app.mods_ui.link).hint_text("https://gamebanana.com/mods/…").desired_width(320.0));
            let id = mods::gb_id(&app.mods_ui.link);
            if widgets::button(ui, &p, "Install from GameBanana", id.is_some() && !busy).clicked() {
                let id = id.unwrap();
                app.mods_ui.fetching = Some(spawn(move || mods::gb_mod(id)));
            }
        });
        if let Some((name, _)) = &app.mods_ui.installing {
            ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                ui.spinner();
                ui.label(format!("Installing {name}…"));
            });
        }
    });

    let mut chosen: Option<(GbMod, GbFile)> = None;
    if let Some((m, files)) = &app.mods_ui.files {
        let mut close = false;
        widgets::section(ui, &p, &format!("Files of {}", m.name), |ui| {
            for f in files {
                ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                    ui.label(RichText::new(&f.name).font(theme::mono(13.0)).color(p.ink));
                    ui.label(RichText::new(format!("{:.1} MB", f.size as f64 / 1e6)).color(p.muted));
                    if !f.description.is_empty() {
                        ui.label(RichText::new(&f.description).color(p.body));
                    }
                    if widgets::button(ui, &p, "Install", !busy).clicked() {
                        chosen = Some((m.clone(), f.clone()));
                    }
                });
            }
            if widgets::button(ui, &p, "Close", true).clicked() {
                close = true;
            }
        });
        if close {
            app.mods_ui.files = None;
        }
    }
    if let Some((m, f)) = chosen {
        let d = dir.clone();
        app.mods_ui.files = None;
        app.mods_ui.installing = Some((m.name.clone(), spawn(move || mods::gb_install(&m, &f, &d))));
    }

    widgets::section(ui, &p, "GameBanana", |ui| {
        ui.horizontal(|ui| {
            ui.label(RichText::new("Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave mods, newest first.").color(p.body));
            if widgets::button(ui, &p, if app.mods_ui.browse.is_empty() { "Load list" } else { "Refresh" }, app.mods_ui.listing.is_none()).clicked() {
                app.mods_ui.page = 1;
                app.mods_ui.listing = Some(spawn(|| mods::gb_list(1)));
            }
            ui.hyperlink_to("Open on gamebanana.com", format!("https://gamebanana.com/mods/games/{}", mods::GAMEBANANA_GAME));
        });
        if app.mods_ui.listing.is_some() {
            ui.spinner();
        }
        let installed: Vec<u64> = mods::list(&dir).iter().filter_map(|m| m.info.gamebanana_id).collect();
        let mut fetch: Option<u64> = None;
        egui::Grid::new("gb").num_columns(4).spacing([14.0, 6.0]).striped(true).show(ui, |ui| {
            for m in &app.mods_ui.browse {
                ui.vertical(|ui| {
                    ui.hyperlink_to(RichText::new(&m.name).font(theme::semibold(13.5)), &m.url);
                    ui.label(RichText::new(format!("{} by {}{}", m.kind, m.author, if m.version.is_empty() { String::new() } else { format!(", {}", m.version) })).size(12.0).color(p.muted));
                });
                ui.label(RichText::new(format!("♥ {}", m.likes)).color(p.muted));
                if installed.contains(&m.id) {
                    widgets::pill(ui, &p, "Installed", Tone::Ok);
                } else {
                    ui.label("");
                }
                if m.kind == "Mod" {
                    if widgets::button(ui, &p, "Install", !busy).clicked() {
                        fetch = Some(m.id);
                    }
                } else {
                    ui.label(RichText::new("a tool, not a mod").size(12.0).color(p.muted));
                }
                ui.end_row();
            }
        });
        if let Some(id) = fetch {
            app.mods_ui.fetching = Some(spawn(move || mods::gb_mod(id)));
        }
        if app.mods_ui.more && widgets::button(ui, &p, "More", app.mods_ui.listing.is_none()).clicked() {
            app.mods_ui.page += 1;
            let n = app.mods_ui.page;
            app.mods_ui.listing = Some(spawn(move || mods::gb_list(n)));
        }
        ui.add_space(4.0);
        ui.label(RichText::new("Mods are made by their authors and installed as they are; mods that patch the game's code (exefs) cannot apply.").size(12.5).color(p.muted));
    });

    if let Some((text, tone)) = message {
        app.notify(text, tone);
    }
}
```

`apps/eblemweave/src/pages/overview.rs`:

```rs
//! The landing page: the title, where the project stands, and the next step.

use crate::gamedata::{Severity, TITLE_NAME};
use crate::jobs::JobKind;
use crate::pages::Page;
use crate::theme;
use crate::widgets::{self, Tone};
use crate::{logo, App};
use eframe::egui::{self, RichText};

/// One honest word for the sidebar: what the user can do right now.
pub fn readiness(app: &App) -> (&'static str, Tone) {
    if app.running(JobKind::Boot).is_some() {
        ("Runtime running", Tone::Accent)
    } else if app.game.bootable_inputs() {
        ("Boot test available", Tone::Accent)
    } else if app.game.exefs.is_some() {
        ("Setup incomplete", Tone::Warn)
    } else {
        ("No game data", Tone::Neutral)
    }
}

pub fn show(app: &mut App, ui: &mut egui::Ui) {
    let p = app.config.theme.palette();
    ui.add_space(theme::SPACE_L);

    // Hero: the lockup over a faint electric wash, then the title card.
    egui::Frame::new()
        .fill(p.panel)
        .stroke(egui::Stroke::new(1.0_f32, p.line))
        .corner_radius(egui::CornerRadius::same(theme::RADIUS_M + 4))
        .inner_margin(egui::Margin::symmetric(28, 24))
        .show(ui, |ui| {
            ui.set_width(ui.available_width());
            ui.horizontal_top(|ui| {
                logo::show_lockup(ui, &p, 340.0_f32.min(ui.available_width() * 0.42));
                ui.add_space(theme::SPACE_L);
                ui.vertical(|ui| {
                    ui.set_max_width(ui.available_width());
                    ui.add_space(theme::SPACE_M);
                    let (name, version) = app.game.title.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| (TITLE_NAME.to_string(), String::new()));
                    ui.label(RichText::new(name).font(theme::display(26.0)).color(p.ink));
                    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                        if !version.is_empty() {
                            widgets::pill(ui, &p, &format!("Version {version}"), Tone::Neutral);
                        }
                        widgets::pill(ui, &p, "Nintendo Switch 2 → Windows x64", Tone::Accent);
                    });
                    ui.add_space(theme::SPACE_S);
                    ui.label(
                        RichText::new("Statically recompiled from your own copy of the game into native code. No emulator.")
                            .size(14.0)
                            .color(p.body),
                    );
                    ui.add_space(theme::SPACE_M);
                    let ready = crate::engine::ready();
                    let building = app.running(JobKind::Engine).is_some();
                    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                        if widgets::primary_button(ui, &p, "▶  Play", ready && !building)
                            .on_disabled_hover_text("Build the game first: it is compiled from your dump once, on this PC.")
                            .clicked()
                        {
                            match crate::engine::play() {
                                Ok(()) => app.notify("Starting Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave", Tone::Ok),
                                Err(e) => app.notify(e, Tone::Bad),
                            }
                        }
                        let label = if ready { "Rebuild" } else { "Build the game" };
                        let can_build = app.game.exefs.is_some() && app.game.romfs.is_some() && !building;
                        if widgets::button(ui, &p, label, can_build)
                            .on_hover_text("Compiles the game from your dump with the engine (engine/fefw-recomp) and translates its shaders. The first build takes a while; later ones only redo what changed.")
                            .clicked()
                        {
                            app.start(JobKind::Engine);
                        }
                    });
                    ui.add_space(4.0);
                    let missing = crate::engine::missing_tools();
                    let (text, colour) = if building {
                        ("Building the game from your dump; progress is in the status bar and on Diagnostics.".to_string(), p.body)
                    } else if ready {
                        ("Ready to play. Saves are kept in EmblemWeave's save folder; RomFS mods go in the run folder's mods folder.".to_string(), p.ok)
                    } else if !missing.is_empty() {
                        (format!("To build the game, install: {}.", missing.join(", ")), p.warn)
                    } else {
                        ("Not built yet: press Build the game. It runs once, on this PC, from your own dump.".to_string(), p.warn)
                    };
                    ui.label(RichText::new(text).size(12.5).color(colour));
                    ui.add_space(theme::SPACE_S);
                    quick_actions(app, ui, &p);
                });
            });
        });
    ui.add_space(theme::SPACE_M);

    // Three status cards.
    ui.columns(3, |cols| {
        let worst = app.game.worst();
        let (data_text, data_tone) = match worst {
            Severity::Ok | Severity::Info => ("Ready", Tone::Ok),
            Severity::Warn => ("Needs attention", Tone::Warn),
            Severity::Error => ("Incomplete", Tone::Bad),
        };
        card(&mut cols[0], &p, "Game data", data_text, data_tone, &summary_of_data(app));

        let (rtext, rtone, rdetail) = match &app.last_pipeline {
            Some(s) => match (&s.report, s.verified) {
                (Some(r), Some((ok, n))) => (
                    "Recompiled".to_string(),
                    if ok == n { Tone::Ok } else { Tone::Warn },
                    format!("{} functions, {:.2}% decode, {ok}/{n} verified", r.lifted_functions, r.decode_coverage * 100.0),
                ),
                (Some(r), None) => ("Lifted".to_string(), Tone::Accent, format!("{} functions; native build not verified", r.lifted_functions)),
                _ => ("Run incomplete".to_string(), Tone::Warn, String::new()),
            },
            None => ("Not run this session".to_string(), Tone::Neutral, "Run the pipeline on the Recompilation page".to_string()),
        };
        card(&mut cols[1], &p, "Recompilation", &rtext, rtone, &rdetail);

        let (btext, btone, bdetail) = match &app.last_boot {
            Some((r, ms)) => (
                format!("Reached {}", r.phase),
                Tone::Accent,
                format!(
                    "{} instructions, {} threads, {:.1}s. {}",
                    crate::fmt_count(r.steps),
                    r.threads,
                    *ms as f32 / 1000.0,
                    widgets::demangle_line(&r.stop.describe())
                ),
            ),
            None => ("No run yet".to_string(), Tone::Neutral, "Run the boot test to execute the game's code".to_string()),
        };
        card(&mut cols[2], &p, "Runtime", &btext, btone, &bdetail);
    });
    ui.add_space(theme::SPACE_M);

    // Next steps, while setup is incomplete.
    let steps = [
        (app.game.exefs.is_some() && app.game.romfs.is_some(), "Choose your game folder", "Game Setup finds ExeFS, RomFS and control.nacp", Page::Setup),
        (app.game.bootable_inputs(), "Decode the main module", "One-time decode of the ZBIC-compressed executable", Page::Setup),
        (app.last_pipeline.is_some(), "Run the recompilation pipeline", "Lift, emit, compile and verify the game's code", Page::Recompile),
        (app.last_boot.is_some(), "Run the boot test", "Execute the game through startup and see where it stops", Page::Overview),
    ];
    if steps.iter().any(|s| !s.0) {
        widgets::section(ui, &p, "Next steps", |ui| {
            for (i, (done, title, help, page)) in steps.iter().enumerate() {
                ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                    let mark = if *done { RichText::new("✔").color(p.ok) } else { RichText::new(format!("{}", i + 1)).color(p.accent_hi) };
                    ui.label(mark.font(theme::semibold(14.0)));
                    ui.label(RichText::new(*title).font(theme::semibold(14.0)).color(if *done { p.body } else { p.ink }));
                    ui.label(RichText::new(*help).size(12.5).color(p.muted));
                    if !*done && *page != Page::Overview {
                        ui.with_layout(egui::Layout::right_to_left(egui::Align::Center), |ui| {
                            if ui.link(format!("Open {}", page.label())).clicked() {
                                app.page = *page;
                            }
                        });
                    }
                });
            }
        });
    }

    ui.columns(2, |cols| {
        widgets::section(&mut cols[0], &p, "Current configuration", |ui| {
            widgets::kv(ui, &p, "Language", &app.config.system.language);
            widgets::kv(ui, &p, "Profile", &app.config.system.user_name);
            widgets::kv(ui, &p, "Theme", app.config.theme.label());
            widgets::kv(ui, &p, "Instruction budget", &crate::fmt_count(app.config.runtime.max_steps));
            widgets::kv(ui, &p, "Guest heap", &format!("{} MiB", app.config.runtime.heap_mib));
        });
        widgets::section(&mut cols[1], &p, "Recent activity", |ui| {
            if app.activity.is_empty() {
                ui.label(RichText::new("Nothing yet").color(p.muted));
            }
            for a in app.activity.iter().rev().take(7) {
                ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                    ui.label(RichText::new(&a.at).font(theme::mono(11.5)).color(p.muted));
                    ui.add(egui::Label::new(RichText::new(&a.text).size(13.0).color(a.tone.colour(&p))).wrap());
                });
            }
        });
    });
}

fn summary_of_data(app: &App) -> String {
    let g = &app.game;
    match (&g.exefs, &g.title) {
        (None, _) => "Choose the folder with your extracted game".into(),
        (Some(_), Some((_, v))) => format!("Version {v}, {} RomFS entries", g.romfs_entries),
        (Some(_), None) => format!("{} RomFS entries", g.romfs_entries),
    }
}

fn card(ui: &mut egui::Ui, p: &theme::Palette, title: &str, value: &str, tone: Tone, detail: &str) {
    widgets::section(ui, p, title, |ui| {
        ui.label(RichText::new(value).font(theme::display(20.0)).color(tone.colour(p)));
        ui.add_space(2.0);
        ui.label(RichText::new(detail).size(12.5).color(p.body));
    });
}

/// One-click access to what the player changes most between sessions: which
/// save to play, the save editor, mods and cheats.
fn quick_actions(app: &mut App, ui: &mut egui::Ui, p: &crate::theme::Palette) {
    let save_dir = crate::config::Config::save_dir();
    let profiles = save_dir.as_deref().map(crate::saves::profiles).unwrap_or_default();
    let mods_on = crate::mods::dir().map(|d| crate::mods::list(&d).iter().filter(|m| m.enabled).count()).unwrap_or(0);
    let cheats_on: usize = crate::cheats::dir().map(|d| crate::cheats::load_enabled(&d).values().map(|v| v.len()).sum()).unwrap_or(0);
    let running = crate::cheats::process::find(crate::cheats::GAME_EXE).is_some();
    let mut load: Option<crate::saves::Profile> = None;
    ui.horizontal_wrapped(|ui| {
        ui.label(RichText::new("Save").color(p.muted));
        egui::ComboBox::from_id_salt("quick-profile")
            .selected_text(if profiles.is_empty() { "current save" } else { "load a profile…" })
            .width(170.0)
            .show_ui(ui, |ui| {
                if profiles.is_empty() {
                    ui.label("No profiles yet: keep one on the Saves page.");
                }
                for pr in &profiles {
                    if ui.add_enabled(!running, egui::Button::new(&pr.name)).on_disabled_hover_text("Close the game first").clicked() {
                        load = Some(pr.clone());
                    }
                }
            });
        if widgets::button(ui, p, "Edit saves", true).clicked() {
            app.page = crate::pages::Page::Saves;
        }
        if widgets::button(ui, p, &format!("Mods ({mods_on} on)"), true).clicked() {
            app.page = crate::pages::Page::Mods;
        }
        if widgets::button(ui, p, &format!("Cheats ({cheats_on} on)"), true).clicked() {
            app.page = crate::pages::Page::Cheats;
        }
    });
    if let (Some(pr), Some(dir)) = (load, save_dir) {
        let title = app
            .game
            .title_id
            .or_else(|| app.game.nacp.as_deref().and_then(crate::saves::nacp_save_owner))
            .unwrap_or(crate::saves::FALLBACK_TITLE_ID);
        let stamp = std::time::SystemTime::now().duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).map(|d| d.as_secs()).unwrap_or(0).to_string();
        match crate::saves::load_profile(&dir, &pr, title, &stamp) {
            Ok(_) => {
                app.saves_ui.editor = None;
                app.notify(format!("Loaded save profile {}; the previous save is in the backups folder", pr.name), Tone::Ok);
            }
            Err(e) => app.notify(format!("Could not load the profile: {e}"), Tone::Bad),
        }
    }
}
```

`apps/eblemweave/src/pages/recompile.rs`:

```rs
//! Recompilation: run and inspect the static recompilation pipeline.

use crate::jobs::{JobKind, Stage, StageStatus, PIPELINE_STAGES};
use crate::theme;
use crate::widgets::{self, Tone};
use crate::App;
use eframe::egui::{self, RichText};

pub fn show(app: &mut App, ui: &mut egui::Ui) {
    let p = app.config.theme.palette();
    widgets::page_header(
        ui,
        &p,
        "Recompilation",
        "Decode the game's AArch64 code, recover its functions, emit C, build it natively and verify it against the reference interpreter.",
    );

    let running = app.running(JobKind::Pipeline).is_some();
    widgets::section(ui, &p, "Pipeline", |ui| {
        ui.horizontal(|ui| {
            let ready = app.game.decoded.is_some() && app.game.segments.iter().all(|s| s.ok());
            if widgets::primary_button(ui, &p, if running { "Running…" } else { "Run pipeline" }, ready && !running)
                .on_disabled_hover_text("Decode the main module on Game Setup first")
                .clicked()
            {
                app.start(JobKind::Pipeline);
            }
            ui.add_space(theme::SPACE_M);
            ui.vertical(|ui| {
                ui.label(RichText::new("Functions to recover").font(theme::semibold(13.0)).color(p.ink));
                ui.add_enabled(!running, egui::Slider::new(&mut app.lift_limit, 500..=40_000).logarithmic(true));
            });
            if running {
                ui.with_layout(egui::Layout::right_to_left(egui::Align::Center), |ui| {
                    if widgets::button(ui, &p, "Cancel", true).clicked() {
                        app.confirm = Some(crate::Confirm::CancelJob(JobKind::Pipeline));
                    }
                });
            }
        });
        ui.add_space(theme::SPACE_M);

        let stages: Vec<Stage> = match app.running(JobKind::Pipeline) {
            Some(job) => job.snapshot(|pr| pr.stages.clone()),
            None => PIPELINE_STAGES
                .iter()
                .map(|&name| Stage { name, status: StageStatus::Pending, detail: String::new(), started: None, elapsed: None })
                .collect(),
        };
        if running {
            let done = stages.iter().filter(|s| matches!(s.status, StageStatus::Done | StageStatus::Skipped | StageStatus::Failed)).count();
            widgets::progress_bar(ui, &p, Some(done as f32 / stages.len() as f32));
            ui.add_space(theme::SPACE_S);
        }
        widgets::stage_list(ui, &p, &stages);
        if !running && app.last_pipeline.is_some() {
            ui.label(RichText::new("The last completed run is summarised below.").size(12.5).color(p.muted));
        }
    });

    if let Some(s) = &app.last_pipeline {
        widgets::section(ui, &p, "Last run", |ui| {
            if let Some(r) = &s.report {
                ui.columns(4, |c| {
                    metric(&mut c[0], &p, "Decode coverage", &format!("{:.2}%", r.decode_coverage * 100.0));
                    metric(&mut c[1], &p, "Functions", &crate::fmt_count(r.lifted_functions as u64));
                    metric(&mut c[2], &p, "Basic blocks", &crate::fmt_count(r.blocks_lifted as u64));
                    metric(&mut c[3], &p, "Jump tables", &crate::fmt_count(r.jump_tables as u64));
                });
                ui.add_space(theme::SPACE_S);
                widgets::kv(ui, &p, "Unsupported words", &crate::fmt_count(r.unsupported_words as u64));
                widgets::kv(ui, &p, "Indirect edges", &format!("{} (resolved at run time)", r.unresolved_edges));
            }
            match s.compiled {
                Some(true) => widgets::status_line(ui, &p, Tone::Ok, "Native build", "the emitted C compiled to a native object"),
                Some(false) => widgets::status_line(ui, &p, Tone::Bad, "Native build", "the C compiler rejected the output"),
                None => widgets::status_line(ui, &p, Tone::Warn, "Native build", "skipped: no C compiler available"),
            }
            if let Some((ok, n)) = s.verified {
                let tone = if ok == n { Tone::Ok } else { Tone::Bad };
                widgets::status_line(ui, &p, tone, "Verification", &format!("{ok} of {n} functions identical to the reference interpreter"));
            }
            if let Some(out) = &s.output {
                ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                    widgets::kv(ui, &p, "Output", &out.display().to_string());
                    if ui.link("Open folder").clicked() {
                        let _ = std::process::Command::new("explorer").arg(out).spawn();
                    }
                });
            }
        });
    }

    if !app.last_job_log.is_empty() {
        widgets::section(ui, &p, "Log", |ui| {
            egui::ScrollArea::vertical().max_height(220.0).stick_to_bottom(true).show(ui, |ui| {
                for line in &app.last_job_log {
                    ui.label(RichText::new(line).font(theme::mono(12.0)).color(p.body));
                }
            });
        });
    }
}

fn metric(ui: &mut egui::Ui, p: &theme::Palette, label: &str, value: &str) {
    ui.label(RichText::new(value).font(theme::display(22.0)).color(p.ink));
    ui.label(RichText::new(label).size(12.0).color(p.muted));
}
```

`apps/eblemweave/src/pages/saves.rs`:

```rs
//! Saves: save profiles (named copies to switch between), the slots in the
//! current save with an editor, and import and export.

use crate::savefile::{grade, Ids, Player, Slot, Unit, GRADES, MASTERY_NAMES, STAT_NAMES};
use crate::theme;
use crate::widgets::{self, Tone};
use crate::App;
use eframe::egui::{self, RichText};
use std::path::PathBuf;

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct Ui {
    pub profile_name: String,
    pub editor: Option<Editor>,
    ids: Option<std::sync::Arc<Ids>>,
}

pub struct Editor {
    slot: Slot,
    player: Option<Player>,
    units: Vec<Unit>,
    original: (Option<Player>, Vec<Unit>),
}

fn stamp() -> String {
    std::time::SystemTime::now().duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).map(|d| d.as_secs()).unwrap_or(0).to_string()
}

fn ago(t: Option<std::time::SystemTime>) -> String {
    let Some(secs) = t.and_then(|t| std::time::SystemTime::now().duration_since(t).ok()).map(|d| d.as_secs()) else {
        return String::new();
    };
    match secs {
        0..=59 => "just now".into(),
        60..=3599 => format!("{} min ago", secs / 60),
        3600..=86_399 => format!("{} h ago", secs / 3600),
        _ => format!("{} days ago", secs / 86_400),
    }
}

/// The game's RomFS as a folder, where the game data (and so the names of
/// units) can be read: the one the engine was configured with, else the
/// dump's when it is a folder.
pub fn romfs_dir(app: &App) -> Option<PathBuf> {
    let ini = crate::engine::run_dir().and_then(|d| std::fs::read_to_string(d.join("fefw.ini")).ok());
    let from_ini = ini.and_then(|t| {
        t.lines().find_map(|l| l.trim().strip_prefix("romfs").map(|r| r.trim_start().trim_start_matches('=').trim().to_string()))
    });
    from_ini.map(PathBuf::from).filter(|p| p.join("GameData").is_dir()).or_else(|| app.game.romfs.clone().filter(|p| p.join("GameData").is_dir()))
}

pub fn show(app: &mut App, ui: &mut egui::Ui) {
    let p = app.config.theme.palette();
    widgets::page_header(ui, &p, "Saves", "Switch between saves, edit a slot, and bring saves in from an emulator.");
    let Some(save_dir) = crate::config::Config::save_dir() else { return };
    let title = app
        .game
        .title_id
        .or_else(|| app.game.nacp.as_deref().and_then(crate::saves::nacp_save_owner))
        .unwrap_or(crate::saves::FALLBACK_TITLE_ID);
    let running = cfg!(windows) && crate::cheats::process::find(crate::cheats::GAME_EXE).is_some();
    let mut message: Option<(String, Tone)> = None;

    if running {
        widgets::status_line(ui, &p, Tone::Warn, "The game is running", "Close it before switching or editing saves: it writes its save when it closes.");
        ui.add_space(theme::SPACE_S);
    }

    widgets::section(ui, &p, "Save profiles", |ui| {
        ui.label("A profile is a named copy of the whole save. Loading one makes it the current save; the save it replaces is kept in the backups folder.");
        ui.add_space(6.0);
        let profiles = crate::saves::profiles(&save_dir);
        if profiles.is_empty() {
            ui.label(RichText::new("No profiles yet.").color(p.muted));
        }
        for pr in &profiles {
            ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                ui.label(RichText::new(&pr.name).font(theme::semibold(14.0)).color(p.ink));
                ui.label(RichText::new(format!("{} files, {}", pr.files, ago(pr.modified))).color(p.muted));
                ui.with_layout(egui::Layout::right_to_left(egui::Align::Center), |ui| {
                    if widgets::button(ui, &p, "Remove", true).on_hover_text("Moves the profile to the backups folder").clicked() {
                        message = Some(match crate::saves::remove_profile(&save_dir, pr, &stamp()) {
                            Ok(b) => (format!("Moved profile {} to {}", pr.name, b.display()), Tone::Ok),
                            Err(e) => (format!("Could not remove the profile: {e}"), Tone::Bad),
                        });
                    }
                    if widgets::button(ui, &p, "Load", !running).clicked() {
                        message = Some(match crate::saves::load_profile(&save_dir, pr, title, &stamp()) {
                            Ok(i) => {
                                app.saves_ui.editor = None;
                                (format!("Loaded profile {} ({} files){}", pr.name, i.files, i.backup.map(|b| format!("; the previous save is in {}", b.display())).unwrap_or_default()), Tone::Ok)
                            }
                            Err(e) => (format!("Could not load the profile: {e}"), Tone::Bad),
                        });
                    }
                });
            });
        }
        ui.add_space(6.0);
        ui.horizontal(|ui| {
            ui.add(egui::TextEdit::singleline(&mut app.saves_ui.profile_name).hint_text("Profile name").desired_width(220.0));
            let ok = !app.saves_ui.profile_name.trim().is_empty();
            if widgets::button(ui, &p, "Keep current save as profile", ok).clicked() {
                let name = app.saves_ui.profile_name.trim().to_string();
                message = Some(match crate::saves::store_profile(&save_dir, &name, &stamp()) {
                    Ok(n) => (format!("Kept the current save ({n} files) as profile {name}"), Tone::Ok),
                    Err(e) => (format!("Could not keep the save: {e}"), Tone::Bad),
                });
                app.saves_ui.profile_name.clear();
            }
        });
    });

    widgets::section(ui, &p, "Slots in the current save", |ui| {
        let slots = crate::saves::slots(&save_dir);
        if slots.is_empty() {
            ui.label(RichText::new("No save yet. Play the game or import a save below.").color(p.muted));
        }
        egui::Grid::new("slots").num_columns(3).spacing([18.0, 6.0]).striped(true).show(ui, |ui| {
            for (path, when) in &slots {
                let name = path.file_name().unwrap_or_default().to_string_lossy().into_owned();
                ui.label(RichText::new(&name).font(theme::mono(13.0)).color(p.ink));
                ui.label(RichText::new(ago(*when)).color(p.muted));
                let open = app.saves_ui.editor.as_ref().is_some_and(|e| &e.slot.path == path);
                if widgets::button(ui, &p, if open { "Editing" } else { "Edit" }, !open).clicked() {
                    match Slot::open(path) {
                        Ok(slot) => {
                            if app.saves_ui.ids.is_none() {
                                app.saves_ui.ids = Some(std::sync::Arc::new(romfs_dir(app).map(|r| Ids::from_romfs(&r)).unwrap_or_default()));
                            }
                            let ids = app.saves_ui.ids.clone().unwrap_or_default();
                            let (player, units) = (slot.player(), slot.units(&ids));
                            app.saves_ui.editor = Some(Editor { original: (player, units.clone()), slot, player, units });
                        }
                        Err(e) => message = Some((format!("{name}: {e}"), Tone::Bad)),
                    }
                }
                ui.end_row();
            }
        });
    });

    if let Some(m) = editor(app, ui, &p, running) {
        message = Some(m);
    }

    crate::pages::setup::saves_section(app, ui, &p);
    if let Some((text, tone)) = message {
        app.notify(text, tone);
    }
}

fn editor(app: &mut App, ui: &mut egui::Ui, p: &crate::theme::Palette, running: bool) -> Option<(String, Tone)> {
    let named = app.saves_ui.ids.as_ref().is_some_and(|i| !i.people.is_empty());
    let ids = app.saves_ui.ids.clone().unwrap_or_default();
    let ed = app.saves_ui.editor.as_mut()?;
    let mut message = None;
    let mut close = false;
    let title = format!("Editing {}", ed.slot.path.file_name().unwrap_or_default().to_string_lossy());
    widgets::section(ui, p, &title, |ui| {
        let problems = ed.slot.verify();
        if !problems.is_empty() {
            widgets::status_line(ui, p, Tone::Warn, "Checksums", &problems.join(", "));
        }
        if let Some(pl) = ed.player.as_mut() {
            ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                ui.label(RichText::new("Gold").font(theme::semibold(14.0)).color(p.ink));
                ui.add(egui::DragValue::new(&mut pl.gold).range(0..=9_999_999));
                ui.add_space(18.0);
                ui.label(RichText::new("Renown").font(theme::semibold(14.0)).color(p.ink));
                ui.add(egui::DragValue::new(&mut pl.renown).range(0..=999_999));
            });
            ui.add_space(6.0);
        } else {
            ui.label(RichText::new("This slot has no player data (gold, renown).").color(p.muted));
        }
        if !named {
            ui.label(RichText::new("Units are found by the ids in your game data; choose your game on Game Setup to list them.").color(p.muted));
        } else if ed.units.is_empty() {
            ui.label(RichText::new("No units were found in this slot.").color(p.muted));
        } else {
            ui.label(
                RichText::new("Stats are what each unit has gained from level-ups; the game adds class and personal bases on top. HP is current HP.")
                    .size(12.5)
                    .color(p.muted),
            );
            egui::ScrollArea::horizontal().id_salt("units").show(ui, |ui| {
                egui::Grid::new("units").num_columns(13).spacing([10.0, 6.0]).striped(true).show(ui, |ui| {
                    for h in ["Unit", "Lv", "Exp", "Max HP"].iter().chain(STAT_NAMES.iter()) {
                        ui.label(RichText::new(*h).font(theme::semibold(12.0)).color(p.muted));
                    }
                    ui.end_row();
                    for u in ed.units.iter_mut() {
                        ui.label(RichText::new(&u.name).color(p.ink)).on_hover_text(format!("record at {:#x}", u.at));
                        ui.add(egui::DragValue::new(&mut u.level).range(1..=99));
                        ui.add(egui::DragValue::new(&mut u.exp).range(0..=99));
                        ui.add(egui::DragValue::new(&mut u.max_hp).range(1..=if u.hp_width == 1 { 255 } else { 999 }));
                        for v in u.stats.iter_mut() {
                            ui.add(egui::DragValue::new(v).range(0..=255));
                        }
                        ui.end_row();
                    }
                });
            });
            ui.add_space(6.0);
            for (n, u) in ed.units.iter_mut().enumerate() {
                if u.masteries.is_empty() && u.items.is_empty() && u.spells.is_empty() {
                    continue;
                }
                egui::CollapsingHeader::new(RichText::new(format!("{}: masteries and items", u.name)).color(p.ink)).id_salt(("unit-more", n)).show(ui, |ui| {
                    if !u.masteries.is_empty() {
                        ui.label(RichText::new("Masteries (experience, grade)").font(theme::semibold(12.5)).color(p.muted));
                        egui::Grid::new(("mastery", n)).num_columns(4).spacing([10.0, 4.0]).show(ui, |ui| {
                            for (_, k, v) in u.masteries.iter_mut() {
                                ui.label(MASTERY_NAMES.get(*k as usize).copied().unwrap_or("?"));
                                ui.add(egui::DragValue::new(v).range(0..=2560));
                                ui.label(RichText::new(grade(*v)).font(theme::semibold(13.0)).color(p.accent_hi));
                                egui::ComboBox::from_id_salt(("grade", n, *k)).selected_text("set grade").width(90.0).show_ui(ui, |ui| {
                                    for (g, t) in GRADES {
                                        if ui.selectable_label(false, g).clicked() {
                                            *v = t;
                                        }
                                    }
                                });
                                ui.end_row();
                            }
                        });
                    }
                    for (label, list) in [("Items", &mut u.items), ("Spells", &mut u.spells)] {
                        if list.is_empty() {
                            continue;
                        }
                        ui.label(RichText::new(label).font(theme::semibold(12.5)).color(p.muted));
                        for (i, (_, id)) in list.iter_mut().enumerate() {
                            item_picker(ui, (label, n, i), id, &ids.items);
                        }
                    }
                    ui.label(RichText::new("Items are swapped in place: the slot keeps its kind (a forged item stays forged). Adding or removing slots is not supported yet.").size(12.0).color(p.muted));
                });
            }
        }
        ui.add_space(8.0);
        let dirty = (ed.player, ed.units.clone()) != ed.original;
        ui.horizontal(|ui| {
            if widgets::primary_button(ui, p, "Save changes", dirty && !running).clicked() {
                if let Some(pl) = ed.player {
                    ed.slot.set_player(&pl);
                }
                for u in &ed.units {
                    ed.slot.write_unit(u);
                }
                message = Some(match ed.slot.save() {
                    Ok(()) => {
                        ed.original = (ed.player, ed.units.clone());
                        (format!("Saved {}; the original is kept as {}.orig", ed.slot.path.display(), ed.slot.path.file_name().unwrap_or_default().to_string_lossy()), Tone::Ok)
                    }
                    Err(e) => (format!("Could not save: {e}"), Tone::Bad),
                });
            }
            if widgets::button(ui, p, "Revert", dirty).clicked() {
                ed.player = ed.original.0;
                ed.units = ed.original.1.clone();
            }
            if widgets::button(ui, p, "Close", true).clicked() {
                close = true;
            }
        });
    });
    if close {
        app.saves_ui.editor = None;
    }
    message
}

/// A searchable choice of item, by the id names in the player's game data.
fn item_picker(ui: &mut egui::Ui, salt: impl std::hash::Hash + Copy, id: &mut u32, names: &std::collections::HashMap<u32, String>) {
    let current = names.get(id).cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| format!("item {id:08x}"));
    let filter_id = ui.make_persistent_id(("item-filter", salt));
    egui::ComboBox::from_id_salt(salt).selected_text(current).width(260.0).height(320.0).show_ui(ui, |ui| {
        let mut filter: String = ui.data_mut(|d| d.get_temp(filter_id).unwrap_or_default());
        ui.add(egui::TextEdit::singleline(&mut filter).hint_text("search").desired_width(240.0));
        ui.data_mut(|d| d.insert_temp(filter_id, filter.clone()));
        let f = filter.to_lowercase();
        let mut shown: Vec<(&u32, &String)> = names.iter().filter(|(_, n)| f.is_empty() || n.to_lowercase().contains(&f)).collect();
        shown.sort_by(|a, b| a.1.cmp(b.1));
        for (k, n) in shown.into_iter().take(300) {
            if ui.selectable_label(k == id, n).clicked() {
                *id = *k;
            }
        }
    });
}
```

```rs
fn path_row(ui: &mut egui::Ui, p: &theme::Palette, label: &str, value: &mut String, hint: &str, pick: Pick) -> bool {
    let mut changed = false;
    ui.label(RichText::new(label).font(theme::semibold(13.5)).color(p.ink));
    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        let w = ui.available_width() - if pick == Pick::Dump { 236.0 } else { 110.0 };
        changed |= ui.add(egui::TextEdit::singleline(value).desired_width(w).hint_text(hint).font(theme::mono(12.5))).lost_focus();
        let mut picked = None;
        if pick == Pick::Dump && widgets::button(ui, p, "Choose .nup…", true).clicked() {
            picked = rfd::FileDialog::new().add_filter("Game dump (.nup)", &["nup"]).pick_file();
        }
        let browse = if pick == Pick::Dump { "Folder…" } else { "Browse…" };
        if widgets::button(ui, p, browse, true).clicked() {
            picked = match pick {
                Pick::Nacp => rfd::FileDialog::new().add_filter("control.nacp", &["nacp"]).pick_file(),
                _ => rfd::FileDialog::new().pick_folder(),
            };
        }
        if let Some(path) = picked {
            *value = path.to_string_lossy().into_owned();
            changed = true;
        }
    });
    ui.add_space(theme::SPACE_XS);
    changed
}

/// Save data: where EmblemWeave keeps it, saves found from emulators, and
/// import and export.
pub(crate) fn saves_section(app: &mut App, ui: &mut egui::Ui, p: &crate::theme::Palette) {
    let Some(save_dir) = crate::config::Config::save_dir() else { return };
    let title = app
        .game
        .title_id
        .or_else(|| app.game.nacp.as_deref().and_then(crate::saves::nacp_save_owner))
        .unwrap_or(crate::saves::FALLBACK_TITLE_ID);
    let stamp = || {
        std::time::SystemTime::now().duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).map(|d| d.as_secs()).unwrap_or(0).to_string()
    };
    let mut message: Option<(String, Tone)> = None;
    widgets::section(ui, p, "Save data", |ui| {
        let (files, _) = crate::saves::summary(&crate::saves::account_dir(&save_dir));
        widgets::kv(ui, p, "Save folder", &save_dir.display().to_string());
        widgets::kv(ui, p, "Files", &if files == 0 { "none yet".to_string() } else { files.to_string() });
        widgets::kv(ui, p, "Title", &format!("{title:016X}"));
        ui.add_space(6.0);
        let found = crate::saves::find_here(title);
        if found.is_empty() {
            ui.label("No emulator saves for this game were found on this PC.");
        }
        for f in &found {
            ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                let when = f
                    .modified
                    .and_then(|t| t.duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).ok())
                    .map(|d| format!(", last written {} days ago", (std::time::SystemTime::now().duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).map(|n| n.as_secs()).unwrap_or(0).saturating_sub(d.as_secs())) / 86_400))
                    .unwrap_or_default();
                ui.label(format!("{}: {} files{when}", f.source, f.files)).on_hover_text(f.path.display().to_string());
                if widgets::button(ui, p, "Import", true).clicked() {
                    message = Some(import_message(crate::saves::import(&f.path, &save_dir, title, &stamp())));
                }
            });
        }
        ui.add_space(6.0);
        ui.horizontal(|ui| {
            if widgets::button(ui, p, "Import from folder…", true).clicked() {
                if let Some(dir) = rfd::FileDialog::new().set_title("Choose the game's save folder (the one named by its title id)").pick_folder() {
                    message = Some(import_message(crate::saves::import(&dir, &save_dir, title, &stamp())));
                }
            }
            if widgets::button(ui, p, "Export…", files > 0).clicked() {
                if let Some(dir) = rfd::FileDialog::new().set_title("Choose a folder to export the save into").pick_folder() {
                    message = Some(match crate::saves::export(&save_dir, &dir, title) {
                        Ok((to, n)) => (format!("Exported {n} save files to {}", to.display()), Tone::Ok),
                        Err(e) => (format!("Export failed: {e}"), Tone::Bad),
                    });
                }
            }
            if widgets::button(ui, p, "Open folder", true).clicked() {
                let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&save_dir);
                let _ = std::process::Command::new("explorer").arg(&save_dir).spawn();
            }
        });
        ui.label("Importing moves the current save to the backups folder first; the source is only read.");
    });
    if let Some((text, tone)) = message {
        app.notify(text, tone);
    }
}

pub(crate) fn import_message(r: Result<crate::saves::Imported, String>) -> (String, Tone) {
    match r {
        Ok(i) => match i.backup {
            Some(b) => (format!("Imported {} save files; the previous save is in {}", i.files, b.display()), Tone::Ok),
            None => (format!("Imported {} save files", i.files), Tone::Ok),
        },
        Err(e) => (format!("Import failed: {e}"), Tone::Bad),
    }
}
```
