`apps/eblemweave/src/savefile.rs`:

```rs
//! Fortune's Weave save slots: reading, editing and writing one slot file
//! (`Auto`, `Chapter_Ism_0_3`, ...).
//!
//! The container, as the game writes it:
//!
//! ```text
//! 0x000 u32 0xCDEFBCDD
//! 0x004 u32 length of the header checksum window (0xE0)
//! 0x008 u32 FNV-1a 32 over file[0x1F .. 0x1F + window]
//! 0x100 u32 file length - 0x104
//! 0x104 u32 0xCDEFBCDD
//! 0x108 u32 length of the zstd frame
//! 0x10C u32 FNV-1 32 over the decompressed payload
//! 0x110 u32 3 (zstd)
//! 0x124     zstd frame to the end of the file
//! ```
//!
//! The payload is the game's object tree. Its first u32 points (pointers are
//! `(v & 0xFFFFFF) - 32`) at a table of `(FNV-1 32 of the block name, pointer
//! to the block)` pairs; each block starts with a pointer to its end.
//! Game ids (people, classes, items) are stored as the low 32 bits of the
//! FNV-1 64 hash of their id string, such as `PID_カイ`. The strings come from
//! the player's own game data, so nothing of the game is shipped here.
//!
//! When EmblemWeave writes a slot it stores the payload in raw (uncompressed)
//! zstd blocks: a valid zstd frame that any decoder reads, so no compressor
//! is needed. The first time a slot is written, the untouched original is kept
//! beside it as `<slot>.orig`.

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::io::Read;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

const MAGIC: u32 = 0xCDEF_BCDD;
const HDR_FNV_START: usize = 0x1F;
const HDR_FNV_LEN: usize = 0xE0;
const ZSTD_MAGIC: [u8; 4] = [0x28, 0xB5, 0x2F, 0xFD];

pub fn fnv1a32(data: &[u8]) -> u32 {
    data.iter().fold(0x811C_9DC5u32, |h, &b| (h ^ b as u32).wrapping_mul(0x0100_0193))
}

pub fn fnv1_32(data: &[u8]) -> u32 {
    data.iter().fold(0x811C_9DC5u32, |h, &b| h.wrapping_mul(0x0100_0193) ^ b as u32)
}

pub fn fnv1_64(data: &[u8]) -> u64 {
    data.iter().fold(0xCBF2_9CE4_8422_2325u64, |h, &b| h.wrapping_mul(0x0000_0100_0000_01B3) ^ b as u64)
}

/// How the save stores a game id string.
pub fn id_hash(id: &str) -> u32 {
    fnv1_64(id.as_bytes()) as u32
}

fn u32_at(b: &[u8], at: usize) -> Option<u32> {
    b.get(at..at + 4).map(|s| u32::from_le_bytes(s.try_into().unwrap()))
}

fn ptr(v: u32) -> usize {
    ((v & 0x00FF_FFFF) as usize).wrapping_sub(32)
}

/// Named blocks of the payload, by the FNV-1 32 of their name.
pub const BLOCK_NAMES: [&str; 20] = [
    "Header", "GameSound", "GameSchedule", "GameUserData", "HubData", "GmapSpotMgr", "GmapTroopMgr", "GameGmapData",
    "GameRestartData", "SubquestData", "SideStoryData", "Calendar", "RecommendData", "Random", "UnitPool", "RidePool",
    "LegionPool", "Transporter", "HubSeq", "Data",
];

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Block {
    pub name: String,
    pub start: usize,
    pub end: usize,
}

/// One decoded slot.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Slot {
    pub path: PathBuf,
    raw: Vec<u8>,
    zstd_at: usize,
    pub payload: Vec<u8>,
}

impl Slot {
    pub fn open(path: &Path) -> Result<Slot, String> {
        let raw = std::fs::read(path).map_err(|e| format!("reading {}: {e}", path.display()))?;
        Self::from_bytes(path, raw)
    }

    pub fn from_bytes(path: &Path, raw: Vec<u8>) -> Result<Slot, String> {
        if raw.len() < 0x124 || u32_at(&raw, 0) != Some(MAGIC) {
            return Err("not a Fortune's Weave save slot".into());
        }
        let zstd_at = raw.windows(4).position(|w| w == ZSTD_MAGIC).ok_or("the slot holds no zstd frame")?;
        let mut payload = Vec::new();
        ruzstd::StreamingDecoder::new(std::io::Cursor::new(&raw[zstd_at..]))
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
            .read_to_end(&mut payload)
            .map_err(|e| format!("decompressing: {e}"))?;
        Ok(Slot { path: path.to_path_buf(), raw, zstd_at, payload })
    }

    /// Problems with the slot's checksums, empty when it is intact.
    pub fn verify(&self) -> Vec<String> {
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        let window = u32_at(&self.raw, 4).map(|w| w as usize).filter(|&w| w > 0).unwrap_or(HDR_FNV_LEN);
        if self.raw.get(HDR_FNV_START..HDR_FNV_START + window).map(fnv1a32) != u32_at(&self.raw, 8) {
            out.push("header checksum mismatch".into());
        }
        if u32_at(&self.raw, 0x10C) != Some(fnv1_32(&self.payload)) {
            out.push("payload checksum mismatch".into());
        }
        out
    }

    /// The slot file with the current payload and fresh checksums.
    pub fn to_bytes(&self) -> Vec<u8> {
        let mut out = self.raw[..self.zstd_at].to_vec();
        out.extend(raw_zstd_frame(&self.payload));
        let n = out.len();
        out[0x100..0x104].copy_from_slice(&((n - 0x104) as u32).to_le_bytes());
        out[0x104..0x108].copy_from_slice(&MAGIC.to_le_bytes());
        out[0x108..0x10C].copy_from_slice(&((n - self.zstd_at) as u32).to_le_bytes());
        out[0x10C..0x110].copy_from_slice(&fnv1_32(&self.payload).to_le_bytes());
        out[0x110..0x114].copy_from_slice(&3u32.to_le_bytes());
        let window = u32_at(&out, 4).map(|w| w as usize).filter(|&w| w > 0).unwrap_or(HDR_FNV_LEN);
        let sum = fnv1a32(&out[HDR_FNV_START..HDR_FNV_START + window]);
        out[8..12].copy_from_slice(&sum.to_le_bytes());
        out
    }

    /// Write the slot back. The original file is kept once as `<slot>.orig`;
    /// the new file is written beside the slot and swapped in.
    pub fn save(&mut self) -> Result<(), String> {
        let orig = with_suffix(&self.path, ".orig");
        if self.path.is_file() && !orig.exists() {
            std::fs::copy(&self.path, &orig).map_err(|e| format!("keeping the original: {e}"))?;
        }
        let bytes = self.to_bytes();
        let tmp = with_suffix(&self.path, ".tmp");
        std::fs::write(&tmp, &bytes).map_err(|e| format!("writing {}: {e}", tmp.display()))?;
        std::fs::rename(&tmp, &self.path).map_err(|e| format!("replacing {}: {e}", self.path.display()))?;
        self.zstd_at = self.zstd_at.min(bytes.len());
        self.raw = bytes;
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn blocks(&self) -> Vec<Block> {
        let p = &self.payload;
        let Some(table) = u32_at(p, 0).map(ptr) else { return Vec::new() };
        if table == 0 || table >= p.len() {
            return Vec::new();
        }
        let names: HashMap<u32, &str> = BLOCK_NAMES.iter().map(|n| (fnv1_32(n.as_bytes()), *n)).collect();
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        let mut i = table;
        while i + 8 <= p.len() {
            let (h, s) = (u32_at(p, i).unwrap(), ptr(u32_at(p, i + 4).unwrap()));
            if (4..p.len().saturating_sub(4)).contains(&s) {
                let e = ptr(u32_at(p, s).unwrap());
                if s < e && e <= p.len() {
                    out.push(Block { name: names.get(&h).map(|n| n.to_string()).unwrap_or(format!("#{h:08X}")), start: s, end: e });
                }
            }
            i += 8;
        }
        out.sort_by_key(|b| b.start);
        out
    }

    pub fn block(&self, name: &str) -> Option<Block> {
        self.blocks().into_iter().find(|b| b.name == name)
    }

    /// Offset of the player data (gold and the like), when the slot has it.
    fn user_data(&self) -> Option<usize> {
        let b = self.block("GameUserData")?;
        (self.payload.get(b.start + 4) == Some(&23) && b.start + 4 + 19 <= self.payload.len()).then_some(b.start + 4)
    }

    pub fn player(&self) -> Option<Player> {
        let at = self.user_data()?;
        Some(Player { gold: u32_at(&self.payload, at + 6)?, renown: u32_at(&self.payload, at + 10)? })
    }

    pub fn set_player(&mut self, p: &Player) -> bool {
        let Some(at) = self.user_data() else { return false };
        self.payload[at + 6..at + 10].copy_from_slice(&p.gold.to_le_bytes());
        self.payload[at + 10..at + 14].copy_from_slice(&p.renown.to_le_bytes());
        true
    }

    /// The units recorded in the slot: every place a known person id is
    /// followed by a known class id and a stat block. A unit can appear more
    /// than once (the party, a restart copy); each copy is listed.
    pub fn units(&self, ids: &Ids) -> Vec<Unit> {
        let p = &self.payload;
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        if ids.people.is_empty() {
            return out;
        }
        for o in 0..p.len().saturating_sub(80) {
            let person = u32_at(p, o).unwrap();
            let Some(name) = ids.people.get(&person) else { continue };
            let class = u32_at(p, o + 4).unwrap();
            if !ids.classes.is_empty() && !ids.classes.contains_key(&class) {
                continue;
            }
            if let Some(mut u) = parse_unit(p, o, name, class) {
                if let Some((table, m)) = find_masteries(p, u.level_at + 5) {
                    let after = table + 1 + 3 * m.len();
                    u.masteries = m;
                    if let Some((items, spells)) = find_items(p, after, &ids.items) {
                        u.items = items;
                        u.spells = spells;
                    }
                }
                out.push(u);
            }
        }
        out
    }

    pub fn write_unit(&mut self, u: &Unit) {
        let p = &mut self.payload;
        for (i, v) in u.stats.iter().enumerate() {
            p[u.stats_at + 2 * i..u.stats_at + 2 * i + 2].copy_from_slice(&v.to_le_bytes());
        }
        p[u.level_at] = u.level;
        for &(o, _, v) in &u.masteries {
            p[o..o + 2].copy_from_slice(&v.to_le_bytes());
        }
        for &(o, id) in u.items.iter().chain(&u.spells) {
            p[o..o + 4].copy_from_slice(&id.to_le_bytes());
        }
        let total = (u.level.max(1) as u16 - 1) * 100 + u.exp.min(99) as u16;
        p[u.level_at + 1..u.level_at + 3].copy_from_slice(&total.to_le_bytes());
        match u.hp_width {
            4 => p[u.level_at + 5..u.level_at + 9].copy_from_slice(&(u.max_hp as u32).to_le_bytes()),
            2 => p[u.level_at + 5..u.level_at + 7].copy_from_slice(&u.max_hp.to_le_bytes()),
            _ => p[u.level_at + 5] = u.max_hp.min(255) as u8,
        }
    }
}

fn with_suffix(p: &Path, s: &str) -> PathBuf {
    let mut o = p.as_os_str().to_owned();
    o.push(s);
    PathBuf::from(o)
}

/// A zstd frame holding `data` in raw blocks.
pub fn raw_zstd_frame(data: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut out = ZSTD_MAGIC.to_vec();
    // Single segment, 4-byte content size, no checksum, no dictionary.
    out.push(0b1010_0000);
    out.extend((data.len() as u32).to_le_bytes());
    const MAX: usize = 128 * 1024;
    let mut chunks = data.chunks(MAX).peekable();
    if data.is_empty() {
        out.extend([1, 0, 0]);
    }
    while let Some(c) = chunks.next() {
        let last = chunks.peek().is_none() as u32;
        let h = last | ((c.len() as u32) << 3);
        out.extend(&h.to_le_bytes()[..3]);
        out.extend(c);
    }
    out
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Player {
    pub gold: u32,
    pub renown: u32,
}

pub const STAT_NAMES: [&str; 9] = ["HP", "Str", "Mag", "Dex", "Spd", "Lck", "Def", "Res", "Cha"];

/// One copy of a unit's record.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Unit {
    pub at: usize,
    pub name: String,
    pub class: u32,
    pub stats_at: usize,
    /// What each stat has gained from level-ups (the game adds the class and
    /// personal bases on top), current HP first.
    pub stats: [u16; 9],
    pub level_at: usize,
    pub level: u8,
    /// Experience into the current level (0-99).
    pub exp: u8,
    pub max_hp: u16,
    pub hp_width: u8,
    /// Weapon and movement masteries: (offset of the value, key, cumulative
    /// experience). Keys are [`MASTERY_NAMES`].
    pub masteries: Vec<(usize, u8, u16)>,
    /// Carried items, then known spells: (offset of the item id, item id).
    pub items: Vec<(usize, u32)>,
    pub spells: Vec<(usize, u32)>,
}

/// Mastery keys, in the order the game stores them.
pub const MASTERY_NAMES: [&str; 13] = [
    "Sword", "Lance", "Axe", "Bow", "Fist", "Black magic", "White magic", "Other (7)", "Infantry", "Horse", "Armor", "Wing", "Flag",
];

/// Experience at which each mastery grade starts.
pub const GRADES: [(&str, u16); 12] =
    [("E", 0), ("E+", 20), ("D", 35), ("D+", 80), ("C", 220), ("C+", 440), ("B", 690), ("B+", 910), ("A", 1215), ("A+", 1510), ("S", 1960), ("S+", 2560)];

pub fn grade(exp: u16) -> &'static str {
    GRADES.iter().rev().find(|(_, t)| exp >= *t).map(|(g, _)| *g).unwrap_or("E")
}

/// The mastery table after a record's HP: a count byte, then (u8 key, u16
/// cumulative experience) entries with rising keys. The gap varies between
/// copies, so the longest table found in a short window wins.
fn find_masteries(p: &[u8], hp_at: usize) -> Option<(usize, Vec<(usize, u8, u16)>)> {
    let mut best: Option<(usize, Vec<(usize, u8, u16)>)> = None;
    for off in hp_at + 4..hp_at + 24 {
        let Some(&n) = p.get(off) else { break };
        if !(1..=13).contains(&n) || off + 1 + 3 * n as usize > p.len() {
            continue;
        }
        let mut v = Vec::new();
        let mut last: i32 = -1;
        for i in 0..n as usize {
            let o = off + 1 + 3 * i;
            let (k, val) = (p[o], u16::from_le_bytes([p[o + 1], p[o + 2]]));
            if k > 12 || (k as i32) <= last || val > 9999 {
                v.clear();
                break;
            }
            last = k as i32;
            v.push((o + 1, k, val));
        }
        if !v.is_empty() && best.as_ref().is_none_or(|(_, b)| v.len() > b.len()) {
            best = Some((off, v));
        }
    }
    best
}

/// The carried items and spells that follow the mastery table: a u32 marker,
/// a zero byte, the item and spell counts, then entries tagged 0x41 (an item
/// id) or 0x61 (an item id and 8 bytes of state, such as uses).
fn find_items(p: &[u8], from: usize, ids: &HashMap<u32, String>) -> Option<(Vec<(usize, u32)>, Vec<(usize, u32)>)> {
    for h in from..(from + 0x80).min(p.len().saturating_sub(7)) {
        let marker = u32_at(p, h)?;
        if !(1..0x0100_0000).contains(&marker) || p[h + 4] != 0 {
            continue;
        }
        let (ni, ns) = (p[h + 5] as usize, p[h + 6] as usize);
        if ni + ns == 0 || ni > 32 || ns > 64 {
            continue;
        }
        let mut o = h + 7;
        let mut all = Vec::new();
        let mut ok = true;
        for _ in 0..ni + ns {
            let size = match p.get(o) {
                Some(0x41) => 5,
                Some(0x61) => 13,
                _ => {
                    ok = false;
                    break;
                }
            };
            match u32_at(p, o + 1) {
                Some(id) if ids.contains_key(&id) => all.push((o + 1, id)),
                _ => {
                    ok = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            o += size;
        }
        if ok {
            let spells = all.split_off(ni);
            return Some((all, spells));
        }
    }
    None
}

/// The level byte of a record: level 1-99, a zero byte at +4, then max HP as
/// a u32, a u16 or a byte. Returns HP and its width.
fn level_sig(p: &[u8], b: usize) -> Option<(u16, u8)> {
    if b + 9 > p.len() || !(1..=99).contains(&p[b]) || p[b + 4] != 0 {
        return None;
    }
    let hp32 = u32_at(p, b + 5)?;
    if (5..=999).contains(&hp32) {
        return Some((hp32 as u16, 4));
    }
    let hp16 = u16::from_le_bytes([p[b + 5], p[b + 6]]);
    if (5..=999).contains(&hp16) && p[b + 7] == 0 && p[b + 8] == 0 {
        return Some((hp16, 2));
    }
    (p[b + 5] >= 5 && p[b + 6] >= 5).then_some((p[b + 5] as u16, 1))
}

fn parse_unit(p: &[u8], o: usize, name: &str, class: u32) -> Option<Unit> {
    // The nine u16 stats, then up to four zero bytes, then the level byte, a
    // little past the person and class ids.
    for s in o + 16..o + 56 {
        let stats: Vec<u16> = (0..9).map(|i| u16::from_le_bytes([p[s + 2 * i], p[s + 2 * i + 1]])).collect();
        if stats.iter().any(|&v| v > 255) {
            continue;
        }
        for gap in 0..=4 {
            let b = s + 18 + gap;
            if p[s + 18..b].iter().any(|&z| z != 0) {
                break;
            }
            if let Some((hp, w)) = level_sig(p, b) {
                let level = p[b];
                let raw = u16::from_le_bytes([p[b + 1], p[b + 2]]);
                let into = raw as i32 - (level as i32 - 1) * 100;
                let exp = if (0..=99).contains(&into) { into as u8 } else { (raw % 100) as u8 };
                return Some(Unit {
                    at: o,
                    name: name.to_string(),
                    class,
                    stats_at: s,
                    stats: stats.try_into().ok()?,
                    level_at: b,
                    level,
                    exp,
                    max_hp: hp,
                    hp_width: w,
                    masteries: Vec::new(),
                    items: Vec::new(),
                    spells: Vec::new(),
                });
            }
        }
    }
    None
}

/// Game ids by hash, read from the player's RomFS `GameData`.
#[derive(Debug, Default, Clone)]
pub struct Ids {
    pub people: HashMap<u32, String>,
    pub classes: HashMap<u32, String>,
    pub items: HashMap<u32, String>,
}

impl Ids {
    /// Collect `PID_`, `JID_` and `IID_` strings from `GameData/*.bin`.
    pub fn from_romfs(romfs: &Path) -> Ids {
        let mut ids = Ids::default();
        let Ok(dir) = std::fs::read_dir(romfs.join("GameData")) else { return ids };
        for e in dir.flatten() {
            let path = e.path();
            if path.extension().and_then(|x| x.to_str()) != Some("bin") {
                continue;
            }
            let Ok(bytes) = std::fs::read(&path) else { continue };
            ids.harvest(&bytes);
        }
        ids
    }

    pub fn harvest(&mut self, bytes: &[u8]) {
        for (prefix, which) in [(&b"PID_"[..], 0), (b"JID_", 1), (b"IID_", 2)] {
            let mut i = 0;
            while let Some(k) = bytes[i..].windows(4).position(|w| w == prefix) {
                let start = i + k;
                let end = bytes[start..].iter().position(|&c| c == 0 || c < 0x20).map_or(bytes.len(), |n| start + n);
                if let Ok(s) = std::str::from_utf8(&bytes[start..end]) {
                    if s.len() > 4 && s.len() < 96 {
                        let map = match which {
                            0 => &mut self.people,
                            1 => &mut self.classes,
                            _ => &mut self.items,
                        };
                        map.entry(id_hash(s)).or_insert_with(|| s[4..].to_string());
                    }
                }
                i = end.max(start + 4);
            }
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn raw_frames_decode() {
        for n in [0usize, 1, 1000, 128 * 1024, 300_000] {
            let data: Vec<u8> = (0..n).map(|i| (i * 7 % 251) as u8).collect();
            let frame = raw_zstd_frame(&data);
            let mut out = Vec::new();
            ruzstd::StreamingDecoder::new(std::io::Cursor::new(&frame[..])).unwrap().read_to_end(&mut out).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(out, data, "{n} bytes");
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn hashes_match_the_format() {
        assert_eq!(fnv1_32(b""), 0x811C_9DC5);
        assert_eq!(fnv1a32(b"a"), 0xE40C_292C);
        assert_eq!(fnv1_64(b"a"), 0xAF63_BD4C_8601_B7BE);
    }

    #[test]
    fn harvests_ids() {
        let mut ids = Ids::default();
        ids.harvest("..PID_カイ\0JID_剣士\0IID_鉄の剣\0".as_bytes());
        assert_eq!(ids.people.get(&id_hash("PID_カイ")).map(String::as_str), Some("カイ"));
        assert_eq!(ids.classes.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(ids.items.len(), 1);
    }

    /// Reads the real slots when they are on this PC: they decode, verify,
    /// and survive a write unchanged apart from the frame.
    #[test]
    fn real_slots_round_trip() {
        let Some(dir) = crate::config::Config::save_dir() else { return };
        let dir = crate::saves::account_dir(&dir).join("000");
        let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(&dir) else { return };
        for e in entries.flatten() {
            let p = e.path();
            if p.extension().is_some() {
                continue;
            }
            let Ok(slot) = Slot::open(&p) else { continue };
            assert!(slot.verify().is_empty(), "{}: {:?}", p.display(), slot.verify());
            let again = Slot::from_bytes(&p, slot.to_bytes()).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(again.payload, slot.payload);
            assert!(again.verify().is_empty());
        }
    }
}


#[cfg(test)]
mod edits {
    /// Edits a copy of the real Auto slot, when it is here: a mastery, an
    /// item and gold survive a save and a reopen, with valid checksums.
    #[test]
    fn edits_survive_a_save() {
        let romfs = std::path::Path::new("E:/FEFW/romfs");
        let Some(save) = crate::config::Config::save_dir() else { return };
        let auto = crate::saves::account_dir(&save).join("000").join("Auto");
        if !auto.is_file() || !romfs.is_dir() {
            return;
        }
        let ids = super::Ids::from_romfs(romfs);
        let dir = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("ew-edit-{}", std::process::id()));
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir);
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();
        let copy = dir.join("Auto");
        std::fs::copy(&auto, &copy).unwrap();
        let mut s = super::Slot::open(&copy).unwrap();
        let mut u = s.units(&ids).into_iter().find(|u| !u.masteries.is_empty() && u.items.len() >= 2).expect("a unit with masteries and two items");
        let other = u.items[1].1;
        u.masteries[0].2 = 2560;
        u.items[0].1 = other;
        s.write_unit(&u);
        let mut pl = s.player().unwrap();
        pl.gold = 123_456;
        s.set_player(&pl);
        s.save().unwrap();
        assert!(dir.join("Auto.orig").is_file());
        let again = super::Slot::open(&copy).unwrap();
        assert!(again.verify().is_empty(), "{:?}", again.verify());

        assert_eq!(v.masteries[0].2, 2560);
        assert_eq!(v.items[0].1, other);
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(dir);
    }
}

`apps/eblemweave/src/saves.rs`:

```rs
//! Save data: importing a Switch save from an emulator or a folder, and
//! exporting EmblemWeave's.
//!
//! The engine keeps the game's account save in
//! `<save folder>/account/<user id>/`, with a `<user id>.meta` file beside it
//! (size, journal size, owner and the save's 64-byte attribute). A Switch
//! emulator keeps the same files under
//! `nand/user/save/0000000000000000/<user>/<title id>`, so a save moves between
//! them as a copy of that folder's contents.
//!
//! Import never touches the source. If the account folder already holds a
//! save, it is moved to `<save folder>/backups/<time>/` first, so an import
//! can always be undone. When the game has not created its save yet, the
//! import writes the `.meta` the engine expects.

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

/// Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave's program id: the save folder's name in an
/// emulator's NAND. Used when the dump does not state it.
pub const FALLBACK_TITLE_ID: u64 = 0x0400_7EF0_1F8A_E000;

/// Emulators that keep saves as `<root>/nand/user/save/...` under
/// `%APPDATA%`.
const EMULATOR_DIRS: &[&str] = &["yuzu", "suyu", "sudachi", "citron", "eden", "torzu", "Ryujinx-yuzu"];

/// A save found on this PC.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Found {
    /// The emulator folder it was found under, such as `yuzu`.
    pub source: String,
    /// The title's save folder.
    pub path: PathBuf,
    /// Number of files and their newest modification time.
    pub files: usize,
    pub modified: Option<std::time::SystemTime>,
}

/// Saves for `title_id` under every known emulator in `appdata`.
pub fn find(appdata: &Path, title_id: u64) -> Vec<Found> {
    let name = format!("{title_id:016X}");
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    for emu in EMULATOR_DIRS {
        let users = appdata.join(emu).join("nand").join("user").join("save").join("0000000000000000");
        let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(&users) else { continue };
        for user in entries.flatten() {
            let path = user.path().join(&name);
            if path.is_dir() {
                let (files, modified) = summary(&path);
                if files > 0 {
                    out.push(Found { source: emu.to_string(), path, files, modified });
                }
            }
        }
    }
    out.sort_by(|a, b| b.modified.cmp(&a.modified));
    out
}

/// Saves under the current user's `%APPDATA%`.
pub fn find_here(title_id: u64) -> Vec<Found> {
    std::env::var_os("APPDATA").map(|a| find(Path::new(&a), title_id)).unwrap_or_default()
}

/// File count and newest modification time below `dir`.
pub fn summary(dir: &Path) -> (usize, Option<std::time::SystemTime>) {
    let mut files = 0;
    let mut newest = None;
    let mut stack = vec![dir.to_path_buf()];
    while let Some(d) = stack.pop() {
        let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(&d) else { continue };
        for e in entries.flatten() {
            let p = e.path();
            if p.is_dir() {
                stack.push(p);
            } else if let Ok(m) = e.metadata() {
                files += 1;
                if let Ok(t) = m.modified() {
                    newest = Some(newest.map_or(t, |n: std::time::SystemTime| n.max(t)));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    (files, newest)
}

fn copy_tree(from: &Path, to: &Path) -> Result<usize, String> {
    std::fs::create_dir_all(to).map_err(|e| format!("creating {}: {e}", to.display()))?;
    let mut copied = 0;
    for e in std::fs::read_dir(from).map_err(|e| format!("reading {}: {e}", from.display()))?.flatten() {
        let (src, dst) = (e.path(), to.join(e.file_name()));
        if src.is_dir() {
            copied += copy_tree(&src, &dst)?;
        } else {
            std::fs::copy(&src, &dst).map_err(|e| format!("copying {} to {}: {e}", src.display(), dst.display()))?;
            copied += 1;
        }
    }
    Ok(copied)
}

/// What an import did.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Imported {
    pub files: usize,
    /// Where the previous save was moved, if there was one.
    pub backup: Option<PathBuf>,
}

/// The engine's built-in local user id (`[account] uid` unset), as its save
/// folder names it.
pub const DEFAULT_USER: &str = "0100000000000000706d635257464546";
/// Save data and journal size the game asks for: 64 MiB each.
const SAVE_SIZE: u64 = 64 << 20;

/// The account save folder in the engine's save folder: the one the game
/// created, else the default user's.
pub fn account_dir(save_dir: &Path) -> PathBuf {
    let account = save_dir.join("account");
    std::fs::read_dir(&account)
        .ok()
        .and_then(|d| d.flatten().map(|e| e.path()).filter(|p| p.is_dir()).min())
        .unwrap_or_else(|| account.join(DEFAULT_USER))
}

/// The `.meta` the engine writes for an account save of `title_id`.
fn meta_text(title_id: u64, user_hex: &str) -> Option<String> {
    if user_hex.len() != 32 {
        return None;
    }
    let mut attr = [0u8; 0x40];
    attr[0..8].copy_from_slice(&title_id.to_le_bytes());
    for i in 0..16 {
        attr[8 + i] = u8::from_str_radix(user_hex.get(i * 2..i * 2 + 2)?, 16).ok()?;
    }
    attr[32] = 1; // SaveDataType::Account
    let hex: String = attr.iter().map(|b| format!("{b:02x}")).collect();
    Some(format!("size={SAVE_SIZE}\njournal={SAVE_SIZE}\nowner={title_id:x}\nattr={hex}\n"))
}

/// Copy `source` into the game's account save, moving any existing save to
/// `<save folder>/backups/<stamp>/` first.
pub fn import(source: &Path, save_dir: &Path, title_id: u64, stamp: &str) -> Result<Imported, String> {
    if !source.is_dir() {
        return Err(format!("{} is not a folder", source.display()));
    }
    if summary(source).0 == 0 {
        return Err(format!("{} holds no save files", source.display()));
    }
    let target = account_dir(save_dir);
    // A profile under the save folder is fine; the current save, or a folder
    // holding the save folder, is not.
    if source.starts_with(&target) || target.starts_with(source) || save_dir.starts_with(source) {
        return Err("the source and the save folder overlap".into());
    }
    let backup = if target.is_dir() && summary(&target).0 > 0 {
        let to = save_dir.join("backups").join(stamp);
        std::fs::create_dir_all(save_dir.join("backups")).map_err(|e| format!("creating the backups folder: {e}"))?;
        std::fs::rename(&target, &to).map_err(|e| format!("moving the current save to {}: {e}", to.display()))?;
        Some(to)
    } else {
        None
    };
    match copy_tree(source, &target) {
        Ok(files) => {
            let user = target.file_name().map(|n| n.to_string_lossy().into_owned()).unwrap_or_default();
            let meta = target.with_extension("meta");
            if !meta.is_file() {
                if let Some(text) = meta_text(title_id, &user) {
                    std::fs::write(&meta, text).map_err(|e| format!("writing {}: {e}", meta.display()))?;
                }
            }
            Ok(Imported { files, backup })
        }
        Err(e) => {
            // Put the previous save back rather than leave a partial copy.
            let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&target);
            if let Some(b) = &backup {
                let _ = std::fs::rename(b, &target);
            }
            Err(e)
        }
    }
}

/// Copy the game's account save into `dest/<title id>`, the layout an
/// emulator's user folder expects. Returns the folder written.
pub fn export(save_dir: &Path, dest: &Path, title_id: u64) -> Result<(PathBuf, usize), String> {
    let from = account_dir(save_dir);
    if summary(&from).0 == 0 {
        return Err("there is no EmblemWeave save to export yet".into());
    }
    let to = dest.join(format!("{title_id:016X}"));
    if to.exists() {
        return Err(format!("{} already exists; choose an empty folder", to.display()));
    }
    copy_tree(&from, &to).map(|n| (to, n))
}

/// A named copy of the account save, kept in `<save folder>/profiles/<name>`.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Profile {
    pub name: String,
    pub path: PathBuf,
    pub files: usize,
    pub modified: Option<std::time::SystemTime>,
}

pub fn profiles(save_dir: &Path) -> Vec<Profile> {
    let mut out: Vec<Profile> = std::fs::read_dir(save_dir.join("profiles"))
        .map(|d| {
            d.flatten()
                .map(|e| e.path())
                .filter(|p| p.is_dir())
                .map(|path| {
                    let (files, modified) = summary(&path);
                    Profile { name: path.file_name().unwrap_or_default().to_string_lossy().into_owned(), path, files, modified }
                })
                .collect()
        })
        .unwrap_or_default();
    out.sort_by(|a, b| a.name.to_lowercase().cmp(&b.name.to_lowercase()));
    out
}

/// Keep a copy of the current save as profile `name` (replacing a profile of
/// that name, which is moved to the backups first).
pub fn store_profile(save_dir: &Path, name: &str, stamp: &str) -> Result<usize, String> {
    let name = crate::mods::clean_name(name);
    let from = account_dir(save_dir);
    if summary(&from).0 == 0 {
        return Err("there is no save to keep yet".into());
    }
    let to = save_dir.join("profiles").join(&name);
    if to.exists() {
        let b = save_dir.join("backups").join(format!("{stamp}-profile-{name}"));
        std::fs::create_dir_all(save_dir.join("backups")).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        std::fs::rename(&to, &b).map_err(|e| format!("moving the old profile aside: {e}"))?;
    }
    copy_tree(&from, &to)
}

/// Make profile `p` the current save. The current save goes to the backups.
pub fn load_profile(save_dir: &Path, p: &Profile, title_id: u64, stamp: &str) -> Result<Imported, String> {
    import(&p.path, save_dir, title_id, stamp)
}

/// Move a profile to the backups folder.
pub fn remove_profile(save_dir: &Path, p: &Profile, stamp: &str) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
    let b = save_dir.join("backups").join(format!("{stamp}-profile-{}", p.name));
    std::fs::create_dir_all(save_dir.join("backups")).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    std::fs::rename(&p.path, &b).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    Ok(b)
}

/// The save slots in the current save: files directly in its folders, newest first.
pub fn slots(save_dir: &Path) -> Vec<(PathBuf, Option<std::time::SystemTime>)> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    let mut stack = vec![account_dir(save_dir)];
    while let Some(d) = stack.pop() {
        let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(&d) else { continue };
        for e in entries.flatten() {
            let p = e.path();
            if p.is_dir() {
                stack.push(p);
            } else if p.extension().is_none() {
                out.push((p, e.metadata().ok().and_then(|m| m.modified().ok())));
            }
        }
    }
    out.sort_by(|a, b| b.1.cmp(&a.1));
    out
}

/// The program id a `control.nacp` names as its save data owner.
pub fn nacp_save_owner(nacp: &Path) -> Option<u64> {
    let b = std::fs::read(nacp).ok()?;
    let v = u64::from_le_bytes(b.get(0x3078..0x3080)?.try_into().ok()?);
    (v != 0).then_some(v)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn temp(name: &str) -> PathBuf {
        let d = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("ew-saves-{name}-{}", std::process::id()));
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&d);
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&d).unwrap();
        d
    }

    fn write(p: &Path, text: &str) {
        std::fs::create_dir_all(p.parent().unwrap()).unwrap();
        std::fs::write(p, text).unwrap();
    }

    #[test]
    fn finds_emulator_saves_by_title() {
        let root = temp("find");
        let title = root.join("yuzu/nand/user/save/0000000000000000/5A3C/04007EF01F8AE000");
        write(&title.join("000/Auto"), "a");
        write(&root.join("yuzu/nand/user/save/0000000000000000/5A3C/0100000000000000/x"), "other game");
        let found = find(&root, FALLBACK_TITLE_ID);
        assert_eq!(found.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!((found[0].source.as_str(), found[0].files), ("yuzu", 1));
        assert_eq!(found[0].path, title);
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(root);
    }

    #[test]
    fn import_backs_up_and_leaves_the_source_alone() {
        let root = temp("import");
        let (src, save) = (root.join("src"), root.join("app/save"));
        write(&src.join("000/Auto"), "new");
        write(&src.join("000/Global"), "g");
        let user = save.join("account").join(DEFAULT_USER);
        write(&user.join("000/Auto"), "old");
        let r = import(&src, &save, FALLBACK_TITLE_ID, "1").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(r.files, 2);
        assert_eq!(std::fs::read_to_string(user.join("000/Auto")).unwrap(), "new");
        let backup = r.backup.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(std::fs::read_to_string(backup.join("000/Auto")).unwrap(), "old");
        assert_eq!(std::fs::read_to_string(src.join("000/Auto")).unwrap(), "new");
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(root);
    }

    #[test]
    fn import_refuses_empty_or_overlapping_sources() {
        let root = temp("refuse");
        let save = root.join("save");
        std::fs::create_dir_all(root.join("empty")).unwrap();
        assert!(import(&root.join("empty"), &save, FALLBACK_TITLE_ID, "1").is_err());
        write(&save.join("account/u/000/Auto"), "x");
        assert!(import(&save.join("account"), &save, FALLBACK_TITLE_ID, "1").is_err());
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(root);
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_first_import_writes_the_engines_meta() {
        let root = temp("meta");
        let (src, save) = (root.join("src"), root.join("save"));
        write(&src.join("000/Auto"), "a");
        import(&src, &save, FALLBACK_TITLE_ID, "1").unwrap();
        let meta = std::fs::read_to_string(save.join("account").join(format!("{DEFAULT_USER}.meta"))).unwrap();
        // The same attribute the engine wrote for this game's save.
        assert!(meta.starts_with("size=67108864\njournal=67108864\nowner=4007ef01f8ae000\n"));
        assert!(meta.contains("attr=00e08a1ff07e00040100000000000000706d6352574645460000000000000000010000"));
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(root);
    }

    #[test]
    fn profiles_store_and_load() {
        let root = temp("profiles");
        let save = root.join("save");
        let user = save.join("account").join(DEFAULT_USER);
        write(&user.join("000/Auto"), "first");
        store_profile(&save, "Run A", "1").unwrap();
        write(&user.join("000/Auto"), "second");
        let ps = profiles(&save);
        assert_eq!(ps.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(ps[0].name, "Run A");
        let r = load_profile(&save, &ps[0], FALLBACK_TITLE_ID, "2").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(std::fs::read_to_string(user.join("000/Auto")).unwrap(), "first");
        assert_eq!(std::fs::read_to_string(r.backup.unwrap().join("000/Auto")).unwrap(), "second");
        assert_eq!(slots(&save).len(), 1);
        remove_profile(&save, &ps[0], "3").unwrap();
        assert!(profiles(&save).is_empty());
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(root);
    }

    #[test]
    fn export_writes_the_emulator_layout() {
        let root = temp("export");
        let save = root.join("save");
        write(&save.join("account").join(DEFAULT_USER).join("000/Auto"), "x");
        let (to, n) = export(&save, &root.join("out"), FALLBACK_TITLE_ID).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(n, 1);
        assert!(to.ends_with("04007EF01F8AE000"));
        assert!(to.join("000/Auto").is_file());
        assert!(export(&save, &root.join("out"), FALLBACK_TITLE_ID).is_err());
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(root);
    }
}

const fn rgb(r: u8, g: u8, b: u8) -> Color32 {
    Color32::from_rgb(r, g, b)
}

const fn rgba(r: u8, g: u8, b: u8, a: u8) -> Color32 {
    Color32::from_rgba_premultiplied(
        (r as u32 * a as u32 / 255) as u8,
        (g as u32 * a as u32 / 255) as u8,
        (b as u32 * a as u32 / 255) as u8,
        a,
    )
}

/// White at an opacity, as the site's `rgba(255, 255, 255, a)` hairlines.
const fn white(a: f32) -> Color32 {
    let v = (a * 255.0) as u8;
    Color32::from_rgba_premultiplied(v, v, v, v)
}

/// Translucent version of an opaque colour.
pub fn alpha(c: Color32, a: u8) -> Color32 {
    let [r, g, b, _] = c.to_array();
    Color32::from_rgba_unmultiplied(r, g, b, a)
}

// ---- typography ------------------------------------------------------------

pub fn display_family() -> FontFamily {
    FontFamily::Name("display".into())
}
pub fn display_bold_family() -> FontFamily {
    FontFamily::Name("display_bold".into())
}
pub fn semibold_family() -> FontFamily {
    FontFamily::Name("semibold".into())
}

/// Serif display type for branding and page titles.
pub fn display(size: f32) -> FontId {
    FontId::new(size, display_family())
}
/// Semibold sans for labels and buttons.
pub fn semibold(size: f32) -> FontId {
    FontId::new(size, semibold_family())
}
pub fn mono(size: f32) -> FontId {
    FontId::new(size, FontFamily::Monospace)
}

/// Install the launcher's typefaces from the fonts the system already has.
/// Each family falls back to egui's bundled faces, so a missing system font
/// changes the look, never the ability to render.
pub fn configure_fonts(ctx: &egui::Context) {
    let mut fonts = egui::FontDefinitions::default();
    let base_prop = fonts.families.get(&FontFamily::Proportional).cloned().unwrap_or_default();
    let base_mono = fonts.families.get(&FontFamily::Monospace).cloned().unwrap_or_default();

    let mut load = |key: &str, candidates: &[&str]| -> Option<String> {
        let bytes = candidates.iter().find_map(|p| std::fs::read(p).ok())?;
        fonts.font_data.insert(key.to_owned(), std::sync::Arc::new(egui::FontData::from_owned(bytes)));
        Some(key.to_owned())
    };
    let win = |f: &str| format!(r"C:\Windows\Fonts\{f}");
    let serif = load("serif", &[&win("constan.ttf"), &win("georgia.ttf"), &win("pala.ttf"), "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSerif.ttf"]);
    let serif_bold = load("serif_bold", &[&win("constanb.ttf"), &win("georgiab.ttf"), &win("palab.ttf"), "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSerif-Bold.ttf"]);
    let sans = load("sans", &[&win("segoeui.ttf"), "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"]);
    let sans_semi = load("sans_semi", &[&win("seguisb.ttf"), &win("segoeuib.ttf")]);
    let mono = load("mono", &[&win("CascadiaMono.ttf"), &win("consola.ttf"), "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono.ttf"]);

    let chain = |first: Option<String>, rest: &[String]| -> Vec<String> {
        first.into_iter().chain(rest.iter().cloned()).collect()
    };
    let prop = chain(sans.clone(), &base_prop);
    fonts.families.insert(FontFamily::Proportional, prop.clone());
    fonts.families.insert(FontFamily::Monospace, chain(mono, &base_mono));
    fonts.families.insert(display_family(), chain(serif.clone(), &prop));
    fonts.families.insert(display_bold_family(), chain(serif_bold.or(serif), &prop));
    fonts.families.insert(semibold_family(), chain(sans_semi.or(sans), &prop));
    ctx.set_fonts(fonts);
}

/// Apply a scheme to the whole interface.
pub fn apply(ctx: &egui::Context, scheme: Scheme) {
    let p = scheme.palette();
    let mut style = (*ctx.style()).clone();
    let v = &mut style.visuals;
    v.dark_mode = true;
    v.panel_fill = p.bg;
    v.window_fill = p.surface;
    v.window_stroke = egui::Stroke::new(1.0_f32, p.line_strong);
    v.faint_bg_color = p.panel;
    v.extreme_bg_color = p.bg_deep;
    v.code_bg_color = p.bg_deep;
    v.override_text_color = Some(p.body);
    v.hyperlink_color = p.accent_hi;
    v.warn_fg_color = p.warn;
    v.error_fg_color = p.bad;
    v.window_corner_radius = RADIUS_M.into();
    v.menu_corner_radius = RADIUS_S.into();
    v.popup_shadow = egui::epaint::Shadow { offset: [0, 12], blur: 30, spread: 0, color: Color32::from_black_alpha(190) };
    v.window_shadow = v.popup_shadow;

    let w = &mut v.widgets;
    w.noninteractive.bg_fill = p.surface;
    w.noninteractive.weak_bg_fill = p.surface;
    w.noninteractive.bg_stroke = egui::Stroke::new(1.0_f32, p.line);
    w.noninteractive.fg_stroke = egui::Stroke::new(1.0_f32, p.body);
    w.inactive.bg_fill = p.panel_hi;
    w.inactive.weak_bg_fill = alpha(Color32::WHITE, 5);
    w.inactive.bg_stroke = egui::Stroke::new(1.0_f32, p.line_strong);
    w.inactive.fg_stroke = egui::Stroke::new(1.0_f32, p.ink);
    w.hovered.bg_fill = alpha(p.accent, 40);
    w.hovered.weak_bg_fill = alpha(p.accent, 18);
    w.hovered.bg_stroke = egui::Stroke::new(1.0_f32, alpha(p.accent, 115));
    w.hovered.fg_stroke = egui::Stroke::new(1.5_f32, p.ink);
    w.active.bg_fill = alpha(p.accent, 80);
    w.active.weak_bg_fill = alpha(p.accent, 60);
    w.active.bg_stroke = egui::Stroke::new(1.0_f32, p.accent_hi);
    w.active.fg_stroke = egui::Stroke::new(1.5_f32, p.ink);
    w.open.bg_fill = p.panel_hi;
    w.open.weak_bg_fill = p.panel_hi;
    w.open.bg_stroke = egui::Stroke::new(1.0_f32, p.accent);
    for state in [&mut w.noninteractive, &mut w.inactive, &mut w.hovered, &mut w.active, &mut w.open] {
        state.corner_radius = RADIUS_S.into();
    }
    v.selection.bg_fill = alpha(p.accent, 110);
    v.selection.stroke = egui::Stroke::new(1.0_f32, p.ink);

    style.spacing.item_spacing = egui::vec2(SPACE_S + 2.0, SPACE_S);
    style.spacing.button_padding = egui::vec2(14.0, 7.0);
    style.spacing.interact_size.y = 30.0;
    style.spacing.slider_width = 220.0;
    style.text_styles.insert(TextStyle::Heading, display(26.0));
    style.text_styles.insert(TextStyle::Body, FontId::new(14.0, FontFamily::Proportional));
    style.text_styles.insert(TextStyle::Button, FontId::new(14.0, FontFamily::Proportional));
    style.text_styles.insert(TextStyle::Small, FontId::new(12.0, FontFamily::Proportional));
    style.text_styles.insert(TextStyle::Monospace, mono(12.5));
    style.animation_time = 0.18;
    ctx.set_style(style);
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn default_scheme_is_xion() {
        assert_eq!(Scheme::default(), Scheme::Xion);
    }

    #[test]
    fn the_xion_scheme_uses_the_site_tokens() {
        let p = Scheme::Xion.palette();
        assert_eq!(p.bg, Color32::from_rgb(0x05, 0x06, 0x07));
        assert_eq!(p.panel, Color32::from_rgb(0x0A, 0x0B, 0x0D));
        assert_eq!(p.surface, Color32::from_rgb(0x0C, 0x0E, 0x11));
        assert_eq!(p.panel_hi, Color32::from_rgb(0x10, 0x13, 0x18));
        assert_eq!(p.ink, Color32::from_rgb(0xEC, 0xED, 0xEF));
        assert_eq!(p.body, Color32::from_rgb(0xBD, 0xC3, 0xCC));
        assert_eq!(p.muted, Color32::from_rgb(0x8B, 0x90, 0x99));
        assert_eq!(p.accent, Color32::from_rgb(0x3F, 0x80, 0xFF));
        assert_eq!(p.accent_hover, Color32::from_rgb(0x4D, 0x8A, 0xFF));
        assert_eq!(p.accent_hi, Color32::from_rgb(0x79, 0xA8, 0xFF));
        assert_eq!(p.line, white(0.07));
        assert_eq!(p.line_strong, white(0.14));
    }

    #[test]
    fn arcade_is_its_own_palette_with_the_grid() {
        let (x, a) = (Scheme::Xion.palette(), Scheme::Arcade.palette());
        assert_ne!(x.accent, a.accent);
        assert_ne!(x.bg, a.bg);
        assert!(a.grid && !x.grid);
    }

    #[test]
    fn an_old_emblem_setting_loads_as_fe() {
        let s: Scheme = serde_json::from_str("\"emblem\"").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(s, Scheme::Fe);
    }

    #[test]
    fn every_scheme_separates_its_surfaces_and_text() {
        for s in Scheme::ALL {
            let p = s.palette();
            assert_ne!(p.bg, p.surface, "{}", s.label());
            assert_ne!(p.ink, p.body, "{}", s.label());
            assert_ne!(p.accent, p.accent_hi, "{}", s.label());
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn schemes_round_trip_through_the_config() {
        for s in Scheme::ALL {
            let back: Scheme = serde_json::from_str(&serde_json::to_string(&s).unwrap()).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(back, s);
        }
    }
}

`apps/eblemweave/src/widgets.rs`:

```rs
//! Shared interface components. Every one takes its colours from the active
//! [`Palette`] and its sizes from `theme`, so pages compose them instead of
//! styling widgets themselves.

use crate::jobs::{Stage, StageStatus};
use crate::theme::{self, alpha, Palette};
use eframe::egui::{self, Color32, CornerRadius, Margin, Pos2, Rect, RichText, Sense, Stroke, StrokeKind, Vec2};

/// Status colours with their meaning, so a page never picks a raw colour.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Tone {
    Neutral,
    Accent,
    Ok,
    Warn,
    Bad,
}

impl Tone {
    pub fn colour(self, p: &Palette) -> Color32 {
        match self {
            Tone::Neutral => p.body,
            Tone::Accent => p.accent_hi,
            Tone::Ok => p.ok,
            Tone::Warn => p.warn,
            Tone::Bad => p.bad,
        }
    }
}

/// Page title in the display serif with a one-line description.
pub fn page_header(ui: &mut egui::Ui, p: &Palette, title: &str, subtitle: &str) {
    ui.add_space(theme::SPACE_L);
    ui.label(RichText::new(title).font(theme::display(30.0)).color(p.ink));
    ui.add_space(2.0);
    ui.label(RichText::new(subtitle).size(14.0).color(p.body));
    ui.add_space(theme::SPACE_L);
}

/// An elevated section with a small caps title.
pub fn section<R>(ui: &mut egui::Ui, p: &Palette, title: &str, add: impl FnOnce(&mut egui::Ui) -> R) -> R {
    let face = ui.painter().add(egui::Shape::Noop);
    let r = card_frame(p, Margin::symmetric(24, 20))
        .show(ui, |ui| {
            ui.set_width(ui.available_width());
            if !title.is_empty() {
                ui.label(RichText::new(title.to_uppercase()).font(theme::semibold(11.5)).color(p.muted));
                ui.add_space(theme::SPACE_S);
            }
            add(ui)
        });
    // The face is painted under the content once the card's size is known.
    ui.painter().set(face, card_face(r.response.rect, p));
    ui.add_space(theme::SPACE_M);
    r.inner
}

/// The frame of a raised card: no hard outline, a deep soft shadow.
pub fn card_frame(p: &Palette, margin: Margin) -> egui::Frame {
    egui::Frame::new()
        .fill(lerp(p.surface, p.panel_hi, 0.35))
        .stroke(Stroke::new(1.0_f32, alpha(Color32::WHITE, 9)))
        .corner_radius(CornerRadius::same(theme::RADIUS_M))
        .shadow(egui::epaint::Shadow { offset: [0, 22], blur: 52, spread: 0, color: Color32::from_black_alpha(120) })
        .inner_margin(margin)
}

/// The face of a card: lighter at the top, with a thin highlight along the
/// top edge, as the soft-UI style has it.
pub fn card_face(r: Rect, p: &Palette) -> egui::Shape {
    let radius = theme::RADIUS_M as f32 - 1.0;
    let top = Rect::from_min_max(r.min + Vec2::new(radius * 0.6, 1.0), Pos2::new(r.max.x - radius * 0.6, r.min.y + 2.0));
    egui::Shape::Vec(vec![
        gradient_shape(r.shrink(1.0), radius, alpha(Color32::WHITE, 10), alpha(p.bg_deep, 40)),
        egui::Shape::rect_filled(top, CornerRadius::same(1), alpha(Color32::WHITE, 16)),
    ])
}

/// A small rounded label: status, counts, flags.
pub fn pill(ui: &mut egui::Ui, p: &Palette, text: &str, tone: Tone) -> egui::Response {
    let c = tone.colour(p);
    egui::Frame::new()
        .fill(alpha(c, 30))
        .stroke(Stroke::new(1.0_f32, alpha(c, 90)))
        .corner_radius(CornerRadius::same(255))
        .inner_margin(Margin::symmetric(11, 4))
        .show(ui, |ui| ui.label(RichText::new(text).font(theme::semibold(12.0)).color(c)))
        .response
}

/// A coloured dot followed by text, for check lists.
pub fn status_line(ui: &mut egui::Ui, p: &Palette, tone: Tone, label: &str, detail: &str) {
    ui.horizontal_wrapped(|ui| {
        let (r, _) = ui.allocate_exact_size(Vec2::splat(10.0), Sense::hover());
        ui.painter().circle_filled(r.center(), 4.0, tone.colour(p));
        ui.label(RichText::new(label).font(theme::semibold(13.5)).color(p.ink));
        ui.label(RichText::new(detail).size(13.0).color(p.body));
    });
}

/// The outline of a rounded rectangle, clockwise from the top left.
fn rounded_outline(rect: Rect, radius: f32) -> Vec<Pos2> {
    let r = radius.min(rect.width() / 2.0).min(rect.height() / 2.0);
    let corners = [
        (Pos2::new(rect.left() + r, rect.top() + r), std::f32::consts::PI),
        (Pos2::new(rect.right() - r, rect.top() + r), 1.5 * std::f32::consts::PI),
        (Pos2::new(rect.right() - r, rect.bottom() - r), 0.0),
        (Pos2::new(rect.left() + r, rect.bottom() - r), 0.5 * std::f32::consts::PI),
    ];
    let mut pts = Vec::with_capacity(4 * 9);
    for (c, start) in corners {
        for k in 0..=8 {
            let a = start + k as f32 / 8.0 * std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_2;
            pts.push(c + Vec2::new(a.cos(), a.sin()) * r);
        }
    }
    pts
}

/// Fill a rounded rectangle with a vertical gradient, as one mesh.
pub fn gradient_fill(painter: &egui::Painter, rect: Rect, radius: f32, top: Color32, bottom: Color32) {
    painter.add(gradient_shape(rect, radius, top, bottom));
}

/// [`gradient_fill`] as a shape, for painting behind content laid out later.
pub fn gradient_shape(rect: Rect, radius: f32, top: Color32, bottom: Color32) -> egui::Shape {
    let outline = rounded_outline(rect, radius);
    let shade = |y: f32| lerp(top, bottom, ((y - rect.top()) / rect.height().max(1.0)).clamp(0.0, 1.0));
    let mut mesh = egui::Mesh::default();
    mesh.colored_vertex(rect.center(), shade(rect.center().y));
    for q in &outline {
        mesh.colored_vertex(*q, shade(q.y));
    }
    let n = outline.len() as u32;
    for i in 0..n {
        mesh.add_triangle(0, 1 + i, 1 + (i + 1) % n);
    }
    egui::Shape::mesh(mesh)
}

/// A liquid surface: a deep-to-light body, a glossy meniscus across the top
/// half, a lit rim, and a sheen that drifts across while `flow` is above zero.
pub fn liquid(ui: &egui::Ui, rect: Rect, radius: f32, base: Color32, flow: f32) {
    let painter = ui.painter();
    let deep = lerp(base, Color32::BLACK, 0.28);
    let light = lerp(base, Color32::WHITE, 0.16);
    gradient_fill(painter, rect, radius, light, deep);
    // The meniscus: a bright film over the top half that fades to nothing.
    let film = Rect::from_min_max(rect.min + Vec2::new(1.5, 1.5), Pos2::new(rect.max.x - 1.5, rect.center().y + 1.0));
    gradient_fill(painter, film, (radius - 1.5).max(0.0), Color32::from_white_alpha(52), Color32::from_white_alpha(4));
    // A caustic sheen: a soft diagonal band moving left to right.
    if flow > 0.0 {
        let t = (ui.input(|i| i.time) as f32 * 0.45).fract();
        let band = rect.height() * 1.4;
        let x = rect.left() - band + (rect.width() + band * 2.0) * t;
        let clip = painter.with_clip_rect(rect.shrink(1.0).intersect(painter.clip_rect()));
        let a = (34.0 * flow) as u8;
        let mut mesh = egui::Mesh::default();
        let slant = rect.height() * 0.6;
        for (dx, alpha) in [(0.0, 0u8), (band * 0.5, a), (band, 0u8)] {
            mesh.colored_vertex(Pos2::new(x + dx + slant, rect.top()), Color32::from_white_alpha(alpha));
            mesh.colored_vertex(Pos2::new(x + dx - slant, rect.bottom()), Color32::from_white_alpha(alpha));
        }
        for i in 0..2u32 {
            mesh.add_triangle(i * 2, i * 2 + 1, i * 2 + 2);
            mesh.add_triangle(i * 2 + 1, i * 2 + 2, i * 2 + 3);
        }
        clip.add(egui::Shape::mesh(mesh));
        ui.ctx().request_repaint();
    }
    // Lit upper rim and a darker lower rim give the surface its thickness.
    let rim = CornerRadius::same(radius as u8);
    painter.rect_stroke(rect, rim, Stroke::new(1.0_f32, Color32::from_white_alpha(26)), StrokeKind::Inside);
    painter.line_segment(
        [Pos2::new(rect.left() + radius, rect.top() + 0.8), Pos2::new(rect.right() - radius, rect.top() + 0.8)],
        Stroke::new(1.0_f32, Color32::from_white_alpha(70)),
    );
}

fn button_core(ui: &mut egui::Ui, p: &Palette, text: &str, enabled: bool, primary: bool, height: f32) -> egui::Response {
    let font = theme::semibold(if primary { 15.5 } else { 14.0 });
    let galley = ui.painter().layout_no_wrap(text.to_owned(), font, p.ink);
    let size = Vec2::new(galley.size().x + if primary { 46.0 } else { 32.0 }, height);
    let sense = if enabled { Sense::click() } else { Sense::hover() };
    let (slot, response) = ui.allocate_exact_size(size, sense);
    if ui.is_rect_visible(slot) {
        let hover = ui.ctx().animate_bool(response.id.with("hover"), enabled && response.hovered());
        let pressed = enabled && response.is_pointer_button_down_on();
        // The site lifts a hovered button by two pixels.
        let rect = slot.translate(Vec2::new(0.0, -2.0 * hover + if pressed { 1.0 } else { 0.0 }));
        let radius = theme::RADIUS_S as f32;
        let painter = ui.painter();
        if !enabled {
            painter.rect_filled(rect, CornerRadius::same(theme::RADIUS_S), alpha(Color32::WHITE, 6));
            painter.rect_stroke(rect, CornerRadius::same(theme::RADIUS_S), Stroke::new(1.0_f32, p.line), StrokeKind::Inside);
            painter.galley_with_override_text_color(rect.center() - galley.size() / 2.0, galley, p.muted);
            return response;
        }
        if primary {
            // A blue shadow under the button, deeper on hover.
            for i in 1..=5 {
                let spread = i as f32 * 2.6;
                let r = Rect::from_min_max(
                    Pos2::new(rect.left() + 8.0 - spread * 0.4, rect.bottom() - 6.0),
                    Pos2::new(rect.right() - 8.0 + spread * 0.4, rect.bottom() + spread * (1.0 + hover)),
                );
                painter.rect_filled(r, CornerRadius::same(12), alpha(p.accent, ((26.0 + 22.0 * hover) / i as f32) as u8));
            }
            let base = if pressed { p.accent_deep } else { lerp(p.accent, p.accent_hover, hover) };
            liquid(ui, rect, radius, base, hover);
        } else {
            let base = lerp(alpha(Color32::WHITE, 5), alpha(p.accent, 22), hover);
            ui.painter().rect_filled(rect, CornerRadius::same(theme::RADIUS_S), base);
            gradient_fill(ui.painter(), Rect::from_min_max(rect.min + Vec2::splat(1.0), Pos2::new(rect.max.x - 1.0, rect.center().y)), radius - 1.0, Color32::from_white_alpha(14), Color32::from_white_alpha(0));
            let edge = lerp(p.line_strong, alpha(p.accent, 115), hover);
            ui.painter().rect_stroke(rect, CornerRadius::same(theme::RADIUS_S), Stroke::new(1.0_f32, edge), StrokeKind::Inside);
            if hover > 0.0 {
                liquid_sheen(ui, rect, hover);
            }
        }
        if response.has_focus() {
            ui.painter().rect_stroke(rect.expand(3.0), CornerRadius::same(theme::RADIUS_S + 3), Stroke::new(1.5_f32, p.accent_hi), StrokeKind::Outside);
        }
        let ink = if primary { Color32::WHITE } else { lerp(p.ink, Color32::WHITE, hover) };
        ui.painter().galley_with_override_text_color(rect.center() - galley.size() / 2.0, galley, ink);
    }
    if enabled {
        response.on_hover_cursor(egui::CursorIcon::PointingHand)
    } else {
        response
    }
}

/// Only the drifting sheen of [`liquid`], for glass controls.
fn liquid_sheen(ui: &egui::Ui, rect: Rect, flow: f32) {
    let t = (ui.input(|i| i.time) as f32 * 0.45).fract();
    let band = rect.height() * 1.4;
    let x = rect.left() - band + (rect.width() + band * 2.0) * t;
    let clip = ui.painter().with_clip_rect(rect.shrink(1.0).intersect(ui.clip_rect()));
    let a = (22.0 * flow) as u8;
    let slant = rect.height() * 0.6;
    let mut mesh = egui::Mesh::default();
    for (dx, alpha) in [(0.0, 0u8), (band * 0.5, a), (band, 0u8)] {
        mesh.colored_vertex(Pos2::new(x + dx + slant, rect.top()), Color32::from_white_alpha(alpha));
        mesh.colored_vertex(Pos2::new(x + dx - slant, rect.bottom()), Color32::from_white_alpha(alpha));
    }
    for i in 0..2u32 {
        mesh.add_triangle(i * 2, i * 2 + 1, i * 2 + 2);
        mesh.add_triangle(i * 2 + 1, i * 2 + 2, i * 2 + 3);
    }
    clip.add(egui::Shape::mesh(mesh));
    ui.ctx().request_repaint();
}

/// The page backdrop: a radial accent glow from the top, and for the arcade
/// scheme a 32 pixel neon grid, fading out away from the glow.
pub fn backdrop(painter: &egui::Painter, rect: Rect, p: &Palette) {
    let focus = Pos2::new(rect.left() + rect.width() * 0.40, rect.top());
    let reach = rect.width().max(rect.height()) * 0.9;
    if p.grid {
        let step = 32.0;
        let mut x = rect.left() - (rect.left() % step);
        while x < rect.right() {
            let mut y = rect.top();
            while y < rect.bottom() {
                let d = ((Pos2::new(x, y) - focus).length() / reach).min(1.0);
                // Neon grid lines in the scheme's highlight colour.
                let a = (26.0 * (1.0 - d).powi(2)) as u8;
                if a > 0 {
                    let line = Stroke::new(1.0_f32, alpha(p.electric, a));
                    painter.line_segment([Pos2::new(x, y), Pos2::new(x, y + step)], line);
                    painter.line_segment([Pos2::new(x, y), Pos2::new(x + step, y)], line);
                }
                y += step;
            }
            x += step;
        }
    }
    // One wide ellipse of the accent from the top edge.
    let [r, g, b, _] = p.accent.to_array();
    let peak = if p.grid { 40u8 } else { 26 };
    let mut mesh = egui::Mesh::default();
    let (rings, segs) = (10u32, 40u32);
    mesh.colored_vertex(focus, Color32::from_rgba_unmultiplied(r, g, b, peak));
    for ring in 1..=rings {
        let t = ring as f32 / rings as f32;
        let a = (peak as f32 * (1.0 - t).powi(2)) as u8;
        for s in 0..segs {
            let ang = s as f32 / segs as f32 * std::f32::consts::TAU;
            mesh.colored_vertex(focus + Vec2::new(ang.cos() * reach * 0.75 * t, ang.sin() * reach * 0.45 * t), Color32::from_rgba_unmultiplied(r, g, b, a));
        }
    }
    let idx = |ring: u32, s: u32| 1 + (ring - 1) * segs + (s % segs);
    for s in 0..segs {
        mesh.add_triangle(0, idx(1, s), idx(1, s + 1));
    }
    for ring in 1..rings {
        for s in 0..segs {
            let (a, b, c, d) = (idx(ring, s), idx(ring, s + 1), idx(ring + 1, s), idx(ring + 1, s + 1));
            mesh.add_triangle(a, b, c);
            mesh.add_triangle(b, d, c);
        }
    }
    painter.add(egui::Shape::mesh(mesh));
}

fn lerp(a: Color32, b: Color32, t: f32) -> Color32 {
    let [ar, ag, ab, aa] = a.to_array();
    let [br, bg, bb, ba] = b.to_array();
    let m = |x: u8, y: u8| (x as f32 + (y as f32 - x as f32) * t).round() as u8;
    Color32::from_rgba_premultiplied(m(ar, br), m(ag, bg), m(ab, bb), m(aa, ba))
}

/// The one prominent action on a page.
pub fn primary_button(ui: &mut egui::Ui, p: &Palette, text: &str, enabled: bool) -> egui::Response {
    button_core(ui, p, text, enabled, true, 44.0)
}

pub fn button(ui: &mut egui::Ui, p: &Palette, text: &str, enabled: bool) -> egui::Response {
    button_core(ui, p, text, enabled, false, 32.0)
}

/// An animated on/off switch.
pub fn toggle(ui: &mut egui::Ui, p: &Palette, on: &mut bool) -> egui::Response {
    let size = Vec2::new(40.0, 22.0);
    let (rect, mut response) = ui.allocate_exact_size(size, Sense::click());
    if response.clicked() {
        *on = !*on;
        response.mark_changed();
    }
    if ui.is_rect_visible(rect) {
        let t = ui.ctx().animate_bool(response.id, *on);
        let painter = ui.painter();
        let track = lerp(p.panel_hi, p.accent, t);
        painter.rect_filled(rect, CornerRadius::same(11), track);
        painter.rect_stroke(
            rect,
            CornerRadius::same(11),
            Stroke::new(1.0_f32, if response.hovered() { p.accent_hi } else { p.line }),
            StrokeKind::Inside,
        );
        let x = egui::lerp(rect.left() + 11.0..=rect.right() - 11.0, t);
        painter.circle_filled(Pos2::new(x, rect.center().y), 8.0, if *on { Color32::WHITE } else { p.body });
        if response.has_focus() {
            painter.rect_stroke(rect.expand(3.0), CornerRadius::same(13), Stroke::new(1.5_f32, p.electric), StrokeKind::Outside);
        }
    }
    response.on_hover_cursor(egui::CursorIcon::PointingHand)
}

/// A labelled settings row: label and help on the left, control on the right.
pub fn setting_row(ui: &mut egui::Ui, p: &Palette, label: &str, help: &str, control: impl FnOnce(&mut egui::Ui)) {
    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        ui.vertical(|ui| {
            ui.set_width((ui.available_width() * 0.5).max(220.0));
            ui.label(RichText::new(label).font(theme::semibold(14.0)).color(p.ink));
            if !help.is_empty() {
                ui.label(RichText::new(help).size(12.5).color(p.muted));
            }
        });
        ui.with_layout(egui::Layout::right_to_left(egui::Align::Center), control);
    });
    ui.add_space(theme::SPACE_XS);
    let r = ui.available_rect_before_wrap();
    ui.painter().hline(r.x_range(), r.top(), Stroke::new(1.0_f32, alpha(p.line, 120)));
    ui.add_space(theme::SPACE_S);
}

/// A key/value line in monospace, for addresses and counts.
pub fn kv(ui: &mut egui::Ui, p: &Palette, key: &str, value: &str) {

        });
        ui.add(egui::Label::new(RichText::new(value).font(theme::mono(12.5)).color(p.ink)).truncate())
            .on_hover_text(value);
    });
}

/// The honest marker for settings that are stored but not yet consumed.
pub fn pending_note(ui: &mut egui::Ui, p: &Palette, text: &str) {
    egui::Frame::new()
        .fill(alpha(p.warn, 18))
        .stroke(Stroke::new(1.0_f32, alpha(p.warn, 90)))
        .corner_radius(CornerRadius::same(theme::RADIUS_S))
        .inner_margin(Margin::symmetric(12, 8))
        .show(ui, |ui| {
            ui.set_width(ui.available_width());
            ui.label(RichText::new(text).size(13.0).color(p.warn));
        });
    ui.add_space(theme::SPACE_M);
}

/// A vertical list of pipeline stages with status, timing and detail.
pub fn stage_list(ui: &mut egui::Ui, p: &Palette, stages: &[Stage]) {
    for (i, s) in stages.iter().enumerate() {
        let (tone, mark) = match s.status {
            StageStatus::Pending => (Tone::Neutral, "○"),
            StageStatus::Active => (Tone::Accent, "▶"),
            StageStatus::Done => (Tone::Ok, "●"),
            StageStatus::Skipped => (Tone::Warn, "◌"),
            StageStatus::Failed => (Tone::Bad, "✕"),
        };
        ui.horizontal(|ui| {
            ui.label(RichText::new(format!("{:>2}", i + 1)).font(theme::mono(12.0)).color(p.muted));
            ui.label(RichText::new(mark).size(15.0).color(tone.colour(p)));
            let name_colour = if s.status == StageStatus::Pending { p.body } else { p.ink };
            ui.label(RichText::new(s.name).font(theme::semibold(14.0)).color(name_colour));
            ui.with_layout(egui::Layout::right_to_left(egui::Align::Center), |ui| {
                let time = match (s.elapsed, s.started, s.status) {
                    (Some(d), _, _) => format!("{:.2}s", d.as_secs_f32()),
                    (None, Some(t), StageStatus::Active) => format!("{:.1}s", t.elapsed().as_secs_f32()),
                    _ => String::new(),
                };
                ui.label(RichText::new(time).font(theme::mono(12.0)).color(p.muted));
            });
        });
        if !s.detail.is_empty() {
            ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                ui.add_space(46.0);
                ui.label(RichText::new(&s.detail).size(12.5).color(p.body));
            });
        }
        ui.add_space(2.0);
    }
}

/// A navigation entry with an icon, the active indicator and hover feedback.
pub fn nav_item(ui: &mut egui::Ui, p: &Palette, icon: &str, label: &str, selected: bool) -> egui::Response {
    let size = Vec2::new(ui.available_width(), 39.0);
    let (rect, response) = ui.allocate_exact_size(size, Sense::click());
    if ui.is_rect_visible(rect) {
        let hover = ui.ctx().animate_bool(response.id.with("h"), response.hovered());
        let sel = ui.ctx().animate_bool(response.id.with("s"), selected);
        let bg = rect.shrink2(Vec2::new(12.0, 3.0));
        let painter = ui.painter();
        if sel > 0.0 {
            // A raised, glowing tile for the current page.
            for i in 1..=4 {
                let g = bg.expand(i as f32 * 2.5).translate(Vec2::new(0.0, 3.0));
                painter.rect_filled(g, CornerRadius::same(theme::RADIUS_S + i * 2), alpha(p.accent, ((30.0 / i as f32) * sel) as u8));
            }
            liquid(ui, bg, theme::RADIUS_S as f32, lerp(p.panel_hi, p.accent, sel * 0.85), 0.0);
        } else if hover > 0.0 {
            painter.rect_filled(bg, CornerRadius::same(theme::RADIUS_S), alpha(Color32::WHITE, (10.0 * hover) as u8));
        }
        let painter = ui.painter();
        // The icon sits in its own rounded tile.
        let tile = Rect::from_center_size(Pos2::new(bg.left() + 20.0, bg.center().y), Vec2::splat(28.0));
        if sel == 0.0 {
            painter.rect_filled(tile, CornerRadius::same(10), alpha(Color32::WHITE, (6.0 + 8.0 * hover) as u8));
        }
        if response.has_focus() {
            painter.rect_stroke(bg, CornerRadius::same(theme::RADIUS_S + 2), Stroke::new(1.0_f32, p.electric), StrokeKind::Inside);
        }
        let ink = if selected { Color32::WHITE } else { lerp(p.body, p.ink, hover) };
        let icon_colour = if selected { Color32::WHITE } else { lerp(p.muted, p.accent_hi, hover) };
        painter.text(tile.center(), egui::Align2::CENTER_CENTER, icon, egui::FontId::proportional(15.0), icon_colour);
        painter.text(Pos2::new(bg.left() + 44.0, bg.center().y), egui::Align2::LEFT_CENTER, label, theme::semibold(14.5), ink);
    }
    response.on_hover_cursor(egui::CursorIcon::PointingHand)
}

/// A thin determinate or indeterminate progress bar.
pub fn progress_bar(ui: &mut egui::Ui, p: &Palette, fraction: Option<f32>) {
    let (rect, _) = ui.allocate_exact_size(Vec2::new(ui.available_width(), 4.0), Sense::hover());
    let painter = ui.painter();
    painter.rect_filled(rect, CornerRadius::same(2), p.panel_hi);
    let fill = match fraction {
        Some(f) => Rect::from_min_size(rect.min, Vec2::new(rect.width() * f.clamp(0.0, 1.0), rect.height())),
        None => {
            let t = (ui.input(|i| i.time) as f32 * 0.6).fract();
            let w = rect.width() * 0.25;
            Rect::from_min_size(Pos2::new(rect.left() + (rect.width() + w) * t - w, rect.top()), Vec2::new(w, rect.height()))
                .intersect(rect)
        }
    };
    painter.rect_filled(fill, CornerRadius::same(2), p.accent_hi);
    if fraction.is_none() {
        ui.ctx().request_repaint();
    }
}

/// The qualified name of an Itanium-mangled C++ symbol, for display:
/// `_ZN2nn2os9LockMutexEPNS0_9MutexTypeE` becomes `nn::os::LockMutex`.
/// Anything that is not a mangled name is returned unchanged.
pub fn demangle(sym: &str) -> String {
    let Some(rest) = sym.strip_prefix("_Z") else { return sym.to_string() };
    let b = rest.as_bytes();
    let mut i = 0;
    let read = |i: &mut usize| -> Option<String> {
        let start = *i;
        while *i < b.len() && b[*i].is_ascii_digit() {
            *i += 1;
        }
        let n: usize = rest[start..*i].parse().ok()?;
        let s = rest.get(*i..*i + n)?.to_string();
        *i += n;
        Some(s)
    };
    let mut parts = Vec::new();
    if b.first() == Some(&b'N') {
        i += 1;
        while i < b.len() && matches!(b[i], b'K' | b'V' | b'r') {
            i += 1;
        }
        if rest[i..].starts_with("St") {
            parts.push("std".to_string());
            i += 2;
        }
        while i < b.len() && b[i] != b'E' {
            if b[i].is_ascii_digit() {
                match read(&mut i) {
                    Some(s) => parts.push(s),
                    None => return sym.to_string(),
                }
            } else if rest[i..].starts_with("C2") || rest[i..].starts_with("C1") {
                let class = parts.last().cloned().unwrap_or_default();
                parts.push(class);
                i += 2;
            } else if rest[i..].starts_with("D2") || rest[i..].starts_with("D1") || rest[i..].starts_with("D0") {
                let class = parts.last().cloned().unwrap_or_default();
                parts.push(format!("~{class}"));
                i += 2;
            } else {
                // Operators, templates and substitutions: stop at what we have.
                break;
            }
        }
    } else if b.first().is_some_and(|c| c.is_ascii_digit()) {
        match read(&mut i) {
            Some(s) => parts.push(s),
            None => return sym.to_string(),
        }
    }
    if parts.is_empty() {
        sym.to_string()
    } else {
        parts.join("::")
    }
}

/// Demangle every mangled word in a line of text.
pub fn demangle_line(line: &str) -> String {
    line.split(' ')
        .map(|w| {
            let core = w.trim_end_matches([',', ')', ';']);
            if core.starts_with("_Z") {
                format!("{}{}", demangle(core), &w[core.len()..])
            } else {
                w.to_string()
            }
        })
        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        .join(" ")
}

/// A wrapped monospace line, for logs and reports.
pub fn mono_line(ui: &mut egui::Ui, text: &str, colour: Color32) {
    ui.add(egui::Label::new(RichText::new(text).font(theme::mono(12.0)).color(colour)).wrap());
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn demangles_the_names_the_runtime_reports() {
        assert_eq!(demangle("_ZN2nn2os9LockMutexEPNS0_9MutexTypeE"), "nn::os::LockMutex");
        assert_eq!(demangle("_ZN2nv18InitializeGraphicsEPvm"), "nv::InitializeGraphics");
        assert_eq!(demangle("_ZNSt3__113random_deviceclEv"), "std::__1::random_device");
        assert_eq!(demangle("_ZNSt3__113random_deviceC2ERKNS_12basic_stringIcNS_11char_traitsIcEENS_9allocatorIcEEEE"), "std::__1::random_device::random_device");
        assert_eq!(demangle("memset"), "memset");
        assert_eq!(
            demangle_line("thread 0x1 waiting in _ZN2nn2oe22PopNotificationMessageEv, pc 0x2"),
            "thread 0x1 waiting in nn::oe::PopNotificationMessage, pc 0x2"
        );
    }
}
