`crates/ew-boot/src/nvn_prog.rs`:

```rs
//! NVN samplers, programs and events on the host.
//!
//! A program holds the game's compiled shaders: per stage, the GPU address of
//! the code and a pointer to its control section. The host records both so the
//! renderer can translate the stages when a draw uses them; nothing is
//! translated here, and the run report counts programs created.
//!
//! An event is a 32-bit value in pool memory that queues and the CPU signal
//! and read, so it lives in guest memory exactly where the game put it.

use crate::hle::{read_bytes, write_bytes, HostResult, HostServices};
use crate::nvn::called;
use ew_lift::State;
use std::collections::BTreeMap;

const NVN_TRUE: u64 = 1;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
pub struct Program {
    /// Per stage: GPU address of the code and the control section, copied.
    pub stages: Vec<(u64, u64)>,
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct Programs {
    pub programs: BTreeMap<u64, Program>,
    pub samplers: BTreeMap<u64, u64>,
    /// Events: object to guest address of its 32-bit value.
    pub events: BTreeMap<u64, u64>,
    pub shader_sets: u64,
}

fn progs<R>(state: &State, f: impl FnOnce(&mut Programs) -> R) -> R {
    state.host.ext.with::<Programs, R>(f)
}

fn recorded_args(state: &State, obj: u64, setter: &str) -> Option<Vec<u64>> {
    state.host.ext.with::<crate::nvn::Nvn, _>(|n| n.state.get(&obj).and_then(|m| m.get(setter)).cloned())
}

/// `nvnSamplerInitialize(NVNsampler*, const NVNsamplerBuilder*)`: the sampler
/// keeps its builder's state.
fn sampler_initialize(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let (s, b) = (state.x[0], state.x[1]);
    state.host.ext.with::<crate::nvn::Nvn, _>(|n| {
        let from = n.state.get(&b).cloned().unwrap_or_default();
        n.state.insert(s, from);
    });
    progs(state, |p| p.samplers.insert(s, b));
    HostResult::Returned(NVN_TRUE)
}

fn sampler_finalize(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let s = state.x[0];
    progs(state, |p| p.samplers.remove(&s));
    HostResult::Returned(0)
}

fn program_initialize(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let p = state.x[0];
    progs(state, |x| x.programs.insert(p, Program::default()));
    HostResult::Returned(NVN_TRUE)
}

fn program_finalize(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let p = state.x[0];
    progs(state, |x| x.programs.remove(&p));
    HostResult::Returned(0)
}

/// `nvnProgramSetShaders(NVNprogram*, int count, const NVNshaderData*)`: each
/// entry is the code's GPU address and a pointer to its control section.
fn program_set_shaders(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let (p, count, list) = (state.x[0], state.x[1] & 0xFFFF_FFFF, state.x[2]);
    if count > 6 {
        return HostResult::Unavailable(format!("{} with {count} stages", called(state)));
    }
    let raw = match read_bytes(state, list, count * 16) {
        Ok(b) => b,
        Err(e) => return e,
    };
    let stages: Vec<(u64, u64)> = raw
        .chunks(16)
        .map(|c| (u64::from_le_bytes(c[0..8].try_into().unwrap()), u64::from_le_bytes(c[8..16].try_into().unwrap())))
        .collect();
    let first = progs(state, |x| {
        x.shader_sets += 1;
        x.programs.entry(p).or_default().stages = stages;
        x.shader_sets == 1
    });
    if first {
        state.host.log.push(format!("gfx: first shader program 0x{p:x} set with {count} stage(s)"));
    }
    HostResult::Returned(NVN_TRUE)
}

/// `nvnProgramSetShadersExt(NVNprogram*, int count, const NVNshaderDataExt*)`:
/// 24-byte records (code GPU address, control section, one more word, laid out
/// by the game at 0x6045e0), recorded like `SetShaders`.
fn program_set_shaders_ext(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let (p, count, list) = (state.x[0], state.x[1] & 0xFFFF_FFFF, state.x[2]);
    if count > 9 {
        return HostResult::Unavailable(format!("nvnProgramSetShadersExt with {count} stages"));
    }
    let raw = match read_bytes(state, list, count * 24) {
        Ok(b) => b,
        Err(e) => return e,
    };
    let stages: Vec<(u64, u64)> = raw
        .chunks(24)
        .map(|c| (u64::from_le_bytes(c[0..8].try_into().unwrap()), u64::from_le_bytes(c[8..16].try_into().unwrap())))
        .collect();
    let first = progs(state, |x| {
        x.shader_sets += 1;
        x.programs.entry(p).or_default().stages = stages;
        x.shader_sets == 1
    });
    if first {
        state.host.log.push(format!("gfx: first shader program 0x{p:x} set with {count} stage(s)"));
    }
    HostResult::Returned(NVN_TRUE)
}

/// `nvnEventInitialize(NVNevent*, const NVNeventBuilder*)`: the event's value
/// sits at the builder's pool and offset.
fn event_initialize(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let (e, b) = (state.x[0], state.x[1]);
    let Some(st) = recorded_args(state, b, "nvnEventBuilderSetStorage") else {
        return HostResult::Unavailable("nvnEventInitialize with no storage set".into());
    };
    let (pool, offset) = (st[0], st[1]);
    let at = state.host.ext.with::<crate::nvn_mem::Memory, _>(|m| {
        m.pools.get(&pool).filter(|p| p.storage != 0).map(|p| p.storage + offset)
    });
    let Some(at) = at else {
        return HostResult::Unavailable(format!("nvnEventInitialize on pool 0x{pool:x}, which has no CPU storage"));
    };
    progs(state, |x| x.events.insert(e, at));
    HostResult::Returned(NVN_TRUE)
}

fn event_addr(state: &State, e: u64) -> Option<u64> {
    progs(state, |x| x.events.get(&e).copied())
}

fn event_get_value(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let e = state.x[0];
    let Some(at) = event_addr(state, e) else {
        return HostResult::Unavailable(format!("nvnEventGetValue on event 0x{e:x}, which was never initialized"));
    };
    match read_bytes(state, at, 4) {
        Ok(b) => HostResult::Returned(u32::from_le_bytes(b.try_into().unwrap()) as u64),
        Err(e) => e,
    }
}

/// NVN event signal modes: write the value, or add it.
const SIGNAL_ADD: u64 = 1;

/// Signal an event from the CPU or from an executed command.
pub fn signal(state: &mut State, e: u64, mode: u64, value: u32) -> Result<(), HostResult> {
    let Some(at) = event_addr(state, e) else {
        return Err(HostResult::Unavailable(format!("signal of event 0x{e:x}, which was never initialized")));
    };
    let old = u32::from_le_bytes(read_bytes(state, at, 4)?.try_into().unwrap());
    let new = if mode == SIGNAL_ADD { old.wrapping_add(value) } else { value };
    write_bytes(state, at, &new.to_le_bytes())
}

/// `nvnEventSignal(NVNevent*, NVNeventSignalMode, uint32 value)`.
fn event_signal(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let (e, mode, value) = (state.x[0], state.x[1] & 0xFFFF_FFFF, state.x[2] as u32);
    match signal(state, e, mode, value) {
        Ok(()) => HostResult::Returned(0),
        Err(err) => err,
    }
}

fn event_finalize(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let e = state.x[0];
    progs(state, |x| x.events.remove(&e));
    HostResult::Returned(0)
}

/// Where a sampler getter's values come from: the setter, then for each out
/// pointer the recorded argument (x1.. are 0..6, v0.. are 7..10) and the
/// value used when the game never called the setter.
struct Getter {
    name: &'static str,
    setter: &'static str,
    outs: &'static [(usize, u64)],
    /// Returned instead of written: (argument, default, in v0 as a float).
    ret: Option<(usize, u64, bool)>,
}

const ONE_F32: u64 = 0x3F80_0000;
const LOD_MAX_F32: u64 = 0x447A_0000; // 1000.0

const SAMPLER_GETTERS: &[Getter] = &[
    Getter { name: "MinMagFilter", setter: "MinMagFilter", outs: &[(0, 0), (1, 0)], ret: None },
    Getter { name: "WrapMode", setter: "WrapMode", outs: &[(0, 0), (1, 0), (2, 0)], ret: None },
    Getter { name: "LodClamp", setter: "LodClamp", outs: &[(7, 0), (8, LOD_MAX_F32)], ret: None },
    Getter { name: "Compare", setter: "Compare", outs: &[(0, 0), (1, 0)], ret: None },
    Getter { name: "LodBias", setter: "LodBias", outs: &[], ret: Some((7, 0, true)) },
    Getter { name: "MaxAnisotropy", setter: "MaxAnisotropy", outs: &[], ret: Some((7, ONE_F32, true)) },
    Getter { name: "ReductionFilter", setter: "ReductionFilter", outs: &[], ret: Some((0, 0, false)) },
];

/// `nvnSamplerGet*`: the value its builder set, or the default.
fn sampler_get(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let name = called(state);
    let smp = state.x[0];
    let field = name.trim_start_matches("nvnSamplerGet");
    if field.starts_with("BorderColor") {
        // (sampler, out[4]): copy the 16 bytes the setter pointed at.
        let rec = recorded_args(state, smp, &format!("nvnSamplerBuilderSet{field}"));
        let bytes = match rec.map(|a| a[0]).filter(|p| *p != 0) {
            Some(p) => match read_bytes(state, p, 16) {
                Ok(b) => b,
                Err(e) => return e,
            },
            None => vec![0u8; 16],
        };
        return match write_bytes(state, state.x[1], &bytes) {
            Ok(()) => HostResult::Returned(0),
            Err(e) => e,
        };
    }
    let Some(g) = SAMPLER_GETTERS.iter().find(|g| g.name == field) else {
        return HostResult::Unavailable(format!("{name} is not modelled"));
    };
    let rec = recorded_args(state, smp, &format!("nvnSamplerBuilderSet{}", g.setter));
    let arg = |i: usize, d: u64| rec.as_ref().map(|a| a[i]).unwrap_or(d);
    for (k, &(i, d)) in g.outs.iter().enumerate() {
        let out = state.x[1 + k];
        if out != 0 {
            if let Err(e) = write_bytes(state, out, &(arg(i, d) as u32).to_le_bytes()) {
                return e;
            }
        }
    }
    match g.ret {
        Some((i, d, true)) => {
            state.v[0] = [arg(i, d) & 0xFFFF_FFFF, 0];
            HostResult::Returned(state.x[0])
        }
        Some((i, d, false)) => HostResult::Returned(arg(i, d) & 0xFFFF_FFFF),
        None => HostResult::Returned(0),
    }
}

/// The sampler state that matters, as the getters see it.
fn sampler_key(state: &State, smp: u64) -> Vec<u64> {
    let mut key = Vec::new();
    for g in SAMPLER_GETTERS {
        let rec = recorded_args(state, smp, &format!("nvnSamplerBuilderSet{}", g.setter));
        for &(i, d) in g.outs {
            key.push(rec.as_ref().map(|a| a[i]).unwrap_or(d) & 0xFFFF_FFFF);
        }
        if let Some((i, d, _)) = g.ret {
            key.push(rec.as_ref().map(|a| a[i]).unwrap_or(d) & 0xFFFF_FFFF);
        }
    }
    let border = recorded_args(state, smp, "nvnSamplerBuilderSetBorderColor").map(|a| a[0]).filter(|p| *p != 0);
    key.extend(border.and_then(|p| read_bytes(state, p, 16).ok()).unwrap_or_default().iter().map(|b| *b as u64));
    key
}

/// `nvnSamplerCompare(const NVNsampler*, const NVNsampler*)`.
fn sampler_compare(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let (a, b) = (state.x[0], state.x[1]);
    HostResult::Returned((sampler_key(state, a) == sampler_key(state, b)) as u64)
}

pub fn register(s: &mut HostServices) {
    s.register("nvn:nvnSamplerCompare", sampler_compare, "equal when every getter would report the same state");
    s.register_prefix("nvn:nvnSamplerGet", sampler_get, "the value the sampler's builder set, or its default");
    let table: &[(&str, fn(&mut State) -> HostResult, &'static str)] = &[
        ("nvnSamplerInitialize", sampler_initialize, "a sampler with its builder's state"),
        ("nvnSamplerFinalize", sampler_finalize, "forgets the sampler"),
        ("nvnProgramInitialize", program_initialize, "a program record on the host"),
        ("nvnProgramFinalize", program_finalize, "forgets the program"),
        ("nvnProgramSetShaders", program_set_shaders, "stage code addresses and control sections recorded for translation"),
        ("nvnProgramSetShadersExt", program_set_shaders_ext, "stage code addresses and control sections recorded for translation"),
        ("nvnEventInitialize", event_initialize, "a 32-bit value in the game's pool memory"),
        ("nvnEventFinalize", event_finalize, "forgets the event"),
        ("nvnEventGetValue", event_get_value, "reads the value from guest memory"),
        ("nvnEventSignal", event_signal, "writes or adds to the value in guest memory"),
    ];
    for (name, handler, claim) in table {
        s.register(&format!("nvn:{name}"), *handler, claim);
    }
}
```

`crates/ew-boot/src/nvn_state.rs`:

```rs
//! NVN render-state objects: blend, color, channel mask, depth/stencil,
//! multisample, polygon, vertex attribute and vertex stream state.
//!
//! These are small structures in guest memory that the game sets, copies by
//! value and binds by pointer. Their state therefore lives in the structure's
//! own bytes: each setter packs its arguments into fixed bit fields of the
//! structure, each getter unpacks them, and a bind copies the bytes. The
//! packing is this host's own (the game never reads the bytes itself); each
//! layout fits inside the structure size NVN reserves for that object.

use crate::hle::{read_bytes, write_bytes, HostResult, HostServices};
use crate::nvn::called;
use ew_lift::State;

/// A field: which argument holds it, its bit offset and width.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct F {
    arg: usize,
    at: u32,
    bits: u32,
}

const fn f(arg: usize, at: u32, bits: u32) -> F {
    F { arg, at, bits }
}

/// How a method maps onto the packed word.
struct Method {
    name: &'static str,
    fields: &'static [F],
    /// For per-target or per-face methods: the argument holding the index or
    /// face mask, and the bit stride between consecutive targets.
    indexed: Option<(usize, u32, Indexing)>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
enum Indexing {
    /// A render target number.
    Target,
    /// An NVN face mask: front = 1, back = 2.
    Face,
}

struct Kind {
    prefix: &'static str,
    /// Bytes NVN reserves for the structure; the packed state uses at most 8.
    size: u64,
    defaults: u64,
    methods: &'static [Method],
}

const fn m(name: &'static str, fields: &'static [F]) -> Method {
    Method { name, fields, indexed: None }
}

const KINDS: &[Kind] = &[
    Kind {
        prefix: "nvnPolygonState",
        size: 4,
        // cull none, counter-clockwise front, fill, no offset
        defaults: (1 << 2) | (2 << 3),
        methods: &[
            m("CullFace", &[f(1, 0, 2)]),
            m("FrontFace", &[f(1, 2, 1)]),
            m("PolygonMode", &[f(1, 3, 2)]),
            m("PolygonOffsetEnables", &[f(1, 5, 3)]),
        ],
    },
    Kind {
        prefix: "nvnColorState",
        size: 4,
        // blending off, logic op copy, alpha test always
        defaults: (3 << 8) | (8 << 12),
        methods: &[
            Method { name: "BlendEnable", fields: &[f(2, 0, 1)], indexed: Some((1, 1, Indexing::Target)) },
            m("LogicOp", &[f(1, 8, 4)]),
            m("AlphaTest", &[f(1, 12, 4)]),
        ],
    },
    Kind {
        prefix: "nvnChannelMaskState",
        size: 4,
        defaults: 0xFFFF_FFFF,
        methods: &[Method {
            name: "ChannelMask",
            fields: &[f(2, 0, 1), f(3, 1, 1), f(4, 2, 1), f(5, 3, 1)],
            indexed: Some((1, 4, Indexing::Target)),
        }],
    },
    Kind {
        prefix: "nvnDepthStencilState",
        size: 8,
        // depth test off, depth write on, less; stencil off, always, keep
        defaults: (1 << 1) | (2 << 2) | (8 << 7) | (8 << 11) | (0x111 << 15) | (0x111 << 27),
        methods: &[
            m("DepthTestEnable", &[f(1, 0, 1)]),
            m("DepthWriteEnable", &[f(1, 1, 1)]),
            m("DepthFunc", &[f(1, 2, 4)]),
            m("StencilTestEnable", &[f(1, 6, 1)]),
            Method { name: "StencilFunc", fields: &[f(2, 7, 4)], indexed: Some((1, 4, Indexing::Face)) },
            Method {
                name: "StencilOp",
                fields: &[f(2, 15, 4), f(3, 19, 4), f(4, 23, 4)],
                indexed: Some((1, 12, Indexing::Face)),
            },
        ],
    },
    Kind {
        prefix: "nvnBlendState",
        size: 8,
        // target 0, one/zero for color and alpha, add for both
        defaults: (2 << 3) | (1 << 8) | (2 << 13) | (1 << 18) | (1 << 23) | (1 << 26),
        methods: &[
            m("BlendTarget", &[f(1, 0, 3)]),
            m("BlendFunc", &[f(1, 3, 5), f(2, 8, 5), f(3, 13, 5), f(4, 18, 5)]),
            m("BlendEquation", &[f(1, 23, 3), f(2, 26, 3)]),
            m("AdvancedMode", &[f(1, 29, 7)]),
            m("AdvancedOverlap", &[f(1, 36, 2)]),
            m("AdvancedPremultipliedSrc", &[f(1, 38, 1)]),
            m("AdvancedNormalizedDst", &[f(1, 39, 1)]),
        ],
    },
    Kind {
        prefix: "nvnMultisampleState",
        size: 8,
        // multisampling on, alpha-to-coverage dither on
        defaults: 1 | (1 << 7),
        methods: &[
            m("MultisampleEnable", &[f(1, 0, 1)]),
            m("Samples", &[f(1, 1, 5)]),
            m("AlphaToCoverageEnable", &[f(1, 6, 1)]),
            m("AlphaToCoverageDither", &[f(1, 7, 1)]),
            m("RasterSamples", &[f(1, 8, 5)]),
            m("CoverageModulationMode", &[f(1, 13, 2)]),
            m("CoverageTruncationEnable", &[f(1, 15, 1)]),
            m("CoverageToColorEnable", &[f(1, 16, 1)]),
            m("CoverageToColorOutput", &[f(1, 17, 3)]),
            m("SampleLocationsEnable", &[f(1, 20, 1)]),
            m("SampleLocationsGridEnable", &[f(1, 21, 1)]),
        ],
    },
    Kind {
        prefix: "nvnVertexAttribState",
        size: 4,
        defaults: 0,
        methods: &[m("Format", &[f(1, 0, 10), f(2, 10, 14)]), m("StreamIndex", &[f(1, 24, 5)])],
    },
    Kind {
        prefix: "nvnVertexStreamState",
        size: 8,
        defaults: 0,
        methods: &[m("Stride", &[f(1, 0, 32)]), m("Divisor", &[f(1, 32, 32)])],
    },
];

fn read_word(state: &State, addr: u64, size: u64) -> Result<u64, HostResult> {
    let b = read_bytes(state, addr, size.min(8))?;
    let mut w = [0u8; 8];
    w[..b.len()].copy_from_slice(&b);
    Ok(u64::from_le_bytes(w))
}

fn write_word(state: &mut State, addr: u64, size: u64, v: u64) -> Result<(), HostResult> {
    write_bytes(state, addr, &v.to_le_bytes()[..size.min(8) as usize])
}

fn mask(bits: u32) -> u64 {
    if bits >= 64 {
        u64::MAX
    } else {
        (1u64 << bits) - 1
    }
}

/// The bit shifts a method applies to: one per target, or one per face named
/// by the face mask.
fn shifts(method: &Method, args: &[u64]) -> Vec<u32> {
    match method.indexed {
        None => vec![0],
        Some((arg, stride, Indexing::Target)) => vec![(args[arg] as u32 & 7) * stride],
        Some((arg, stride, Indexing::Face)) => {
            let faces = args[arg] as u32;
            [(1u32, 0u32), (2, 1)].iter().filter(|(bit, _)| faces & bit != 0).map(|(_, i)| i * stride).collect()
        }
    }
}

fn lookup(name: &str) -> Option<(&'static Kind, Option<&'static Method>, bool)> {
    let kind = KINDS.iter().find(|k| name.starts_with(k.prefix))?;
    let rest = &name[kind.prefix.len()..];
    if rest == "SetDefaults" {
        return Some((kind, None, true));
    }
    let (set, field) = if let Some(f) = rest.strip_prefix("Set") { (true, f) } else { (false, rest.strip_prefix("Get")?) };
    kind.methods.iter().find(|m| m.name == field).map(|m| (kind, Some(m), set))
}

fn handle(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let name = called(state);
    let Some((kind, method, set)) = lookup(&name) else {
        return HostResult::Unavailable(format!("{name} is not modelled"));
    };
    let obj = state.x[0];
    let args: Vec<u64> = state.x[0..8].to_vec();
    let Some(method) = method else {
        return match write_word(state, obj, kind.size, kind.defaults) {
            Ok(()) => HostResult::Returned(0),
            Err(e) => e,
        };
    };
    let mut word = match read_word(state, obj, kind.size) {
        Ok(w) => w,
        Err(e) => return e,
    };
    let shifts = shifts(method, &args);
    if set {
        for s in &shifts {
            for fl in method.fields {
                let at = fl.at + s;
                word = (word & !(mask(fl.bits) << at)) | ((args[fl.arg] & mask(fl.bits)) << at);
            }
        }
        return match write_word(state, obj, kind.size, word) {
            Ok(()) => HostResult::Returned(0),
            Err(e) => e,
        };
    }
    // A getter reads one face or target. Single-field getters without an
    // index return the value; the rest write through their out pointers,
    // which follow the index argument when there is one.
    let s = shifts.first().copied().unwrap_or(0);
    let value = |fl: &F| (word >> (fl.at + s)) & mask(fl.bits);
    if method.fields.len() == 1 && method.indexed.is_none() {
        return HostResult::Returned(value(&method.fields[0]));
    }
    if method.fields.len() == 1 {
        return HostResult::Returned(value(&method.fields[0]));
    }
    let first_out = if method.indexed.is_some() { 2 } else { 1 };
    for (i, fl) in method.fields.iter().enumerate() {
        let out = args[first_out + i];
        if out != 0 {
            if let Err(e) = write_bytes(state, out, &(value(fl) as u32).to_le_bytes()) {
                return e;
            }
        }
    }
    HostResult::Returned(0)
}

/// Bytes of a state structure a bind should copy, by the bind procedure.
#[allow(dead_code)]
pub fn bind_size(bind: &str) -> Option<u64> {
    let kind = bind.trim_start_matches("nvnCommandBufferBind");
    KINDS.iter().find(|k| k.prefix.trim_start_matches("nvn") == kind).map(|k| k.size)
}

pub fn register(s: &mut HostServices) {
    for k in KINDS {
        s.register_prefix(&format!("nvn:{}", k.prefix), handle, "state packed into the structure's own bytes");
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn call(s: &mut State, name: &str, args: &[u64]) -> HostResult {
        s.host.dyn_base = 0x1000;
        s.host.dyn_stubs = vec![format!("nvn:{name}")];
        s.pc = 0x1000;
        for (i, a) in args.iter().enumerate() {
            s.x[i] = *a;
        }
        handle(s)
    }

    #[test]
    fn setters_pack_and_getters_unpack() {
        let mut s = State { mem: vec![0; 0x2000], ..State::default() };
        assert_eq!(call(&mut s, "nvnDepthStencilStateSetDefaults", &[0x100]), HostResult::Returned(0));
        assert_eq!(call(&mut s, "nvnDepthStencilStateGetDepthFunc", &[0x100]), HostResult::Returned(2));
        call(&mut s, "nvnDepthStencilStateSetDepthFunc", &[0x100, 4]);
        assert_eq!(call(&mut s, "nvnDepthStencilStateGetDepthFunc", &[0x100]), HostResult::Returned(4));
        // Back face only: the front face keeps its default.
        call(&mut s, "nvnDepthStencilStateSetStencilFunc", &[0x100, 2, 3]);
        assert_eq!(call(&mut s, "nvnDepthStencilStateGetStencilFunc", &[0x100, 1]), HostResult::Returned(8));
        assert_eq!(call(&mut s, "nvnDepthStencilStateGetStencilFunc", &[0x100, 2]), HostResult::Returned(3));
        // Out-pointer getter.
        call(&mut s, "nvnBlendStateSetDefaults", &[0x200]);
        call(&mut s, "nvnBlendStateSetBlendFunc", &[0x200, 5, 6, 2, 1]);
        call(&mut s, "nvnBlendStateGetBlendFunc", &[0x200, 0x300, 0x304, 0x308, 0x30c]);
        assert_eq!(&s.mem[0x300..0x310], &[5, 0, 0, 0, 6, 0, 0, 0, 2, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_copied_structure_keeps_its_state() {
        let mut s = State { mem: vec![0; 0x2000], ..State::default() };
        call(&mut s, "nvnPolygonStateSetDefaults", &[0x100]);
        call(&mut s, "nvnPolygonStateSetCullFace", &[0x100, 2]);
        let bytes = s.mem[0x100..0x104].to_vec();
        s.mem[0x500..0x504].copy_from_slice(&bytes);
        assert_eq!(call(&mut s, "nvnPolygonStateGetCullFace", &[0x500]), HostResult::Returned(2));
        assert_eq!(call(&mut s, "nvnPolygonStateGetPolygonMode", &[0x500]), HostResult::Returned(2));
    }
}
```

`crates/ew-boot/src/nvn_tex.rs`:

```rs
//! NVN textures, texture pools and sampler pools on the host.
//!
//! A texture's storage is a range of a memory pool. Titles ship texture data
//! already laid out for the console GPU (block-linear tiling) and copy it into
//! pool memory themselves, so the storage size the host reports has to be the
//! block-linear size the data was built for. [`storage_size`] computes it with
//! the GPU's published tiling rules: 64-byte by 8-row GOBs stacked into blocks
//! whose height shrinks with the image. The host renderer reads the texels from
//! guest memory with the same rules.
//!
//! Formats are identified by their NVN enumeration value. The numbering is
//! confirmed by the game's own table from BNTX surface formats (a public file
//! format) to NVN formats at rodata 0x1b6c004: every BNTX format there maps to
//! the value listed below. Only formats whose value and texel size are
//! established are listed; any other stops the run naming the value.

use crate::hle::{read_bytes, HostResult, HostServices};
use crate::nvn::called;
use ew_lift::State;
use std::collections::BTreeMap;

const NVN_TRUE: u64 = 1;

/// Texel block of a format: block width and height in texels, bytes per block.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Block {
    pub w: u32,
    pub h: u32,
    pub bytes: u32,
}

const fn px(bytes: u32) -> Option<Block> {
    Some(Block { w: 1, h: 1, bytes })
}

const fn bc(bytes: u32) -> Option<Block> {
    Some(Block { w: 4, h: 4, bytes })
}

/// NVN format value to its texel block.
pub fn format_block(format: u32) -> Option<Block> {
    match format {
        0x01..=0x04 => px(1),             // R8, R8SN, R8UI, R8I
        0x05..=0x09 => px(2),             // R16F, R16, R16SN, R16UI, R16I
        0x0A..=0x0C => px(4),             // R32F, R32UI, R32I
        0x0D..=0x10 => px(2),             // RG8 family
        0x11..=0x15 => px(4),             // RG16 family
        0x16..=0x18 => px(8),             // RG32 family
        0x19..=0x1C => px(3),             // RGB8 family
        0x1D..=0x21 => px(6),             // RGB16 family
        0x22..=0x24 => px(12),            // RGB32 family
        0x25..=0x28 => px(4),             // RGBA8 family
        0x29..=0x2D => px(8),             // RGBA16 family
        0x2E..=0x30 => px(16),            // RGBA32 family
        0x31 => px(1),                    // STENCIL8
        0x32 => px(2),                    // DEPTH16
        0x33 | 0x34 | 0x35 => px(4),      // DEPTH24, DEPTH32F, DEPTH24_STENCIL8
        0x36 => px(8),                    // DEPTH32F_STENCIL8
        0x37 | 0x38 => px(4),             // RGBX8_SRGB, RGBA8_SRGB
        0x39..=0x3C => px(2),             // RGBA4, RGB5, RGB5A1, RGB565
        0x3D..=0x40 => px(4),             // RGB10A2, RGB10A2UI, R11G11B10F, RGB9E5F
        0x41 | 0x42 | 0x45 | 0x46 => bc(8), // DXT1 (BC1), linear and sRGB
        0x43 | 0x44 | 0x47 | 0x48 => bc(16), // DXT3, DXT5 (BC2, BC3)
        0x49 | 0x4A => bc(8),             // RGTC1 (BC4)
        0x4B | 0x4C => bc(16),            // RGTC2 (BC5)
        0x4D..=0x50 => bc(16),            // BPTC (BC7, BC6H)
        // ASTC, linear 0x79..=0x86 and sRGB 0x87..=0x94, 16 bytes per block.
        0x79..=0x94 => {
            const DIMS: [(u32, u32); 14] = [
                (4, 4), (5, 4), (5, 5), (6, 5), (6, 6), (8, 5), (8, 6),
                (8, 8), (10, 5), (10, 6), (10, 8), (10, 10), (12, 10), (12, 12),
            ];
            let (w, h) = DIMS[((format - 0x79) % 14) as usize];
            Some(Block { w, h, bytes: 16 })
        }
        0x95 | 0x97 | 0x98 => px(2),      // BGR565, BGR5A1, A1BGR5
        0x9A | 0x9C => px(4),             // BGRA8, BGRA8_SRGB
        _ => None,
    }
}

/// NVN texture targets.
pub const TARGET_3D: u32 = 2;

/// NVN texture flags this layer acts on.
pub const FLAG_LINEAR: u32 = 0x10;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
pub struct TexDesc {
    pub target: u32,
    pub width: u32,
    pub height: u32,
    pub depth: u32,
    pub levels: u32,
    pub format: u32,
    pub samples: u32,
    pub flags: u32,
    pub stride: u32,
    pub swizzle: [u32; 4],
    pub depth_stencil_mode: u32,
    pub pool: u64,
    pub offset: u64,
}

impl TexDesc {
    fn defaults() -> TexDesc {
        TexDesc { target: 1, width: 1, height: 1, depth: 1, levels: 1, swizzle: [2, 3, 4, 5], ..TexDesc::default() }
    }
}

fn gob_height(height_blocks: u32, mut bh: u32) -> u32 {
    while bh > 1 && height_blocks <= (bh / 2) * 8 {
        bh /= 2;
    }
    bh
}

fn gob_depth(depth: u32, mut bd: u32) -> u32 {
    while bd > 1 && depth <= bd / 2 {
        bd /= 2;
    }
    bd
}

/// One mip level of a texture's storage.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Level {
    /// Byte offset of the level within a layer.
    pub offset: u64,
    /// Bytes per row of blocks, padded to whole GOBs (block-linear) or the
    /// stride (linear).
    pub row_bytes: u64,
    /// Rows of blocks, padded to whole blocks of GOBs.
    pub rows: u64,
    /// Depth slices, and the block height and depth in GOBs.
    pub depth: u64,
    pub gob_h: u64,
    pub gob_d: u64,
}

/// Where every texel block of a texture lives in its storage.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Layout {
    pub block: Block,
    pub levels: Vec<Level>,
    pub layer_stride: u64,
    pub layers: u64,
    pub linear: bool,
}

impl Layout {
    pub fn size(&self) -> u64 {
        self.layer_stride * self.layers
    }

    /// Byte offset of block (bx, by) in slice `bz` of `level` and `layer`.
    pub fn offset(&self, level: usize, layer: u64, bx: u64, by: u64, bz: u64) -> u64 {
        let lv = &self.levels[level];
        let base = layer * self.layer_stride + lv.offset;
        let xb = bx * self.block.bytes as u64;
        if self.linear {
            return base + bz * lv.row_bytes * lv.rows + by * lv.row_bytes + xb;
        }
        let gob_block = 512 * lv.gob_h * lv.gob_d;
        let gobs_wide = lv.row_bytes / 64;
        let blocks_high = lv.rows / (8 * lv.gob_h);
        base + (bz / lv.gob_d) * gobs_wide * blocks_high * gob_block
            + (by / (8 * lv.gob_h)) * gobs_wide * gob_block
            + (xb / 64) * gob_block
            + (bz % lv.gob_d) * 512 * lv.gob_h
            + ((by / 8) % lv.gob_h) * 512
            + gob_offset(xb % 64, by % 8)
    }
}

/// Offset of byte column `x` (0..64) of row `y` (0..8) inside one GOB.
pub fn gob_offset(x: u64, y: u64) -> u64 {
    (x / 32) * 256 + (y / 2) * 64 + ((x % 32) / 16) * 32 + (y % 2) * 16 + (x % 16)
}

/// The storage layout of a texture: linear rows when it is linear, otherwise
/// the GOB tiling, with each array layer starting on a block boundary.
pub fn layout(d: &TexDesc) -> Result<Layout, String> {
    let b = format_block(d.format).ok_or_else(|| format!("texture format 0x{:x} is not established", d.format))?;
    let blocks = |v: u32, n: u32| v.max(1).div_ceil(n) as u64;
    let samples = d.samples.max(1) as u64;
    let (depth, layers) = if d.target == TARGET_3D { (d.depth.max(1), 1) } else { (1, d.depth.max(1)) };
    if d.flags & FLAG_LINEAR != 0 {
        let row = if d.stride != 0 { d.stride as u64 } else { (blocks(d.width, b.w) * b.bytes as u64).div_ceil(32) * 32 };
        let rows = blocks(d.height, b.h);
        let level = Level { offset: 0, row_bytes: row * samples, rows, depth: 1, gob_h: 1, gob_d: 1 };
        return Ok(Layout { block: b, levels: vec![level], layer_stride: row * samples * rows, layers: layers as u64, linear: true });
    }
    let h0 = blocks(d.height, b.h) as u32;
    let bh0 = gob_height(h0, 16);
    let bd0 = if d.target == TARGET_3D { gob_depth(depth, 32) } else { 1 };
    let mut levels = Vec::new();
    let mut layer = 0u64;
    for l in 0..d.levels.max(1) {
        let (w, h, z) = ((d.width >> l).max(1), (d.height >> l).max(1), (depth >> l).max(1));
        let (wb, hb) = (blocks(w, b.w), blocks(h, b.h));
        let bh = gob_height(hb as u32, bh0) as u64;
        let bd = gob_depth(z, bd0) as u64;
        let row_bytes = (wb * b.bytes as u64 * samples).div_ceil(64) * 64;
        let rows = hb.div_ceil(8 * bh) * 8 * bh;
        let slices = (z as u64).div_ceil(bd) * bd;
        levels.push(Level { offset: layer, row_bytes, rows, depth: z as u64, gob_h: bh, gob_d: bd });
        layer += row_bytes * rows * slices;
    }
    let block_bytes = 512 * bh0 as u64 * bd0 as u64;
    let stride = if layers > 1 { layer.div_ceil(block_bytes) * block_bytes } else { layer };
    Ok(Layout { block: b, levels, layer_stride: stride, layers: layers as u64, linear: false })
}

/// Bytes a texture occupies in its pool.
pub fn storage_size(d: &TexDesc) -> Result<u64, String> {
    layout(d).map(|l| l.size())
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct Textures {
    /// Builder state, by builder address.
    pub builders: BTreeMap<u64, TexDesc>,
    /// Initialized textures.
    pub textures: BTreeMap<u64, TexDesc>,
    /// Texture and sampler pools: object to (memory pool, offset, descriptors).
    pub texture_pools: BTreeMap<u64, (u64, u64, u64)>,
    pub sampler_pools: BTreeMap<u64, (u64, u64, u64)>,
    /// Descriptor slots: (pool, id) to the texture or sampler registered there.
    pub texture_slots: BTreeMap<(u64, u64), (u64, u64)>,
    pub sampler_slots: BTreeMap<(u64, u64), u64>,
}

fn tex<R>(state: &State, f: impl FnOnce(&mut Textures) -> R) -> R {
    state.host.ext.with::<Textures, R>(f)
}

fn w32(v: u64) -> u32 {
    (v & 0xFFFF_FFFF) as u32
}

/// Every `nvnTextureBuilderSet*` that shapes the texture.
fn builder_set(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let name = called(state);
    let (b, a1, a2, a3, a4) = (state.x[0], state.x[1], state.x[2], state.x[3], state.x[4]);
    let field = name.trim_start_matches("nvnTextureBuilderSet").to_string();
    let ok = tex(state, |t| {
        if field == "Defaults" {
            t.builders.insert(b, TexDesc::defaults());
            return true;
        }
        let d = t.builders.entry(b).or_insert_with(TexDesc::defaults);
        match field.as_str() {
            "Device" | "GLTextureName" | "PackagedTextureData" | "PackagedTextureLayout" => {}
            "Flags" => d.flags = w32(a1),
            "Target" => d.target = w32(a1),
            "Width" => d.width = w32(a1),
            "Height" => d.height = w32(a1),
            "Depth" => d.depth = w32(a1),
            "Size1D" => d.width = w32(a1),
            "Size2D" => (d.width, d.height) = (w32(a1), w32(a2)),
            "Size3D" => (d.width, d.height, d.depth) = (w32(a1), w32(a2), w32(a3)),
            "Levels" => d.levels = w32(a1),
            "Format" => d.format = w32(a1),
            "Samples" => d.samples = w32(a1),
            "Swizzle" => d.swizzle = [w32(a1), w32(a2), w32(a3), w32(a4)],
            "DepthStencilMode" => d.depth_stencil_mode = w32(a1),
            "Stride" => d.stride = w32(a1),
            "Storage" => (d.pool, d.offset) = (a1, a2),
            _ => return false,
        }
        true
    });
    if ok {
        HostResult::Returned(0)
    } else {
        HostResult::Unavailable(format!("{name} is not modelled"))
    }
}

fn builder_desc(state: &State, b: u64) -> TexDesc {
    tex(state, |t| t.builders.get(&b).cloned().unwrap_or_else(TexDesc::defaults))
}

fn builder_get_storage_size(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    match storage_size(&builder_desc(state, state.x[0])) {
        Ok(n) => HostResult::Returned(n),
        Err(e) => HostResult::Unavailable(format!("nvnTextureBuilderGetStorageSize: {e}")),
    }
}

/// Alignment of a texture's storage: one GOB, the unit of the tiling.
fn builder_get_storage_alignment(_state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    HostResult::Returned(512)
}

fn desc_field(d: &TexDesc, name: &str) -> Option<u64> {
    Some(match name {
        "Flags" => d.flags as u64,
        "Target" => d.target as u64,
        "Width" => d.width as u64,
        "Height" => d.height as u64,
        "Depth" => d.depth as u64,
        "Levels" => d.levels as u64,
        "Format" => d.format as u64,
        "Samples" => d.samples as u64,
        "DepthStencilMode" => d.depth_stencil_mode as u64,
        "Stride" => d.stride as u64,
        "MemoryPool" => d.pool,
        "MemoryOffset" => d.offset,
        _ => return None,
    })
}

fn builder_get(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let name = called(state);
    let d = builder_desc(state, state.x[0]);
    match desc_field(&d, name.trim_start_matches("nvnTextureBuilderGet")) {
        Some(v) => HostResult::Returned(v),
        None => HostResult::Unavailable(format!("{name} is not modelled")),
    }
}

/// `nvnTextureInitialize(NVNtexture*, const NVNtextureBuilder*)`.
fn texture_initialize(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let (t, b) = (state.x[0], state.x[1]);
    let d = builder_desc(state, b);
    if let Err(e) = storage_size(&d) {
        return HostResult::Unavailable(format!("nvnTextureInitialize: {e}"));
    }
    tex(state, |x| x.textures.insert(t, d));
    HostResult::Returned(NVN_TRUE)
}

fn texture_finalize(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let t = state.x[0];
    tex(state, |x| x.textures.remove(&t));
    HostResult::Returned(0)
}

fn texture_get(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let name = called(state);
    let t = state.x[0];
    let Some(d) = tex(state, |x| x.textures.get(&t).cloned()) else {
        return HostResult::Unavailable(format!("{name} on texture 0x{t:x}, which was never initialized"));
    };
    let field = name.trim_start_matches("nvnTextureGet");
    let v = match field {
        "StorageSize" => storage_size(&d).ok(),
        "TextureAddress" => state.host.ext.with::<crate::nvn_mem::Memory, _>(|m| m.pools.get(&d.pool).map(|p| p.gpu + d.offset)),
        _ => desc_field(&d, field),
    };
    match v {
        Some(v) => HostResult::Returned(v),
        None => HostResult::Unavailable(format!("{name} is not modelled")),
    }
}

/// `nvnTexturePoolInitialize(pool, memoryPool, offset, numDescriptors)` and the
/// sampler pool equivalent.
fn texture_pool_initialize(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let (p, mp, off, n) = (state.x[0], state.x[1], state.x[2], state.x[3] & 0xFFFF_FFFF);
    tex(state, |x| x.texture_pools.insert(p, (mp, off, n)));
    HostResult::Returned(NVN_TRUE)
}

fn sampler_pool_initialize(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let (p, mp, off, n) = (state.x[0], state.x[1], state.x[2], state.x[3] & 0xFFFF_FFFF);
    tex(state, |x| x.sampler_pools.insert(p, (mp, off, n)));
    HostResult::Returned(NVN_TRUE)
}

fn pool_get(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let name = called(state);
    let p = state.x[0];
    let sampler = name.starts_with("nvnSamplerPool");
    let entry = tex(state, |x| if sampler { x.sampler_pools.get(&p).copied() } else { x.texture_pools.get(&p).copied() });
    let Some((mp, off, n)) = entry else {
        return HostResult::Unavailable(format!("{name} on pool 0x{p:x}, which was never initialized"));
    };
    match name.rsplit("Get").next().unwrap_or("") {
        "MemoryPool" => HostResult::Returned(mp),
        "MemoryOffset" => HostResult::Returned(off),
        "Size" => HostResult::Returned(n),
        _ => HostResult::Unavailable(format!("{name} is not modelled")),
    }
}

fn pool_finalize(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let p = state.x[0];
    tex(state, |x| {
        x.texture_pools.remove(&p);
        x.sampler_pools.remove(&p);
    });
    HostResult::Returned(0)
}

/// `nvnTexturePoolRegisterTexture(pool, id, texture, view)` and
/// `RegisterImage`: the slot now names that texture.
fn texture_pool_register(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let (p, id, t, view) = (state.x[0], state.x[1] & 0xFFFF_FFFF, state.x[2], state.x[3]);
    tex(state, |x| x.texture_slots.insert((p, id), (t, view)));
    HostResult::Returned(0)
}

/// `nvnSamplerPoolRegisterSampler(pool, id, sampler)` and the builder form.
fn sampler_pool_register(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let (p, id, s) = (state.x[0], state.x[1] & 0xFFFF_FFFF, state.x[2]);
    tex(state, |x| x.sampler_slots.insert((p, id), s));
    HostResult::Returned(0)
}

/// `nvnDeviceGetTextureHandle(device, textureID, samplerID)`: the GPU's
/// combined handle, texture index in the low 20 bits and sampler index above.
fn device_get_texture_handle(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let (t, s) = (state.x[1] & 0xF_FFFF, state.x[2] & 0xFFF);
    HostResult::Returned(t | (s << 20))
}

/// `nvnDeviceGetImageHandle(device, imageID)` and the texel-fetch form.
fn device_get_image_handle(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    HostResult::Returned(state.x[1] & 0xF_FFFF)
}

/// `nvnTextureViewGet*(view, out...)`: copies what the matching setter
/// recorded into the out pointers and returns true, or returns false when the
/// view never set it, which is how NVN reports an unset view field.
fn view_get(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let name = called(state);
    let view = state.x[0];
    let setter = name.replacen("Get", "Set", 1);
    let outs = match name.trim_start_matches("nvnTextureViewGet") {
        "Levels" | "Layers" => 2,
        "Swizzle" => 4,
        "Format" | "DepthStencilMode" | "Target" => 1,
        _ => return HostResult::Unavailable(format!("{name} is not modelled")),
    };
    let args = state.host.ext.with::<crate::nvn::Nvn, _>(|n| n.state.get(&view).and_then(|m| m.get(&setter)).cloned());
    let Some(args) = args else { return HostResult::Returned(0) };
    for i in 0..outs {
        let out = state.x[1 + i];
        if out != 0 {
            if let Err(e) = crate::hle::write_bytes(state, out, &(args[i] as u32).to_le_bytes()) {
                return e;
            }
        }
    }
    HostResult::Returned(NVN_TRUE)
}

/// Guest address of a texture's storage.
fn storage_address(state: &State, d: &TexDesc) -> Option<u64> {
    state.host.ext.with::<crate::nvn_mem::Memory, _>(|m| m.pools.get(&d.pool).filter(|p| p.storage != 0).map(|p| p.storage + d.offset))
}

/// Copy texels between packed guest memory and a texture's tiled storage.
/// `region` is NVNcopyRegion: x, y, z offset then width, height, depth, in
/// texels; a view selects the base level and layer.
fn transfer_texels(state: &mut State, to_texture: bool, row_stride: Option<u64>, image_stride: Option<u64>) -> HostResult {
    let (t, view, region, data) = (state.x[0], state.x[1], state.x[2], state.x[3]);
    let Some(d) = tex(state, |x| x.textures.get(&t).cloned()) else {
        return HostResult::Unavailable(format!("texel transfer on texture 0x{t:x}, which was never initialized"));
    };
    let lay = match layout(&d) {
        Ok(l) => l,
        Err(e) => return HostResult::Unavailable(e),
    };
    let Some(base) = storage_address(state, &d) else {
        return HostResult::Unavailable(format!("texture 0x{t:x} has no CPU-visible storage"));
    };
    let r = match read_bytes(state, region, 24) {
        Ok(b) => b,
        Err(e) => return e,
    };
    let field = |i: usize| i32::from_le_bytes(r[i * 4..i * 4 + 4].try_into().unwrap()).max(0) as u64;
    let (x, y, z, w, h, dd) = (field(0), field(1), field(2), field(3), field(4), field(5).max(1));
    let view_arg = |setter: &str, i: usize| {
        if view == 0 {
            return 0;
        }
        state.host.ext.with::<crate::nvn::Nvn, _>(|n| n.state.get(&view).and_then(|m| m.get(setter)).map(|a| a[i] & 0xFFFF_FFFF).unwrap_or(0))
    };
    let level = view_arg("nvnTextureViewSetLevels", 0) as usize;
    let first_layer = view_arg("nvnTextureViewSetLayers", 0);
    if level >= lay.levels.len() {
        return HostResult::Unavailable(format!("texel transfer on level {level} of a {}-level texture", lay.levels.len()));
    }
    let blk = lay.block;
    let (bx0, by0) = (x / blk.w as u64, y / blk.h as u64);
    let (bw, bh) = (w.div_ceil(blk.w as u64), h.div_ceil(blk.h as u64));
    let bytes = blk.bytes as u64;
    let row = row_stride.unwrap_or(bw * bytes);
    let image = image_stride.unwrap_or(row * bh);
    let is3d = d.target == TARGET_3D;
    let size = lay.size();
    for k in 0..dd {
        let (layer, slice) = if is3d { (0, z + k) } else { (first_layer + z + k, 0) };
        for j in 0..bh {
            for i in 0..bw {
                let off = lay.offset(level, layer, bx0 + i, by0 + j, slice);
                if off + bytes > size {
                    return HostResult::Unavailable(format!("texel transfer outside texture 0x{t:x}"));
                }
                let (tex_at, mem_at) = (base + off, data + k * image + j * row + i * bytes);
                let (from, to) = if to_texture { (mem_at, tex_at) } else { (tex_at, mem_at) };
                let (f, o) = (from as usize, to as usize);
                if f + bytes as usize > state.mem.len() || o + bytes as usize > state.mem.len() {
                    return HostResult::Unavailable(format!("texel transfer at 0x{from:x} or 0x{to:x} is outside guest memory"));
                }
                state.mem.copy_within(f..f + bytes as usize, o);
            }
        }
    }
    HostResult::Returned(0)
}

/// `nvnTextureWriteTexels(texture, view, region, data)`.
fn write_texels(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    transfer_texels(state, true, None, None)
}

/// `nvnTextureWriteTexelsStrided(texture, view, region, data, rowStride, imageStride)`.
fn write_texels_strided(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let (rs, is) = (state.x[4], state.x[5]);
    transfer_texels(state, true, (rs != 0).then_some(rs), (is != 0).then_some(is))
}

/// `nvnTextureReadTexels(texture, view, region, data)`.
fn read_texels(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    transfer_texels(state, false, None, None)
}

fn read_texels_strided(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let (rs, is) = (state.x[4], state.x[5]);
    transfer_texels(state, false, (rs != 0).then_some(rs), (is != 0).then_some(is))
}

/// Flushes and invalidates: the host reads guest memory in place.
fn coherent(_state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    HostResult::Returned(0)
}

pub fn register(s: &mut HostServices) {
    s.register_prefix("nvn:nvnTextureViewSet", crate::nvn::record_state, "texture view state on the host");
    s.register_prefix("nvn:nvnTextureViewGet", view_get, "texture view state on the host");
    s.register_prefix("nvn:nvnTextureBuilderSet", builder_set, "texture builder state on the host");
    s.register_prefix("nvn:nvnTextureBuilderGet", builder_get, "texture builder state on the host");
    s.register_prefix("nvn:nvnTextureGet", texture_get, "texture state on the host");
    let table: &[(&str, fn(&mut State) -> HostResult, &'static str)] = &[
        ("nvnTextureBuilderGetStorageSize", builder_get_storage_size, "block-linear size by the GPU's tiling rules"),
        ("nvnTextureBuilderGetStorageAlignment", builder_get_storage_alignment, "one GOB"),
        ("nvnTextureInitialize", texture_initialize, "a texture over pool storage, for formats the host knows"),
        ("nvnTextureFinalize", texture_finalize, "forgets the texture"),
        ("nvnTextureWriteTexels", write_texels, "tiled into the texture's block-linear storage"),
        ("nvnTextureWriteTexelsStrided", write_texels_strided, "tiled into the texture's block-linear storage"),
        ("nvnTextureReadTexels", read_texels, "read back out of the block-linear storage"),
        ("nvnTextureReadTexelsStrided", read_texels_strided, "read back out of the block-linear storage"),
        ("nvnTextureFlushTexels", coherent, "guest memory is read in place, so it is coherent"),
        ("nvnTextureInvalidateTexels", coherent, "guest memory is read in place, so it is coherent"),
        ("nvnTexturePoolInitialize", texture_pool_initialize, "descriptor slots kept on the host"),
        ("nvnSamplerPoolInitialize", sampler_pool_initialize, "descriptor slots kept on the host"),
        ("nvnTexturePoolGetMemoryPool", pool_get, "the pool the descriptors live in"),
        ("nvnTexturePoolGetMemoryOffset", pool_get, "the descriptors' offset"),
        ("nvnTexturePoolGetSize", pool_get, "the descriptor count"),
        ("nvnSamplerPoolGetMemoryPool", pool_get, "the pool the descriptors live in"),
        ("nvnSamplerPoolGetMemoryOffset", pool_get, "the descriptors' offset"),
        ("nvnSamplerPoolGetSize", pool_get, "the descriptor count"),
        ("nvnTexturePoolFinalize", pool_finalize, "forgets the pool"),
        ("nvnSamplerPoolFinalize", pool_finalize, "forgets the pool"),
        ("nvnTexturePoolRegisterTexture", texture_pool_register, "slot to texture, kept on the host"),
        ("nvnTexturePoolRegisterImage", texture_pool_register, "slot to image, kept on the host"),
        ("nvnSamplerPoolRegisterSampler", sampler_pool_register, "slot to sampler, kept on the host"),
        ("nvnSamplerPoolRegisterSamplerBuilder", sampler_pool_register, "slot to sampler state, kept on the host"),
        ("nvnDeviceGetTextureHandle", device_get_texture_handle, "texture index low 20 bits, sampler index above"),
        ("nvnDeviceGetSeparateTextureHandle", device_get_image_handle, "texture index"),
        ("nvnDeviceGetSeparateSamplerHandle", device_get_image_handle, "sampler index"),
        ("nvnDeviceGetImageHandle", device_get_image_handle, "image index"),
        ("nvnDeviceGetTexelFetchHandle", device_get_image_handle, "texture index"),
    ];
    for (name, handler, claim) in table {
        s.register(&format!("nvn:{name}"), *handler, claim);
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn d2(w: u32, h: u32, format: u32) -> TexDesc {
        TexDesc { width: w, height: h, format, ..TexDesc::defaults() }
    }

    #[test]
    fn block_linear_sizes_follow_the_gob_rules() {
        // 3840x2160 RGB10A2: 15360-byte rows, 2160 rows padded to 16-GOB blocks (128 rows).
        assert_eq!(storage_size(&d2(3840, 2160, 0x3D)).unwrap(), 15360 * 2176);
        // A small texture shrinks its block height: 16x16 RGBA8 is 64 bytes by 16 rows.
        assert_eq!(storage_size(&d2(16, 16, 0x25)).unwrap(), 64 * 16);
        // BC1 counts 4x4 blocks: 256x256 is 64x64 blocks of 8 bytes.
        assert_eq!(storage_size(&d2(256, 256, 0x41)).unwrap(), 512 * 64);
    }

    #[test]
    fn mips_and_layers_add_up() {
        let mut d = d2(64, 64, 0x25);
        d.levels = 2;
        // 256 bytes x 64 rows, then 128 -> 128 bytes... padded to 64-byte rows: 128 x 32 rows.
        assert_eq!(storage_size(&d).unwrap(), 256 * 64 + 128 * 32);
        d.levels = 1;
        d.target = 4;
        d.depth = 3;
        let one = storage_size(&d2(64, 64, 0x25)).unwrap();
        assert!(storage_size(&d).unwrap() >= 3 * one);
    }

    #[test]
    fn astc_blocks_follow_the_bntx_table() {
        // BNTX 0x3406 (ASTC 8x8 sRGB) maps to NVN 0x8e in the game's table.
        assert_eq!(format_block(0x8e), Some(Block { w: 8, h: 8, bytes: 16 }));
        assert_eq!(format_block(0x79), Some(Block { w: 4, h: 4, bytes: 16 }));
        assert_eq!(format_block(0x86), Some(Block { w: 12, h: 12, bytes: 16 }));
        assert_eq!(format_block(0x94), Some(Block { w: 12, h: 12, bytes: 16 }));
    }

    #[test]
    fn tiling_matches_the_gob_layout() {
        // Within one GOB: 16-byte runs, two rows per 64 bytes, halves of 256.
        assert_eq!(gob_offset(0, 0), 0);
        assert_eq!(gob_offset(16, 0), 32);
        assert_eq!(gob_offset(0, 1), 16);
        assert_eq!(gob_offset(0, 2), 64);
        assert_eq!(gob_offset(32, 0), 256);
        // 256x256 RGBA8: 1024-byte rows, 16-GOB blocks. Block (16, 0) is
        // byte 64 of row 0, the second GOB column.
        let l = layout(&d2(256, 256, 0x25)).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(l.offset(0, 0, 16, 0, 0), 512 * 16);
        // Row 8 is the second GOB down the same block column.
        assert_eq!(l.offset(0, 0, 0, 8, 0), 512);
        // Row 128 starts the second row of blocks: 16 GOB columns of 8 KiB.
        assert_eq!(l.offset(0, 0, 0, 128, 0), 16 * 512 * 16);
        // Every block of the level lands at a distinct offset inside it.
        let mut seen = std::collections::HashSet::new();
        for by in 0..256 {
            for bx in 0..256 {
                let o = l.offset(0, 0, bx, by, 0);
                assert!(o + 4 <= l.size());
                assert!(seen.insert(o));
            }
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn unknown_formats_are_refused() {
        assert!(storage_size(&d2(4, 4, 0x200)).is_err());
    }
}
```

`crates/ew-boot/src/nvn_win.rs`:

```rs
//! NVN windows: the swap chain the game renders into and presents.
//!
//! A window owns the textures the game handed its builder. Acquiring returns
//! the next texture in turn; presenting records the frame. The frames are what
//! the host display shows once the renderer executes the game's commands; until
//! then the run report counts them, so a present is never mistaken for an
//! image on screen.

use crate::hle::{read_bytes, write_bytes, HostResult, HostServices};
use crate::nvn::called;
use ew_lift::State;
use std::collections::BTreeMap;

const NVN_TRUE: u64 = 1;
/// `NVN_WINDOW_ACQUIRE_TEXTURE_RESULT_SUCCESS`.
const ACQUIRE_SUCCESS: u64 = 0;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
pub struct Window {
    pub textures: Vec<u64>,
    pub active: u32,
    pub next: u32,
    pub present_interval: u32,
    pub acquire_timeout: u64,
    pub crop: [i32; 4],
    pub native: u64,
    pub presented: u64,
    pub last_presented: Option<u32>,
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct Windows {
    pub windows: BTreeMap<u64, Window>,
    /// Every present, as (window, texture index), most recent last, capped.
    pub frames: u64,
}

fn win<R>(state: &State, f: impl FnOnce(&mut Windows) -> R) -> R {
    state.host.ext.with::<Windows, R>(f)
}

/// Frames presented so far, across every window.
pub fn frames_presented(state: &State) -> u64 {
    win(state, |w| w.frames)
}

fn recorded_args(state: &State, obj: u64, setter: &str) -> Option<Vec<u64>> {
    state.host.ext.with::<crate::nvn::Nvn, _>(|n| n.state.get(&obj).and_then(|m| m.get(setter)).cloned())
}

/// `nvnWindowInitialize(NVNwindow*, const NVNwindowBuilder*)`.
fn window_initialize(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let (w, b) = (state.x[0], state.x[1]);
    let Some(t) = recorded_args(state, b, "nvnWindowBuilderSetTextures") else {
        return HostResult::Unavailable("nvnWindowInitialize with no textures set".into());
    };
    let (count, list) = (t[0] & 0xFFFF_FFFF, t[1]);
    if count == 0 || count > 16 {
        return HostResult::Unavailable(format!("nvnWindowInitialize with {count} textures"));
    }
    let bytes = match read_bytes(state, list, count * 8) {
        Ok(b) => b,
        Err(e) => return e,
    };
    let textures: Vec<u64> = bytes.chunks(8).map(|c| u64::from_le_bytes(c.try_into().unwrap())).collect();
    let interval = recorded_args(state, b, "nvnWindowBuilderSetPresentInterval").map(|a| a[0] as u32).unwrap_or(1);
    let native = recorded_args(state, b, "nvnWindowBuilderSetNativeWindow").map(|a| a[0]).unwrap_or(0);
    let size = state.host.ext.with::<crate::nvn_tex::Textures, _>(|x| {
        x.textures.get(&textures[0]).map(|d| (d.width, d.height, d.format))
    });
    let Some((width, height, format)) = size else {
        return HostResult::Unavailable(format!("nvnWindowInitialize: texture 0x{:x} was never initialized", textures[0]));
    };
    state.host.log.push(format!(
        "gfx: window 0x{w:x}: {count} textures of {width}x{height}, format 0x{format:x}, present interval {interval}"
    ));
    win(state, |x| {
        x.windows.insert(
            w,
            Window {
                active: count as u32,
                textures,
                present_interval: interval,
                acquire_timeout: u64::MAX,
                crop: [0, 0, width as i32, height as i32],
                native,
                ..Window::default()
            },
        )
    });
    HostResult::Returned(NVN_TRUE)
}

fn with_window(state: &mut State, f: impl FnOnce(&mut Window) -> u64) -> HostResult {
    let w = state.x[0];
    match win(state, |x| x.windows.get_mut(&w).map(f)) {
        Some(v) => HostResult::Returned(v),
        None => HostResult::Unavailable(format!("{} on window 0x{w:x}, which was never initialized", called(state))),
    }
}

/// `nvnWindowAcquireTexture(NVNwindow*, NVNsync*, int* textureIndex)`: the next
/// texture in turn. Its previous frame has been presented already, so the sync
/// is signalled at once.
fn window_acquire_texture(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let (w, sync, out) = (state.x[0], state.x[1], state.x[2]);
    let Some(index) = win(state, |x| {
        x.windows.get_mut(&w).map(|win| {
            let i = win.next % win.active.max(1);
            win.next = (i + 1) % win.active.max(1);
            i
        })
    }) else {
        return HostResult::Unavailable(format!("nvnWindowAcquireTexture on window 0x{w:x}, which was never initialized"));
    };
    state.host.ext.with::<crate::nvn_mem::Memory, _>(|m| m.signalled.insert(sync, true));
    match write_bytes(state, out, &(index as i32).to_le_bytes()) {
        Ok(()) => HostResult::Returned(ACQUIRE_SUCCESS),
        Err(e) => e,
    }
}

/// `nvnQueuePresentTexture(NVNqueue*, NVNwindow*, int textureIndex)`.
fn queue_present_texture(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let (w, index) = (state.x[1], state.x[2] as u32);
    let (first, frames) = win(state, |x| {
        x.frames += 1;
        let first = x.windows.get_mut(&w).map(|win| {
            win.presented += 1;
            win.last_presented = Some(index);
            win.presented == 1
        });
        (first, x.frames)
    });
    if frames % 300 == 0 {
        state.host.log.push(format!("gfx: {frames} frames presented"));
    }
    match first {
        Some(true) => {
            state.host.log.push(format!("gfx: first frame presented on window 0x{w:x} (texture {index})"));
            HostResult::Returned(0)
        }
        Some(false) => HostResult::Returned(0),
        None => HostResult::Unavailable(format!("nvnQueuePresentTexture on window 0x{w:x}, which was never initialized")),
    }
}

fn get_present_interval(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    with_window(state, |w| w.present_interval as u64)
}

fn set_present_interval(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let v = state.x[1] as u32;
    with_window(state, |w| {
        w.present_interval = v;
        0
    })
}

fn get_acquire_timeout(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    with_window(state, |w| w.acquire_timeout)
}

fn set_acquire_timeout(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let v = state.x[1];
    with_window(state, |w| {
        w.acquire_timeout = v;
        0
    })
}

fn set_crop(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let c = [state.x[1] as i32, state.x[2] as i32, state.x[3] as i32, state.x[4] as i32];
    with_window(state, |w| {
        w.crop = c;
        0
    })
}

/// `nvnWindowGetCrop(const NVNwindow*, NVNrectangle*)`.
fn get_crop(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let (w, out) = (state.x[0], state.x[1]);
    let Some(c) = win(state, |x| x.windows.get(&w).map(|w| w.crop)) else {
        return HostResult::Unavailable(format!("nvnWindowGetCrop on window 0x{w:x}, which was never initialized"));
    };
    let bytes: Vec<u8> = c.iter().flat_map(|v| v.to_le_bytes()).collect();
    match write_bytes(state, out, &bytes) {
        Ok(()) => HostResult::Returned(0),
        Err(e) => e,
    }
}

fn set_num_active(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let n = state.x[1] as u32;
    with_window(state, |w| {
        w.active = n.clamp(1, w.textures.len() as u32);
        0
    })
}

fn get_num_active(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    with_window(state, |w| w.active as u64)
}

fn get_num_textures(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    with_window(state, |w| w.textures.len() as u64)
}

fn get_native_window(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    with_window(state, |w| w.native)
}

fn window_finalize(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let w = state.x[0];
    win(state, |x| x.windows.remove(&w));
    HostResult::Returned(0)
}

pub fn register(s: &mut HostServices) {
    let table: &[(&str, fn(&mut State) -> HostResult, &'static str)] = &[
        ("nvnWindowInitialize", window_initialize, "a swap chain over the game's textures"),
        ("nvnWindowFinalize", window_finalize, "forgets the window"),
        ("nvnWindowAcquireTexture", window_acquire_texture, "next texture in turn, sync signalled"),
        ("nvnQueuePresentTexture", queue_present_texture, "frame recorded; shown once the renderer executes commands"),
        ("nvnWindowGetPresentInterval", get_present_interval, "window state on the host"),
        ("nvnWindowSetPresentInterval", set_present_interval, "window state on the host"),
        ("nvnWindowGetAcquireTimeout", get_acquire_timeout, "window state on the host"),
        ("nvnWindowSetAcquireTimeout", set_acquire_timeout, "window state on the host"),
        ("nvnWindowSetCrop", set_crop, "window state on the host"),
        ("nvnWindowGetCrop", get_crop, "window state on the host"),
        ("nvnWindowSetNumActiveTextures", set_num_active, "window state on the host"),
        ("nvnWindowGetNumActiveTextures", get_num_active, "window state on the host"),
        ("nvnWindowGetNumTextures", get_num_textures, "window state on the host"),
        ("nvnWindowGetNativeWindow", get_native_window, "the native window handle the builder was given"),
    ];
    for (name, handler, claim) in table {
        s.register(&format!("nvn:{name}"), *handler, claim);
    }
}
```

`crates/ew-boot/src/pmr.rs`:

```rs
//! `std::pmr`, the polymorphic memory resources of libc++.
//!
//! libc++ keeps one process-wide default resource, initially
//! `std::pmr::new_delete_resource()`. That resource is an object with a vtable,
//! and its allocation methods call the global `operator new` and
//! `operator delete`. This title replaces those operators with its own (it
//! exports `_Znwm`, `_ZnwmSt11align_val_t` and the matching deletes), so the
//! exact behaviour is a vtable whose entries forward into the game's own code.
//!
//! The host therefore builds a real object in guest memory: a vtable pointer,
//! and an Itanium-layout vtable whose entries are host stubs. Each stub moves
//! the arguments into place and tail-calls the game's operator, which is what
//! libc++'s `__libcpp_allocate` and `__libcpp_deallocate` do: alignments above
//! the default new alignment (16) use the `align_val_t` overloads.

use crate::hle::{HostResult, HostServices};
use ew_lift::State;

/// Host functions with no import slot, reachable only through the objects
/// built here. The dispatcher gives each one its own stub address.
pub const SYNTHETIC: [&str; 5] = [
    "<host> new_delete_resource::~new_delete_resource",
    "<host> new_delete_resource::~new_delete_resource (deleting)",
    "<host> new_delete_resource::do_allocate",
    "<host> new_delete_resource::do_deallocate",
    "<host> new_delete_resource::do_is_equal",
];

/// The default alignment `operator new` guarantees on AArch64.
const NEW_ALIGN: u64 = 16;

/// Lay out the `new_delete_resource` object and its vtable, given the stub
/// address of each entry of [`SYNTHETIC`]. Records the addresses the handlers
/// need in `state.host.named`.
pub fn install(state: &mut State, stubs: &[u64], exports: &[(&str, Option<u64>)]) -> Result<(), String> {
    // offset-to-top, typeinfo, then the five virtual functions; the object is
    // one vtable pointer. typeinfo is null: nothing in this host emits a
    // `dynamic_cast` against it, and a guest that tried would fault visibly.
    let base = state.host.allocate(8 * 8, 16)?;
    let vtable = base + 16;
    let object = base + 16 + 8 * 5;
    let mut bytes = Vec::with_capacity(64);
    bytes.extend_from_slice(&0u64.to_le_bytes());
    bytes.extend_from_slice(&0u64.to_le_bytes());
    for s in stubs {
        bytes.extend_from_slice(&s.to_le_bytes());
    }
    bytes.extend_from_slice(&vtable.to_le_bytes());
    let at = base as usize;
    if at + bytes.len() > state.mem.len() {
        return Err("no room for the pmr resource object".into());
    }
    state.mem[at..at + bytes.len()].copy_from_slice(&bytes);
    state.host.named.insert("pmr.new_delete".into(), object);
    state.host.named.insert("pmr.default".into(), object);
    for (name, addr) in exports {
        if let Some(a) = addr {
            state.host.named.insert(format!("export.{name}"), *a);
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn export(state: &State, name: &str) -> Result<u64, HostResult> {
    state.host.named.get(&format!("export.{name}")).copied().ok_or_else(|| {
        HostResult::Unavailable(format!(
            "new_delete_resource needs `{name}`, which this module does not export"
        ))
    })
}

fn dtor(_state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    HostResult::Returned(0)
}

/// The deleting destructor of a static object is never legitimately called.
fn deleting_dtor(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    HostResult::Unavailable(format!(
        "the guest deleted std::pmr::new_delete_resource (object 0x{:x}), which libc++ never does",
        state.x[0]
    ))
}

/// `do_allocate(this, bytes, alignment)`.
fn do_allocate(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let (bytes, align) = (state.x[1], state.x[2]);
    let name = if align > NEW_ALIGN { "_ZnwmSt11align_val_t" } else { "_Znwm" };
    match export(state, name) {
        Ok(target) => {
            state.x[0] = bytes;
            state.x[1] = align;
            HostResult::Jump(target)
        }
        Err(e) => e,
    }
}

/// `do_deallocate(this, p, bytes, alignment)`.
fn do_deallocate(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let (p, align) = (state.x[1], state.x[3]);
    let name = if align > NEW_ALIGN { "_ZdlPvSt11align_val_t" } else { "_ZdlPv" };
    match export(state, name) {
        Ok(target) => {
            state.x[0] = p;
            state.x[1] = align;
            HostResult::Jump(target)
        }
        Err(e) => e,
    }
}

/// `do_is_equal(this, other)`: new_delete_resource is equal only to itself.
fn do_is_equal(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    HostResult::Returned((state.x[0] == state.x[1]) as u64)
}

/// `std::pmr::set_default_resource(memory_resource*)`: a null argument restores
/// `new_delete_resource()`; returns the previous default.
fn set_default(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let Some(&new_delete) = state.host.named.get("pmr.new_delete") else {
        return HostResult::Unavailable("the pmr resources were not installed".into());
    };
    let next = if state.x[0] == 0 { new_delete } else { state.x[0] };
    let prev = state.host.named.insert("pmr.default".into(), next).unwrap_or(new_delete);
    HostResult::Returned(prev)
}

fn get_default(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    match state.host.named.get("pmr.default") {
        Some(&r) => HostResult::Returned(r),
        None => HostResult::Unavailable("the pmr resources were not installed".into()),
    }
}

/// `std::pmr::memory_resource::~memory_resource()` (base subobject): trivial.
fn base_dtor(_state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    HostResult::Returned(0)
}

pub fn register(services: &mut HostServices) {
    let handlers: [fn(&mut State) -> HostResult; 5] =
        [dtor, deleting_dtor, do_allocate, do_deallocate, do_is_equal];
    for (name, handler) in SYNTHETIC.iter().zip(handlers) {
        services.register(name, handler, "libc++ new_delete_resource, forwarding to the game's own operator new/delete");
    }
    services.register(
        "_ZNSt3__13pmr20set_default_resourceEPNS0_15memory_resourceE",
        set_default as _,
        "stores the new default, null restores new_delete_resource(), returns the previous one",
    );
    services.register(
        "_ZNSt3__13pmr20get_default_resourceEv",
        get_default as _,
        "returns the current default, initially new_delete_resource()",
    );
    services.register(
        "_ZNSt3__13pmr15memory_resourceD2Ev",
        base_dtor as _,
        "the base destructor of memory_resource is trivial",
    );
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn setup() -> State {
        let mut s = State::default();
        s.host.alloc_next = 0x10000;
        s.host.alloc_end = 0x20000;
        install(
            &mut s,
            &[0xA0, 0xB0, 0xC0, 0xD0, 0xE0],
            &[("_Znwm", Some(0x1000)), ("_ZnwmSt11align_val_t", Some(0x2000)), ("_ZdlPv", Some(0x3000))],
        )
        .unwrap();
        s
    }

    #[test]
    fn default_resource_round_trips() {
        let mut s = setup();
        let nd = s.host.named["pmr.new_delete"];
        s.x[0] = 0x5000;
        assert_eq!(set_default(&mut s), HostResult::Returned(nd));
        assert_eq!(get_default(&mut s), HostResult::Returned(0x5000));
        s.x[0] = 0;
        assert_eq!(set_default(&mut s), HostResult::Returned(0x5000));
        assert_eq!(get_default(&mut s), HostResult::Returned(nd));
    }

    #[test]
    fn the_object_points_at_its_vtable() {
        let s = setup();
        let obj = s.host.named["pmr.new_delete"] as usize;
        let vt = u64::from_le_bytes(s.mem[obj..obj + 8].try_into().unwrap()) as usize;
        let alloc = u64::from_le_bytes(s.mem[vt + 16..vt + 24].try_into().unwrap());
        assert_eq!(alloc, 0xC0, "slot 2 is do_allocate");
    }

    #[test]
    fn allocation_forwards_to_the_games_operator_new() {
        let mut s = setup();
        s.x = [0; 31];
        s.x[1] = 64;
        s.x[2] = 8;
        assert_eq!(do_allocate(&mut s), HostResult::Jump(0x1000));
        assert_eq!(s.x[0], 64);
        s.x[1] = 64;
        s.x[2] = 64;
        assert_eq!(do_allocate(&mut s), HostResult::Jump(0x2000));
        assert_eq!((s.x[0], s.x[1]), (64, 64));
    }
}
```

`crates/ew-boot/src/prepo.rs`:

```rs
//! `nn::prepo` play reports: telemetry the game builds and hands to the system
//! to upload. The host accepts every report and sends nothing anywhere. It
//! counts the entries added to each report so `GetCount` answers truthfully,
//! and `Clear` resets the count.

use crate::hle::{HostResult, HostServices};
use ew_lift::State;
use std::collections::HashMap;

#[derive(Default)]
struct Reports {
    counts: HashMap<u64, u64>,
}

fn reports<R>(state: &State, f: impl FnOnce(&mut Reports) -> R) -> R {
    state.host.ext.with::<Reports, R>(f)
}

/// Constructors, buffers, event ids, and `Save`: accepted, nothing kept.
fn accept(_state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    HostResult::Returned(0)
}

fn add(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let object = state.x[0];
    reports(state, |r| *r.counts.entry(object).or_insert(0) += 1);
    HostResult::Returned(0)
}

fn clear(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let object = state.x[0];
    reports(state, |r| r.counts.remove(&object));
    HostResult::Returned(0)
}

fn count(state: &mut State) -> HostResult {
    let object = state.x[0];
    HostResult::Returned(reports(state, |r| r.counts.get(&object).copied().unwrap_or(0)))
}

pub fn register(s: &mut HostServices) {
    let table: &[(&str, fn(&mut State) -> HostResult)] = &[
        ("_ZN2nn5prepo10PlayReportC1Ev", clear),
        ("_ZN2nn5prepo10PlayReportD1Ev", clear),
        ("_ZN2nn5prepo10PlayReport9SetBufferEPvm", clear),
        ("_ZN2nn5prepo10PlayReport10SetEventIdEPKc", accept),
        ("_ZN2nn5prepo10PlayReport5ClearEv", clear),
        ("_ZN2nn5prepo10PlayReport3AddEPKcb", add),
        ("_ZN2nn5prepo10PlayReport3AddEPKcS3_", add),
        ("_ZN2nn5prepo10PlayReport3AddEPKcl", add),
        ("_ZN2nn5prepo10PlayReport3AddEPKcRKNS0_10Any64BitIdE", add),
        ("_ZN2nn5prepo10PlayReport3AddEPKcRKNS0_5ArrayE", add),
        ("_ZNK2nn5prepo10PlayReport8GetCountEv", count),
        ("_ZN2nn5prepo10PlayReport4SaveERKNS_7account3UidE", accept),
        ("_ZN2nn5prepo10PlayReport4SaveEv", accept),
        ("_ZN2nn5prepo6StructC1Ev", clear),
        ("_ZN2nn5prepo6Struct9SetBufferEPvm", clear),
        ("_ZN2nn5prepo6Struct5ClearEv", clear),
        ("_ZN2nn5prepo6Struct3AddEPKcb", add),
        ("_ZN2nn5prepo6Struct3AddEPKcS3_", add),
        ("_ZN2nn5prepo6Struct3AddEPKcl", add),
        ("_ZN2nn5prepo6Struct3AddEPKcRKNS0_5ArrayE", add),
        ("_ZN2nn5prepo6Struct3AddEPKcRKS1_", add),
        ("_ZN2nn5prepo5ArrayC1Ev", clear),
        ("_ZN2nn5prepo5Array9SetBufferEPvm", clear),
        ("_ZN2nn5prepo5Array5ClearEv", clear),
        ("_ZN2nn5prepo5Array3AddEPKc", add),
        ("_ZN2nn5prepo5Array3AddEl", add),
        ("_ZN2nn5prepo5Array3AddERKNS0_6StructE", add),
    ];
    for (name, handler) in table {
        s.register(name, *handler, "play reports are accepted and never sent");
    }
}
```
