#[cfg(test)]
mod ldapr_tests {
    use super::*;

    /// `ldaprb w8, [x8]`, the instruction that stopped the boot attempt.
    #[test]
    fn ldaprb_decodes_as_a_plain_byte_load() {
        match decode(0x38BF_C108, 0) {
            Op::LoadStore { rt, rn, offset, bytes, load, signed, mode, is64 } => {
                assert_eq!((rt, rn, offset), (8, 8, 0));
                assert_eq!((bytes, load, signed), (1, true, false));
                assert_eq!(mode, MemMode::Offset);
                assert!(!is64);
            }
            other => panic!("expected a byte load, got {other:?}"),
        }
    }

    /// `ldaprb` is one byte; the word and doubleword forms follow the size
    /// field, not a fixed width.
    #[test]
    fn ldapr_sizes_follow_the_size_field() {
        match decode(0xF8BF_C020, 0) {
            Op::LoadStore { bytes, is64, .. } => {
                assert_eq!(bytes, 8);
                assert!(is64);
            }
            other => panic!("expected a doubleword load, got {other:?}"),
        }
    }
}

```

`crates/ew-lift/src/bin/ew_lift.rs`:

```rs
//! `ew-lift` — lift a decompressed text segment into C.
//!
//! Input is either a raw `text.bin` produced by `ew-inspect`/`zbic_extract.py`
//! or an NSO module that the pipeline can decompress itself.

use anyhow::{bail, Context, Result};
use ew_lift::{
    decode, dispatch_header, emit_campaign, emit_harness, emit_module, interpreter, lift_function,
    lift_text_in, Op, LiftOptions, RUNTIME_HEADER,
};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::path::PathBuf;

struct Args {
    text: PathBuf,
    module: String,
    out: PathBuf,
    opts: LiftOptions,
    harness: bool,
    interpret: bool,
    families: bool,
    segments: Vec<(u64, PathBuf)>,
    campaign: Option<usize>,
    simd_campaign: Option<usize>,
}

fn main() {
    if let Err(e) = run() {
        eprintln!("ew-lift: {e:#}");
        std::process::exit(1);
    }
}

fn run() -> Result<()> {
    let mut args = Args {
        text: PathBuf::new(),
        module: "app".to_string(),
        out: PathBuf::from("build/lift"),
        opts: LiftOptions::default(),
        harness: false,
        interpret: false,
        families: false,
        segments: Vec::new(),
        campaign: None,
        simd_campaign: None,
    };
    let mut text_given = false;

    let mut it = std::env::args().skip(1);
    while let Some(a) = it.next() {
        match a.as_str() {
            "--text" => {
                args.text = PathBuf::from(value(&mut it, "--text")?);
                text_given = true;
            }
            "--module" => args.module = value(&mut it, "--module")?,
            "--out" => args.out = PathBuf::from(value(&mut it, "--out")?),
            "--limit" => args.opts.max_functions = value(&mut it, "--limit")?.parse()?,
            "--max-insns" => args.opts.max_insns = value(&mut it, "--max-insns")?.parse()?,
            "--entry" => {
                let v = value(&mut it, "--entry")?;
                args.opts.entry = u64::from_str_radix(v.trim_start_matches("0x"), 16)
                    .context("--entry expects a hex address")?;
            }
            "--pure-leaf" => args.opts.pure_leaf_only = true,
            "--harness" => args.harness = true,
            "--interpret" => args.interpret = true,
            "--families" => args.families = true,
            "--simd-campaign" => {
                args.simd_campaign = Some(value(&mut it, "--simd-campaign")?.parse()?);
            }
            "--campaign" => {
                args.campaign = Some(value(&mut it, "--campaign")?.parse()?);
            }
            "--segment" => {
                let v = value(&mut it, "--segment")?;
                let (addr, path) = v
                    .split_once(':')
                    .context("--segment expects ADDR:PATH")?;
                let addr = u64::from_str_radix(addr.trim_start_matches("0x"), 16)
                    .context("--segment address must be hex")?;
                args.segments.push((addr, PathBuf::from(path)));
            }
            "-h" | "--help" => {
                println!(
                    "ew-lift — lift an AArch64 text segment of Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave to C\n\
                     \n\
                     USAGE:\n  ew-lift --text <text.bin> [--module NAME] [--out DIR] [options]\n\
                     \n\
                     OPTIONS:\n\
                     \x20 --limit N        lift at most N blocks (default 512)\n\
                     \x20 --max-insns N   instruction cap per block (default 256)\n\
                     \x20 --pure-leaf     keep only register-only blocks that end in ret/br\n\
                     \x20 --entry ADDR    module entry point in hex\n\
                     \x20 --harness       also emit a self-checking C harness\n\
                     \x20 --interpret     run the reference interpreter on the first pure block\n\
                     \x20 --families      report the largest unsupported instruction groups\n\
                     \x20 --segment A:P   map module segment at hex address A from file P\n\
                     \x20                (use for rodata so jump tables can be resolved)\n\
                     \x20 --campaign N    write a C program that runs N functions plus\n\
                     \x20                expected.txt from the reference interpreter\n"
                );
                std::process::exit(0);
            }
            other => bail!("unknown argument `{other}` (try --help)"),
        }
    }
    if !text_given {
        bail!("--text is required (try --help)");
    }
    args.opts.module = args.module.clone();

    let text = std::fs::read(&args.text)
        .with_context(|| format!("reading text segment {}", args.text.display()))?;
    if text.len() % 4 != 0 {
        bail!("text segment length {} is not a multiple of 4", text.len());
    }

    let mut segment_bytes = Vec::new();
    for (addr, path) in &args.segments {
        let bytes = std::fs::read(path)
            .with_context(|| format!("reading segment {}", path.display()))?;
        segment_bytes.push((*addr, bytes));
    }
    let segments: Vec<(u64, &[u8])> = segment_bytes
        .iter()
        .map(|(addr, bytes)| (*addr, bytes.as_slice()))
        .collect();

    let (report, funcs) = lift_text_in(&text, &segments, &args.opts);
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&args.out)?;

    let c_path = args.out.join(format!("{}_lift.c", args.module));
    std::fs::write(&c_path, emit_module(&args.module, &funcs))?;
    std::fs::write(args.out.join("ew_aarch64.h"), RUNTIME_HEADER)?;
    std::fs::write(args.out.join("ew_dispatch.h"), dispatch_header())?;
    std::fs::write(
        args.out.join("lift_report.json"),
        serde_json::to_string_pretty(&report)?,
    )?;

    println!("module:            {}", report.module);
    println!("text:              {} bytes ({} words)", report.text_bytes, report.text_words);
    println!(
        "decode coverage:   {:.2}% of {} real words ({} padding, {} unsupported)",
        report.decode_coverage * 100.0,
        report.text_words.saturating_sub(report.padding_words),
        report.padding_words,
        report.unsupported_words
    );
    println!("candidate starts:  {}", report.candidate_starts);
    println!(
        "lifted functions:  {} ({} complete, {} pure leaf)",
        report.lifted_functions, report.complete_functions, report.pure_leaf_functions
    );
    println!("basic blocks:      {}", report.blocks_lifted);
    println!("instructions:      {}", report.instructions_lifted);
    println!("jump tables:       {} ({} targets)", report.jump_tables, report.jump_table_targets);
    println!("unresolved edges:  {}", report.unresolved_edges);
    println!(
        "partial functions: {} budget, {} unterminated block, {} indirect",
        report.incomplete_budget, report.incomplete_unterminated, report.incomplete_indirect
    );
    println!("unsupported (in):  {}", report.unsupported_in_lifted);
    println!("wrote:             {}", c_path.display());

    if args.families {
        print_families(&text);
    }

    // Verification targets the largest register-only function, preferring one
    // with more than a single block: a one-instruction `ret` proves very little.
    let best = || {
        funcs
            .iter()
            .filter(|f| f.is_pure_leaf())
            .max_by_key(|f| (f.blocks.len(), f.insn_count()))
    };

    if args.harness {
        let target = best();
        if let Some(f) = target {
            let path = args.out.join("harness.c");
            std::fs::write(&path, emit_harness(&args.module, f))?;
            println!("harness:           {} (guest 0x{:x})", path.display(), f.addr);
        } else {
            println!("harness:           no pure-leaf block available");
        }
    }

    if args.interpret {
        let target = best();
        match target {
            None => println!("interpret:         no pure-leaf block available"),
            Some(f) => {
                let mut st = interpreter::State::patterned();
                interpreter::run_function(&mut st, f, 100_000).map_err(|e| {
                    anyhow::anyhow!("interpreting guest 0x{:x}: {e}", f.addr)
                })?;
                println!(
                    "interpret:         guest 0x{:x} ({} blocks, {} instructions)",
                    f.addr,
                    f.blocks.len(),
                    f.insn_count()
                );
                println!("  halted={} pc=0x{:x} nzcv=0x{:x}", st.halted, st.pc, st.nzcv);
                for i in 0..8 {
                    println!("  x{i}=0x{:x}", st.x[i]);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if let Some(wanted) = args.simd_campaign {
        let (cases, expected, skipped) = build_simd_campaign(&text, wanted);
        let c_path = args.out.join("simd_campaign.c");
        std::fs::write(&c_path, ew_lift::emit_simd_campaign(&cases, SIMD_SEEDS_PER_CASE))?;
        std::fs::write(args.out.join("simd_expected.txt"), expected)?;
        println!(
            "simd campaign:     {} distinct encodings x {} states in {} ({} skipped: reference faulted)",
            cases.len(),
            SIMD_SEEDS_PER_CASE,
            c_path.display(),
            skipped
        );
    }

    if let Some(wanted) = args.campaign {
        let (chosen, expected, skipped) = build_campaign(&funcs, wanted);
        if chosen.is_empty() {
            bail!("no function completed a reference run; nothing to verify");
        }
        let c_path = args.out.join("campaign.c");
        std::fs::write(&c_path, emit_campaign(&args.module, &chosen))?;
        std::fs::write(args.out.join("expected.txt"), expected)?;
        println!(
            "campaign:          {} function(s) in {} ({} skipped by the interpreter)",
            chosen.len(),
            c_path.display(),
            skipped
        );
    }

    // Sanity: never emit an empty module silently.
    if funcs.is_empty() {
        bail!("no blocks were lifted; check --entry/--limit");
    }
    let _ = lift_function;
    Ok(())
}

const SIMD_SEEDS_PER_CASE: u32 = 6;

/// The seeded state shared with the C campaign's `ew_seed`.
fn simd_state(seed: u32) -> interpreter::State {
    let mut st = interpreter::State::patterned();
    for r in 0..32u32 {
        for h in 0..2u32 {
            st.v[r as usize][h as usize] = ew_lift::simd_seed_vector(seed, r, h);
        }
    }
    for x in st.x.iter_mut() {
        *x += seed as u64 * 0x100;
    }
    for r in 0..0x4000usize {
        st.mem[r] = (r as u32).wrapping_mul(37).wrapping_add(seed) as u8;
    }
    st
}

fn state_line(addr: u64, st: &interpreter::State) -> String {
    let mut line = format!("fn=0x{addr:x} halted={} pc={:x} nzcv={:x}", st.halted as u32, st.pc, st.nzcv);
    for i in 0..31 {
        line.push_str(&format!(" x{i}={:x}", st.x[i]));
    }
    line.push_str(&format!(" sp={:x}", st.sp));
    for i in 0..32 {
        line.push_str(&format!(" v{i}={:x}:{:x}", st.v[i][1], st.v[i][0]));
    }
    line.push('\n');
    line
}

/// Every distinct Advanced SIMD encoding in the text, up to `wanted`, with the
/// state the reference produces from each seeded register file.
fn build_simd_campaign(text: &[u8], wanted: usize) -> (Vec<(u64, ew_lift::Op)>, String, usize) {
    let mut seen = std::collections::HashSet::new();
    let mut cases = Vec::new();
    let mut expected = String::new();
    let mut skipped = 0;
    for (i, chunk) in text.chunks_exact(4).enumerate() {
        if cases.len() >= wanted {
            break;
        }
        let word = u32::from_le_bytes(chunk.try_into().unwrap());
        let addr = (i * 4) as u64;
        let op = decode(word, addr);
        if !matches!(op, ew_lift::Op::Simd(..) | ew_lift::Op::SimdMem(..)) || !seen.insert(word) {
            continue;
        }
        let mut lines = String::new();
        let mut ok = true;
        for seed in 0..SIMD_SEEDS_PER_CASE {
            let mut st = simd_state(seed);
            let r = match op {
                ew_lift::Op::Simd(ref s) => ew_lift::simd::exec(&mut st, s),
                ew_lift::Op::SimdMem(ref m) => ew_lift::simd::exec_mem(&mut st, m),
                _ => unreachable!(),
            };
            if r.is_err() {
                ok = false;
                break;
            }
            lines.push_str(&state_line(addr, &st));
        }
        if ok {
            expected.push_str(&lines);
            cases.push((addr, op));
        } else {
            skipped += 1;
        }
    }
    (cases, expected, skipped)
}

/// Choose functions that the reference interpreter can run to completion, and
/// record the exact state each one should produce.
fn build_campaign(
    funcs: &[ew_lift::LiftedFunction],
    wanted: usize,
) -> (Vec<ew_lift::LiftedFunction>, String, usize) {
    let mut candidates: Vec<&ew_lift::LiftedFunction> = funcs
        .iter()
        .filter(|f| f.complete && !f.has_calls)
        .collect();
    candidates.sort_by_key(|f| std::cmp::Reverse((f.insn_count(), f.blocks.len())));

    let mut chosen = Vec::new();
    let mut expected = String::new();
    let mut skipped = 0usize;
    for f in candidates {
        if chosen.len() >= wanted {
            break;
        }
        let mut st = interpreter::State::patterned();
        match interpreter::run_function(&mut st, f, 5000) {
            Ok(()) => {
                expected.push_str(&format!(
                    "fn=0x{:x} halted={} pc={:x} nzcv={:x}",
                    f.addr, st.halted as u32, st.pc, st.nzcv
                ));
                for i in 0..31 {
                    expected.push_str(&format!(" x{i}={:x}", st.x[i]));
                }
                expected.push_str(&format!(" sp={:x}", st.sp));
                for i in 0..32 {
                    expected.push_str(&format!(" v{i}={:x}:{:x}", st.v[i][1], st.v[i][0]));
                }
                expected.push('\n');
                chosen.push(f.clone());
            }
            Err(_) => skipped += 1,
        }
    }
    (chosen, expected, skipped)
}

/// Report the largest groups of words the decoder still rejects. Grouping by
/// bits 30:24 separates instruction families; the most common exact encoding in
/// each group is printed so the next decoder addition can be chosen from data.
fn print_families(text: &[u8]) {
    let mut families: HashMap<u32, (usize, HashMap<u32, usize>)> = HashMap::new();
    let mut words: HashMap<u32, usize> = HashMap::new();
    let mut total = 0usize;
    for (_, word) in ew_lift::scan::words(text) {
        if word == 0 {
            continue;
        }
        if matches!(decode(word, 0), Op::Unsupported { .. } | Op::UnsupportedBitfield { .. }) {
            total += 1;
            *words.entry(word).or_insert(0) += 1;
            let entry = families.entry((word >> 24) & 0x7F).or_default();
            entry.0 += 1;
            *entry.1.entry(word).or_insert(0) += 1;
        }
    }
    let mut rows: Vec<_> = families.into_iter().collect();
    rows.sort_by_key(|(_, (count, _))| std::cmp::Reverse(*count));
    println!("unsupported by group (bits 30:24):");
    for (family, (count, words)) in rows.into_iter().take(20) {
        let (word, seen) = words
            .into_iter()
            .max_by_key(|(_, n)| *n)
            .unwrap_or((0, 0));
        println!(
            "  family 0x{family:02x}  {count:>9} words ({:.1}%)  common 0x{word:08x} x{seen}",
            count as f64 * 100.0 / total.max(1) as f64
        );
    }
    println!("  total unsupported:  {total}");

    // Exact encodings, so the next decoder addition can be chosen from data and
    // cross-checked against an assembler rather than guessed from a bit pattern.
    let mut distinct: Vec<(u32, usize)> = words.into_iter().collect();
    distinct.sort_by_key(|(_, n)| std::cmp::Reverse(*n));
    println!("most common unsupported encodings:");
    for (word, n) in distinct.into_iter().take(25) {
        println!("  0x{word:08x} x{n}");
    }
}

fn value(it: &mut impl Iterator<Item = String>, flag: &str) -> Result<String> {
    it.next().with_context(|| format!("{flag} needs a value"))
}

`crates/ew-lift/src/bin/ew_path.rs`:

```rs
//! `ew-path` — report how far execution can reach from a starting address.
//!
//! The probe follows call and branch edges through the recovered control flow
//! graph and stops where the translation cannot continue. Its job is to answer
//! one question with evidence rather than opinion: what is the first thing that
//! blocks the game, and how much code sits behind that point.
//!
//! Nothing here executes guest code. Every number is derived from the static
//! graph, so the report cannot drift away from the lifter's actual behaviour.

use anyhow::{bail, Context, Result};
use ew_lift::{scan, Op};
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet, VecDeque};
use std::path::PathBuf;

struct Args {
    text: PathBuf,
    entry: u64,
    max_functions: usize,
    max_insns: usize,
    segments: Vec<(u64, PathBuf)>,
    verbose: bool,
}

fn main() {
    if let Err(e) = run() {
        eprintln!("ew-path: {e:#}");
        std::process::exit(1);
    }
}

fn run() -> Result<()> {
    let mut args = Args {
        text: PathBuf::new(),
        entry: 0,
        max_functions: 4096,
        max_insns: 512,
        segments: Vec::new(),
        verbose: false,
    };
    let mut text_given = false;

    let mut it = std::env::args().skip(1);
    while let Some(a) = it.next() {
        match a.as_str() {
            "--text" => {
                args.text = PathBuf::from(value(&mut it, "--text")?);
                text_given = true;
            }
            "--entry" => {
                let v = value(&mut it, "--entry")?;
                args.entry = u64::from_str_radix(v.trim_start_matches("0x"), 16)
                    .context("--entry expects a hex address")?;
            }
            "--max-functions" => args.max_functions = value(&mut it, "--max-functions")?.parse()?,
            "--max-insns" => args.max_insns = value(&mut it, "--max-insns")?.parse()?,
            "--verbose" => args.verbose = true,
            "--segment" => {
                let v = value(&mut it, "--segment")?;
                let (addr, path) = v.split_once(':').context("--segment expects ADDR:PATH")?;
                let addr = u64::from_str_radix(addr.trim_start_matches("0x"), 16)
                    .context("--segment address must be hex")?;
                args.segments.push((addr, PathBuf::from(path)));
            }
            "-h" | "--help" => {
                println!(
                    "ew-path — reachability probe for a lifted module\n\
                     \n\
                     USAGE:\n  ew-path --text <text.bin> [--entry ADDR] [options]\n\
                     \n\
                     OPTIONS:\n\
                     \x20 --entry ADDR          start address in hex (default 0)\n\
                     \x20 --max-functions N     stop after N reachable functions\n\
                     \x20 --max-insns N        instruction cap per function\n\
                     \x20 --segment A:P        map a module segment at hex address A\n"
                );
                std::process::exit(0);
            }
            other => bail!("unknown argument `{other}` (try --help)"),
        }
    }
    if !text_given {
        bail!("--text is required (try --help)");
    }

    let text = std::fs::read(&args.text)
        .with_context(|| format!("reading text segment {}", args.text.display()))?;
    if text.len() % 4 != 0 {
        bail!("text segment length {} is not a multiple of 4", text.len());
    }

    let mut segment_bytes = Vec::new();
    for (addr, path) in &args.segments {
        segment_bytes.push((*addr, std::fs::read(path).with_context(|| format!("reading {}", path.display()))?));
    }
    let segments: Vec<(u64, &[u8])> = segment_bytes
        .iter()
        .map(|(addr, bytes)| (*addr, bytes.as_slice()))
        .collect();

    let boundaries = scan::call_targets(&text);
    let mut seen: BTreeSet<u64> = BTreeSet::new();
    let mut queue: VecDeque<u64> = VecDeque::new();
    queue.push_back(args.entry);

    let mut functions = 0usize;
    let mut blocks = 0usize;
    let mut instructions = 0usize;
    let mut unsupported: BTreeMap<u64, u32> = BTreeMap::new();
    let mut call_edges = 0usize;
    let mut external_calls = 0usize;
    let mut unresolved_edges = 0usize;
    let mut truncated = false;

    while let Some(start) = queue.pop_front() {
        if !seen.insert(start) {
            continue;
        }
        if functions >= args.max_functions {
            truncated = true;
            break;
        }
        let func = match ew_lift::cfg::build(&text, &segments, start, args.max_insns, &boundaries) {
            Some(f) => f,
            None => continue,
        };
        functions += 1;
        blocks += func.blocks.len();
        instructions += func.insn_count();
        unresolved_edges += func.unresolved_edges;

        if args.verbose {
            println!("function 0x{start:x}: {} blocks, {} calls", func.blocks.len(), if func.has_calls { "yes" } else { "no" });
            for block in &func.blocks {
                let kinds: Vec<String> = block
                    .edges
                    .iter()
                    .map(|e| match e.target {
                        Some(t) => format!("{:?}->0x{t:x}", e.kind),
                        None => format!("{:?}", e.kind),
                    })
                    .collect();
                println!("  block 0x{:x}: {} insns, edges [{}]", block.addr, block.insns.len(), kinds.join(", "));
            }
        }

        for block in &func.blocks {
            for insn in &block.insns {
                if matches!(insn.op, Op::Unsupported { .. } | Op::UnsupportedBitfield { .. }) {
                    unsupported.insert(insn.addr, insn.word);
                }
            }
            for edge in &block.edges {
                if edge.kind == scan::EdgeKind::Call {
                    if let Some(target) = edge.target {
                        if start_of_code(&text, target) {
                            call_edges += 1;
                            queue.push_back(target);
                        } else {
                            // The callee is outside this module: an import or a
                            // jump slot, which is where the host runtime has to
                            // take over.
                            external_calls += 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    println!("entry:             0x{:x}", args.entry);
    println!("reachable funcs:   {functions}{}", if truncated { " (capped)" } else { "" });
    println!("reachable blocks:  {blocks}");
    println!("instructions:      {instructions}");
    println!("internal calls:    {call_edges}");
    println!("external calls:    {external_calls}");
    println!("unresolved edges:  {unresolved_edges}");
    println!("blocked insns:     {}", unsupported.len());

    // The earliest blocked instruction is the first thing the runtime will hit
    // when it walks the entry path in address order, which is why it is named
    // explicitly rather than left to a histogram.
    if let Some((addr, word)) = unsupported.iter().next() {
        println!();
        println!("first blocker:     0x{addr:x}  word 0x{word:08x}");
    }

    let mut families: BTreeMap<u32, usize> = BTreeMap::new();
    for word in unsupported.values() {
        *families.entry((word >> 24) & 0x7F).or_insert(0) += 1;
    }
    let mut rows: Vec<(u32, usize)> = families.into_iter().collect();
    rows.sort_by_key(|(_, n)| std::cmp::Reverse(*n));
    if !rows.is_empty() {
        println!("blocked by group (bits 30:24):");
        for (family, count) in rows.into_iter().take(10) {
            println!("  family 0x{family:02x}  {count:>8} instructions");
        }
    }

    if text.is_empty() || !start_of_code(&text, args.entry) {
        bail!("entry 0x{:x} is not inside the text segment", args.entry);
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// True when an address lands on an aligned word inside the text segment.
fn start_of_code(text: &[u8], addr: u64) -> bool {
    addr % 4 == 0 && (addr as usize) < text.len()
}

fn value(it: &mut impl Iterator<Item = String>, flag: &str) -> Result<String> {
    it.next().with_context(|| format!("{flag} needs a value"))
}

`crates/ew-lift/src/bin/ew_tables.rs`:

```rs
//! `ew-tables` — measure jump-table recovery over a whole text segment.
//!
//! Every `br` in the image is an indirect branch. This tool asks the same
//! detector the control-flow recovery uses whether that `br` can be resolved to
//! concrete successors, and prints the instruction window of the ones that fail
//! so a pattern the detector is missing shows up as evidence rather than a guess.
//!
//! ```text
//! ew-tables --text text.bin [--segment ADDR:rodata.bin] [--show 8] [--show-resolved 4]
//! ```

use anyhow::{bail, Context, Result};
use ew_lift::jump_table;
use ew_lift::scan::word_at;
use ew_lift::{decode, Op};
use std::path::PathBuf;

fn main() {
    if let Err(e) = run() {
        eprintln!("ew-tables: {e:#}");
        std::process::exit(1);
    }
}

fn run() -> Result<()> {
    let mut text_path = PathBuf::new();
    let mut segments: Vec<(u64, PathBuf)> = Vec::new();
    let mut show_fail = 0usize;
    let mut show_ok = 0usize;
    let mut window_words = 96usize;
    let mut reason_filter = String::new();

    let mut it = std::env::args().skip(1);
    while let Some(a) = it.next() {
        match a.as_str() {
            "--text" => text_path = PathBuf::from(next(&mut it, "--text")?),
            "--segment" => {
                let v = next(&mut it, "--segment")?;
                let (addr, path) = v.split_once(':').context("--segment expects ADDR:PATH")?;
                let addr = u64::from_str_radix(addr.trim_start_matches("0x"), 16)
                    .context("--segment address must be hex")?;
                segments.push((addr, PathBuf::from(path)));
            }
            "--show" => show_fail = next(&mut it, "--show")?.parse()?,
            "--reason" => reason_filter = next(&mut it, "--reason")?,
            "--window" => window_words = next(&mut it, "--window")?.parse()?,
            "--show-resolved" => show_ok = next(&mut it, "--show-resolved")?.parse()?,
            "-h" | "--help" => {
                println!(
                    "ew-tables --text <text.bin> [--segment ADDR:rodata.bin] [--window N] [--show N] [--show-resolved N]"
                );
                return Ok(());
            }
            other => bail!("unknown argument `{other}`"),
        }
    }
    if text_path.as_os_str().is_empty() {
        bail!("--text is required");
    }

    let text =
        std::fs::read(&text_path).with_context(|| format!("reading {}", text_path.display()))?;
    let segment_bytes: Vec<(u64, Vec<u8>)> = segments
        .iter()
        .map(|(addr, path)| {
            std::fs::read(path)
                .map(|bytes| (*addr, bytes))
                .with_context(|| format!("reading {}", path.display()))
        })
        .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
    let segs: Vec<(u64, &[u8])> = segment_bytes.iter().map(|(a, b)| (*a, b.as_slice())).collect();

    let mut brs = 0usize;
    let mut resolved = 0usize;
    let mut targets_total = 0usize;
    let mut shown_fail = 0usize;
    let mut shown_ok = 0usize;
    let mut failures: std::collections::BTreeMap<&'static str, usize> =
        std::collections::BTreeMap::new();

    let mut addr = 0u64;
    while addr + 4 <= text.len() as u64 {
        let word = match word_at(&text, addr) {
            Some(w) => w,
            None => break,
        };
        if matches!(decode(word, addr), Op::Br { .. }) {
            brs += 1;
            let window = window_before(&text, addr, window_words);
            let known = jump_table::prologue_constants(&text, addr, 24);
            match jump_table::detect_with_reason(&text, &segs, &known, &window) {
                Ok(table) => {
                    resolved += 1;
                    targets_total += table.targets.len();
                    if shown_ok < show_ok {
                        println!(
                            "resolved br @0x{addr:x}: table 0x{:x} base 0x{:x}, {} entries, {} targets, {} byte entries, shift {}, signed {}",
                            table.table,
                            table.base,
                            table.entries,
                            table.targets.len(),
                            table.entry_bytes,
                            table.shift,
                            table.signed
                        );
                        shown_ok += 1;
                    }
                }
                Err(reason) => {
                    *failures.entry(reason.as_str()).or_insert(0) += 1;
                    if shown_fail < show_fail
                        && (reason_filter.is_empty() || reason.as_str().contains(reason_filter.as_str()))
                    {
                        println!("unresolved br @0x{addr:x}:");
                        let start = window.len().saturating_sub(10);
                        for insn in &window[start..] {
                            println!("  0x{:08x}  {:08x}  {:?}", insn.addr, insn.word, insn.op);
                        }
                        shown_fail += 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        addr += 4;
    }

    println!(
        "br instructions: {brs}  resolved: {resolved} ({:.1}%)  table targets: {targets_total}",
        if brs == 0 { 0.0 } else { resolved as f64 / brs as f64 * 100.0 }
    );
    let mut reasons: Vec<_> = failures.into_iter().collect();
    reasons.sort_by_key(|(_, n)| std::cmp::Reverse(*n));
    for (reason, count) in reasons {
        println!("  {count:6}  {reason}");
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// Decode `words` instructions before `addr`, then the instruction at `addr`.
fn window_before(text: &[u8], addr: u64, words: usize) -> Vec<ew_lift::Insn> {
    let start = addr.saturating_sub(words as u64 * 4);
    let mut insns = Vec::with_capacity(words + 1);
    let mut at = start;
    while at <= addr {
        if let Some(word) = word_at(text, at) {
            insns.push(ew_lift::Insn { addr: at, word, op: decode(word, at) });
        }
        at += 4;
    }
    insns
}

fn next(it: &mut impl Iterator<Item = String>, name: &str) -> Result<String> {
    it.next().with_context(|| format!("{name} needs a value"))
}

`crates/ew-lift/src/cfg.rs`:

```rs
//! Control-flow graph recovery.
//!
//! The traversal starts at one address and follows every statically known edge
//! until the function's own blocks are exhausted. Three rules keep it honest:
//!
//! * an unconditional branch is followed, so straight-line lifting no longer
//!   stops after the first `b` that a compiler emits for an if/else;
//! * a conditional branch contributes both successors, which is what turns
//!   chains of `cbz`/`b.ne` into one complete function instead of N fragments;
//! * a call edge is not followed into the callee, and a `br` whose table cannot
//!   be resolved stays an explicit unresolved edge rather than a guess.

use crate::aarch64::Op;
use crate::jump_table::{self, JumpTable};
use crate::scan::{word_at, Block, Edge, EdgeKind, Insn, LiftedFunction};
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet, VecDeque};

/// Hard ceiling on one function, so a bad edge cannot walk the module.
const MAX_BLOCKS: usize = 2048;
const MAX_BLOCK_INSNS: usize = 1024;

/// Every call site in a block, including calls that do not end it.
///
/// A `bl` in the middle of a block still calls another function; the block keeps
/// going after the call returns, but the callee exists, and reachability has to
/// know about it. Only recording a call when it happens to be the last
/// instruction is what makes a whole-program walk stop at the first function.
fn call_edges(insns: &[Insn]) -> Vec<Edge> {
    let mut edges = Vec::new();
    for insn in insns {
        match insn.op {
            Op::Bl { target } => edges.push(Edge::direct(EdgeKind::Call, target)),
            Op::Blr { .. } => edges.push(Edge::terminal(EdgeKind::IndirectCall)),
            _ => {}
        }
    }
    edges
}

fn edges_for(
    text: &[u8],
    segments: jump_table::Segments,
    known: &jump_table::Known,
    insns: &[Insn],
    terminated: bool,
) -> (Vec<Edge>, Option<JumpTable>) {
    let mut edges = Vec::new();
    let mut table = None;
    if !terminated {
        return (edges, table);
    }
    let last = match insns.last() {
        Some(i) => i,
        None => return (edges, table),
    };
    let next = last.addr + 4;
    let fallthrough = |edges: &mut Vec<Edge>| {
        if word_at(text, next).is_some() {
            edges.push(Edge::direct(EdgeKind::FallThrough, next));
        }
    };

    match last.op {
        Op::B { target } => edges.push(Edge::direct(EdgeKind::Direct, target)),
        Op::BCond { target, .. }
        | Op::CompareBranchZero { target, .. }
        | Op::TestBitBranch { target, .. } => {
            edges.push(Edge::direct(EdgeKind::Direct, target));
            fallthrough(&mut edges);
        }
        Op::Bl { target } => {
            edges.push(Edge::direct(EdgeKind::Call, target));
            fallthrough(&mut edges);
        }
        Op::Blr { .. } => {
            edges.push(Edge::terminal(EdgeKind::Call));
            fallthrough(&mut edges);
        }
        Op::Ret { .. } => edges.push(Edge::terminal(EdgeKind::Return)),
        Op::Br { .. } => {
            // The table base is usually built in the function prologue, so look
            // back beyond this block rather than only inside it.
            let window = jump_table::context_window(text, insns[0].addr, last.addr);
            match jump_table::detect(text, segments, known, &window) {
                Some(t) => {
                    for target in &t.targets {
                        edges.push(Edge::direct(EdgeKind::Direct, *target));
                    }
                    table = Some(t);
                }
                None => edges.push(Edge::terminal(EdgeKind::Indirect)),
            }
        }
        _ => {}
    }
    (edges, table)
}

/// Recover the function that starts at `start`.
///
/// `boundaries` holds known function entry points (call targets). A branch to
/// one of them is a tail call, so traversal stops there instead of absorbing
/// another function's blocks.
pub fn build(
    text: &[u8],
    segments: jump_table::Segments,
    start: u64,
    max_insns: usize,
    boundaries: &BTreeSet<u64>,
) -> Option<LiftedFunction> {
    if start % 4 != 0 || word_at(text, start).is_none() {
        return None;
    }

    // One linear pass over the prologue: table bases are often built once and
    // reused by every switch in the function.
    let known = jump_table::prologue_constants(text, start, 64);

    let mut blocks: BTreeMap<u64, Block> = BTreeMap::new();
    let mut queue: VecDeque<u64> = VecDeque::new();
    queue.push_back(start);
    let mut total = 0usize;
    let mut truncated = false;

    while let Some(addr) = queue.pop_front() {
        if blocks.contains_key(&addr) {
            continue;
        }
        if word_at(text, addr).is_none() {
            continue;
        }

        let mut insns = Vec::new();
        let mut cur = addr;
        let mut terminated = false;
        while insns.len() < MAX_BLOCK_INSNS {
            let word = match word_at(text, cur) {
                Some(w) => w,
                None => break,
            };
            let op = crate::aarch64::decode(word, cur);
            insns.push(Insn { addr: cur, word, op });
            if op.is_terminal() {
                terminated = true;
                break;
            }
            cur += 4;
        }
        if insns.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }

        total += insns.len();
        let over_budget = total > max_insns;

        let (mut edges, jump_table) = edges_for(text, segments, &known, &insns, terminated);
        // Terminator calls are already present above; add the ones inside the
        // block without duplicating them.
        for edge in call_edges(&insns) {
            if !edges.iter().any(|e| e.kind == edge.kind && e.target == edge.target) {
                edges.push(edge);
            }
        }
        for edge in &edges {
            let target = match (edge.kind, edge.target) {
                (EdgeKind::Direct, Some(t)) | (EdgeKind::FallThrough, Some(t)) => t,
                _ => continue,
            };
            if target == start {
                continue; // loop back to the entry: already discovered
            }
            if boundaries.contains(&target) {
                continue; // tail call into another function
            }
            if word_at(text, target).is_some() {
                queue.push_back(target);
            }
        }

        blocks.insert(
            addr,
            Block { addr, insns, edges, jump_table, terminated },
        );
        // The block that crossed the budget is kept: dropping it would look
        // like the function has no code at that address. The function is
        // flagged partial instead, which is the truth.
        if over_budget || blocks.len() >= MAX_BLOCKS {
            truncated = true;
            break;
        }
    }

    if blocks.is_empty() {
        return None;
    }

    let mut unsupported = 0usize;
    let mut has_memory = false;
    let mut has_calls = false;
    let mut indirect_calls = 0usize;
    let mut jump_tables = 0usize;
    let mut jump_table_targets = 0usize;
    let mut unresolved_edges = 0usize;
    let mut unterminated_blocks = 0usize;

    for block in blocks.values() {
        for insn in &block.insns {
            if matches!(insn.op, Op::Unsupported { .. } | Op::UnsupportedBitfield { .. }) {
                unsupported += 1;
            }
            if insn.op.touches_memory() {
                has_memory = true;
            }
            if insn.op.is_call() {
                has_calls = true;
            }
        }
        if !block.terminated {
            unterminated_blocks += 1;
        }
        if let Some(table) = &block.jump_table {
            jump_tables += 1;
            jump_table_targets += table.targets.len();
        }
        unresolved_edges += block
            .edges
            .iter()
            .filter(|e| e.kind == EdgeKind::Indirect)
            .count();
        indirect_calls += block
            .edges
            .iter()
            .filter(|e| e.kind == EdgeKind::IndirectCall)
            .count();
    }

    Some(LiftedFunction {
        addr: start,
        blocks: blocks.into_values().collect(),
        complete: !truncated && unterminated_blocks == 0 && unresolved_edges == 0,
        unsupported,
        has_memory,
        has_calls,
        jump_tables,
        jump_table_targets,
        unresolved_edges,
        indirect_calls,
        unterminated_blocks,
        budget_exhausted: truncated,
    })
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn put(text: &mut [u8], off: usize, word: u32) {
        text[off..off + 4].copy_from_slice(&word.to_le_bytes());
    }

    /// One switch, recovered as a single function: the conditional branch keeps
    /// both successors and the `br` at the end of the default arm contributes
    /// every table target, so the result is complete rather than four fragments.
    #[test]
    fn a_switch_becomes_one_complete_function() {
        let mut text = vec![0u8; 0x2c];
        put(&mut text, 0x00, 0x7100_051F); // cmp w8, #1
        put(&mut text, 0x04, 0x5400_00A8); // b.hi 0x18
        put(&mut text, 0x08, 0x1000_00C9); // adr x9, 0x20
        put(&mut text, 0x0c, 0x3868_692A); // ldrb w10, [x9, x8]
        put(&mut text, 0x10, 0x8B2A_C929); // add x9, x9, w10, sxtw #2
        put(&mut text, 0x14, 0xD61F_0120); // br x9
        put(&mut text, 0x18, 0xD65F_03C0); // default arm: ret
        put(&mut text, 0x1c, 0xD503_201F); // nop
        // Table at 0x20: two signed byte offsets, relative to the base and
        // scaled by four, so the targets land on the two returns below.
        text[0x20] = 1;
        text[0x21] = 2;
        put(&mut text, 0x24, 0xD65F_03C0); // ret
        put(&mut text, 0x28, 0xD65F_03C0); // ret

        let boundaries = BTreeSet::new();
        let f = build(&text, &[], 0, 4096, &boundaries).expect("function must lift");
        assert!(f.complete, "a fully recovered switch is complete");
        assert_eq!(f.jump_tables, 1);
        assert_eq!(f.jump_table_targets, 2);
        assert_eq!(f.unresolved_edges, 0);
        assert_eq!(f.unterminated_blocks, 0);
        // Entry block (cmp + b.hi), the switch block at the fallthrough 0x08,
        // the default arm, and the two table targets.
        let addrs: Vec<u64> = f.blocks.iter().map(|b| b.addr).collect();
        assert_eq!(addrs, vec![0x00, 0x08, 0x18, 0x24, 0x28]);
    }

    /// A conditional branch that skips an instruction contributes both arms, so
    /// the skipped block is recovered too.
    #[test]
    fn a_conditional_branch_keeps_both_successors() {
        let mut text = vec![0u8; 0x18];
        put(&mut text, 0x00, 0xB500_0040); // cbnz x0, 0x0c
        put(&mut text, 0x04, 0xAA03_03E0); // mov x0, x3
        put(&mut text, 0x08, 0xD65F_03C0); // ret
        put(&mut text, 0x0c, 0xD65F_03C0); // ret

        let boundaries = BTreeSet::new();
        let f = build(&text, &[], 0, 4096, &boundaries).expect("function must lift");
        assert_eq!(f.blocks.len(), 3);
        assert!(f.complete);
    }

    /// A budget too small to reach the terminator is reported as truncated, not
    /// as a complete function.
    #[test]
    fn a_tiny_budget_is_reported_as_partial() {
        let mut text = vec![0u8; 0x40];
        for i in (0..0x3c).step_by(4) {
            put(&mut text, i, 0x9100_4020); // add x0, x1, #0x10
        }
        put(&mut text, 0x3c, 0xD65F_03C0);

        let boundaries = BTreeSet::new();
        let f = build(&text, &[], 0, 8, &boundaries).expect("function must lift");
        assert!(!f.complete);
        assert!(f.budget_exhausted);
    }
}

`crates/ew-lift/src/ew_simd.h`:

```h

/* ---- Advanced SIMD ------------------------------------------------------
 *
 * Written from the Arm pseudocode independently of the Rust reference in
 * ew-lift/src/simd.rs, so a differential run compares two readings of the
 * architecture. Default FPCR: round to nearest even, no flush to zero; NaNs
 * propagate by the Arm priority rule and created NaNs are the Arm default NaN.
 * Operation numbers match the Rust enums' discriminants.
 * Hosts are little-endian (x86-64 and AArch64), which the lane access assumes.
 */

typedef struct { ew_u8 b[16]; } ew_vr;

static inline ew_vr ew_vr_get(Cpu *cpu, unsigned r)
{
    ew_vr v;
    memcpy(v.b, &cpu->v[r & 31u][0], 8);
    memcpy(v.b + 8, &cpu->v[r & 31u][1], 8);
    return v;
}

/* Keep `bytes` bytes, zero the rest. */
static inline void ew_vr_put(Cpu *cpu, unsigned r, ew_vr v, unsigned bytes)
{
    unsigned i;
    for (i = bytes; i < 16u; i++) v.b[i] = 0;
    memcpy(&cpu->v[r & 31u][0], v.b, 8);
    memcpy(&cpu->v[r & 31u][1], v.b + 8, 8);
}

static inline ew_u64 ew_lane(const ew_vr *v, unsigned i, unsigned es)
{
    ew_u64 x = 0;
    unsigned k;
    for (k = 0; k < es; k++) x |= (ew_u64)v->b[i * es + k] << (8u * k);
    return x;
}

static inline void ew_lane_set(ew_vr *v, unsigned i, unsigned es, ew_u64 x)
{
    unsigned k;
    for (k = 0; k < es; k++) v->b[i * es + k] = (ew_u8)(x >> (8u * k));
}

static inline ew_u64 ew_emask(unsigned es)
{
    return es >= 8u ? ~(ew_u64)0 : (((ew_u64)1 << (8u * es)) - 1u);
}

static inline ew_i64 ew_esx(ew_u64 v, unsigned es)
{
    unsigned s = 64u - 8u * es;
    return (ew_i64)(v << s) >> s;
}

static inline ew_u64 ew_gpr(Cpu *cpu, unsigned r)
{
    return r == 31u ? 0 : cpu->x[r];
}

/* -- floating point at both widths. The template is expanded for float and
 *    double; F is the type, U the bit type, S the suffix. */
#define EW_FP_TEMPLATE(F, U, S, QB, DN, SIGN)                                 \
static inline F ew_f##S(ew_u64 b) { U u = (U)b; F f; memcpy(&f, &u, sizeof f); return f; } \
static inline ew_u64 ew_b##S(F f) { U u; memcpy(&u, &f, sizeof u); return (ew_u64)u; } \
static inline int ew_isnan##S(F f) { return f != f; }                         \
static inline int ew_snan##S(F f) { return f != f && (ew_b##S(f) & (QB)) == 0; } \
static inline F ew_quiet##S(F f) { return ew_f##S(ew_b##S(f) | (QB)); }       \
static inline F ew_dnan##S(void) { return ew_f##S(DN); }                      \
static inline int ew_nan2##S(F a, F b, F *out)                                \
{                                                                             \
    if (ew_snan##S(a)) { *out = ew_quiet##S(a); return 1; }                   \
    if (ew_snan##S(b)) { *out = ew_quiet##S(b); return 1; }                   \
    if (ew_isnan##S(a)) { *out = a; return 1; }                               \
    if (ew_isnan##S(b)) { *out = b; return 1; }                               \
    return 0;                                                                 \
}                                                                             \
static inline int ew_nan3##S(F a, F b, F c, F *out)                           \
{                                                                             \
    if (ew_snan##S(a)) { *out = ew_quiet##S(a); return 1; }                   \
    if (ew_snan##S(b)) { *out = ew_quiet##S(b); return 1; }                   \
    if (ew_snan##S(c)) { *out = ew_quiet##S(c); return 1; }                   \
    if (ew_isnan##S(a)) { *out = a; return 1; }                               \
    if (ew_isnan##S(b)) { *out = b; return 1; }                               \
    if (ew_isnan##S(c)) { *out = c; return 1; }                               \
    return 0;                                                                 \
}                                                                             \
static inline F ew_fix##S(F r) { return ew_isnan##S(r) ? ew_dnan##S() : r; } \
static inline F ew_neg##S(F x) { return ew_f##S(ew_b##S(x) ^ (SIGN)); }       \
static inline F ew_abs##S(F x) { return ew_f##S(ew_b##S(x) & ~(ew_u64)(SIGN)); } \
static inline int ew_infzero##S(F a, F b)                                     \
{                                                                             \
    return (isinf(a) && b == 0) || (a == 0 && isinf(b));                      \
}                                                                             \
static inline F ew_max##S(F a, F b)                                           \
{                                                                             \
    F n;                                                                      \
    if (ew_nan2##S(a, b, &n)) return n;                                       \
    if (a == b) return (a == 0 && !(signbit(a) && signbit(b))) ? (F)0 : a;    \
    return a > b ? a : b;                                                     \
}                                                                             \
static inline F ew_min##S(F a, F b)                                           \
{                                                                             \
    F n;                                                                      \
    if (ew_nan2##S(a, b, &n)) return n;                                       \
    if (a == b) return (a == 0 && (signbit(a) || signbit(b))) ? -(F)0 : a;    \
    return a < b ? a : b;                                                     \
}                                                                             \
static inline int ew_qonly##S(F x) { return ew_isnan##S(x) && !ew_snan##S(x); } \
static inline F ew_maxnm##S(F a, F b)                                         \
{                                                                             \
    if (ew_qonly##S(a) && !ew_qonly##S(b)) a = -(F)INFINITY;                  \
    else if (ew_qonly##S(b) && !ew_qonly##S(a)) b = -(F)INFINITY;             \
    return ew_max##S(a, b);                                                   \
}                                                                             \
static inline F ew_minnm##S(F a, F b)                                         \
{                                                                             \
    if (ew_qonly##S(a) && !ew_qonly##S(b)) a = (F)INFINITY;                   \
    else if (ew_qonly##S(b) && !ew_qonly##S(a)) b = (F)INFINITY;              \
    return ew_min##S(a, b);                                                   \
}                                                                             \
static inline F ew_step##S(F a, F b, F k, F scale)                            \
{                                                                             \
    F n;                                                                      \
    a = ew_neg##S(a);                                                         \
    if (ew_nan2##S(a, b, &n)) return n;                                       \
    if (ew_infzero##S(a, b)) return k * scale;                                \
    if (isinf(a) || isinf(b))                                                 \
        return (signbit(a) != signbit(b)) ? -(F)INFINITY : (F)INFINITY;       \
    return ew_fix##S(fma##S##_(a, b, k) * scale);                             \
}                                                                             \
static inline ew_u64 ew_fp3##S(unsigned op, F x, F y, F z)                    \
{                                                                             \
    F n;                                                                      \
    ew_u64 t = (sizeof(F) == 4) ? 0xFFFFFFFFull : ~(ew_u64)0;                 \
    switch (op) {                                                             \
    case 64: case 83: return ew_b##S(ew_nan2##S(x, y, &n) ? n : ew_fix##S(x + y)); \
    case 65: return ew_b##S(ew_nan2##S(x, y, &n) ? n : ew_fix##S(x - y));     \
    case 66: return ew_b##S(ew_nan2##S(x, y, &n) ? n : ew_fix##S(x * y));     \
    case 67: return ew_b##S(ew_nan2##S(x, y, &n) ? n : ew_fix##S(x / y));     \
    case 68: case 84: return ew_b##S(ew_max##S(x, y));                        \
    case 69: case 85: return ew_b##S(ew_min##S(x, y));                        \
    case 70: case 86: return ew_b##S(ew_maxnm##S(x, y));                      \
    case 71: case 87: return ew_b##S(ew_minnm##S(x, y));                      \
    case 72: case 73: {                                                       \
        F a = (op == 73) ? ew_neg##S(x) : x;                                  \
        if (ew_qonly##S(z) && ew_infzero##S(a, y)) return ew_b##S(ew_dnan##S()); \
        if (ew_nan3##S(z, a, y, &n)) return ew_b##S(n);                       \
        return ew_b##S(ew_fix##S(fma##S##_(a, y, z)));                        \
    }                                                                         \
    case 74: {                                                                \
        F d = ew_nan2##S(x, y, &n) ? n : ew_fix##S(x - y);                    \
        return ew_b##S(ew_abs##S(d));                                         \
    }                                                                         \
    case 75:                                                                  \
        if (ew_nan2##S(x, y, &n)) return ew_b##S(n);                          \
        if (ew_infzero##S(x, y))                                              \
            return ew_b##S((signbit(x) != signbit(y)) ? (F)-2.0 : (F)2.0);    \
        return ew_b##S(ew_fix##S(x * y));                                     \
    case 76: return (x == y) ? t : 0;                                         \
    case 77: return (x >= y) ? t : 0;                                         \
    case 78: return (x > y) ? t : 0;                                          \
    case 79: return (ew_abs##S(x) >= ew_abs##S(y)) ? t : 0;                   \
    case 80: return (ew_abs##S(x) > ew_abs##S(y)) ? t : 0;                    \
    case 81: return ew_b##S(ew_step##S(x, y, (F)2.0, (F)1.0));                \
    case 82: return ew_b##S(ew_step##S(x, y, (F)3.0, (F)0.5));                \
    default: return 0;                                                        \
    }                                                                         \
}

#define fma32_(a, b, c) fmaf((a), (b), (c))
#define fma64_(a, b, c) fma((a), (b), (c))

EW_FP_TEMPLATE(float, ew_u32, 32, 0x00400000u, 0x7FC00000u, 0x80000000u)
EW_FP_TEMPLATE(double, ew_u64, 64, 0x0008000000000000ull, 0x7FF8000000000000ull, 0x8000000000000000ull)

static inline ew_u64 ew_fp3(unsigned op, unsigned es, ew_u64 a, ew_u64 b, ew_u64 d)
{
    if (es == 4u) return ew_fp332(op, ew_f32(a), ew_f32(b), ew_f32(d));
    return ew_fp364(op, ew_f64(a), ew_f64(b), ew_f64(d));
}

static inline ew_u64 ew_int3(unsigned op, unsigned es, ew_u64 a, ew_u64 b, ew_u64 d)
{
    ew_u64 m = ew_emask(es), t = m, r;
    unsigned bits = 8u * es;
    ew_i64 sa, sb;
    a &= m; b &= m; d &= m;
    sa = ew_esx(a, es); sb = ew_esx(b, es);
    switch (op) {
    case 0: case 27: r = a + b; break;
    case 1:  r = a - b; break;
    case 2:  r = a * b; break;
    case 3:  r = d + a * b; break;
    case 4:  r = d - a * b; break;
    case 5:  r = a & b; break;
    case 6:  r = a & ~b; break;
    case 7:  r = a | b; break;
    case 8:  r = a | ~b; break;
    case 9:  r = a ^ b; break;
    case 10: r = (d & a) | (~d & b); break;
    case 11: r = (d & ~b) | (a & b); break;
    case 12: r = (d & b) | (a & ~b); break;
    case 13: r = (a == b) ? t : 0; break;
    case 14: r = (sa > sb) ? t : 0; break;
    case 15: r = (sa >= sb) ? t : 0; break;
    case 16: r = (a > b) ? t : 0; break;
    case 17: r = (a >= b) ? t : 0; break;
    case 18: r = (a & b) ? t : 0; break;
    case 19: case 28: r = (sa >= sb) ? a : b; break;
    case 20: case 29: r = (sa <= sb) ? a : b; break;
    case 21: case 30: r = (a >= b) ? a : b; break;
    case 22: case 31: r = (a <= b) ? a : b; break;
    case 23: r = (sa > sb) ? (ew_u64)(sa - sb) : (ew_u64)(sb - sa); break;
    case 24: r = (a > b) ? a - b : b - a; break;
    case 25: case 26: {
        int sh = (int)(signed char)(ew_u8)b;
        if (sh >= 0) {
            r = ((unsigned)sh >= bits) ? 0 : a << sh;
        } else {
            unsigned n = (unsigned)(-sh);
            if (op == 25) r = (ew_u64)(sa >> (n > 63u ? 63u : n));
            else r = (n >= bits) ? 0 : a >> n;
        }
        break;
    }
    default: r = 0; break;
    }
    return r & m;
}

static inline ew_u64 ew_v3op(unsigned op, unsigned es, ew_u64 a, ew_u64 b, ew_u64 d)
{
    return op >= 64u ? ew_fp3(op, es, a, b, d) : ew_int3(op, es, a, b, d);
}

static inline double ew_rnd(double x, unsigned mode)
{
    switch (mode) {
    case 0: return nearbyint(x);
    case 1: return ceil(x);
    case 2: return floor(x);
    case 3: return trunc(x);
    default: return round(x);
    }
}

static inline ew_u64 ew_vfp_to_int(unsigned es, ew_u64 v, unsigned mode, int uns, unsigned fbits)
{
    double x = (es == 4u) ? (double)ew_f32(v) : ew_f64(v);
    double r;
    if (x != x) return 0;
    r = ew_rnd(ldexp(x, (int)fbits), mode);
    if (es == 4u) {
        if (uns) {
            if (r <= 0) return 0;
            if (r >= 4294967295.0) return 0xFFFFFFFFull;
            return (ew_u64)(ew_u32)r;
        }
        if (r >= 2147483647.0) return 0x7FFFFFFFull;
        if (r <= -2147483648.0) return 0x80000000ull;
        return (ew_u64)(ew_u32)(ew_i32)r;
    }
    if (uns) {
        if (r <= 0) return 0;
        if (r >= 18446744073709551616.0) return ~(ew_u64)0;
        return (ew_u64)r;
    }
    if (r >= 9223372036854775808.0) return 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFull;
    if (r <= -9223372036854775808.0) return 0x8000000000000000ull;
    return (ew_u64)(ew_i64)r;
}

static inline ew_u64 ew_vint_to_fp(unsigned es, ew_u64 v, int uns, unsigned fbits)
{
    if (es == 4u) {
        double x = uns ? (double)(ew_u32)v : (double)(ew_i32)(ew_u32)v;
        return ew_b32((float)ldexp(x, -(int)fbits));
    }
    if (fbits == 0u) return ew_b64(uns ? (double)v : (double)(ew_i64)v);
    return ew_b64(ldexp(uns ? (double)v : (double)(ew_i64)v, -(int)fbits));
}

static inline ew_u64 ew_fround(unsigned es, ew_u64 a, unsigned mode)
{
    if (es == 4u) {
        float f = ew_f32(a);
        if (f != f) return ew_b32(ew_quiet32(f));
        return ew_b32((float)ew_rnd((double)f, mode));
    } else {
        double f = ew_f64(a);
        if (f != f) return ew_b64(ew_quiet64(f));
        return ew_b64(ew_rnd(f, mode));
    }
}

/* Arm FPRecipEstimate / FPRSqrtEstimate (round to nearest, no flush to zero),
 * written from the architecture pseudocode independently of the Rust model. */
static inline void ew_est_fields(unsigned es, ew_u64 a, ew_u64 *sign, long long *exp, ew_u64 *frac)
{
    if (es == 4u) {
        a &= 0xFFFFFFFFull;
        *sign = a >> 31; *exp = (long long)((a >> 23) & 0xFF); *frac = (a & 0x7FFFFFull) << 29;
    } else {
        *sign = a >> 63; *exp = (long long)((a >> 52) & 0x7FF); *frac = a & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFull;
    }
}

static inline int ew_est_special(unsigned es, ew_u64 a, int rsqrt, ew_u64 *out)
{
    ew_u64 sign, frac; long long exp;
    ew_u64 maxe = es == 4u ? 0xFFu : 0x7FFu;
    ew_u64 inf = es == 4u ? 0x7F800000ull : 0x7FF0000000000000ull;
    ew_u64 qbit = es == 4u ? 0x400000ull : (1ull << 51);
    ew_u64 dnan = es == 4u ? 0x7FC00000ull : 0x7FF8000000000000ull;
    ew_u64 bits = es == 4u ? (a & 0xFFFFFFFFull) : a;
    ew_u64 sbit;
    ew_est_fields(es, a, &sign, &exp, &frac);
    sbit = sign << (es * 8u - 1u);
    if ((ew_u64)exp == maxe && frac) { *out = bits | qbit; return 1; }
    if (exp == 0 && !frac) { *out = sbit | inf; return 1; }
    if ((ew_u64)exp == maxe) { *out = rsqrt ? (sign ? dnan : 0) : sbit; return 1; }
    if (rsqrt && sign) { *out = dnan; return 1; }
    if (!rsqrt && exp == 0 && (frac >> 50) == 0) { *out = sbit | inf; return 1; }
    return 0;
}

static inline ew_u64 ew_frecpe(unsigned es, ew_u64 a)
{
    ew_u64 sign, frac, out, est, fraction, scaled, b; long long exp, rexp;
    if (ew_est_special(es, a, 0, &out)) return out;
    ew_est_fields(es, a, &sign, &exp, &frac);
    if (exp == 0) {
        if (!((frac >> 51) & 1)) { exp = -1; frac = (frac << 2) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFull; }
        else frac = (frac << 1) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFull;
    }
    scaled = 256u | ((frac >> 44) & 0xFF);
    rexp = es == 4u ? 253 - exp : 2045 - exp;
    scaled = scaled * 2 + 1;
    b = (1ull << 19) / scaled;
    est = (b + 1) / 2;
    fraction = (est & 0xFF) << 44;
    if (rexp == 0) fraction = (1ull << 51) | (fraction >> 1);
    else if (rexp == -1) { fraction = (1ull << 50) | (fraction >> 2); rexp = 0; }
    if (es == 4u) return (sign << 31) | (((ew_u64)rexp & 0xFF) << 23) | (fraction >> 29);
    return (sign << 63) | (((ew_u64)rexp & 0x7FF) << 52) | fraction;
}

static inline ew_u64 ew_frsqrte(unsigned es, ew_u64 a)
{
    ew_u64 sign, frac, out, scaled, b, est; long long exp, rexp;
    if (ew_est_special(es, a, 1, &out)) return out;
    ew_est_fields(es, a, &sign, &exp, &frac);
    if (exp == 0) {
        while (!((frac >> 51) & 1)) { frac = (frac << 1) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFull; exp--; }
        frac = (frac << 1) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFull;
    }
    if ((exp & 1) == 0) scaled = 256u | ((frac >> 44) & 0xFF);
    else scaled = 128u | ((frac >> 45) & 0x7F);
    if (scaled < 256) scaled = scaled * 2 + 1;
    else { scaled = (scaled >> 1) << 1; scaled = (scaled + 1) * 2; }
    b = 512;
    while (scaled * (b + 1) * (b + 1) < (1ull << 28)) b++;
    est = ((b + 1) / 2) & 0xFF;
    if (es == 4u) { rexp = (380 - exp) / 2; return (((ew_u64)rexp & 0xFF) << 23) | (est << 15); }
    rexp = (3068 - exp) / 2;
    return (((ew_u64)rexp & 0x7FF) << 52) | (est << 44);
}

static inline ew_u64 ew_v2op(unsigned op, unsigned es, ew_u64 a)
{
    ew_u64 m = ew_emask(es), t = m;
    unsigned bits = 8u * es;
    ew_i64 s = ew_esx(a & m, es);
    a &= m;
    switch (op) {
    case 3: { unsigned c = 0; ew_u8 x = (ew_u8)a; while (x) { c += x & 1u; x >>= 1; } return c; }
    case 4: return ~a & m;
    case 5: { ew_u8 x = (ew_u8)a, r = 0; int i; for (i = 0; i < 8; i++) if (x & (1u << i)) r |= (ew_u8)(0x80u >> i); return r; }
    case 6: { unsigned n = 0; while (n < bits && !(a & ((ew_u64)1 << (bits - 1u - n)))) n++; return n; }
    case 7: { ew_u64 v = (s < 0) ? (~a & m) : a; unsigned n = 0; while (n < bits && !(v & ((ew_u64)1 << (bits - 1u - n)))) n++; return n - 1u; }
    case 8: return (s < 0 ? (ew_u64)0 - (ew_u64)s : (ew_u64)s) & m;
    case 9: return ((ew_u64)0 - (ew_u64)s) & m;
    case 10: return s > 0 ? t : 0;
    case 11: return s >= 0 ? t : 0;
    case 12: return a == 0 ? t : 0;
    case 13: return s <= 0 ? t : 0;
    case 14: return s < 0 ? t : 0;
    case 93: return ew_frecpe(es, a);
    case 94: return ew_frsqrte(es, a);
    case 64: return es == 4u ? ew_b32(ew_abs32(ew_f32(a))) : ew_b64(ew_abs64(ew_f64(a)));
    case 65: return es == 4u ? ew_b32(ew_neg32(ew_f32(a))) : ew_b64(ew_neg64(ew_f64(a)));
    case 66:
        if (es == 4u) {
            float f = ew_f32(a);
            if (f != f) return ew_b32(ew_quiet32(f));
            if (f < 0) return 0x7FC00000ull;
            return ew_b32(sqrtf(f));
        } else {
            double f = ew_f64(a);
            if (f != f) return ew_b64(ew_quiet64(f));
            if (f < 0) return 0x7FF8000000000000ull;
            return ew_b64(sqrt(f));
        }
    case 67: case 72: case 73: return ew_fround(es, a, 0);
    case 68: return ew_fround(es, a, 1);
    case 69: return ew_fround(es, a, 2);
    case 70: return ew_fround(es, a, 3);
    case 71: return ew_fround(es, a, 4);
    case 74: return ew_vfp_to_int(es, a, 0, 0, 0);
    case 75: return ew_vfp_to_int(es, a, 1, 0, 0);
    case 76: return ew_vfp_to_int(es, a, 2, 0, 0);
    case 77: return ew_vfp_to_int(es, a, 3, 0, 0);
    case 78: return ew_vfp_to_int(es, a, 4, 0, 0);
    case 79: return ew_vfp_to_int(es, a, 0, 1, 0);
    case 80: return ew_vfp_to_int(es, a, 1, 1, 0);
    case 81: return ew_vfp_to_int(es, a, 2, 1, 0);
    case 82: return ew_vfp_to_int(es, a, 3, 1, 0);
    case 83: return ew_vfp_to_int(es, a, 4, 1, 0);
    case 84: return ew_vint_to_fp(es, a, 0, 0);
    case 85: return ew_vint_to_fp(es, a, 1, 0);
    case 86: case 87: case 88: case 89: case 90: {
        double x = (es == 4u) ? (double)ew_f32(a) : ew_f64(a);
        int r;
        if (op == 86) r = x > 0; else if (op == 87) r = x >= 0;
        else if (op == 88) r = x == 0; else if (op == 89) r = x <= 0; else r = x < 0;
        return r ? t : 0;
    }
    default: return 0;
    }
}

static inline ew_u64 ew_d2s_bits(ew_u64 a)
{
    double x = ew_f64(a);
    if (x != x) return ((a >> 63) << 31) | 0x7FC00000ull | ((a >> 29) & 0x003FFFFFull);
    return ew_b32((float)x);
}

static inline ew_u64 ew_s2d_bits(ew_u64 a)
{
    float x = ew_f32(a);
    if (x != x) return (((a >> 31) & 1u) << 63) | 0x7FF8000000000000ull | ((a & 0x003FFFFFull) << 29);
    return ew_b64((double)x);
}

/* -- per-form entry points, one per SimdOp variant -- */

static inline void ew_v_dup_elem(Cpu *cpu, unsigned rd, unsigned rn, unsigned es, unsigned idx, int q)
{
    ew_vr n = ew_vr_get(cpu, rn), r;
    unsigned w = q ? 16u : 8u, i;
    ew_u64 e = ew_lane(&n, idx, es);
    memset(&r, 0, sizeof r);
    for (i = 0; i < w / es; i++) ew_lane_set(&r, i, es, e);
    ew_vr_put(cpu, rd, r, w);
}

static inline void ew_v_dup_gen(Cpu *cpu, unsigned rd, unsigned rn, unsigned es, int q)
{
    ew_vr r;
    unsigned w = q ? 16u : 8u, i;
    ew_u64 e = ew_gpr(cpu, rn) & ew_emask(es);
    memset(&r, 0, sizeof r);
    for (i = 0; i < w / es; i++) ew_lane_set(&r, i, es, e);
    ew_vr_put(cpu, rd, r, w);
}

static inline void ew_v_ins_gen(Cpu *cpu, unsigned rd, unsigned rn, unsigned es, unsigned idx)
{
    ew_vr r = ew_vr_get(cpu, rd);
    ew_lane_set(&r, idx, es, ew_gpr(cpu, rn) & ew_emask(es));
    ew_vr_put(cpu, rd, r, 16);
}

static inline void ew_v_ins_elem(Cpu *cpu, unsigned rd, unsigned rn, unsigned es, unsigned dst, unsigned src)
{
    ew_vr n = ew_vr_get(cpu, rn), r = ew_vr_get(cpu, rd);
    ew_lane_set(&r, dst, es, ew_lane(&n, src, es));
    ew_vr_put(cpu, rd, r, 16);
}

static inline void ew_v_to_gp(Cpu *cpu, unsigned rd, unsigned rn, unsigned es, unsigned idx, int sgn, int is64)
{
    ew_vr n = ew_vr_get(cpu, rn);
    ew_u64 e = ew_lane(&n, idx, es);
    if (sgn) e = (ew_u64)ew_esx(e, es);
    if (!is64) e &= 0xFFFFFFFFull;
    if (rd != 31u) cpu->x[rd] = e;
}

static inline void ew_v_dup_scalar(Cpu *cpu, unsigned rd, unsigned rn, unsigned es, unsigned idx)
{
    ew_vr n = ew_vr_get(cpu, rn), r;
    memset(&r, 0, sizeof r);
    ew_lane_set(&r, 0, es, ew_lane(&n, idx, es));
    ew_vr_put(cpu, rd, r, es);
}

static inline void ew_v_ext(Cpu *cpu, unsigned rd, unsigned rn, unsigned rm, unsigned pos, int q)
{
    ew_vr n = ew_vr_get(cpu, rn), m = ew_vr_get(cpu, rm), r;
    ew_u8 cat[32];
    unsigned w = q ? 16u : 8u;
    memcpy(cat, n.b, w);
    memcpy(cat + w, m.b, w);
    memset(&r, 0, sizeof r);
    memcpy(r.b, cat + pos, w);
    ew_vr_put(cpu, rd, r, w);
}

static inline void ew_v_imm(Cpu *cpu, unsigned rd, ew_u64 imm, unsigned kind, int q)
{
    ew_vr r = ew_vr_get(cpu, rd);
    unsigned w = q ? 16u : 8u, i;
    for (i = 0; i < w / 8u; i++) {
        ew_u64 d = ew_lane(&r, i, 8);
        ew_lane_set(&r, i, 8, kind == 0 ? imm : kind == 1 ? (d | imm) : (d & ~imm));
    }
    ew_vr_put(cpu, rd, r, w);
}

static inline int ew_v3_pairwise(unsigned op)
{
    return (op >= 27u && op <= 31u) || (op >= 83u && op <= 87u);
}

static inline void ew_v_three(Cpu *cpu, unsigned rd, unsigned rn, unsigned rm, unsigned op, unsigned es, int q, int scalar)
{
    ew_vr n = ew_vr_get(cpu, rn), m = ew_vr_get(cpu, rm), d = ew_vr_get(cpu, rd), r;
    unsigned w = scalar ? es : (q ? 16u : 8u), lanes = w / es, i;
    memset(&r, 0, sizeof r);
    if (ew_v3_pairwise(op)) {
        unsigned h = lanes / 2u;
        for (i = 0; i < h; i++) {
            ew_lane_set(&r, i, es, ew_v3op(op, es, ew_lane(&n, 2u * i, es), ew_lane(&n, 2u * i + 1u, es), 0));
            ew_lane_set(&r, h + i, es, ew_v3op(op, es, ew_lane(&m, 2u * i, es), ew_lane(&m, 2u * i + 1u, es), 0));
        }
    } else {
        for (i = 0; i < lanes; i++)
            ew_lane_set(&r, i, es, ew_v3op(op, es, ew_lane(&n, i, es), ew_lane(&m, i, es), ew_lane(&d, i, es)));
    }
    ew_vr_put(cpu, rd, r, w);
}

static inline void ew_v_pair(Cpu *cpu, unsigned rd, unsigned rn, unsigned op, unsigned es)
{
    ew_vr n = ew_vr_get(cpu, rn), r;
    memset(&r, 0, sizeof r);
    ew_lane_set(&r, 0, es, ew_v3op(op, es, ew_lane(&n, 0, es), ew_lane(&n, 1, es), 0));
    ew_vr_put(cpu, rd, r, es);
}

static inline void ew_v_two(Cpu *cpu, unsigned rd, unsigned rn, unsigned op, unsigned es, int q, int scalar)
{
    ew_vr n = ew_vr_get(cpu, rn), r;
    unsigned i;
    memset(&r, 0, sizeof r);
    if (op <= 2u) { /* rev16, rev32, rev64 */
        unsigned c = op == 0u ? 2u : op == 1u ? 4u : 8u, per = c / es, w = q ? 16u : 8u;
        for (i = 0; i < w / es; i++)
            ew_lane_set(&r, i, es, ew_lane(&n, (i / per) * per + (per - 1u - i % per), es));
        ew_vr_put(cpu, rd, r, w);
    } else if (op == 15u || op == 91u) { /* xtn, fcvtn: es is the narrow lane */
        unsigned lanes = 8u / es, base = q ? lanes : 0u;
        if (q) r = ew_vr_get(cpu, rd);
        for (i = 0; i < lanes; i++) {
            ew_u64 wide = ew_lane(&n, i, es * 2u);
            ew_lane_set(&r, base + i, es, op == 91u ? ew_d2s_bits(wide) : (wide & ew_emask(es)));
        }
        ew_vr_put(cpu, rd, r, q ? 16u : 8u);
    } else if (op == 92u) { /* fcvtl */
        unsigned base = q ? 2u : 0u;
        for (i = 0; i < 2u; i++) ew_lane_set(&r, i, 8, ew_s2d_bits(ew_lane(&n, base + i, 4)));
        ew_vr_put(cpu, rd, r, 16);
    } else if (op == 16u || op == 17u) { /* saddlp, uaddlp */
        unsigned h = es / 2u, w = q ? 16u : 8u;
        for (i = 0; i < w / es; i++) {
            ew_u64 x = ew_lane(&n, 2u * i, h), y = ew_lane(&n, 2u * i + 1u, h), v;
            v = (op == 16u) ? (ew_u64)(ew_esx(x, h) + ew_esx(y, h)) : x + y;
            ew_lane_set(&r, i, es, v & ew_emask(es));
        }
        ew_vr_put(cpu, rd, r, w);
    } else {
        unsigned w = scalar ? es : (q ? 16u : 8u);
        for (i = 0; i < w / es; i++) ew_lane_set(&r, i, es, ew_v2op(op, es, ew_lane(&n, i, es)));
        ew_vr_put(cpu, rd, r, w);
    }
}

static inline void ew_v_shift(Cpu *cpu, unsigned rd, unsigned rn, unsigned op, unsigned es, unsigned sh, int q, int scalar)
{
    ew_vr n = ew_vr_get(cpu, rn), d = ew_vr_get(cpu, rd), r;
    ew_u64 m = ew_emask(es);
    unsigned i;
    memset(&r, 0, sizeof r);
    if (op == 7u) { /* shrn */
        unsigned lanes = 8u / es, base = q ? lanes : 0u;
        if (q) r = d;
        for (i = 0; i < lanes; i++) ew_lane_set(&r, base + i, es, (ew_lane(&n, i, es * 2u) >> sh) & m);
        ew_vr_put(cpu, rd, r, q ? 16u : 8u);
    } else if (op == 8u || op == 9u) { /* sshll, ushll */
        unsigned h = es / 2u, lanes = 16u / es, base = q ? lanes : 0u;
        for (i = 0; i < lanes; i++) {
            ew_u64 x = ew_lane(&n, base + i, h);
            if (op == 8u) x = (ew_u64)ew_esx(x, h);
            ew_lane_set(&r, i, es, (x << sh) & m);
        }
        ew_vr_put(cpu, rd, r, 16);
    } else {
        unsigned w = scalar ? es : (q ? 16u : 8u), bits = 8u * es;
        for (i = 0; i < w / es; i++) {
            ew_u64 a = ew_lane(&n, i, es), old = ew_lane(&d, i, es), v;
            ew_u64 sshr = (ew_u64)(ew_esx(a, es) >> (sh > 63u ? 63u : sh)) & m;
            ew_u64 ushr = sh >= bits ? 0 : a >> sh;
            switch (op) {
            case 0: v = sshr; break;
            case 1: v = ushr; break;
            case 2: v = (old + sshr) & m; break;
            case 3: v = (old + ushr) & m; break;
            case 4: v = (a << sh) & m; break;
            case 5: v = sh >= bits ? old : ((old & ~(m >> sh)) | ushr); break;
            case 6: { ew_u64 k = (m << sh) & m; v = (old & ~k) | ((a << sh) & k); break; }
            case 10: v = ew_vint_to_fp(es, a, 0, sh); break;
            case 11: v = ew_vint_to_fp(es, a, 1, sh); break;
            case 12: v = ew_vfp_to_int(es, a, 3, 0, sh); break;
            case 13: v = ew_vfp_to_int(es, a, 3, 1, sh); break;
            default: v = 0; break;
            }
            ew_lane_set(&r, i, es, v);
        }
        ew_vr_put(cpu, rd, r, w);
    }
}

static inline void ew_v_long(Cpu *cpu, unsigned rd, unsigned rn, unsigned rm, unsigned op, int sgn, unsigned es, int q)
{
    ew_vr n = ew_vr_get(cpu, rn), m = ew_vr_get(cpu, rm), d = ew_vr_get(cpu, rd), r;
    unsigned h = es / 2u, lanes = 16u / es, base = q ? lanes : 0u, i;
    memset(&r, 0, sizeof r);
    for (i = 0; i < lanes; i++) {
        ew_u64 a, b, v, old = ew_lane(&d, i, es);
        if (op == 1u || op == 3u) a = ew_lane(&n, i, es);
        else { a = ew_lane(&n, base + i, h); if (sgn) a = (ew_u64)ew_esx(a, h); }
        b = ew_lane(&m, base + i, h);
        if (sgn) b = (ew_u64)ew_esx(b, h);
        switch (op) {
        case 0: case 1: v = a + b; break;
        case 2: case 3: v = a - b; break;
        case 4:
            if (sgn) v = ((ew_i64)a > (ew_i64)b) ? a - b : b - a;
            else v = a > b ? a - b : b - a;
            break;
        case 5: v = old + a * b; break;
        case 6: v = old - a * b; break;
        default: v = a * b; break;
        }
        ew_lane_set(&r, i, es, v & ew_emask(es));
    }
    ew_vr_put(cpu, rd, r, 16);
}

static inline void ew_v_perm(Cpu *cpu, unsigned rd, unsigned rn, unsigned rm, unsigned op, unsigned es, int q)
{
    ew_vr n = ew_vr_get(cpu, rn), m = ew_vr_get(cpu, rm), r;
    unsigned w = q ? 16u : 8u, lanes = w / es, h = lanes / 2u, i;
    memset(&r, 0, sizeof r);
    for (i = 0; i < lanes; i++) {
        ew_u64 v;
        unsigned k;
        switch (op) {
        case 0: k = 2u * i; v = k < lanes ? ew_lane(&n, k, es) : ew_lane(&m, k - lanes, es); break;
        case 1: k = 2u * i + 1u; v = k < lanes ? ew_lane(&n, k, es) : ew_lane(&m, k - lanes, es); break;
        case 2: v = (i % 2u == 0u) ? ew_lane(&n, i, es) : ew_lane(&m, i - 1u, es); break;
        case 3: v = (i % 2u == 0u) ? ew_lane(&n, i + 1u, es) : ew_lane(&m, i, es); break;
        case 4: v = (i % 2u == 0u) ? ew_lane(&n, i / 2u, es) : ew_lane(&m, i / 2u, es); break;
        default: v = (i % 2u == 0u) ? ew_lane(&n, h + i / 2u, es) : ew_lane(&m, h + i / 2u, es); break;
        }
        ew_lane_set(&r, i, es, v);
    }
    ew_vr_put(cpu, rd, r, w);
}

static inline void ew_v_elem(Cpu *cpu, unsigned rd, unsigned rn, unsigned rm, unsigned idx, unsigned op, unsigned es, int q, int scalar)
{
    ew_vr n = ew_vr_get(cpu, rn), mr = ew_vr_get(cpu, rm), d = ew_vr_get(cpu, rd), r;
    ew_u64 e = ew_lane(&mr, idx, es), m = ew_emask(es);
    unsigned i;
    memset(&r, 0, sizeof r);
    if (op >= 3u && op <= 6u) { /* smull, umull, smlal, umlal */
        unsigned wd = es * 2u, lanes = 8u / es, base = q ? lanes : 0u;
        int sgn = (op == 3u || op == 5u);
        ew_u64 ee = sgn ? (ew_u64)ew_esx(e, es) : e;
        for (i = 0; i < lanes; i++) {
            ew_u64 a = ew_lane(&n, base + i, es), p;
            if (sgn) a = (ew_u64)ew_esx(a, es);
            p = a * ee;
            if (op >= 5u) p += ew_lane(&d, i, wd);
            ew_lane_set(&r, i, wd, p & ew_emask(wd));
        }
        ew_vr_put(cpu, rd, r, 16);
        return;
    }
    {
        unsigned w = scalar ? es : (q ? 16u : 8u);
        for (i = 0; i < w / es; i++) {
            ew_u64 a = ew_lane(&n, i, es), old = ew_lane(&d, i, es), v;
            switch (op) {
            case 0: v = (a * e) & m; break;
            case 1: v = (old + a * e) & m; break;
            case 2: v = (old - a * e) & m; break;
            case 64: v = ew_fp3(66, es, a, e, old); break;
            case 65: v = ew_fp3(72, es, a, e, old); break;
            case 66: v = ew_fp3(73, es, a, e, old); break;
            default: v = ew_fp3(75, es, a, e, old); break;
            }
            ew_lane_set(&r, i, es, v);
        }
        ew_vr_put(cpu, rd, r, w);
    }
}

static inline ew_u64 ew_reduce(const ew_u64 *v, unsigned count, unsigned op, unsigned es)
{
    unsigned h;
    if (count == 1u) return v[0];
    h = count / 2u;
    return ew_fp3(op, es, ew_reduce(v, h, op, es), ew_reduce(v + h, count - h, op, es), 0);
}

static inline void ew_v_across(Cpu *cpu, unsigned rd, unsigned rn, unsigned op, unsigned es, int q)
{
    ew_vr n = ew_vr_get(cpu, rn), r;
    unsigned w = q ? 16u : 8u, lanes = w / es, i, out = es;
    ew_u64 vals[16], acc;
    memset(&r, 0, sizeof r);
    for (i = 0; i < lanes; i++) vals[i] = ew_lane(&n, i, es);
    acc = vals[0];
    switch (op) {
    case 0: for (i = 1; i < lanes; i++) acc += vals[i]; acc &= ew_emask(es); break;
    case 1: for (i = 1; i < lanes; i++) if (ew_esx(vals[i], es) > ew_esx(acc, es)) acc = vals[i]; break;
    case 2: for (i = 1; i < lanes; i++) if (ew_esx(vals[i], es) < ew_esx(acc, es)) acc = vals[i]; break;
    case 3: for (i = 1; i < lanes; i++) if (vals[i] > acc) acc = vals[i]; break;
    case 4: for (i = 1; i < lanes; i++) if (vals[i] < acc) acc = vals[i]; break;
    case 5: { ew_i64 s = 0; for (i = 0; i < lanes; i++) s += ew_esx(vals[i], es); out = es * 2u; acc = (ew_u64)s & ew_emask(out); break; }
    case 6: { ew_u64 s = 0; for (i = 0; i < lanes; i++) s += vals[i]; out = es * 2u; acc = s & ew_emask(out); break; }
    case 64: acc = ew_reduce(vals, lanes, 68, es); break;
    case 65: acc = ew_reduce(vals, lanes, 69, es); break;
    case 66: acc = ew_reduce(vals, lanes, 70, es); break;
    default: acc = ew_reduce(vals, lanes, 71, es); break;
    }
    ew_lane_set(&r, 0, out, acc);
    ew_vr_put(cpu, rd, r, out);
}

static inline void ew_v_tbl(Cpu *cpu, unsigned rd, unsigned rn, unsigned rm, unsigned len, int tbx, int q)
{
    ew_u8 table[64];
    ew_vr m = ew_vr_get(cpu, rm), d = ew_vr_get(cpu, rd), r;
    unsigned w = q ? 16u : 8u, k, i;
    for (k = 0; k < len; k++) { ew_vr t = ew_vr_get(cpu, (rn + k) & 31u); memcpy(table + 16u * k, t.b, 16); }
    memset(&r, 0, sizeof r);
    for (i = 0; i < w; i++) {
        unsigned idx = m.b[i];
        r.b[i] = idx < 16u * len ? table[idx] : (tbx ? d.b[i] : 0);
    }
    ew_vr_put(cpu, rd, r, w);
}

/* shape: 0 multiple structures, 1 single lane, 2 replicate.
 * post: 0 none, 1 immediate, 2 register. */
static inline void ew_v_mem(Cpu *cpu, unsigned rt, unsigned rn, unsigned regs, unsigned selem,
                            unsigned es, int q, int load, unsigned shape, unsigned idx,
                            unsigned post, ew_u64 postv)
{
    ew_u64 base = rn == 31u ? cpu->sp : cpu->x[rn], addr = base;
    unsigned w = q ? 16u : 8u, s, e, k;
    if (shape == 0u) {
        ew_vr rr[4];
        unsigned rpt = regs / selem, r;
        for (k = 0; k < regs; k++) rr[k] = ew_vr_get(cpu, (rt + k) & 31u);
        for (r = 0; r < rpt; r++)
            for (e = 0; e < w / es; e++)
                for (s = 0; s < selem; s++) {
                    if (load) ew_lane_set(&rr[r + s], e, es, ew_load(cpu, addr, es));
                    else ew_store(cpu, addr, ew_lane(&rr[r + s], e, es), es);
                    addr += es;
                }
        if (load) for (k = 0; k < regs; k++) ew_vr_put(cpu, (rt + k) & 31u, rr[k], w);
    } else if (shape == 1u) {
        for (s = 0; s < selem; s++) {
            unsigned reg = (rt + s) & 31u;
            ew_vr v = ew_vr_get(cpu, reg);
            if (load) { ew_lane_set(&v, idx, es, ew_load(cpu, addr, es)); ew_vr_put(cpu, reg, v, 16); }
            else ew_store(cpu, addr, ew_lane(&v, idx, es), es);
            addr += es;
        }
    } else {
        for (s = 0; s < selem; s++) {
            ew_vr v;
            ew_u64 x = ew_load(cpu, addr, es);
            memset(&v, 0, sizeof v);
            for (e = 0; e < w / es; e++) ew_lane_set(&v, e, es, x);
            ew_vr_put(cpu, (rt + s) & 31u, v, w);
            addr += es;
        }
    }
    if (post) {
        ew_u64 nv = base + (post == 1u ? postv : ew_gpr(cpu, (unsigned)postv));
        if (rn == 31u) cpu->sp = nv; else cpu->x[rn] = nv;
    }
}
