```rs
                if load { "ldp" } else { "stp" },
                bytes
            ));
            for (n, reg) in [(0u64, rt), (1u64, rt2)] {
                let at = if n == 0 {
                    "ea_".to_string()
                } else {
                    format!("ea_ + {}", n * bytes as u64)
                };
                out.push_str(&vector_transfer_line(reg, &at, bytes, load));
            }
            if mode != MemMode::Offset {
                out.push_str(&format!(
                    "      EW_W(cpu, {rn}, 1, {base} + {}); }}\n",
                    offset as i64
                ));
            } else {
                out.push_str("    }\n");
            }
        }
        Op::VectorZero { rd, full } => {
            out.push_str(&format!(
                "    /* 0x{a:x}: movi {}, #0 */\n    ew_vset128(cpu, {rd}, 0, 0);\n",
                if full { "v.2d" } else { "d" }
            ));
        }
        Op::FpMoveGp { fp, gp, to_fp, is64 } => {
            let bytes = if is64 { 8 } else { 4 };
            if to_fp {
                out.push_str(&format!(
                    "    /* 0x{a:x}: fmov {}, {} */\n    ew_vset(cpu, {fp}, {bytes}, {});\n",
                    if is64 { "d" } else { "s" },
                    if is64 { format!("x{gp}") } else { format!("w{gp}") },
                    reg_read(gp, false)
                ));
            } else {
                let raw = format!("ew_vget(cpu, {fp}, {bytes})");
                let value = if is64 { raw } else { format!("EW_M32({raw})") };
                out.push_str(&format!(
                    "    /* 0x{a:x}: fmov {gp_name}, {fp_name} */\n    {{ ew_u64 r_ = {value}; {dest} }}\n",
                    gp_name = if is64 { format!("x{gp}") } else { format!("w{gp}") },
                    fp_name = if is64 { "d" } else { "s" },
                    dest = reg_write(gp, false, "r_"),
                ));
            }
        }
        Op::FpCopy { rd, rn, is64 } => {
            let bytes = if is64 { 8 } else { 4 };
            out.push_str(&format!(
                "    /* 0x{a:x}: fmov {}, {} */\n    ew_vset(cpu, {rd}, {bytes}, ew_vget(cpu, {rn}, {bytes}));\n",
                if is64 { "d" } else { "s" },
                if is64 { format!("d{rn}") } else { format!("s{rn}") }
            ));
        }
        Op::FpBinary { rd, rn, rm, op, is64 } => {
            let width = if is64 { "d" } else { "s" };
            let (get, set) = if is64 { ("ew_dget", "ew_dset") } else { ("ew_sget", "ew_sset") };
            let lhs = format!("{get}(cpu, {rn})");
            let rhs = format!("{get}(cpu, {rm})");
            let expr = match op {
                FpBinop::Mul => format!("({lhs} * {rhs})"),
                FpBinop::Div => format!("({lhs} / {rhs})"),
                FpBinop::Add => format!("({lhs} + {rhs})"),
                FpBinop::Sub => format!("({lhs} - {rhs})"),
                FpBinop::NegMul => format!("-({lhs} * {rhs})"),
                FpBinop::Max | FpBinop::MaxNm => {
                    format!("ew_fmax{}({lhs}, {rhs})", if is64 { 64 } else { 32 })
                }
                FpBinop::Min | FpBinop::MinNm => {
                    format!("ew_fmin{}({lhs}, {rhs})", if is64 { 64 } else { 32 })
                }
            };
            out.push_str(&format!(
                "    /* 0x{a:x}: {} {width}{rd}, {width}{rn}, {width}{rm} */\n    {set}(cpu, {rd}, {expr});\n",
                fp_binop_name(op)
            ));
        }
        Op::FpUnary { rd, rn, op, is64 } => {
            let width = if is64 { "d" } else { "s" };
            if op == FpUnop::Cvt {
                // The destination width is the opposite of the source width.
                if is64 {
                    out.push_str(&format!(
                        "    /* 0x{a:x}: fcvt s{rd}, d{rn} */\n    ew_sset(cpu, {rd}, (float)ew_dget(cpu, {rn}));\n"
                    ));
                } else {
                    out.push_str(&format!(
                        "    /* 0x{a:x}: fcvt d{rd}, s{rn} */\n    ew_dset(cpu, {rd}, (double)ew_sget(cpu, {rn}));\n"
                    ));
                }
                return;
            }
            let (get, set) = if is64 { ("ew_dget", "ew_dset") } else { ("ew_sget", "ew_sset") };
            // C spells the library functions with an `f` suffix for float.
            let lib = if is64 { "" } else { "f" };
            let x = format!("{get}(cpu, {rn})");
            let expr = match op {
                FpUnop::Neg => format!("-{x}"),
                FpUnop::Abs => format!("fabs{lib}({x})"),
                FpUnop::Sqrt => format!("sqrt{lib}({x})"),
                FpUnop::RoundN | FpUnop::RoundX | FpUnop::RoundI => format!("rint{lib}({x})"),
                FpUnop::RoundA => format!("round{lib}({x})"),
                FpUnop::RoundP => format!("ceil{lib}({x})"),
                FpUnop::RoundM => format!("floor{lib}({x})"),
                FpUnop::RoundZ => format!("trunc{lib}({x})"),
                FpUnop::Cvt => x,
            };
            out.push_str(&format!(
                "    /* 0x{a:x}: {} {width}{rd}, {width}{rn} */\n    {set}(cpu, {rd}, {expr});\n",
                fp_unop_name(op)
            ));
        }
        Op::FpCompare { rn, rm, is64, signal } => {
            let width = if is64 { "d" } else { "s" };
            let ty = if is64 { "double" } else { "float" };
            let get = if is64 { "ew_dget" } else { "ew_sget" };
            out.push_str(&format!(
                "    /* 0x{a:x}: {} {width}{rn}, {width}{rm} */\n    {{ {ty} a_ = {get}(cpu, {rn}), b_ = {get}(cpu, {rm});\n      ew_fp_flags(cpu, a_ != a_ || b_ != b_, a_ == b_, a_ < b_, a_ > b_); }}\n",
                if signal { "fcmpe" } else { "fcmp" }
            ));
        }
        Op::FpCompareZero { rn, is64, signal } => {
            let width = if is64 { "d" } else { "s" };
            let ty = if is64 { "double" } else { "float" };
            let get = if is64 { "ew_dget" } else { "ew_sget" };
            out.push_str(&format!(
                "    /* 0x{a:x}: {} {width}{rn}, #0.0 */\n    {{ {ty} a_ = {get}(cpu, {rn});\n      ew_fp_flags(cpu, a_ != a_, a_ == 0.0, a_ < 0.0, a_ > 0.0); }}\n",
                if signal { "fcmpe" } else { "fcmp" }
            ));
        }
        Op::FpCondCompare { rn, rm, cond, nzcv, is64 } => {
            let width = if is64 { "d" } else { "s" };
            let ty = if is64 { "double" } else { "float" };
            let get = if is64 { "ew_dget" } else { "ew_sget" };
            out.push_str(&format!(
                "    /* 0x{a:x}: fccmp {width}{rn}, {width}{rm}, #{nzcv}, cond{cond:?} */\n    if (ew_cond(cpu, {})) {{\n      {ty} a_ = {get}(cpu, {rn}), b_ = {get}(cpu, {rm});\n      ew_fp_flags(cpu, a_ != a_ || b_ != b_, a_ == b_, a_ < b_, a_ > b_);\n    }} else {{\n      cpu->nzcv = {nzcv}u;\n    }}\n",
                cond as u32
            ));
        }
        Op::FpCondSelect { rd, rn, rm, cond, is64 } => {
            let width = if is64 { "d" } else { "s" };
            let (get, set) = if is64 { ("ew_dget", "ew_dset") } else { ("ew_sget", "ew_sset") };
            out.push_str(&format!(
                "    /* 0x{a:x}: fcsel {width}{rd}, {width}{rn}, {width}{rm}, cond{cond:?} */\n    {set}(cpu, {rd}, ew_cond(cpu, {}) ? {get}(cpu, {rn}) : {get}(cpu, {rm}));\n",
                cond as u32
            ));
        }
        Op::FpToInt { rd, rn, round, unsigned, src_is64, dest_is64 } => {
            let get = if src_is64 { "ew_dget" } else { "ew_sget" };
            out.push_str(&format!(
                "    /* 0x{a:x}: {} x{rd}, {}{rn} */\n    {} }}\n",
                fp_round_name(round, unsigned, dest_is64),
                if src_is64 { "d" } else { "s" },
                format!(
                    "{{ ew_u64 r_ = ew_fp_to_int((double){get}(cpu, {rn}), {}, {}, {});\n      {}",
                    round.c_code(),
                    if dest_is64 { 1 } else { 0 },
                    if unsigned { 1 } else { 0 },
                    reg_write(rd, false, "r_")
                )
            ));
        }
        Op::IntToFp { rd, rn, unsigned, src_is64, dest_is64 } => {
            let bytes = if dest_is64 { 8 } else { 4 };
            out.push_str(&format!(
                "    /* 0x{a:x}: {} {}{rd}, x{rn} */\n    ew_vset(cpu, {rd}, {bytes}, ew_int_to_fp({}, {}, {}, {}));\n",
                if unsigned { "ucvtf" } else { "scvtf" },
                if dest_is64 { "d" } else { "s" },
                reg_read(rn, false),
                if src_is64 { 1 } else { 0 },
                if unsigned { 1 } else { 0 },
                if dest_is64 { 1 } else { 0 }
            ));
        }
        Op::IntToFpFixed { rd, rn, unsigned, src_is64, dest_is64, fbits } => {
            let bytes = if dest_is64 { 8 } else { 4 };
            out.push_str(&format!(
                "    /* 0x{a:x}: fixed-point {}cvtf, #{fbits} */\n    ew_vset(cpu, {rd}, {bytes}, ew_int_to_fp_fixed({}, {}, {}, {}, {fbits}));\n",
                if unsigned { "u" } else { "s" },
                reg_read(rn, false),
                src_is64 as u8,
                unsigned as u8,
                dest_is64 as u8
            ));
        }
        Op::FpToIntFixed { rd, rn, unsigned, src_is64, dest_is64, fbits } => {
            let get = if src_is64 { "ew_dget" } else { "ew_sget" };
            out.push_str(&format!(
                "    /* 0x{a:x}: fixed-point fcvtz{}, #{fbits} */\n    {{ ew_u64 r_ = ew_fp_to_int(ldexp((double){get}(cpu, {rn}), {fbits}), {}, {}, {});\n      {} }}\n",
                if unsigned { "u" } else { "s" },
                FpRound::Zero.c_code(),
                dest_is64 as u8,
                unsigned as u8,
                reg_write(rd, false, "r_")
            ));
        }
        Op::FpRoundFp { rd, rn, round, is64 } => {
            let width = if is64 { "d" } else { "s" };
            let lib = if is64 { "" } else { "f" };
            let (get, set) = if is64 { ("ew_dget", "ew_dset") } else { ("ew_sget", "ew_sset") };
            let call = match round {
                FpRound::NearestEven => "rint",
                FpRound::NearestAway => "round",
                FpRound::PlusInf => "ceil",
                FpRound::MinusInf => "floor",
                FpRound::Zero => "trunc",
            };
            out.push_str(&format!(
                "    /* 0x{a:x}: {} {width}{rd}, {width}{rn} */\n    {set}(cpu, {rd}, {call}{lib}({get}(cpu, {rn})));\n",
                fp_round_fp_name(round, is64)
            ));
        }
        Op::FpMovImm { rd, imm8, is64 } => {
            let bytes = if is64 { 8 } else { 4 };
            out.push_str(&format!(
                "    /* 0x{a:x}: fmov {}{rd}, #0x{imm8:02x} */\n    ew_vset(cpu, {rd}, {bytes}, ew_fmov_imm(0x{imm8:02x}, {}));\n",
                if is64 { "d" } else { "s" },
                if is64 { 1 } else { 0 }
            ));
        }
        Op::FpMulAdd { rd, rn, rm, ra, negate_product, negate_addend, is64 } => {
            let width = if is64 { "d" } else { "s" };
            let ty = if is64 { "double" } else { "float" };
            let (get, set) = if is64 { ("ew_dget", "ew_dset") } else { ("ew_sget", "ew_sset") };
            let mnemonic = match (negate_product, negate_addend) {
                (false, false) => "fmadd",
                (false, true) => "fmsub",
                (true, false) => "fnmadd",
                (true, true) => "fnmsub",
            };
            out.push_str(&format!(
                "    /* 0x{a:x}: {mnemonic} {width}{rd}, {width}{rn}, {width}{rm}, {width}{ra} */\n    {{ {ty} p_ = {get}(cpu, {rn}) * {get}(cpu, {rm});\n      if ({}) p_ = -p_;\n      {set}(cpu, {rd}, p_ + ({})); }}\n",
                if negate_product { 1 } else { 0 },
                if negate_addend {
                    format!("-{get}(cpu, {ra})")
                } else {
                    format!("{get}(cpu, {ra})")
                }
            ));
        }
        Op::LoadLiteral { rt, target, is64 } => {
            let bytes = if is64 { 8 } else { 4 };
            out.push_str(&format!(
                "    /* 0x{a:x}: ldr x{rt}, =0x{target:x} */\n    {{ ew_u64 v_ = ew_load(cpu, 0x{target:x}ULL, {bytes}); {} }}\n",
                reg_write(rt, false, &masked(is64, "v_"))
            ));
        }
        Op::Simd(..) | Op::SimdMem(..) => out.push_str(&emit_simd_insn(a, &insn.op)),
        Op::Exclusive { .. } | Op::Cas { .. } => out.push_str(&emit_exclusive(a, &insn.op)),
        Op::Extr { rd, rn, rm, lsb, is64 } => {
            let expr = if is64 {
                if lsb == 0 {
                    reg_read(rm, false)
                } else {
                    format!("(({} >> {lsb}) | ({} << {}))", reg_read(rm, false), reg_read(rn, false), 64 - lsb as u32)
                }
            } else {
                format!(
                    "(((((EW_M32({})) << 32) | EW_M32({})) >> {lsb}) & 0xFFFFFFFFULL)",
                    reg_read(rn, false),
                    reg_read(rm, false)
                )
            };
            out.push_str(&format!("    /* 0x{a:x}: extr */
    {}
", reg_write(rd, false, &expr)));
        }
        Op::MulHigh { rd, rn, rm, unsigned } => {
            let f = if unsigned { "ew_umulh" } else { "ew_smulh" };
            out.push_str(&format!(
                "    /* 0x{a:x}: {}mulh */
    {}
",
                if unsigned { "u" } else { "s" },
                reg_write(rd, false, &format!("{f}({}, {})", reg_read(rn, false), reg_read(rm, false)))
            ));
        }
        Op::Mrs { rt, reg } => {
            out.push_str(&format!(
                "    /* 0x{a:x}: mrs */\n    {{ ew_u64 ew_t0 = 0;\n    if (!ew_mrs(cpu, 0x{a:x}ULL, {reg}u, &ew_t0)) return 0;\n    {} }}\n",
                reg_write(rt, false, "ew_t0")
            ));
        }
        Op::Msr { rt, reg } => {
            out.push_str(&format!(
                "    /* 0x{a:x}: msr */\n    if (!ew_msr(cpu, 0x{a:x}ULL, {reg}u, {})) return 0;\n",
                reg_read(rt, false)
            ));
        }
        Op::Svc { imm } => {
            // Control returns to the run loop, which services the call and
            // resumes at the next instruction.
            out.push_str(&format!(
                "    /* 0x{a:x}: svc */\n    cpu->svc = {imm};\n    cpu->pc = 0x{next:x}ULL;\n    return 0;\n",
                next = a + 4
            ));
        }
        Op::Unsupported { word } | Op::UnsupportedBitfield { word } => {
            out.push_str(&format!(
                "    /* 0x{a:x}: UNSUPPORTED 0x{word:08x} */\n    ew_halt(cpu, 0x{a:x}ULL, \"unsupported instruction 0x{word:08x}\");\n    return 0;\n"
            ));
        }
    }

}

fn logical_name(op: LogicalOp) -> &'static str {
    match op {
        LogicalOp::And => "and",
        LogicalOp::Orr => "orr",
        LogicalOp::Eor => "eor",
        LogicalOp::Ands => "ands",
    }
}

fn shift_name(s: Shift) -> &'static str {
    match s {
        Shift::Lsl => "lsl",
        Shift::Lsr => "lsr",
        Shift::Asr => "asr",
        Shift::Ror => "ror",
    }
}

/// Emit one translation unit containing every lifted function.
pub fn emit_module(module: &str, funcs: &[LiftedFunction]) -> String {
    let mut out = String::new();
    out.push_str(&format!(
        "/* {module}_lift.c - machine-generated by ew-lift {} - do not edit.\n\
         *\n\
         * Every function returns 1 to continue dispatch and 0 after a trap.\n\
         * Blocks: {}, instructions: {}\n\
         */\n\n#include \"ew_aarch64.h\"\n#include \"ew_dispatch.h\"\n\n",
        env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"),
        funcs.iter().map(|f| f.blocks.len()).sum::<usize>(),
        funcs.iter().map(|f| f.insn_count()).sum::<usize>()
    ));

    for f in funcs {
        out.push_str(&format!(
            "/* guest 0x{:x}: {} block(s), {} instruction(s), {}, {} jump table(s) */\nint {}(Cpu *cpu)\n{{\n    /* Entered at cpu->pc: 0x{:x} or any block below it. */\n    for (;;) {{\n        switch (cpu->pc) {{\n",
            f.addr,
            f.blocks.len(),
            f.insn_count(),
            if f.complete { "complete" } else { "partial" },
            f.jump_tables,
            f.c_name(),
            f.addr
        ));
        for e in entry_points(f) {
            out.push_str(&format!("        case 0x{e:x}ULL: goto L_{e:x};\n"));
        }
        out.push_str("        default: return 1; /* pc left this function */\n        }\n");

        for b in &f.blocks {
            // Each stretch of a block up to a call, and from a call's return
            // to the next, gets a label and charges its instructions to the
            // budget first: a function that runs out of budget leaves with pc
            // at a point it can be entered at again, and a call returns
            // straight into the code after it.
            let mut seg_start = 0usize;
            for (i, insn) in b.insns.iter().enumerate() {
                if i == seg_start {
                    let n = b.insns[i..].iter().position(|x| is_call(&x.op)).map_or(b.insns.len() - i, |k| k + 1);
                    out.push_str(&format!(
                        "    L_{a:x}:\n    if ((cpu->budget -= {n}) < 0) {{ cpu->budget += {n}; cpu->pc = 0x{a:x}ULL; cpu->svc = -2; return 1; }}\n",
                        a = insn.addr
                    ));
                }
                emit_insn(&mut out, insn, f, b.jump_table.as_ref());
                if is_call(&insn.op) {
                    seg_start = i + 1;
                }
            }
            let conditional = b.insns.last().map(|i| i.op.is_conditional_branch()).unwrap_or(false);
            if conditional {
                // Not taken: continue at the instruction after the branch.
                match b.fallthrough() {
                    Some(ft) => out.push_str(&format!("    cpu->pc = 0x{ft:x}ULL; continue;\n")),
                    None => out.push_str("    return 1;\n"),
                }
            } else if !b.terminated {
                out.push_str(&format!(
                    "    ew_halt(cpu, 0x{:x}ULL, \"block ended before a terminator\");\n    return 0;\n",
                    b.end_addr()
                ));
            }
        }
        out.push_str("    }\n}\n\n");
    }

    // Dispatch table: the runtime only needs the address -> function mapping.
    out.push_str(&format!(
        "const ew_func_entry {module}_functions[] = {{\n"
    ));
    for f in funcs {
        out.push_str(&format!("    {{ 0x{:x}ULL, {} }},\n", f.addr, f.c_name()));
    }
    out.push_str("    { 0ULL, 0 }\n};\n");
    out.push_str(&format!(
        "const unsigned {module}_function_count = {}u;\n",
        funcs.len()
    ));
    // Every block start, so the run loop can enter a function where a call
    // returns or a branch lands, not only at its entry.
    out.push_str(&format!("const ew_func_entry {module}_blocks[] = {{\n"));
    let mut blocks = 0usize;
    for f in funcs {
        for e in entry_points(f) {
            out.push_str(&format!("    {{ 0x{e:x}ULL, {} }},\n", f.c_name()));
            blocks += 1;
        }
    }
    out.push_str("    { 0ULL, 0 }\n};\n");
    out.push_str(&format!("const unsigned {module}_block_count = {blocks}u;\n"));
    out
}

fn is_call(op: &Op) -> bool {
    matches!(op, Op::Bl { .. } | Op::Blr { .. })
}

/// Where a lifted function can be entered: each block start, and the
/// instruction after each call inside a block (where the call returns).
pub fn entry_points(f: &LiftedFunction) -> Vec<u64> {
    let mut v = Vec::new();
    for b in &f.blocks {
        v.push(b.addr);
        for (i, insn) in b.insns.iter().enumerate() {
            if is_call(&insn.op) && i + 1 < b.insns.len() {
                v.push(b.insns[i + 1].addr);
            }
        }
    }
    v.sort_unstable();
    v.dedup();
    v
}

/// Guest memory and state setup shared by every generated harness. The layout
/// matches `interpreter::State::patterned` exactly, so a differential run is
/// comparing instruction semantics rather than test rigs.
pub const HARNESS_SUPPORT: &str = r#"
#define EW_GUEST_SIZE (2u * 1024u * 1024u)
static ew_u8  ew_guest[EW_GUEST_SIZE];
static int    ew_faults;

static ew_u64 ew_mem_read(void *ctx, ew_u64 addr, unsigned bytes)
{
    unsigned i;
    ew_u64 v = 0;
    (void)ctx;
    if (addr + (ew_u64)bytes > (ew_u64)EW_GUEST_SIZE) { ew_faults++; return 0; }
    for (i = 0; i < bytes; i++)
        v |= ((ew_u64)ew_guest[addr + i]) << (8 * i);
    return v;
}

static void ew_mem_write(void *ctx, ew_u64 addr, ew_u64 value, unsigned bytes)
{
    unsigned i;
    (void)ctx;
    if (addr + (ew_u64)bytes > (ew_u64)EW_GUEST_SIZE) { ew_faults++; return; }
    for (i = 0; i < bytes; i++)
        ew_guest[addr + i] = (ew_u8)((value >> (8 * i)) & 0xFFu);
}

static void ew_reset(Cpu *cpu)
{
    int i;
    memset(cpu, 0, sizeof *cpu);
    memset(ew_guest, 0, sizeof ew_guest);
    ew_faults = 0;
    for (i = 0; i < 31; i++) cpu->x[i] = 0x1000ULL + (ew_u64)i * 0x20ULL;
    for (i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
        cpu->v[i][0] = 0x2000ULL + (ew_u64)i * 0x10ULL;
        cpu->v[i][1] = 0x3000ULL + (ew_u64)i * 0x10ULL;
    }
    cpu->sp = 0x100000ULL;
    cpu->budget = (ew_i64)1 << 60;
    cpu->mem_read = ew_mem_read;
    cpu->mem_write = ew_mem_write;
}

static void ew_report(Cpu *cpu, ew_u64 base)
{
    int i;
    printf("fn=0x%llx halted=%d pc=%llx nzcv=%x",
           (unsigned long long)base, cpu->halted ? 1 : 0,
           (unsigned long long)cpu->pc, cpu->nzcv);
    /* Every register is printed, not a sample: a wrong lane or a stale upper
     * half is exactly the kind of bug a partial comparison hides. */
    for (i = 0; i < 31; i++)
        printf(" x%d=%llx", i, (unsigned long long)cpu->x[i]);
    printf(" sp=%llx", (unsigned long long)cpu->sp);
    for (i = 0; i < 32; i++)
        printf(" v%d=%llx:%llx", i, (unsigned long long)cpu->v[i][1],
               (unsigned long long)cpu->v[i][0]);
    printf("\n");
}
"#;

/// Emit a self-checking harness that runs one lifted function on the shared
/// register pattern and prints the resulting state.
pub fn emit_harness(module: &str, func: &LiftedFunction) -> String {
    let _ = module;
    format!(
        r#"/* generated harness: executes one lifted guest function */
#include "ew_aarch64.h"
{HARNESS_SUPPORT}
int {}(Cpu *cpu);

int main(void)
{{
    Cpu cpu;
    ew_reset(&cpu);
    cpu.pc = 0x{:x}ULL;
    (void){}(&cpu);
    ew_report(&cpu, 0x{:x}ULL);
    if (ew_faults) printf("guest-memory-faults=%d\n", ew_faults);
    return cpu.halted ? 2 : 0;
}}
"#,
        func.c_name(),
        func.addr,
        func.c_name(),
        func.addr
    )
}

/// Emit a program that runs many lifted functions in sequence. One compile and
/// one run then covers a whole differential campaign.
pub fn emit_campaign(module: &str, funcs: &[LiftedFunction]) -> String {
    let mut out = emit_module(module, funcs);
    out.push_str(HARNESS_SUPPORT);
    out.push_str("\nint main(void)\n{\n    Cpu cpu;\n");
    for f in funcs {
        out.push_str(&format!(
            "    ew_reset(&cpu);\n    cpu.pc = 0x{:x}ULL;\n    (void){}(&cpu);\n    ew_report(&cpu, 0x{:x}ULL);\n",
            f.addr,
            f.c_name(),
            f.addr
        ));
    }
    out.push_str("    if (ew_faults) printf(\"guest-memory-faults=%d\\n\", ew_faults);\n    return 0;\n}\n");
    out
}

/// Type declaration block for the generated dispatch table.
pub fn dispatch_header() -> &'static str {
    r#"/* Dispatch interface shared by generated modules and ew-runtime. */
#ifndef EW_DISPATCH_H
#define EW_DISPATCH_H
#include "ew_aarch64.h"
typedef struct ew_func_entry {
    ew_u64 address;
    int (*fn)(Cpu *cpu);
} ew_func_entry;
#endif
"#
}

/// One call into `ew_simd.h` per register-only SIMD instruction. The helpers
/// are `static inline` and every argument is a constant, so the C compiler
/// folds each call down to the lane loop for that one form.
fn emit_simd(op: &crate::simd::SimdOp) -> String {
    use crate::simd::SimdOp as S;
    let b = |v: bool| v as u8;
    match *op {
        S::DupElem { rd, rn, esize, index, q } => {
            format!("ew_v_dup_elem(cpu, {rd}, {rn}, {esize}, {index}, {});", b(q))
        }
        S::DupGen { rd, rn, esize, q } => format!("ew_v_dup_gen(cpu, {rd}, {rn}, {esize}, {});", b(q)),
        S::InsGen { rd, rn, esize, index } => format!("ew_v_ins_gen(cpu, {rd}, {rn}, {esize}, {index});"),
        S::InsElem { rd, rn, esize, dst, src } => {
            format!("ew_v_ins_elem(cpu, {rd}, {rn}, {esize}, {dst}, {src});")
        }
        S::ToGp { rd, rn, esize, index, signed, is64 } => format!(
            "ew_v_to_gp(cpu, {rd}, {rn}, {esize}, {index}, {}, {});",
            b(signed),
            b(is64)
        ),
        S::DupScalar { rd, rn, esize, index } => {
            format!("ew_v_dup_scalar(cpu, {rd}, {rn}, {esize}, {index});")
        }
        S::Ext { rd, rn, rm, pos, q } => format!("ew_v_ext(cpu, {rd}, {rn}, {rm}, {pos}, {});", b(q)),
        S::Imm { rd, imm, kind, q } => {
            format!("ew_v_imm(cpu, {rd}, 0x{imm:x}ULL, {}, {});", kind as u8, b(q))
        }
        S::Three { rd, rn, rm, op, esize, q, scalar } => format!(
            "ew_v_three(cpu, {rd}, {rn}, {rm}, {}, {esize}, {}, {});",
            op as u8,
            b(q),
            b(scalar)
        ),
        S::Two { rd, rn, op, esize, q, scalar } => format!(
            "ew_v_two(cpu, {rd}, {rn}, {}, {esize}, {}, {});",
            op as u8,
            b(q),
            b(scalar)
        ),
        S::Shift { rd, rn, op, esize, shift, q, scalar } => format!(
            "ew_v_shift(cpu, {rd}, {rn}, {}, {esize}, {shift}, {}, {});",
            op as u8,
            b(q),
            b(scalar)
        ),
        S::Long { rd, rn, rm, op, signed, esize, q } => format!(
            "ew_v_long(cpu, {rd}, {rn}, {rm}, {}, {}, {esize}, {});",
            op as u8,
            b(signed),
            b(q)
        ),
        S::Perm { rd, rn, rm, op, esize, q } => {
            format!("ew_v_perm(cpu, {rd}, {rn}, {rm}, {}, {esize}, {});", op as u8, b(q))
        }
        S::Elem { rd, rn, rm, index, op, esize, q, scalar } => format!(
            "ew_v_elem(cpu, {rd}, {rn}, {rm}, {index}, {}, {esize}, {}, {});",
            op as u8,
            b(q),
            b(scalar)
        ),
        S::Across { rd, rn, op, esize, q } => {
            format!("ew_v_across(cpu, {rd}, {rn}, {}, {esize}, {});", op as u8, b(q))
        }
        S::Pair { rd, rn, op, esize } => format!("ew_v_pair(cpu, {rd}, {rn}, {}, {esize});", op as u8),
        S::Tbl { rd, rn, rm, len, tbx, q } => {
            format!("ew_v_tbl(cpu, {rd}, {rn}, {rm}, {len}, {}, {});", b(tbx), b(q))
        }
    }
}

/// C for one SIMD instruction, or an empty string for any other op.
pub fn emit_simd_insn(a: u64, op: &Op) -> String {
    match *op {
        Op::Simd(ref simd) => format!(
            "    /* 0x{a:x}: {} */
    {}
",
            crate::simd::describe(simd).replace("*/", "* /"),
            emit_simd(simd)
        ),
        Op::SimdMem(ref m) => {
            use crate::simd::{Post, Shape};
            let (shape, idx) = match m.shape {
                Shape::Multi => (0, 0),
                Shape::Lane(i) => (1, i),
                Shape::Replicate => (2, 0),
            };
            let (post, postv) = match m.post {
                Post::None => (0, 0u64),
                Post::Imm(n) => (1, n as u64),
                Post::Reg(r) => (2, r as u64),
            };
            format!(
                "    /* 0x{a:x}: {} */
    ew_v_mem(cpu, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {shape}, {idx}, {post}, {postv}ULL);
",
                crate::simd::describe_mem(m),
                m.rt,
                m.rn,
                m.regs,
                m.selem,
                m.esize,
                m.q as u8,
                m.load as u8
            )
        }
        _ => String::new(),
    }
}

/// Edge-case lane values shared by the SIMD campaign's two seeders. Each
/// 64-bit entry is either two interesting singles or one interesting double.
pub const SIMD_SEEDS: [u64; 24] = [
    0x0000_0000_8000_0000, // +0.0f, -0.0f
    0x3F80_0000_BF80_0000, // 1.0f, -1.0f
    0x7F80_0000_FF80_0000, // +inf, -inf
    0x7FC0_0000_7F80_0001, // qNaN, sNaN
    0x0000_0001_7F7F_FFFF, // smallest subnormal, largest normal
    0x4F00_0000_CF00_0000, // 2^31, -2^31
    0x4049_0FDB_3EAA_AAAB, // pi, 1/3
    0xDEAD_BEEF_1234_5678,
    0x3FF0_0000_0000_0000, // 1.0
    0xBFF0_0000_0000_0000, // -1.0
    0x7FF0_0000_0000_0000, // +inf
    0x7FF8_0000_0000_0000, // qNaN
    0x7FF0_0000_0000_0001, // sNaN
    0x8000_0000_0000_0000, // -0.0
    0x43E0_0000_0000_0000, // 2^63
    0x400921FB_54442D18,   // pi
    0x0123_4567_89AB_CDEF,
    0xFFFF_FFFF_FFFF_FFFF,
    0x7FFF_FFFF_7FFF_FFFF,
    0x8000_0001_0000_FFFF,
    0x4120_0000_C2C8_0000, // 10.0f, -100.0f
    0x3F00_0000_4B80_0000, // 0.5f, 2^24
    0x0001_0203_0405_0607, // table indices
    0x1F10_2030_0809_0A0B,
];

/// Register state for SIMD campaign case `seed`, identical to the C seeder.
pub fn simd_seed_vector(seed: u32, reg: u32, half: u32) -> u64 {
    let k = (seed.wrapping_mul(7) + reg.wrapping_mul(3) + half.wrapping_mul(11)) as usize;
    SIMD_SEEDS[k % SIMD_SEEDS.len()]
}

/// Emit a program that runs every case of a SIMD campaign. Each case is one
/// instruction executed on one seeded register state.
pub fn emit_simd_campaign(cases: &[(u64, Op)], seeds: u32) -> String {
    let mut out = String::new();
    out.push_str("/* generated SIMD differential campaign */
#include \"ew_aarch64.h\"
");
    out.push_str(HARNESS_SUPPORT);
    out.push_str("
static const ew_u64 ew_seeds[24] = {");
    for (i, v) in SIMD_SEEDS.iter().enumerate() {
        if i % 4 == 0 {
            out.push_str("
   ");
        }
        out.push_str(&format!(" 0x{v:016x}ULL,"));
    }
    out.push_str("
};

static void ew_seed(Cpu *cpu, unsigned seed)
{
    unsigned r, h;
    ew_reset(cpu);
");
    out.push_str("    for (r = 0; r < 32; r++)
        for (h = 0; h < 2; h++)
            cpu->v[r][h] = ew_seeds[(seed * 7u + r * 3u + h * 11u) % 24u];
");
    out.push_str("    for (r = 0; r < 31; r++) cpu->x[r] += (ew_u64)seed * 0x100ULL;
");
    out.push_str("    for (r = 0; r < 0x4000; r++) ew_guest[r] = (ew_u8)(r * 37u + seed);
}

");
    for (i, (addr, op)) in cases.iter().enumerate() {
        out.push_str(&format!("static void case_{i}(Cpu *cpu)
{{
{}}}
", emit_simd_insn(*addr, op)));
    }
    out.push_str("
int main(void)
{
    Cpu cpu;
    unsigned s;
");
    for (i, (addr, _)) in cases.iter().enumerate() {
        out.push_str(&format!(
            "    for (s = 0; s < {seeds}u; s++) {{ ew_seed(&cpu, s); case_{i}(&cpu); ew_report(&cpu, 0x{addr:x}ULL); }}
"
        ));
    }
    out.push_str("    if (ew_faults) printf(\"guest-memory-faults=%d\\n\", ew_faults);
    return 0;
}
");
    out
}

/// C for the exclusive and compare-and-swap families.
fn emit_exclusive(a: u64, op: &Op) -> String {
    let mut out = String::new();
    match *op {
        Op::Exclusive { rs, rt, rt2, rn, bytes, load, pair } => {
            let is64 = bytes == 8;
            let b = bytes as u64;
            out.push_str(&format!(
                "    /* 0x{a:x}: {}x{} */\n    {{ ew_u64 ea_ = {};\n",
                if load { "ld" } else { "st" },
                if pair { "p" } else { "r" },
                reg_read(rn, true)
            ));
            if load {
                out.push_str(&format!("      {}\n", reg_write(rt, false, &format!("ew_load(cpu, ea_, {bytes})"))));
                if pair {
                    out.push_str(&format!(
                        "      {}\n",
                        reg_write(rt2, false, &format!("ew_load(cpu, ea_ + {b}, {bytes})"))
                    ));
                }
                out.push_str("      cpu->excl_addr = ea_; cpu->excl_valid = 1; }\n");
            } else {
                out.push_str("      int ok_ = cpu->excl_valid && cpu->excl_addr == ea_;\n      if (ok_) {\n");
                out.push_str(&format!("        ew_store(cpu, ea_, {}, {bytes});\n", masked(is64, &reg_read(rt, false))));
                if pair {
                    out.push_str(&format!(
                        "        ew_store(cpu, ea_ + {b}, {}, {bytes});\n",
                        masked(is64, &reg_read(rt2, false))
                    ));
                }
                out.push_str(&format!("      }}\n      {}\n      cpu->excl_valid = 0; }}\n", reg_write(rs, false, "ok_ ? 0 : 1")));
            }
        }
        Op::Cas { rs, rt, rn, bytes, pair } => {
            let b = bytes as u64;
            let m = |e: String| {
                if bytes >= 8 {
                    e
                } else {
                    format!("(({e}) & 0x{:x}ULL)", (1u64 << (bytes * 8)) - 1)
                }
            };
            out.push_str(&format!(
                "    /* 0x{a:x}: cas{} */\n    {{ ew_u64 ea_ = {};\n      ew_u64 old_ = ew_load(cpu, ea_, {bytes});\n",
                if pair { "p" } else { "" },
                reg_read(rn, true)
            ));
            if pair {
                out.push_str(&format!("      ew_u64 old2_ = ew_load(cpu, ea_ + {b}, {bytes});\n"));
                out.push_str(&format!(
                    "      if (old_ == {} && old2_ == {}) {{ ew_store(cpu, ea_, {}, {bytes}); ew_store(cpu, ea_ + {b}, {}, {bytes}); }}\n",
                    m(reg_read(rs, false)),
                    m(reg_read(rs + 1, false)),
                    m(reg_read(rt, false)),
                    m(reg_read(rt + 1, false))
                ));
                out.push_str(&format!(
                    "      {}\n      {} }}\n",
                    reg_write(rs, false, "old_"),
                    reg_write(rs + 1, false, "old2_")
                ));
            } else {
                out.push_str(&format!(
                    "      if (old_ == {}) ew_store(cpu, ea_, {}, {bytes});\n      {} }}\n",
                    m(reg_read(rs, false)),
                    m(reg_read(rt, false)),
                    reg_write(rs, false, "old_")
                ));
            }
        }
        _ => {}
    }
    out
}
```

`crates/ew-lift/src/scan.rs`:

```rs
//! Function and block discovery.
//!
//! Discovery has two jobs: find addresses that must be dispatchable, and hold
//! the types that describe a recovered function. The actual graph traversal
//! lives in [`crate::cfg`]; this module owns the data model so that the emitter,
//! the interpreter and the reports all describe functions the same way.
//!
//! A function is a set of basic blocks. A block is a straight-line run of
//! instructions that ends at the first control-flow instruction. Every block
//! records its outgoing edges, so "complete" is a statement about the graph
//! rather than about a single straight-line body.

use crate::aarch64::{decode, MemMode, Op};
use serde::Serialize;
use std::collections::BTreeSet;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize)]
pub struct Insn {
    pub addr: u64,
    pub word: u32,
    pub op: Op,
}

/// Where control can go when a block ends.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize)]
pub enum EdgeKind {
    /// Direct branch or resolved jump-table target.
    Direct,
    /// Address of the next instruction after a conditional branch or a call.
    FallThrough,
    /// Return to the caller; the address comes from a register at run time.
    Return,
    /// A call into another function through a known address (`bl`).
    Call,
    /// A call through a register (`blr`). The callee is unknown, but control
    /// returns here, so this does not make the caller's own graph incomplete.
    IndirectCall,
    /// Indirect branch we could not resolve statically. This is the one kind
    /// that leaves a function's own control flow genuinely unknown.
    Indirect,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Serialize)]
pub struct Edge {
    pub kind: EdgeKind,
    pub target: Option<u64>,
}

impl Edge {
    pub fn direct(kind: EdgeKind, target: u64) -> Edge {
        Edge { kind, target: Some(target) }
    }
    pub fn terminal(kind: EdgeKind) -> Edge {
        Edge { kind, target: None }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize)]
pub struct Block {
    pub addr: u64,
    pub insns: Vec<Insn>,
    pub edges: Vec<Edge>,
    /// Set when the block ends in a `br` driven by a resolved jump table.
    pub jump_table: Option<crate::jump_table::JumpTable>,
    /// False when the block ran into the instruction cap before a terminator.
    pub terminated: bool,
}

impl Block {
    pub fn end_addr(&self) -> u64 {
        self.insns.last().map(|i| i.addr + 4).unwrap_or(self.addr)
    }

    /// Address the block falls through to, if it can.
    pub fn fallthrough(&self) -> Option<u64> {
        self.edges
            .iter()
            .find(|e| e.kind == EdgeKind::FallThrough)
            .and_then(|e| e.target)
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize)]
pub struct LiftedFunction {
    pub addr: u64,
    pub blocks: Vec<Block>,
    /// True when every block terminated and no edge was left unresolved.
    pub complete: bool,
    pub unsupported: usize,
    pub has_memory: bool,
    pub has_calls: bool,
    pub jump_tables: usize,
    pub jump_table_targets: usize,
    pub unresolved_edges: usize,
    /// Calls through a register. Counted, but not treated as a gap in the
    /// caller's own control flow.
    pub indirect_calls: usize,
    /// Blocks that ran into the instruction budget instead of a terminator.
    pub unterminated_blocks: usize,
    /// The function's instruction budget was exhausted, so its recovery is
    /// partial by construction rather than blocked by an unknown instruction.
    pub budget_exhausted: bool,
}

impl LiftedFunction {
    pub fn c_name(&self) -> String {
        format!("ew_fn_{:08x}", self.addr)
    }

    pub fn insn_count(&self) -> usize {
        self.blocks.iter().map(|b| b.insns.len()).sum()
    }

    pub fn insns(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &Insn> {
        self.blocks.iter().flat_map(|b| b.insns.iter())
    }

    /// A function that only touches registers, calls nothing and has fully
    /// recovered control flow: suitable for bit-exact differential testing
    /// against the reference interpreter.
    pub fn is_pure_leaf(&self) -> bool {
        self.complete && !self.has_memory && !self.has_calls && self.unsupported == 0
    }

    /// True when the block set contains `addr`.
    pub fn contains(&self, addr: u64) -> bool {
        self.blocks.binary_search_by_key(&addr, |b| b.addr).is_ok()
    }
}

/// Iterate the text segment as 32-bit guest words at addresses `0..len`.
pub fn words(text: &[u8]) -> impl Iterator<Item = (u64, u32)> + '_ {
    text.chunks_exact(4)
        .enumerate()
        .map(|(i, c)| ((i as u64) * 4, u32::from_le_bytes([c[0], c[1], c[2], c[3]])))
}

pub fn word_at(text: &[u8], addr: u64) -> Option<u32> {
    // The address comes from guest registers, so it can be anything the guest
    // computed. A wrapped addition here would panic in debug builds and read the
    // wrong word in release builds.
    if addr % 4 != 0 {
        return None;
    }
    let off = usize::try_from(addr).ok()?;
    let end = off.checked_add(4)?;
    if end > text.len() {
        return None;
    }
    Some(u32::from_le_bytes([text[off], text[off + 1], text[off + 2], text[off + 3]]))
}

/// Entry points of other functions, used to keep a traversal inside one
/// function: a branch to a known call target is a tail call, not a block.
pub fn call_targets(text: &[u8]) -> BTreeSet<u64> {
    let mut set = BTreeSet::new();
    let len = text.len() as u64;
    for (addr, word) in words(text) {
        if let Op::Bl { target } = decode(word, addr) {
            if target % 4 == 0 && target < len {
                set.insert(target);
            }
        }
    }
    set
}

/// Collect every address that must be dispatchable: the module entry point,
/// branch targets, call targets, call return sites, and resolved jump-table
/// targets.
pub fn discover_starts(text: &[u8], entry: u64, limit: usize) -> Vec<u64> {
    discover_starts_in(text, &[], entry, limit)
}

/// True when `addr` is preceded by a terminator or padding, which is what a
/// real function boundary looks like in a linked image.
fn is_boundary(text: &[u8], addr: u64) -> bool {
    if addr == 0 {
        return true;
    }
    match word_at(text, addr - 4) {
        None => true,
        Some(0) => true,
        Some(word) => matches!(
            decode(word, addr - 4),
            Op::Ret { .. } | Op::Br { .. } | Op::B { .. }
        ),
    }
}

/// The prologue shapes this toolchain emits: a frame push of `x29`/`x30`, or a
/// plain stack reservation.
fn looks_like_prologue(word: u32, addr: u64) -> bool {
    match decode(word, addr) {
        Op::LoadStorePair { rt: 29, rt2: 30, mode: MemMode::PreIndex, .. } => true,
        Op::AddSubImm { rd: 31, rn: 31, sub: true, .. } => true,
        _ => false,
    }
}

/// Function entries that no branch reaches.
///
/// C++ virtual functions and callbacks are only ever called through a register,
/// so nothing in the branch graph points at them, yet a large share of the
/// switch-heavy code sits behind exactly those entry points. A prologue at a
/// real boundary is the standard way to recover them, and both conditions are
/// required so a mid-function instruction is never mistaken for an entry.
pub fn prologue_starts(text: &[u8], limit: usize) -> Vec<u64> {
    let mut set = BTreeSet::new();
    for (addr, word) in words(text) {
        if addr == 0 || word == 0 {
            continue;
        }
        if looks_like_prologue(word, addr) && is_boundary(text, addr) {
            set.insert(addr);
            if set.len() >= limit {
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    set.into_iter().collect()
}

pub fn discover_starts_in(
    text: &[u8],
    segments: crate::jump_table::Segments,
    entry: u64,
    limit: usize,
) -> Vec<u64> {
    let mut set = BTreeSet::new();
    let len = text.len() as u64;
    fn push(set: &mut BTreeSet<u64>, a: u64, len: u64) {
        if a % 4 == 0 && a < len {
            set.insert(a);
        }
    }
    push(&mut set, entry, len);
    for (addr, word) in words(text) {
        match decode(word, addr) {
            Op::B { target } => push(&mut set, target, len),
            Op::Bl { target } => {
                push(&mut set, target, len);
                push(&mut set, addr + 4, len);
            }
            Op::BCond { target, .. }
            | Op::CompareBranchZero { target, .. }
            | Op::TestBitBranch { target, .. } => push(&mut set, target, len),
            Op::Br { .. } => {
                for target in crate::jump_table::targets_at(text, segments, addr) {
                    push(&mut set, target, len);
                }
            }
            _ => {}
        }
        if set.len() >= limit {
            break;
        }
    }
    // Prologue entries get their own budget. Sharing the edge budget meant they
    // were never added at all: the branch scan always filled it first.
    let mut added = 0usize;
    for start in prologue_starts(text, limit) {
        if added >= limit {
            break;
        }
        if set.insert(start) {
            added += 1;
        }
    }
    set.into_iter().collect()
}

/// Recover one function, starting at `start`.
pub fn lift_function(text: &[u8], start: u64, max_insns: usize) -> Option<LiftedFunction> {
    lift_function_in(text, &[], start, max_insns)
}

/// Recover one function using the module image, so jump tables held in rodata
/// can be read.
pub fn lift_function_in(
    text: &[u8],
    segments: crate::jump_table::Segments,
    start: u64,
    max_insns: usize,
) -> Option<LiftedFunction> {
    let boundaries = call_targets(text);
    crate::cfg::build(text, segments, start, max_insns, &boundaries)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn words_to_bytes(words: &[u32]) -> Vec<u8> {
        words.iter().flat_map(|w| w.to_le_bytes()).collect()
    }

    #[test]
    fn discovers_calls_and_returns() {
        // bl 0x20 ; b 0x10 ; <pad> ... ; function bodies
        let text = words_to_bytes(&[
            0x9400_0008, // 0x00: bl 0x20
            0x1400_0004, // 0x04: b 0x14
            0xD503201F,  // 0x08: nop
            0xD503201F,  // 0x0c: nop
            0xD503201F,  // 0x10: nop
            0xD65F03C0,  // 0x14: ret
            0xD503201F,  // 0x18: nop
            0xD503201F,  // 0x1c: nop
            0xD65F03C0,  // 0x20: ret
        ]);
        let starts = discover_starts(&text, 0, 100);
        for expected in [0u64, 0x04, 0x14, 0x20] {
            assert!(starts.contains(&expected), "missing start 0x{expected:x}");
        }
        assert!(starts.contains(&0x04), "call return address must be a start");
    }

    #[test]
    fn straight_line_body_is_complete() {
        let text = words_to_bytes(&[
            0x9100_4020, // add x0, x1, #0x10
            0xD65F03C0, // ret
        ]);
        let f = lift_function(&text, 0, 256).unwrap();
        assert!(f.complete);
        assert_eq!(f.insn_count(), 2);
        assert!(f.is_pure_leaf());
    }

    #[test]
    fn conditional_branch_recovers_both_paths() {
        // cbz x0, +8 ; ret ; ret
        let text = words_to_bytes(&[
            0xB400_0040, // 0x00: cbz x0, 0x08
            0xD65F03C0, // 0x04: ret
            0xD65F03C0, // 0x08: ret
        ]);
        let f = lift_function(&text, 0, 256).unwrap();
        assert!(f.complete, "both successors of a conditional branch must be recovered");
        assert_eq!(f.blocks.len(), 3);
        assert_eq!(f.blocks[0].edges.len(), 2);
        assert_eq!(f.unresolved_edges, 0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn backward_branch_does_not_loop_forever() {
        // loop: b loop
        let text = words_to_bytes(&[0x1400_0000]);
        let f = lift_function(&text, 0, 256).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(f.blocks.len(), 1);
        assert!(f.complete);
    }

    #[test]
    fn unsupported_instruction_is_counted() {
        let text = words_to_bytes(&[0x0000_0000, 0xD65F03C0]);
        let f = lift_function(&text, 0, 256).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(f.unsupported, 1);
        assert!(!f.is_pure_leaf());
    }

    #[test]
    fn ignores_unaligned_and_out_of_range() {
        let text = words_to_bytes(&[0xD65F03C0]);
        assert!(lift_function(&text, 2, 8).is_none());
        assert!(lift_function(&text, 0x100, 8).is_none());
    }
}
```
